sentences.en: That performance was actually not so amazing; it was just a display of basic tricks.

sentences.zh: 他在這場辯論中的表現非常了不起，成功說服了眾人接納他的觀點。
sentences.en: His performance in the debate was quite amazing, successfully persuading others to accept his views.

sentences.zh: 雖然第一次嘗試失敗了，但這在修行中沒有什麼了不起，重要的是繼續努力。
sentences.en: Although the first attempt failed, it is not so amazing in practice; what matters is to keep trying.

phrase.en: Perfectly Clear: A Mind Awakened to the Way

sentences.zh: 修行者經過長時間的冥思與自省，終於達到了了了分明覺道於心的境界。
sentences.en: After long periods of meditation and introspection, the practitioner finally reached a state where his mind is perfectly clear and awakened to the way.

sentences.zh: 當生命中的困惑漸漸消散，她感到了一種了了分明覺道於心的寧靜。
sentences.en: As the confusion in her life gradually faded away, she felt a tranquility that was perfectly clear, with her mind awakened to the way.

sentences.zh: 師父教導弟子要在日常生活中保持了了分明覺道於心，這樣才能應對各種挑戰。
sentences.en: The master taught his disciples to maintain a state of mind that is perfectly clear and awakened to the way in daily life to handle various challenges.

sentences.zh: 在觀照自身的過程中，他體悟到了一種了了分明覺道於心的深邃智慧。
sentences.en: In the process of self-reflection, he attained a deep wisdom that was perfectly clear, with his mind awakened to the way.

phrase.zh: 了卻人間多少事 笑開天下古今愁
phrase.en: See through the many mundane affairs, Laugh away sorrows past and present.

sentences.zh: 通過修行，他終於能夠了卻人間多少事，笑開天下古今愁。
sentences.en: Through cultivation, he finally was able to see through the many mundane affairs and laugh away sorrows past and present.

sentences.zh: 佛陀教導我們如何了卻人間多少事，笑開天下古今愁，以達到真正的解脫。
sentences.en: Buddha taught us how to see through the many mundane affairs and laugh away sorrows past and present to achieve true liberation.

sentences.zh: 當你能了卻人間多少事，笑開天下古今愁，生活便會變得自在輕鬆。
sentences.en: When you can see through the many mundane affairs and laugh away sorrows past and present, life becomes more carefree and relaxed.

sentences.zh: 禪修的目的是讓我們能夠了卻人間多少事，笑開天下古今愁，以便心靈得到平和。
sentences.en: The purpose of zen meditation is to allow us to see through the many mundane affairs and laugh away sorrows past and present so that the mind can find peace.

phrase.en: Attain a Perfect Understanding of the Origin of Your Mind

sentences.zh: 通過多年的修行，他終於了悟心源，達到了內心的寧靜與和諧。
sentences.en: Through years of practice, he finally attained a perfect understanding of the origin of his mind, achieving inner peace and harmony.

sentences.zh: 佛教修行的目標之一是通過禪定來了悟心源，並從煩惱中解脫。
sentences.en: One of the goals of Buddhist practice is to attain a perfect understanding of the origin of your mind through meditation and to be liberated from suffering.

sentences.zh: 老師教導我們如何了悟心源，以便在日常生活中保持清澈的心靈。
sentences.en: The teacher instructed us on how to attain a perfect understanding of the origin of our mind in order to maintain a clear mind in daily life.

sentences.zh: 她深信，了悟心源能讓她更好地應對人生的挑戰。
sentences.en: She firmly believes that attaining a perfect understanding of the origin of her mind will better equip her to face life's challenges.

phrase.en: Attain a Perfect Understanding in the Here and Now

sentences.zh: 在禪修中，他逐漸了悟當下，內心的焦慮得以平息。
sentences.en: During meditation, he gradually attained a perfect understanding in the here and now, calming his inner anxiety.

sentences.zh: 修行的目的之一是了悟當下，體驗生命的真實本質。
sentences.en: One of the aims of spiritual practice is to attain a perfect understanding in the here and now, experiencing the true essence of life.

sentences.zh: 她通過靜觀，試圖了悟當下，放下對過去的執著。
sentences.en: Through mindfulness, she tried to attain a perfect understanding in the here and now, letting go of attachments to the past.

sentences.zh: 每天的清晨，他享受寧靜的時光，以便更好地了悟當下。
sentences.en: Every morning, he enjoyed moments of tranquility in order to better attain a perfect understanding in the here and now.

phrase.en: Completely Free of Worries Without obstacles.

sentences.zh: 修行者達到了一種了無罣礙沒有牽絆的狀態，內心無比自在。
sentences.en: The practitioner reached a state of being completely free of worries without obstacles, feeling an immense inner peace.

sentences.zh: 在這個靜謐的禪修環境中，他感受到心靈的了無罣礙沒有牽絆。
sentences.en: In the serene meditation environment, he experienced a mind completely free of worries without obstacles.

sentences.zh: 瑜伽課後，她覺得身體輕盈，精神上了無罣礙沒有牽絆。
sentences.en: After the yoga class, she felt physically light and mentally completely free of worries without obstacles.

sentences.zh: 面對挑戰時，他能保持鎮定，因為他已經學會了了無罣礙沒有牽絆地面對困難。
sentences.en: He remains calm in the face of challenges because he has learned to confront difficulties completely free of worries without obstacles.

phrase.en: ending the cycle of birth and death

sentences.zh: 修習佛法的目標是了生死，達到究竟的解脫。
sentences.en: The goal of practicing Buddhism is ending the cycle of birth and death to achieve ultimate liberation.

sentences.zh: 許多僧人在寺院裡努力修行，希望能夠早日達到了生死的境界。
sentences.en: Many monks diligently practice in the monastery with the hope of soon reaching the state of ending the cycle of birth and death.

sentences.zh: 佛陀教導弟子們要透過智慧和慈悲來了生死。
sentences.en: The Buddha taught his disciples to end the cycle of birth and death through wisdom and compassion.

sentences.zh: 這部經典內容深奧，講述了如何通過修行來了生死。
sentences.en: This classic text is profound in content and discusses how to end the cycle of birth and death through practice.

sentences.zh: 在達到事事無礙的悟境時，人能夠感受到自身與環境的和諧，所有事物間的相互配合無有阻礙。
sentences.en: When one attains the realization of mutual unobstructedness among phenomena, they feel a harmony between themselves and their surroundings, with all things cooperating seamlessly without obstruction.

sentences.zh: 佛法教導我們追求心靈的事事無礙，打破心中的障礙，讓一切順利而行。
sentences.en: Buddhism teaches us to pursue mental mutual unobstructedness by breaking down internal barriers, allowing everything to flow smoothly.

sentences.zh: 禪修的目的是讓我們的心靈達到事事無礙的狀態，這樣我們就能在日常生活中處理複雜的問題而不感到困頓。
sentences.en: The purpose of meditation is to bring our mind to a state of mutual unobstructedness among phenomena, so we can handle complex issues in daily life without feeling stuck.

sentences.zh: 透過鍛鍊心靈的柔韌性，我們能逐步領悟到世界的事事無礙，使內心更加平靜。
sentences.en: By cultivating mental flexibility, we gradually understand the world’s mutual unobstructedness among phenomena, bringing greater peace to our hearts.

phrase.zh: 事有人我相 禪無分別心
phrase.en: Characteristics of self and other are found in phenomena; Discriminative minds are absent in Chan.

sentences.zh: 在修行的過程中，我們應學會超越事有人我相，以達到禪無分別心的境界。
sentences.en: In the process of practice, we should learn to transcend the characteristics of self and other to reach the state where discriminative minds are absent in Chan.

sentences.zh: 當我們被事有人我相所束縛時，就無法感受到禪無分別心的解脫。
sentences.en: When we are bound by the characteristics of self and other, we cannot experience the liberation of a discriminative mind-free state in Chan.

sentences.zh: 禪宗大師教導我們放下事有人我相，進入禪無分別心的平和世界。
sentences.en: Zen masters teach us to let go of the characteristics of self and other, and enter the peaceful world where discriminative minds are absent in Chan.

sentences.zh: 理解事有人我相是修行的第一步，而追求禪無分別心則是解脫的途徑。
sentences.en: Understanding the characteristics of self and other is the first step in practice, while pursuing a state with no discriminative minds is the path to liberation.

phrase.zh: 事能知足心常泰 人到無求品自高
phrase.en: A contented mind is a perpetual feast; A mind bereft of desire naturally makes one noble.

sentences.zh: 他相信事能知足心常泰，因此生活中總能保持快樂與平和。
sentences.en: He believes that a contented mind is a perpetual feast, and thus he remains happy and serene in life.

sentences.zh: 修行者常言人到無求品自高，因為放下貪欲後，便能展現出真正的高尚品德。
sentences.en: Practitioners often say a mind bereft of desire naturally makes one noble, for abandoning greed allows one's true noble character to shine.

sentences.zh: 在波折中保持一顆知足的心，是他獲得內心安寧的重要原因，正如古訓所言，事能知足心常泰。
sentences.en: Keeping a contented mind amidst challenges is the key to his inner peace, as the old saying goes, 'A contented mind is a perpetual feast.'

sentences.zh: 她不再追求虛榮，因為她明白人到無求品自高的道理，生活也因此變得更為簡單快樂。
sentences.en: She no longer chases vanity, understanding that a mind bereft of desire naturally makes one noble, making her life simpler and happier.

phrase.en: when things go against your will

sentences.zh: 他本想周末去爬山，卻因為下大雨事與願違。
sentences.en: He intended to go hiking over the weekend, but the heavy rain caused things to go against his will.

sentences.zh: 讓人惋惜的是，他計畫周全，卻事與願違。
sentences.en: It's unfortunate that despite his thorough planning, things went against his will.

sentences.zh: 他想要早些回家，但在擁擠的交通中事與願違。
sentences.en: He wanted to go home early, but the heavy traffic caused things to go against his will.

sentences.zh: 她原以為今晚能好好休息，然而事與願違，工作上突然有緊急狀況需要處理。
sentences.en: She thought she could rest well tonight, but things went against her will when an emergency arose at work.

sentences.zh: 佛教中，修行者被要求二六時專注於修行，不分晝夜。
sentences.en: In Buddhism, practitioners are asked to focus on their practice twelve hours a day, both day and night.

sentences.zh: 二六時甘露水不斷，象徵著無盡的慈悲與智慧。
sentences.en: The continual flow of amrita for twelve hours symbolizes endless compassion and wisdom.

sentences.zh: 寺院裏的僧人們在二六時中進行誦經，以達到心靈的祥和。
sentences.en: Monks in the monastery chant sutras for twelve hours to attain peace of mind.

sentences.zh: 修行者應該在二六時保持正念，戒除所有不善的念頭。
sentences.en: Practitioners should maintain mindfulness for twelve hours, eliminating all unwholesome thoughts.

phrase.zh: 二十一世紀的未來世界

sentences.zh: 二十一世紀的未來世界充滿挑戰，需共同面對氣候變化和科技發展的影響。
sentences.en: The prospects of the 21st century are filled with challenges, requiring a collective response to climate change and technological advancements.

sentences.zh: 教育體系必須適應二十一世紀的未來世界，以迎合快速變化的社會需求。
sentences.en: Educational systems must adapt to the prospects of the 21st century to cater to the rapidly changing societal needs.

sentences.zh: 在二十一世紀的未來世界中，人工智慧將在各個領域扮演重要角色。
sentences.en: In the prospects of the 21st century, artificial intelligence will play a crucial role in various fields.

sentences.zh: 二十一世紀的未來世界可能會見證人類歷史上前所未有的合作和創新。
sentences.en: The prospects of the 21st century may witness unprecedented collaboration and innovation in human history.

sentences.zh: 二十四史是中國古代記載歷代王朝的正史，內容涵蓋了從先秦到明朝的歷史事件。
sentences.en: The Twenty-four Dynastic Histories are the official historical records of China's ancient dynasties, covering historical events from the pre-Qin to the Ming dynasty.

sentences.zh: 研究二十四史能夠幫助我們更好地理解中國歷史文化的發展與變遷。
sentences.en: Studying the Twenty-four Dynastic Histories can help us better understand the development and transformation of Chinese historical culture.

sentences.zh: 學者們常常參考二十四史來考證歷史上的人物與事件，以求真實還原歷史。
sentences.en: Scholars often refer to the Twenty-four Dynastic Histories to verify historical figures and events, striving for an accurate reconstruction of history.

sentences.zh: 二十四史的編纂體現了古人對歷史記錄的重視及嚴謹的治史精神。
sentences.en: The compilation of the Twenty-four Dynastic Histories reflects the ancients' emphasis on historical records and their meticulous spirit in historiography.

sentences.zh: 犯錯的人樂在懺悔，因為懺悔能使他們從錯誤中得到啟示並提升。
sentences.en: Wrongdoers can find joy in repentance, for it allows them to gain insight and grow from their mistakes.

sentences.zh: 安份的人樂在其中，因為他們懂得珍惜當下的每一刻。
sentences.en: Find joy in enjoying one's actions, as content people cherish each moment they live.

sentences.zh: 中獎的人樂不可支，因為他們實現了夢想的願望。
sentences.en: Prizewinners find joy in rewards, as it signifies the fulfillment of their dreams.

sentences.zh: 喜捨的人樂善好施，因為他們相信行善能帶來心靈的平和。
sentences.en: Generous people find joy in giving, believing that kindness leads to inner peace.

sentences.zh: 他在法會上被任命為二單書記，負責協助推動佛教活動的管理工作。
sentences.en: He was appointed as the Second Deputy Secretary during the Dharma assembly, responsible for assisting in managing Buddhist activities.

sentences.zh: 作為二單書記，她的主要任務是協調各部門之間的溝通與合作。
sentences.en: As the Second Deputy Secretary, her main task is to coordinate communication and cooperation between different departments.

sentences.zh: 二單書記必須具備優秀的組織能力和全面的佛學知識。
sentences.en: The Second Deputy Secretary must possess excellent organizational skills and comprehensive knowledge of Buddhism.

sentences.zh: 他們新頒布的政策受到了二單書記的支持，並認為這會促進教團的和諧發展。
sentences.en: The new policy received support from the Second Deputy Secretary, who believed it would promote harmonious development within the Buddhist community.

sentences.zh: 師父委任他為二單監寺，負責協助管理寺院的日常運作。
sentences.en: The master appointed him as the Second Deputy Superintendent, responsible for assisting in the management of the daily operations of the temple.

sentences.zh: 作為二單監寺，他需要確保所有僧眾都按照禪修時間表行動。
sentences.en: As the Second Deputy Superintendent, he needs to ensure that all monks adhere to the meditation schedule.

sentences.zh: 二單監寺常常在重要法會中發揮關鍵作用，協助主法師。
sentences.en: The Second Deputy Superintendent often plays a key role in important Dharma meetings, assisting the chief abbot.

sentences.zh: 新任命的二單監寺對於他的職責感到既興奮又責重如山。
sentences.en: The newly appointed Second Deputy Superintendent feels both excited and heavily responsible for his duties.

sentences.zh: 修行的過程中，會有一個階段需要在二壇上進行更深入的靜坐修持。
sentences.en: During the practice, there is a phase where one must engage in deeper meditation on the second platform.

sentences.zh: 二壇通常是用於特定法會儀式，其中包括重要的佛法教導。
sentences.en: The second platform is usually used for specific Dharma assemblies, including significant teachings.

sentences.zh: 在寺廟的結構中，二壇往往設置於更高處，以象徵佛法的提升。
sentences.en: In the structure of a temple, the second platform is often set at a higher place to symbolize the elevation of the Dharma.

sentences.zh: 僧侶們在二壇上共同誦經，以增強修行的力量和集體的和諧。
sentences.en: Monks chant sutras together on the second platform to enhance the power of practice and collective harmony.

sentences.zh: 法師了解到寺院新建了一座二眾塔，專門用來供奉僧俗二眾的舍利。
sentences.en: The monk learned that the temple had built a new Two Assemblies Pagoda dedicated for enshrining the relics of both monastic and lay practitioners.

sentences.zh: 這座二眾塔的設計融合了傳統佛教建築和現代藝術風格。
sentences.en: The design of the Two Assemblies Pagoda combines traditional Buddhist architecture with modern artistic style.

sentences.zh: 在佛教節日期間，信徒們聚集在二眾塔前，進行祈禱和供養儀式。
sentences.en: During Buddhist festivals, devotees gather in front of the Two Assemblies Pagoda to perform prayers and offerings.

sentences.zh: 這座二眾塔不僅是信仰的象徵，還是當地文化的重要一部分。
sentences.en: The Two Assemblies Pagoda is not only a symbol of faith but also an integral part of the local culture.

sentences.zh: 修行者在達到二禪時，能夠體會到更深層的內心平靜與安寧。
sentences.en: Practitioners achieving the second dhyana experience a deeper level of inner peace and tranquility.

sentences.zh: 在佛教的禪定階段中，二禪被認為是超越初禪的重要階段，帶來更高的喜悅與專注。
sentences.en: In the stages of Buddhist meditation, the second dhyana is considered an important advancement beyond the first, bringing heightened joy and concentration.

sentences.zh: 二禪的境界中，修行者已經放下了對初禪中粗重喜悅的執取。
sentences.en: In the state of the second dhyana, practitioners have let go of the coarse joy grasped in the first dhyana.

sentences.zh: 二禪的體驗常被描述為寂靜且喜樂，心靈不再受外界雜念的困擾。
sentences.en: The experience of the second dhyana is often described as quiet and blissful, with the mind no longer disturbed by external distractions.

phrase.en: they are different, yet the same

sentences.zh: 雖然所有的宗教信仰似乎各不相同，但其核心教義往往是二而一的，追求愛與和平。
sentences.en: While all religious beliefs seem different, their core teachings are often the same, pursuing love and peace.

sentences.zh: 這兩位藝術家的風格看似截然不同，但其作品的表現力卻是二而一的，皆能引發深刻的情感共鳴。
sentences.en: The styles of these two artists seem vastly different, yet the expressiveness in their works is the same, capable of evoking profound emotional resonance.

sentences.zh: 在這片森林中，樹木和動物看似是二而一的共同體，相互依存、和諧共生。
sentences.en: In this forest, the trees and animals appear to be different, yet they form the same community, interdependent and living in harmony.

sentences.zh: 多樣的文化背景使得城市豐富多彩，但市民們的價值觀和共同願景卻是二而一的。
sentences.en: The diverse cultural backgrounds make the city vibrant, yet the values and common vision of its residents are the same.

sentences.zh: 在修行中，我們常常思考云何應住，以指引我們的日常行為。
sentences.en: In our practice, we often contemplate in what should one abide to guide our daily actions.

sentences.zh: 佛陀教導弟子們在慈悲和智慧中云何應住。
sentences.en: The Buddha taught his disciples in what should one abide within compassion and wisdom.

sentences.zh: 云何應住於心，才能超越生死煩惱，達到涅槃境界?
sentences.en: In what should one abide in mind to transcend the cycles of birth and death and reach Nirvana?

sentences.zh: 禪師告誡門徒，生活中總會有誘惑，但他們應時刻記得云何應住。
sentences.en: The Zen master warned his disciples that temptations are ever-present, but they should always remember in what should one abide.

sentences.zh: 透過人乘的修行，我們可以在日常生活中培養慈悲與智慧。
sentences.en: Through the practice of the Human Vehicle, we can cultivate compassion and wisdom in our daily lives.

sentences.zh: 天乘教導信徒追求更高的精神境界，達到天界的福報。
sentences.en: The Heavenly Vehicle teaches followers to seek higher spiritual realms, achieving the blessings of the heavenly worlds.

sentences.zh: 聲聞乘的修行者專注於聆聽佛法，以期早日證得涅槃。
sentences.en: Practitioners of the Sravaka Vehicle focus on listening to the Dharma with the aim of attaining Nirvana.

sentences.zh: 緣覺乘的行者通過觀察因緣法則來達到自悟境界。
sentences.en: Followers of the Pratyekabuddha Vehicle achieve self-realization through observing the laws of causality.

sentences.zh: 菩薩乘強調無私奉獻，發願度眾生以成就佛道。
sentences.en: The Bodhisattva Vehicle emphasizes selfless dedication, with vows to liberate all beings and achieve Buddhahood.

sentences.zh: 不淨觀是五停心觀之一，透過觀察身心的不淨可以減少對欲望的執迷。
sentences.en: The contemplation of impurity is one of the Five Contemplations; by observing the impurity of body and mind, one can reduce the attachment to desires.

sentences.zh: 慈悲觀在五停心觀中，教導人們以無條件的慈愛與同情心待人。
sentences.en: The contemplation of loving-kindness and compassion, within the Five Contemplations, teaches individuals to treat others with unconditional love and empathy.

sentences.zh: 因緣觀使人理解世間萬物的緣起緣滅，並在五停心觀中能帶來深層的洞見。
sentences.en: The contemplation of causes and conditions allows one to understand the arising and cessation of all things, bringing profound insight within the Five Contemplations.

sentences.zh: 數息觀通過專注於呼吸，幫助修行者在五停心觀中培養專注與平靜的心靈。
sentences.en: The contemplation of counting the breath helps practitioners cultivate concentration and tranquility by focusing on breathing within the Five Contemplations.

sentences.zh: 五台山真容院在秋天的清晨顯得格外靜謐，讓訪客感受到內心的平和。
sentences.en: Zhenrong Temple on Mount Wutai feels especially serene on an autumn morning, offering visitors a sense of inner peace.

sentences.zh: 每年都有來自世界各地的信徒前往五台山真容院朝聖，以求得到精神上的啟迪。
sentences.en: Each year, believers from around the world make pilgrimages to Zhenrong Temple on Mount Wutai, seeking spiritual enlightenment.

sentences.zh: 五台山真容院的建築結合了中國古代的建築藝術，吸引了眾多的建築學者前來研究。
sentences.en: The architecture of Zhenrong Temple on Mount Wutai combines ancient Chinese architectural artistry, attracting numerous architectural scholars for study.

sentences.zh: 在五台山真容院的遊覽中，遊客可以看到精美的佛教雕塑和壁畫作品。
sentences.en: During their tour of Zhenrong Temple on Mount Wutai, visitors can admire exquisite Buddhist sculptures and murals.

sentences.zh: 自心和樂是五和的第一項，它強調個人內心的平和與快樂。
sentences.en: Individual harmony achieved through joy is the first aspect of the Five Harmonies, emphasizing inner peace and personal happiness.

sentences.zh: 人我和敬乃五和之二，通過互相尊重來達成人際關係的和諧。
sentences.en: Interpersonal harmony achieved through respect is the second aspect of the Five Harmonies, attained by mutual respect in relationships.

sentences.zh: 家庭和順是第三個五和的要素，透過家人間的順暢互動來維持和諧。
sentences.en: Family harmony achieved through deference is the third element of the Five Harmonies, maintained by smooth interactions within the family.

sentences.zh: 社會和諧，作為五和中第四項，是要靠社會成員的合作和互助達成的。
sentences.en: Social harmony achieved through cooperation is the fourth aspect of the Five Harmonies, requiring collaboration and mutual assistance among society members.

sentences.zh: 世界和平是五和的終極目標，只有全球的和平才可能讓每個人享有安穩的生活。
sentences.en: World harmony achieved through peace is the ultimate goal of the Five Harmonies, where only worldwide peace can ensure a stable life for everyone.

sentences.zh: 五和塔是這座城市的著名地標之一，以其壯觀的設計和宗教意義而聞名。
sentences.en: The Five Harmonies Pagoda is one of the city's renowned landmarks, famous for its spectacular design and religious significance.

sentences.zh: 每年，成千上萬的遊客來到五和塔，參觀它獨特的建築風格並體驗其寧靜的氛圍。
sentences.en: Each year, thousands of tourists visit the Five Harmonies Pagoda to admire its unique architectural style and experience its tranquil atmosphere.

sentences.zh: 在佛教紀念日，五和塔通常舉行特別的祈福活動，為信徒們提供祈禱的場所。
sentences.en: On Buddhist anniversaries, the Five Harmonies Pagoda usually hosts special blessing ceremonies, providing a place for devotees to pray.

sentences.zh: 五和塔的高度和美麗在夜晚燈光的照耀下顯得更加壯麗，吸引了許多當地居民和遊客。
sentences.en: The height and beauty of the Five Harmonies Pagoda become even more magnificent under the night lights, attracting many locals and visitors.

phrase.zh: 五家七派; 1. 臨濟宗 2. 溈仰宗 3. 曹洞宗 4. 雲門宗 5. 法眼宗 6. 楊岐派 7. 黃龍派
phrase.en: Chan Schools: 1. The Linji School; 2. The Guiyang School; 3. The Caodong School; 4. The Yunmen School; 5. The Fayan School; 6. The Yangqi School; 7. The Huanglong School

sentences.zh: 臨濟宗以其獨特的禪修方式和直指人心的方法而聞名於世。
sentences.en: The Linji School is renowned for its unique meditation practices and direct teaching methods.

sentences.zh: 溈仰宗是由溈山靈祐和仰山慧寂共同創立的，強調心靈的清淨。
sentences.en: The Guiyang School was co-founded by Weishan Lingyou and Yangshan Huiji and emphasizes the purity of the mind.

sentences.zh: 曹洞宗重視坐禪，並提倡不立文字，直指人心的禪修原則。
sentences.en: The Caodong School focuses on seated meditation and advocates the principle of silent illumination beyond words.

sentences.zh: 雲門宗強調悟性和自然的智慧解脫，並流傳著許多禪師的偈語。
sentences.en: The Yunmen School emphasizes intuitive understanding and natural wisdom, with many koans passed down from its masters.

sentences.zh: 法眼宗在五代和宋朝時期廣為流傳，以其直觀的悟道方式吸引了眾多信眾。
sentences.en: The Fayan School was widely influential during the Five Dynasties and Song dynasty, attracting many followers with its direct insight approach.

sentences.zh: 楊岐派是臨濟宗的一個支派，以其創新和變通的方法而受到尊敬。
sentences.en: The Yangqi School, a branch of the Linji School, is respected for its innovative and flexible approach.

sentences.zh: 黃龍派，以其獨到的禪學理論和精辟的見解而著稱，對後世禪宗影響深遠。
sentences.en: The Huanglong School is known for its distinctive Chan theories and profound insights, profoundly influencing later Chan traditions.

phrase.zh: 五戒: 1.不殺 2.不盜 3.不邪淫 4.不妄語 5.不飲酒
phrase.en: Five Precepts: 1. refrain from killing; 2. refrain from stealing; 3. refrain from sexual misconduct; 4. refrain from lying; 5. refrain from consuming intoxicants

sentences.zh: 他遵循佛教的五戒，特別重視不殺生，以慈悲心愛護所有生命。
sentences.en: He adheres to the Five Precepts of Buddhism, especially emphasizing refraining from killing, showing compassion for all living beings.

sentences.zh: 在社區活動中，她努力地不盜取他人財物，保持誠實和正直。
sentences.en: During community activities, she strives to refrain from stealing others' belongings, maintaining honesty and integrity.

sentences.zh: 遵守不邪淫的戒律有助於人們建立健康和尊重的兩性關係。
sentences.en: Observing the precept of refraining from sexual misconduct helps people build healthy and respectful relationships between the sexes.

sentences.zh: 他選擇在日常生活中不妄語，因為追求真實的溝通是他信仰的重要部分。
sentences.en: He chooses to refrain from lying in everyday life, as the pursuit of truthful communication is an important part of his faith.

sentences.zh: 不飲酒是不少修行者對自己的一項要求，這有助於保持清醒專注的心境。
sentences.en: Refraining from consuming intoxicants is a commitment for many practitioners, helping them maintain a clear and focused mind.

sentences.zh: 參加五戒菩薩戒儀式，可以幫助信徒加強他們的道德修煉。
sentences.en: Attending the Five Precepts & Bodhisattva Precepts Ceremony can help practitioners strengthen their moral cultivation.

sentences.zh: 在五戒菩薩戒儀式上，信徒們發願遵守佛教的生活準則。
sentences.en: During the Five Precepts & Bodhisattva Precepts Ceremony, practitioners vow to adhere to the Buddhist principles of living.

sentences.zh: 接受五戒菩薩戒是信仰生活中一個重要的里程碑。
sentences.en: Taking the Five Precepts & Bodhisattva Precepts is a significant milestone in one's spiritual journey.

sentences.zh: 他在五戒菩薩戒儀式上找到了深深的平靜與承諾。
sentences.en: He found deep peace and commitment at the Five Precepts & Bodhisattva Precepts Ceremony.

sentences.zh: 寺廟每年舉行五戒菩薩戒戒會，吸引了許多信眾參加。
sentences.en: The temple holds a Five Precepts & Bodhisattva Precepts Ceremony annually, attracting many devotees.

sentences.zh: 參與五戒菩薩戒戒會讓我更深入理解佛教教義的核心。
sentences.en: Participating in the Five Precepts & Bodhisattva Precepts Ceremony allowed me to deepen my understanding of the core teachings of Buddhism.

sentences.zh: 法師對五戒菩薩戒戒會的開示啟發了許多人走向修行之路。
sentences.en: The monk's sermon during the Five Precepts & Bodhisattva Precepts Ceremony inspired many to embark on the path of spiritual practice.

sentences.zh: 他在五戒菩薩戒戒會上受戒，決定以後過清靜的生活。
sentences.en: He took the precepts at the Five Precepts & Bodhisattva Precepts Ceremony, deciding to lead a more virtuous life henceforth.

sentences.zh: 修行者學習超越五欲，追求更高層次的內在平和。
sentences.en: Practitioners learn to transcend the Five Desires in pursuit of a higher level of inner peace.

sentences.zh: 五欲中的財代表了人們對物質金錢的渴望。
sentences.en: Wealth, one of the Five Desires, represents people’s craving for material wealth and money.

sentences.zh: 在佛教中，克服五欲是修行的一部分，以達到解脫。
sentences.en: In Buddhism, overcoming the Five Desires is part of the practice to achieve liberation.

sentences.zh: 五欲的色語指人對情愛欲望的追求。
sentences.en: Sex, as part of the Five Desires, refers to the pursuit of romantic or sexual desires.

sentences.zh: 佛教中提到的五濁惡世包括劫濁、見濁、煩惱濁、眾生濁以及命濁。
sentences.en: In Buddhism, the Saha World consists of kalpa degeneration, view degeneration, affliction degeneration, sentient being degeneration, and life-span degeneration.

sentences.zh: 在人類歷史的五濁惡世，個人的智慧往往被無數見濁所迷惑。
sentences.en: In the human history of the Saha World, individual wisdom is often confused by countless view degenerations.

sentences.zh: 修行者努力超越眾生濁，以達到心靈的清淨與自在。
sentences.en: Practitioners strive to transcend the sentient being degeneration to achieve purity and freedom of the mind.

sentences.zh: 對於許多人而言，在這個充斥著煩惱濁的五濁惡世中找到內心的平靜是一項艱鉅的挑戰。
sentences.en: For many, finding inner peace in this affliction-filled Saha World presents a formidable challenge.

sentences.zh: 在佛教中，五無間罪的第一苦，受苦無間，意指靈魂在地獄中承受著永無止盡的煎熬。
sentences.en: In Buddhism, the first suffering of the Avici Hell, uninterrupted suffering, means the soul endures unending torment in hell.

sentences.zh: 身形無間的概念強調身體在地獄中持續的存在，不會因為死去而中斷。
sentences.en: The concept of uninterrupted physical form emphasizes the continuous existence of the body in hell, without cessation through death.

sentences.zh: 時間無間讓受苦者覺得時間靜止，無法逃脫此痛苦的折磨。
sentences.en: Uninterrupted time causes sufferers to feel that time is frozen, unable to escape the torment of this agony.

sentences.zh: 在地獄中，罪器無間意味著各種刑具不斷, 極大地加劇了靈魂的痛苦。
sentences.en: In hell, uninterrupted implements of torture mean that various instruments of punishment persistently add to the soul's suffering.

sentences.zh: 眾類無間不分種族階層，所有犯下五無間罪的人都面臨相同的懲罰。
sentences.en: Uninterrupted categories of beings indicates that all who commit the five avici sins, regardless of race or class, face the same punishment.

sentences.zh: 五百羅漢是靈山勝境中的一個著名景點，吸引了無數遊客前來參觀。
sentences.en: The Five Hundred Arhat Garden is a famous attraction in the Lingshan Scenic Area, drawing countless visitors.

sentences.zh: 遊客們在五百羅漢中可以欣賞到不同姿態的雕塑，每一尊都展現出獨特的藝術魅力。
sentences.en: Visitors can admire the sculptures in various poses in the Five Hundred Arhat Garden, each displaying unique artistic charm.

sentences.zh: 在五百羅漢中漫步，你會感受到一種沉靜和靜謐的氛圍，尤如置身於安寧的心靈殿堂。
sentences.en: Strolling through the Five Hundred Arhat Garden, you will feel a tranquil and serene atmosphere, akin to being in a sanctuary of peace.

sentences.zh: 導遊介紹說，五百羅漢象徵著佛教中的超凡智慧與無上功德，是對信仰的頌揚。
sentences.en: The tour guide explained that the Five Hundred Arhat symbolizes extraordinary wisdom and supreme merit in Buddhism, celebrating faith.

phrase.zh: 五聖同心開淨土 七眾協力護道場
phrase.en: With one mind, the Five Sages build Pure Lands; Through concerted effort, the Seven Assemblies support the cultivation court.

sentences.zh: 在五聖同心開淨土的努力下，學者們齊聚一堂，交流修行心得。
sentences.en: With one mind, the Five Sages build Pure Lands, scholars gathered to exchange cultivation insights.

sentences.zh: 因為七眾協力護道場，道場內的修行環境和諧而清淨。
sentences.en: Through concerted effort, the Seven Assemblies support the cultivation court, creating a harmonious and pure environment for practice.

sentences.zh: 五聖同心開淨土，將不可能化為可能，在廟宇中實現新的奇蹟。
sentences.en: With one mind, the Five Sages build Pure Lands, turning the impossible into reality, manifesting new miracles in the temple.

sentences.zh: 七眾協力護道場，即便面對困難也能夠堅持下去，確保修行順利進行。
sentences.en: Through concerted effort, the Seven Assemblies support the cultivation court, ensuring practice continues smoothly even in the face of difficulties.

phrase.en: Five Aggregates: 1. form; 2. feeling; 3. perception; 4. mental formations; 5. consciousness

sentences.zh: 佛教教義認為，生命的所有現象都可以歸納為五蘊：色、受、想、行、識。
sentences.en: Buddhist teachings state that all phenomena of life can be categorized into the Five Aggregates: form, feeling, perception, mental formations, and consciousness.

sentences.zh: 了解五蘊有助於我們洞察自我的構成及其暫時性。
sentences.en: Understanding the Five Aggregates helps us gain insight into the composition of the self and its impermanence.

sentences.zh: 修行者通過禪修來觀察五蘊的生滅，進而達成解脫。
sentences.en: Practitioners observe the arising and ceasing of the Five Aggregates through meditation, leading to liberation.

sentences.zh: 識是五蘊之一，是人類感知世界及自身存在的基礎。
sentences.en: Consciousness, being one of the Five Aggregates, forms the foundation of how humans perceive the world and their own existence.

phrase.zh: 五蘊皆空觀自在 六塵不染見如來
phrase.en: See that the Five Skandhas are empty: be at perfect ease; Remain untainted by the Six Objects: perceive the Tathagata.

sentences.zh: 修行者若能五蘊皆空觀自在，便能超越生死的困惑，達到真正的安寧。
sentences.en: If a practitioner can see that the Five Skandhas are empty and be at perfect ease, they can transcend the confusion of life and death, reaching true peace.

sentences.zh: 境界純淨時，六塵不染見如來，心中自然生起一種無比的清涼與自在。
sentences.en: When one's state is pure, by remaining untainted by the Six Objects, one can perceive the Tathagata, and a sense of incomparable coolness and ease naturally arises in the heart.

sentences.zh: 了解五蘊皆空觀自在，是所有佛教徒修行的重要基礎，因為它能幫助我們放下執著。
sentences.en: Understanding that the Five Skandhas are empty and being at perfect ease is an important foundation for all Buddhist practitioners, as it helps us let go of attachments.

sentences.zh: 當我們在日常生活中能夠做到六塵不染見如來，就會發現生活中的每個時刻都充滿著無限的智慧與慈悲。
sentences.en: When we can remain untainted by the Six Objects and perceive the Tathagata in our daily lives, we find that every moment is filled with infinite wisdom and compassion.

phrase.zh: 五衰相現; 1. 衣服垢穢 2. 頭上華萎 3. 腋下出汗 4. 身體臭穢 5. 不樂本座; 小五衰相; 1.樂聲不起 2.身光忽滅 3.浴水著身 4.著境不捨 5. 眼目數瞬
phrase.en: Five Signs of Decay: 1. Clothes become filthy; 2. Garland atop the head fades; 3. The armpits become sweaty; 4. The body becomes foul-smelling; 5. The heavenly palace appears unpleasant; Five Minor Signs of Decay: 1. The music stops; 2. The body’s radiance fades; 3. Bathwater clings to the body; 4. Attachment to their surroundings; 5. The eyes start blinking

sentences.zh: 天人因不再感到天堂的快樂，並出現五衰相現，逐漸走向終結。
sentences.en: The celestial beings no longer felt the joy of heaven, as the five signs of decay appeared, heralding their gradual decline.

sentences.zh: 小五衰相的出現是天人壽命將結束的徵兆，使他們開始對現時的狀況產生不安。
sentences.en: The appearance of the five minor signs of decay signals the impending end of a celestial being's lifespan, causing them anxiety about their current state.

sentences.zh: 當衣服變得垢穢，身體開始散發臭味，這些跡象表明生命即將發生轉變。
sentences.en: When clothes become filthy and the body starts to smell foul, these are signs that a significant transformation of life is on the horizon.

sentences.zh: 音樂聲不再響起，身光也忽然消失，這是小五衰相中的其中兩項特徵。
sentences.en: The cessation of music and the sudden fading of bodily radiance are two features among the five minor signs of decay.

sentences.zh: 五觀堂是佛教徒修行的地方，他們在那裡進行深度的冥想和禪修。
sentences.en: The Five Contemplations Hall is a place for Buddhists to practice, where they engage in deep meditation and Zen training.

sentences.zh: 每當需要尋找內心的寧靜時，法師都會前往五觀堂以清淨思緒。
sentences.en: Whenever seeking inner peace, the Dharma master would go to the Five Contemplations Hall to clear his mind.

sentences.zh: 五觀堂的設計旨在激發沉思，並讓訪客感受到寧靜和清晰。
sentences.en: The design of the Five Contemplations Hall is meant to inspire contemplation and allow visitors to experience tranquility and clarity.

sentences.zh: 在五觀堂裡，僧人們以專注的心態進行五觀，以達到精神的提升。
sentences.en: In the Five Contemplations Hall, monks practice the five contemplations with a focused mind to achieve spiritual elevation.

phrase.zh: 五觀若明金易化 三心未了水難消
phrase.en: If the Five Contemplations are fully practiced, even gold is easily consumed; Shall the Three Minds remain unaware, even water becomes indigestible.

sentences.zh: 若能通過五觀修行，遇到困難亦如化金般容易克服。
sentences.en: If one can fully practice the Five Contemplations, facing difficulties would be as easy as consuming gold.

sentences.zh: 三心未了，縱然最簡單的事情也會感到困難重重，如同水難消化。
sentences.en: If the Three Minds remain unaware, even the simplest tasks become overwhelmingly challenging, like water becoming indigestible.

sentences.zh: 祖師告誡我們，五觀若明，處於逆境亦游刃有餘。
sentences.en: The master advised us that if the Five Contemplations are fully grasped, one can navigate adversities with ease.

sentences.zh: 修行若不透徹，三心未了，縱是日常小事也常感沉重。
sentences.en: If practice is not thorough and the Three Minds remain unaware, even daily trivialities can feel burdensome.

sentences.zh: 五逆之一是殺父，這是被認為極為重大的罪行。
sentences.en: One of the Five Great Violations is killing one's father, which is considered an extremely grave sin.

sentences.zh: 殺母被列為五逆之一，代表對生命和親情的極大破壞。
sentences.en: Killing one's mother is listed as one of the Five Great Violations, symbolizing a great destruction of life and familial bonds.

sentences.zh: 破和合僧，造成僧團分裂，也是五逆中的一項，對佛教僧團有深遠的影響。
sentences.en: Creating a schism in the monastic community, leading to division, is also one of the Five Great Violations, having a profound impact on the Buddhist monastic order.

sentences.zh: 出佛身血這一逆行，指的是對佛陀本人造成傷害，並被視為五逆的一部分。
sentences.en: Shedding the blood of a Buddha refers to causing harm to the Buddha himself and is considered part of the Five Great Violations.

phrase.en: throwing all five limbs to the ground

sentences.zh: 在佛教的禮拜儀式中，信徒往往會五體投地，表達他們的敬仰之情。
sentences.en: In Buddhist rituals, devotees often throw all five limbs to the ground to express their reverence.

sentences.zh: 他對於她的才華感到五體投地，完全欣賞她的創意和智慧。
sentences.en: He was utterly impressed, throwing all five limbs to the ground in admiration of her talent and creativity.

sentences.zh: 當以色列人民在聖殿前五體投地時，他們顯示出完全的臣服和虔敬。
sentences.en: When the people of Israel threw all five limbs to the ground before the temple, they showed complete submission and devotion.

sentences.zh: 她用五體投地的方式來表示她對師父指導的感恩之情。
sentences.en: She expressed her gratitude for her master's guidance by throwing all five limbs to the ground.

phrase.en: To Enjoy and Appreciate Is Sufficient Enough

sentences.zh: 在簡單的生活中，享有就好，並不需要追求過多的奢華。
sentences.en: In a simple life, to enjoy and appreciate is sufficient enough without pursuing excessive luxuries.

sentences.zh: 對於自然的美麗，享有就好，讓心靈得到純粹的滿足。
sentences.en: When it comes to the beauty of nature, to enjoy and appreciate is sufficient enough, allowing the soul to attain pure satisfaction.

sentences.zh: 在學習中，享有就好，因為知識本身就是一種豐富的回報。
sentences.en: In learning, to enjoy and appreciate is sufficient enough, as knowledge itself is a rich reward.

sentences.zh: 在友情中，享有就好，珍惜每一段無價的相聚時光。
sentences.en: In friendship, to enjoy and appreciate is sufficient enough, cherishing every priceless moment together.

sentences.zh: 佛陀被尊稱為人中尊，因為他的智慧和慈悲在人類中無與倫比。
sentences.en: The Buddha is revered as the Honored One among humans due to his unparalleled wisdom and compassion.

sentences.zh: 作為人中尊，釋迦牟尼佛的教法惠及眾生，讓他們從無明中覺醒。
sentences.en: As the Honored One among humans, Shakyamuni Buddha's teachings benefit sentient beings, awakening them from ignorance.

sentences.zh: 在佛教聖典中，佛陀被描述為人中尊，他的思想影響了無數的追隨者。
sentences.en: In Buddhist scriptures, the Buddha is described as the Honored One among humans, and his teachings have influenced countless followers.

sentences.zh: 在人中尊的指引下，許多修行者找到了解脫苦難的道路。
sentences.en: Under the guidance of the Honored One among humans, many practitioners have found the path to liberation from suffering.

sentences.zh: 作為人事主任，他負責招聘新員工和管理現有員工的福利。
sentences.en: As the Director of Human Resources, he is responsible for recruiting new employees and managing the benefits of current staff.

sentences.zh: 人事主任在公司重組期間發揮了關鍵作用，確保所有員工的過渡順利。
sentences.en: The Director of Human Resources played a crucial role during the company's restructuring, ensuring a smooth transition for all employees.

sentences.zh: 公司的人事主任制定了新的政策以提高工作場所的多樣性和包容性。
sentences.en: The company's Director of Human Resources implemented new policies to enhance diversity and inclusion in the workplace.

sentences.zh: 她成功晉升為人事主任，負責領導整個人力資源部門的戰略規劃。
sentences.en: She was successfully promoted to Director of Human Resources, tasked with leading the strategic planning for the entire HR department.

phrase.zh: 人出巧言 以誠相接 人出漏言 以婉相答 人出戲言 以默相待 人出廢言 以簡相告
phrase.en: In hearing sweet words, Respond with honesty. In hearing flawed words, Respond with politeness. In hearing dishonest words, Respond with silence. In hearing idle words, Respond with brevity.

sentences.zh: 若有人出巧言，當以誠相接，以真誠的心化解任何的虛偽。
sentences.en: In hearing sweet words, respond with honesty to dissolve any deceit with sincerity.

sentences.zh: 當遇到人出漏言時，應以婉相答，保持禮貌以維持和諧的氣氛。
sentences.en: In hearing flawed words, respond with politeness to maintain a harmonious atmosphere.

sentences.zh: 若有人出戲言，不應輕易動怒，以默相待，讓沉默成為最好的回應。
sentences.en: In hearing dishonest words, do not easily get angry; respond with silence, letting it be the best reply.

sentences.zh: 面對人出廢言，應以簡相告，以簡潔的語言回應，避免浪費時間。
sentences.en: In hearing idle words, respond with brevity to avoid wasting time with concise language.

phrase.en: Human Realm: 1. superior bravery; 2. superior recollection; 3. superior pure practices

sentences.zh: 在佛教中，人勝諸天的觀念強調人類通過勇猛勝，可以克服自身的恐懼和挑戰。
sentences.en: In Buddhism, the concept of the human realm surpassing the heavenly realms emphasizes that humans can overcome their fears and challenges through superior bravery.

sentences.zh: 憶念勝是人類能夠記住和保持對佛法的領悟，這使人類的潛力超越了天界的安逸。
sentences.en: Superior recollection is the ability of humans to remember and retain understanding of the Dharma, which allows human potential to surpass the comfort of heavenly realms.

sentences.zh: 通過梵行勝的修行，人類能夠在道德和精神上超越天界的眾生。
sentences.en: Through the practice of superior pure practices, humans can surpass the beings of heavenly realms in moral and spiritual aspects.

sentences.zh: 人們相信在人勝諸天的旅途中，堅持不懈地修行勇猛勝、憶念勝和梵行勝可以達到開悟。
sentences.en: It is believed that on the journey of the human realm surpassing heavenly realms, persistent practice of superior bravery, superior recollection, and superior pure practices can lead to enlightenment.

phrase.zh: 人勤春來早 家和喜事多
phrase.en: Happiness ensues diligent hearts; Joy comes to harmonious families.

sentences.zh: 他們的家庭因為人勤春來早 家和喜事多的理念，總是充滿了繁榮與歡樂。
sentences.en: Their family, guided by the principle 'Happiness ensues diligent hearts; Joy comes to harmonious families,' is always filled with prosperity and joy.

sentences.zh: 在這個村莊裡，人勤春來早 家和喜事多的精神被人人奉行著，村莊因此格外和睦。
sentences.en: In this village, the spirit of 'Happiness ensues diligent hearts; Joy comes to harmonious families' is embraced by all, leading to extraordinary harmony.

sentences.zh: 隨著人勤春來早 家和喜事多的工作態度，公司業務蒸蒸日上，成就更多。
sentences.en: With the work ethic of 'Happiness ensues diligent hearts; Joy comes to harmonious families,' the company's business has been thriving and achieving more.

sentences.zh: 孩子們從小就被教導人勤春來早 家和喜事多的重要性，這讓他們在生活中滿足而快樂。
sentences.en: Children are taught the importance of 'Happiness ensues diligent hearts; Joy comes to harmonious families' from a young age, which makes them content and happy in life.

phrase.en: we can only count on a single breath

sentences.zh: 佛教教義提醒我們，人命在呼吸間，應珍惜當下每一刻。
sentences.en: Buddhist teachings remind us that we can only count on a single breath, emphasizing the importance of cherishing every moment.

sentences.zh: 法師指出，人命在呼吸間，修行人應該時時刻刻專注於內心的平和。
sentences.en: The monk pointed out that we can only count on a single breath, urging practitioners to maintain constant focus on inner peace.

sentences.zh: 這次事故再次讓我深刻感受到，人命在呼吸間，生命的脆弱不可預測。
sentences.en: This accident reminded me profoundly that we can only count on a single breath, illustrating the unpredictability of life's fragility.

sentences.zh: 爸爸常常說，人命在呼吸間，所以我們要學習如何對他人充滿愛與理解。
sentences.en: My father often says that we can only count on a single breath, teaching us to learn how to show love and understanding towards others.

sentences.zh: 當團隊保持人和事成的精神，便能在項目上取得顯著的成功。
sentences.en: When the team maintains the spirit that harmony accomplishes everything, they achieve remarkable success in their projects.

sentences.zh: 在與他人合作時，記住人和事成的重要性會讓工作進展更加順利。
sentences.en: Remembering the importance of 'harmony accomplishes everything' when collaborating with others makes the work process much smoother.

sentences.zh: 家庭之間的人和事成可以為每個成員帶來和諧美滿的生活。
sentences.en: Harmony accomplishes everything within a family, bringing a harmonious and fulfilling life to each member.

sentences.zh: 領導者應該努力營造一個人和事成的環境，以促進團隊凝聚力和創造力。
sentences.en: Leaders should strive to create an environment where harmony accomplishes everything to foster team cohesion and creativity.

sentences.zh: 鄰里之間的人和互助讓這個社區變得更加和諧。
sentences.en: Harmony and mutual help among neighbors have made this community more peaceful.

sentences.zh: 公司的文化強調人和互助，以促進員工之間的合作。
sentences.en: The company's culture emphasizes harmony and mutual help to foster collaboration among employees.

sentences.zh: 老師鼓勵學生在學習上人和互助，以提升集體成就。
sentences.en: The teacher encourages students to practice harmony and mutual help in their studies to enhance collective achievement.

sentences.zh: 這個組織提倡人和互助的原則，致力於改善社會的福祉。
sentences.en: The organization advocates for the principles of harmony and mutual help, committed to improving social well-being.

phrase.en: A Harmonious Family Calls for Celebration

sentences.zh: 新年的時候，全家圍坐在一起，共享人和家慶的快樂時光。
sentences.en: During the New Year, the whole family sits together to share the joyful times that a harmonious family calls for celebration.

sentences.zh: 人和家慶是一種美好的願景，讓每個家庭成員都感受到幸福。
sentences.en: A harmonious family calls for celebration is a beautiful vision, allowing every family member to experience happiness.

sentences.zh: 為了實現人和家慶，我們一起努力構建一個和睦的家庭環境。
sentences.en: To achieve a harmonious family that calls for celebration, we work together to build a harmonious home environment.

sentences.zh: 小時候，奶奶常常告訴我，只有人和家慶才能帶來真正的幸福生活。
sentences.en: When I was young, Grandma often told me that only a harmonious family that calls for celebration could bring true happiness in life.

phrase.zh: 人和家慶 金玉滿堂
phrase.en: A Harmonious Family Calls for Celebration; A House Filled with Treasures of Gold and Jade

sentences.zh: 在人和家慶的日子裡，親朋好友聚在一起，共同慶祝這個美滿的家庭。
sentences.en: On the day of a harmonious family celebration, friends and relatives gather to celebrate this wonderful family.

sentences.zh: 這座古老的宅邸以其金玉滿堂的裝潢而聞名，吸引了無數人的目光。
sentences.en: This ancient mansion is renowned for its decoration that is filled with treasures of gold and jade, capturing the attention of countless people.

sentences.zh: 他的夢想是創建一個人和家慶的家庭，讓孩子們在愛與關懷中成長。
sentences.en: His dream is to build a harmonious family that calls for celebration, where children grow up surrounded by love and care.

sentences.zh: 金玉滿堂的圖畫象徵著家中的富裕與繁榮，是這家博物館的珍貴藏品之一。
sentences.en: The painting depicting a house filled with treasures of gold and jade symbolizes wealth and prosperity in the home, and is one of the prized pieces in the museum.

phrase.zh: 人在眾中 心在定中
phrase.en: Settle Amongst People, Abide in Meditative Concentration

sentences.zh: 在喧囂的城市生活中，他仍然能夠做到人在眾中 心在定中，保持內心的平靜。
sentences.en: In the bustling city life, he is able to settle amongst people and abide in meditative concentration, maintaining inner peace.

sentences.zh: 工作繁忙時，她懂得人在眾中 心在定中，讓自己專注於當下的每一個瞬間。
sentences.en: Amidst busy work schedules, she knows how to settle amongst people and abide in meditative concentration, allowing herself to focus on every moment of the present.

sentences.zh: 即使身處於一個充滿壓力的環境，他總是有人在眾中 心在定中的能力，應付任何挑戰。
sentences.en: Even in a high-pressure environment, he always possesses the ability to settle amongst people and abide in meditative concentration, tackling any challenge.

sentences.zh: 參加大型活動時，她用人在眾中 心在定中的方法來管理自己的情緒，保持穩定。
sentences.en: When attending large events, she uses the method of settling amongst people and abiding in meditative concentration to manage her emotions and stay grounded.

phrase.zh: 人在眾中 心在定裏
phrase.en: Settle Amongst People, Abide in Meditative Concentration

sentences.zh: 即使在繁忙的工作環境中，她仍能保持人在眾中，心在定裏的狀態，專注於每日的任務。
sentences.en: Even in a hectic work environment, she managed to settle amongst people, abide in meditative concentration, and focus on her daily tasks.

sentences.zh: 修行者學會人在眾中，心在定裏，無論四周有多喧囂，他內心仍能保持平靜。
sentences.en: The practitioner learns to settle amongst people, abide in meditative concentration, maintaining inner peace regardless of the surrounding chaos.

sentences.zh: 他在城市車水馬龍的環境中，練習人在眾中，心在定裏的方法，發現了內心的寧靜。
sentences.en: In the bustling city environment, he practiced the method of settling amongst people, abiding in meditative concentration, and discovered inner calm.

sentences.zh: 即使身處雜亂的人群中，她總能做到人在眾中，心在定裏，讓自己進入深度的冥想狀態。
sentences.en: Even in a crowded setting, she always managed to settle amongst people, abiding in meditative concentration, allowing herself to enter deep meditation.

sentences.zh: 佛教經典中常常提到利益人天的教義，強調要同時利益世間的人類和天界的眾神。
sentences.en: Buddhist scriptures often refer to teachings that benefit humans and devas, emphasizing the need to serve both earthly humans and celestial gods.

sentences.zh: 修行者應該持守五戒，不僅能在人天界提升自己的福報，還能促進世界的和諧。
sentences.en: Practitioners should uphold the Five Precepts, which not only enhance their own merit among humans and devas but also promote harmony in the world.

sentences.zh: 通過修習佛法，信眾可以在人天兩界中獲得安樂，從而超越輪迴的痛苦。
sentences.en: By practicing the Dharma, devotees can attain peace among humans and devas, thus transcending the suffering of samsara.

sentences.zh: 菩薩的慈悲是無量的，祂們致力於利益一切眾生，無論是人天還是其他生命形式。
sentences.en: The compassion of the Bodhisattvas is boundless; they are dedicated to benefiting all beings, whether they are humans and devas or other forms of life.

phrase.en: Joy for Both Heavenly and Human Beings

sentences.zh: 在大廟的開光典禮上，法師的慈悲教誨帶給了在場眾生人天歡喜。
sentences.en: At the grand temple's consecration ceremony, the master's compassionate teachings brought joy for both heavenly and human beings present.

sentences.zh: 這部佛教經典以淨化心靈的內容聞名，被稱為人天歡喜的寶典。
sentences.en: This Buddhist scripture is renowned for its soul-purifying content and is regarded as a treasure that brings joy for both heavenly and human beings.

sentences.zh: 他的德行圓滿，讓所在的城市人天歡喜，充滿了和諧美好的氛圍。
sentences.en: His virtuous conduct brought joy for both heavenly and human beings in the city, creating an atmosphere of harmony and goodwill.

sentences.zh: 佛法的弘揚使得法界充滿了人天歡喜的盛況。
sentences.en: The propagation of the Dharma filled the realm with a grand display of joy for both heavenly and human beings.

sentences.zh: 菩薩具有智慧圓滿的能力，如同人天眼目，觀照一切眾生的苦樂。
sentences.en: Bodhisattvas possess the perfect ability of wisdom, like the Eyes of Heaven and Earth, observing the suffering and joy of all beings.

sentences.zh: 修行者應當培養人天眼目，以便看清真相，不被幻象所迷惑。
sentences.en: Practitioners should develop the Eyes of Heaven and Earth to discern the truth clearly, and not be deceived by illusions.

sentences.zh: 人天眼目使得一位智者能夠平等無偏地關懷所有生靈。
sentences.en: The Eyes of Heaven and Earth allow a sage to care for all living beings equally and impartially.

sentences.zh: 在佛教中，人天眼目的修行意味著內在智慧的開展，超越世間的限制。
sentences.en: In Buddhism, cultivating the Eyes of Heaven and Earth signifies the unfolding of inner wisdom, transcending worldly limitations.

phrase.en: The importance of learning how to be a human

sentences.zh: 佛教強調人學的重要，因為理解自己的本性是悟道的起點。
sentences.en: Buddhism emphasizes the importance of learning how to be a human, as understanding one's nature is the starting point of enlightenment.

sentences.zh: 老師在課堂上談到了人學的重要，提醒學生要培養善良與正直。
sentences.en: The teacher discussed the importance of learning how to be a human, reminding students to cultivate kindness and integrity.

sentences.zh: 面對科技的迅猛發展，人學的重要更顯得不可或缺。
sentences.en: In the face of rapid technological advancement, the importance of learning how to be a human becomes even more indispensable.

sentences.zh: 通過禪修，我們可以更深刻地理解人學的重要，達到心靈的成長。
sentences.en: Through meditation, we can gain a deeper understanding of the importance of learning how to be a human, achieving spiritual growth.

sentences.zh: 在佛教中，人師不僅教授知識，還引導弟子如何修行。
sentences.en: In Buddhism, a teacher of humans not only imparts knowledge but also guides disciples on how to practice.

sentences.zh: 這位人師以其深厚的智慧和慈悲心廣受信徒尊敬。
sentences.en: This teacher of humans is widely respected for their profound wisdom and compassion.

sentences.zh: 他立志成為一位能啟發和引導他人的人師。
sentences.en: He aspires to become a teacher of humans who can inspire and guide others.

sentences.zh: 在人們心目中，這位人師擁有如明燈般的指引力量。
sentences.en: In the minds of people, this teacher of humans possesses the guiding power akin to a beacon of light.

phrase.en: Buddhahood Is Attained Upon the Attainment of a Perfected Character

sentences.zh: 在修行的過程中，他深知人成佛成的道理，因而不斷自我反省與完善。
sentences.en: Throughout his practice, he deeply understood that Buddhahood is attained upon the attainment of a perfected character, hence he constantly engaged in self-reflection and improvement.

sentences.zh: 寺院的長老經常教誡弟子們，只有當人成佛成，才能真正解脫煩惱。
sentences.en: The elder of the monastery often admonishes the disciples that only when Buddhahood is attained upon the attainment of a perfected character can one truly liberate from afflictions.

sentences.zh: 她的修為已經到達人成佛成的境界，讓周圍的人都感到一種祥和與安定。
sentences.en: Her cultivation has reached a state where Buddhahood is attained upon the attainment of a perfected character, bringing a sense of peace and stability to those around her.

sentences.zh: 在這條菩提道上，人成佛成的修行目標是每一位信徒的終極追求。
sentences.en: On this Bodhi path, the practice goal of attaining Buddhahood upon the attainment of a perfected character is the ultimate pursuit for every devotee.

phrase.en: Buddhahood is attained the instant our characters are perfected

sentences.zh: 在佛教中，修行的目標是達到人成即佛成，這意味著每個人的完善即是佛陀的境界。
sentences.en: In Buddhism, the goal of practice is to achieve 'Buddhahood is attained the instant our characters are perfected,' which means that the perfection of each individual is the state of a Buddha.

sentences.zh: 禪師教導我們，當我們內心的缺點被克服時，人成即佛成的智慧自然迸發。
sentences.en: The Zen master teaches us that when the flaws within our hearts are overcome, the wisdom of 'Buddhahood is attained the instant our characters are perfected' naturally emerges.

sentences.zh: 他相信通過不斷自我反省，最終可以達到人成即佛成的境界。
sentences.en: He believes that through continuous self-reflection, one can eventually reach the state where 'Buddhahood is attained the instant our characters are perfected.'

sentences.zh: 此信念強調了在修行過程中，自我提升和精神淨化的重要性，即人成即佛成。
sentences.en: This belief emphasizes the importance of self-improvement and spiritual purification during the practice, signifying that 'Buddhahood is attained the instant our characters are perfected.'

sentences.zh: 在人我不二的境界中，個人的幸福與他人的幸福是不可分割的。
sentences.en: In the state of unity of self and others, an individual's happiness is inseparable from the happiness of others.

sentences.zh: 修行者強調人我不二，因為這能夠帶來更深層次的慈悲與和諧。
sentences.en: Practitioners emphasize the unity of self and others, as it leads to a deeper level of compassion and harmony.

sentences.zh: 人我不二的理念引導人們從自我中心走向大愛。
sentences.en: The concept of unity of self and others guides people from self-centeredness to universal love.

sentences.zh: 體驗到人我不二後，我感受到與世界更深的聯繫。
sentences.en: After experiencing the unity of self and others, I felt a deeper connection with the world.

sentences.zh: 在修行中，我們學會了人我互換的練習，這有助於培養同理心和慈悲心。
sentences.en: In our practice, we have learned the exercise of switching places with others, which helps cultivate empathy and compassion.

sentences.zh: 老師鼓勵學生嘗試人我互換的冥想，以理解他人面臨的挑戰。
sentences.en: The teacher encouraged students to try the meditation of switching places with others to understand the challenges faced by them.

sentences.zh: 當你人我互換時，你會發現自己對他人的批評會更加少。
sentences.en: When you switch places with others, you may find yourself becoming less critical of them.

sentences.zh: 透過人我互換的觀想，個人能夠更深入地了解他人的感受與需求。
sentences.en: Through the visualization of switching places with others, individuals can gain a deeper understanding of the feelings and needs of others.

phrase.en: Auspicious Blessings for the Self and Others

sentences.zh: 他每天早晨祈禱，願人我吉祥，祈求所有眾生都能感受到幸福和平安。
sentences.en: Every morning he prays for auspicious blessings for the self and others, wishing all beings to experience happiness and peace.

sentences.zh: 在佛教儀式中，僧人們高唱經文，祈求世界和諧、人我吉祥。
sentences.en: During the Buddhist ceremony, the monks chant scriptures, praying for world harmony and auspicious blessings for the self and others.

sentences.zh: 這是一個人我吉祥的日子，適合與家人團聚，享受共度的美好時光。
sentences.en: It is a day of auspicious blessings for the self and others, ideal for reuniting with family and enjoying wonderful moments together.

sentences.zh: 老師提醒學生們要常懷人我吉祥之心，待人以禮，助人為樂。
sentences.en: The teacher reminded the students to always hold a heart of auspicious blessings for the self and others, treating others with respect and finding joy in helping them.

sentences.zh: 在這個和諧的社區中，人我和敬是每個人共同遵循的原則。
sentences.en: In this harmonious community, harmonious and respectful relations are principles adhered to by everyone.

sentences.zh: 佛教教導我們在人我和敬中尋找內在的平和與幸福。
sentences.en: Buddhism teaches us to find inner peace and happiness through harmonious and respectful relations.

sentences.zh: 當彼此間能夠達到人我和敬的境界，合作就會更為順利。
sentences.en: When individuals achieve harmonious and respectful relations, cooperation becomes more seamless.

sentences.zh: 建立良好的人我和敬需要付出持續的努力和相互的理解。
sentences.en: Establishing good harmonious and respectful relations requires continuous effort and mutual understanding.

phrase.zh: 人我和敬 共生吉祥
phrase.en: Harmonious and Respectful Relations; Auspicious Coexistence

sentences.zh: 在所有關係中，人我和敬共生吉祥，能夠促進社會和諧與長遠的幸福。
sentences.en: In all relationships, harmonious and respectful relations lead to auspicious coexistence, promoting societal harmony and long-term happiness.

sentences.zh: 佛教教導我們，透過人我和敬共生吉祥的互動，個人和社群將共同繁榮。
sentences.en: Buddhism teaches us that through harmonious and respectful interactions, individuals and communities will thrive together in auspicious coexistence.

sentences.zh: 企業文化若能強調人我和敬共生吉祥，將有助於提升工作環境與員工的整體滿足感。
sentences.en: If a corporate culture emphasizes harmonious and respectful relations and auspicious coexistence, it will help improve the work environment and overall employee satisfaction.

sentences.zh: 在人生旅途中，秉持人我和敬共生吉祥的精神，我們可以克服困難，創造美好的未來。
sentences.en: In the journey of life, by upholding the spirit of harmonious and respectful relations and auspicious coexistence, we can overcome challenges and create a brighter future.

phrase.en: characteristics of the self and others

sentences.zh: 在修行中，認識並放下人我相是重要的一步，這能幫助我們達到心靈的平和。
sentences.en: In spiritual practice, recognizing and letting go of the characteristics of the self and others is an important step that can help us attain inner peace.

sentences.zh: 佛教教導我們，人我相的執著是痛苦的根源，應該學習如何真正地理解和超越它。
sentences.en: Buddhism teaches that attachment to the characteristics of the self and others is the root of suffering, and we should learn how to truly understand and transcend it.

sentences.zh: 透過靜坐和自省，我們可以逐漸減少對人我相的誤解，進而提升自我的覺察力。
sentences.en: Through meditation and introspection, we can gradually reduce misunderstandings of the characteristics of the self and others, thereby enhancing self-awareness.

sentences.zh: 他發現，放下人我相的分別之後，他能以更開放和包容的心態面對生活中的挑戰。
sentences.en: He found that by letting go of the distinctions between the characteristics of the self and others, he could face life's challenges with a more open and inclusive mindset.

sentences.zh: 人文國小的師生共同參加了社區服務日，增進了鄰里之間的連結。
sentences.en: The teachers and students of Ilan Humanity Primary School participated in the Community Service Day, enhancing neighborhood connections.

sentences.zh: 人文國小以其創新的教學方法和豐富的課外活動而聞名。
sentences.en: Ilan Humanity Primary School is renowned for its innovative teaching methods and extensive extracurricular activities.

sentences.zh: 每年，人文國小都舉辦文化節，展示不同國家的傳統和習俗。
sentences.en: Every year, Ilan Humanity Primary School hosts a cultural festival to showcase the traditions and customs of various countries.

sentences.zh: 在全國科學比賽中，人文國小的學生取得了優異的成績，為學校爭光。
sentences.en: The students from Ilan Humanity Primary School achieved excellent results in the national science competition, bringing honor to the school.

phrase.en: An Upright Personality Makes a Good Heart

sentences.zh: 在面對困難時，人正心好的人總能保持冷靜與鎮定。
sentences.en: In the face of difficulties, a person with an upright personality and a good heart always remains calm and composed.

sentences.zh: 他因為人正心好，贏得了周圍所有人的尊敬和愛戴。
sentences.en: Because of his upright personality and good heart, he earned the respect and affection of everyone around him.

sentences.zh: 人正心好是他能成為領袖的重要原因之一。
sentences.en: An upright personality and a good heart are among the key reasons why he became a leader.

sentences.zh: 父母時常教導孩子要人正心好，這是他們家庭的重要價值觀。
sentences.en: The parents often teach their children to have an upright personality and a good heart, as it is an important family value.

phrase.en: An Upright Character with a Mind at Peace

sentences.zh: 在面對任何挑戰時，他始終保持人正心安，不會被外界的壓力動搖。
sentences.en: In the face of any challenge, he maintains an upright character with a mind at peace, never swayed by external pressures.

sentences.zh: 練習冥想可以幫助我們達成人正心安的狀態，促進內心的和諧。
sentences.en: Practicing meditation can help us achieve a state of an upright character with a mind at peace, promoting inner harmony.

sentences.zh: 她以人正心安的態度處理公司裡的複雜事務，贏得了同事們的尊敬。
sentences.en: She handled complex matters at the company with an upright character and a mind at peace, earning the respect of her colleagues.

sentences.zh: 他的生活哲學是保持人正心安，無論在順境或逆境中都能夠如如不動。
sentences.en: His life philosophy is to maintain an upright character with a mind at peace, remaining unmoved whether in favorable or adverse conditions.

phrase.zh: 人海慈航─怎樣知道有觀世音菩薩
phrase.en: A Compassionate Ferry: Where is Guanyin Bodhisattva?

sentences.zh: 在艱難的時刻中，他常常祈禱觀世音菩薩如人海慈航般救度眾生，因為他相信慈悲無處不在。
sentences.en: In difficult times, he often prays for Guanyin Bodhisattva to save sentient beings like a compassionate ferry because he believes compassion is everywhere.

sentences.zh: 人們問道：如何才能在人海中找到觀世音菩薩的慈航？答案在於信念和修行。
sentences.en: People ask: How can one find the compassionate ferry of Guanyin Bodhisattva in the sea of humanity? The answer lies in faith and practice.

sentences.zh: 觀世音菩薩被譽為人海慈航，她的慈悲如大海般廣大，時刻準備接引我們渡過苦厄。
sentences.en: Guanyin Bodhisattva is hailed as a compassionate ferry; her compassion is as vast as the ocean, always ready to guide us across hardships.

sentences.zh: 那位老僧告訴弟子：『想知道觀世音菩薩是不是在你身邊，就觀察生活中的善行和慈愛。』
sentences.en: The old monk told his disciple: 'To know if Guanyin Bodhisattva is by your side, observe the acts of goodness and compassion in life.'

phrase.en: Lamp in the Ocean of People

sentences.zh: 在人海燈下，他覺得找到了方向，心靈得到了片刻的寧靜。
sentences.en: Under the lamp in the ocean of people, he felt a sense of direction and a moment of peace.

sentences.zh: 這本書像人海燈一樣，為迷茫的讀者點亮了心靈的路。
sentences.en: This book acts like a lamp in the ocean of people, illuminating the path for readers lost in confusion.

sentences.zh: 在這繁忙的城市中，他總能在人海燈的指引下找到歸屬感。
sentences.en: In this bustling city, he always finds a sense of belonging under the guidance of the lamp in the ocean of people.

sentences.zh: 她在人海燈的光芒中，看到了自己的未來和希望。
sentences.en: In the glow of the lamp in the ocean of people, she saw her future and hope.

phrase.zh: 人無信不立 天有日方明
phrase.en: Dishonesty shatters any ground you stand on; Only in the presence of the sun can the sky light up.

sentences.zh: 在商業合作中，人無信不立，誠信是維持長期關係的基石。
sentences.en: In business partnerships, dishonesty shatters any ground you stand on; integrity is the cornerstone of sustained relationships.

sentences.zh: 只有當太陽升起時，天有日方明，我們才能清楚地看到周圍的世界。
sentences.en: Only in the presence of the sun can the sky light up, allowing us to clearly see the world around us.

sentences.zh: 一個人的誠信就如同陽光，人無信不立，缺乏誠信的人難以贏得他人的信任。
sentences.en: A person's honesty is like sunlight; dishonesty shatters any ground you stand on, and a lack of integrity makes it difficult to earn others' trust.

sentences.zh: 古人說：人無信不立，就像只有陽光普照，天有日方明，我們才能找出正確的方向。
sentences.en: As the ancients say: dishonesty shatters any ground you stand on, and just as only in the presence of the sun can the sky light up, we find the right direction.

phrase.en: Live three hundred years' worth of life

sentences.zh: 修行者希望能夠在短短數十年的生命中，達到人生三百歲的智慧境界。
sentences.en: Practitioners aim to achieve the wisdom of 'living three hundred years' worth of life' in the few decades they have.

sentences.zh: 儘管她年紀尚輕，但她如同人生三百歲那般成熟而睿智。
sentences.en: Despite her youth, she possesses maturity and wisdom as if she has lived three hundred years' worth of life.

sentences.zh: 老師鼓勵學生們珍惜時間，如人生三百歲，努力汲取知識。
sentences.en: The teacher encourages students to cherish their time as if living three hundred years' worth of life, striving to absorb knowledge.

sentences.zh: 他總是滿懷活力地享受生活，彷彿在活著人生三百歲的時光。
sentences.en: He always enjoys life with such vitality, as if he is living three hundred years' worth of time.

phrase.zh: 人生三百歲 寺院億萬千
phrase.en: Live a life worth three hundred years' endeavors; Building temples in thousands and millions.

sentences.zh: 她的人生三百歲，寺院億萬千，無論去哪裡，她都致力於傳播佛法與建設心靈的聖殿。
sentences.en: Her life was one worth three hundred years' endeavors; building temples in thousands and millions, wherever she went, she was committed to spreading the Dharma and building sanctuaries of the mind.

sentences.zh: 當一個人決定活出人生三百歲的意義，努力不懈地實現寺院億萬千的夢想，那顆心就不會再輕易動搖。
sentences.en: When one decides to live a life worth three hundred years' endeavors, tirelessly pursuing the dream of building temples in thousands and millions, their heart will no longer be easily swayed.

sentences.zh: 佛陀教導我們要活出人生三百歲，透過在心中建立寺院億萬千來實現真正的智慧與慈悲。
sentences.en: The Buddha taught us to live a life worth three hundred years' endeavors by building temples in thousands and millions within our hearts to achieve true wisdom and compassion.

sentences.zh: 在晚年的日子裡，他常常思考如何令自己的人生如同三百歲般富有意義，並留下了寺院億萬千般的精神遺產。
sentences.en: In his later years, he often pondered how to make his life as meaningful as three hundred years, leaving behind a spiritual legacy akin to building temples in thousands and millions.

sentences.zh: 人生最大的敵人是自己，正如古語有雲，『自作自受』。
sentences.en: The foremost enemy in life is self, as an ancient saying goes, 'One reaps what one sows.'

sentences.zh: 人生最大的美德是慈悲，如佛陀所教導，我們應該以慈悲心待人。
sentences.en: The foremost virtue in life is compassion, as taught by the Buddha, we should treat others with a compassionate heart.

sentences.zh: 人生最大的能源是信仰，因為它能支撐我們度過人生的艱難時刻。
sentences.en: The foremost energy in life is religious faith, as it sustains us through the hardest times in life.

sentences.zh: 人生最大的希望是平安，無論到何處，願彼此問候時都能說『平安』。
sentences.en: The foremost hope in life is peace; wherever we go, it is a wish to greet each other with 'peace.'

sentences.zh: 爭執時友善一笑，展現人生的風度。
sentences.en: A friendly smile in times of quarrel is a demonstration of one's demeanor.

sentences.zh: 吃虧時微微一笑，展現人生的肚量。
sentences.en: A faint smile in times of disadvantage is a demonstration of one's tolerance.

sentences.zh: 委屈時坦然一笑，展現人生的自信。
sentences.en: A genuine smile in times of aggrievement is a demonstration of one's dignity.

sentences.zh: 無奈時幽默一笑，展現人生的境界。
sentences.en: A subtle smile in times of helplessness is a demonstration of one's state of mind.

sentences.zh: 危難時泰然一笑，展現人生的定力。
sentences.en: A composed smile in times of danger is a demonstration of one's calmness.

sentences.zh: 生氣時平靜一笑，展現人生的素養。
sentences.en: A peaceful smile in times of anger is a demonstration of one's disposition.

sentences.zh: 出糗時會心一笑，展現人生的智慧。
sentences.en: A reassuring smile in times of embarrassment is a demonstration of one's wisdom.

sentences.zh: 挫折時淡然一笑，展現人生的力量。
sentences.en: A bland smile in times of setback is a demonstration of one's strength.

sentences.zh: 失意時樂觀一笑，展現人生的豁達。
sentences.en: A cheerful smile in times of disappointment is a demonstration of one's magnanimity.

sentences.zh: 害怕時輕鬆一笑，展現人生的勇氣。
sentences.en: An airy smile in times of fear is a demonstration of one's courage.

sentences.zh: 誤會時灑脫一笑，展現人生的修為。
sentences.en: A carefree smile in times of misunderstanding is a demonstration of one's deportment.

sentences.zh: 分手時優雅一笑，展現人生的大氣。
sentences.en: An elegant smile in times of a breakup is a demonstration of one's manner.

sentences.zh: 生疏時親切一笑，展現人生的隨和。
sentences.en: An amiable smile in times of estrangement is a demonstration of one's friendliness.

sentences.zh: 難堪時轉念一笑，展現人生的睿智。
sentences.en: A hopeful smile in times of sorrow is a demonstration of one's cleverness.

sentences.zh: 羞愧時大方一笑，展現人生的率真。
sentences.en: A gracious smile in times of shame is a demonstration of one's ingenuousness.

sentences.zh: 生病時達觀一笑，展現人生的態度。
sentences.en: An optimistic smile in times of ailment is a demonstration of one's attitude.

sentences.zh: 苦惱時開懷一笑，展現人生的氣度。
sentences.en: A happy smile in times of distress is a demonstration of one's comportment.

sentences.zh: 緊張時天真一笑，展現人生的直率。
sentences.en: An honest smile in times of nervousness is a demonstration of one's frankness.

sentences.zh: 受騙時開朗一笑，展現人生的坦蕩。
sentences.en: A warm smile in times of deceit is a demonstration of one's clear conscience.

sentences.zh: 得意時含蓄一笑，展現人生的謙卑。
sentences.en: A reserved smile in times of triumph is a demonstration of one's humbleness.

phrase.en: Buddhism in Every Step: Ten of Life’s Common Concerns

sentences.zh: 這本書《人生十問》引導讀者用佛教智慧解決日常生活中的困惑。
sentences.en: The book 'Buddhism in Every Step: Ten of Life’s Common Concerns' guides readers in resolving their everyday dilemmas through Buddhist wisdom.

sentences.zh: 法師在講堂上以《人生十問》為主題，探討我們生命中面臨的普遍問題。
sentences.en: The monk discussed 'Buddhism in Every Step: Ten of Life’s Common Concerns' during the lecture, exploring common issues we encounter in life.

sentences.zh: 閱讀《人生十問》讓我更深入理解如何應用佛法在日常抉擇中。
sentences.en: Reading 'Buddhism in Every Step: Ten of Life’s Common Concerns' has deepened my understanding of how to apply Buddhism to everyday decisions.

sentences.zh: 在《人生十問》中，作者列出了生活中最具挑戰性的問題，並提供了應對的方法。
sentences.en: In 'Buddhism in Every Step: Ten of Life’s Common Concerns', the author lists the most challenging questions in life and offers ways to address them.

sentences.zh: 人生卜事謂之吉祥，意指我們對未來充滿光明的展望。
sentences.en: Positive forecasts for life are considered auspicious, implying our bright outlook for the future.

sentences.zh: 佛教中，修行者常求得人生卜事，以此增強信心與勇氣。
sentences.en: In Buddhism, practitioners often seek positive forecasts for life to enhance their confidence and courage.

sentences.zh: 人生卜事提醒我們，無論際遇如何，都應堅持樂觀的心態。
sentences.en: Positive forecasts for life remind us to maintain an optimistic attitude regardless of circumstances.

sentences.zh: 通過冥想和祈禱，我們能更好地迎接人生卜事所帶來的祝福。
sentences.en: Through meditation and prayer, we can better embrace the blessings brought by positive forecasts for life.

phrase.zh: 人生如夢誰是我 到處能安即是家
phrase.en: Life is but a dream, so who am I? Peaceful is a mind that sees anywhere as home.

sentences.zh: 他經常思考『人生如夢誰是我 到處能安即是家』這句話的深層意義，以尋求內心的平靜。
sentences.en: He often reflects on the deeper meaning of the phrase 'Life is but a dream, so who am I? Peaceful is a mind that sees anywhere as home' to find inner peace.

sentences.zh: 面對生命的無常，她明白『人生如夢誰是我 到處能安即是家』，因此學會在不同環境中找到安心的方法。
sentences.en: In facing the impermanence of life, she understood 'Life is but a dream, so who am I? Peaceful is a mind that sees anywhere as home,' and thus learned to find tranquility in various environments.

sentences.zh: 這位佛教禪師教導弟子『人生如夢誰是我 到處能安即是家』，並鼓勵他們放下對物質世界的執著。
sentences.en: The Buddhist monk taught his disciples 'Life is but a dream, so who am I? Peaceful is a mind that sees anywhere as home,' encouraging them to let go of attachments to the material world.

sentences.zh: 他在世界各地旅行，總是相信『人生如夢誰是我 到處能安即是家』，因此能在任何地方感受到家的溫暖。
sentences.en: As he traveled around the world, he always believed that 'Life is but a dream, so who am I? Peaceful is a mind that sees anywhere as home,' allowing him to feel the warmth of home wherever he went.

sentences.zh: 人生月刊是一本涵蓋個人成長和哲學思考的優秀雜誌。
sentences.en: Human Life Monthly Magazine is an excellent publication covering personal growth and philosophical reflections.

sentences.zh: 她每月都期待著人生月刊的新一期，以便獲得新的靈感。
sentences.en: She eagerly awaits each new issue of Human Life Monthly Magazine to gain new inspiration.

sentences.zh: 人生月刊的編輯團隊每個月都努力提供高質量的內容。
sentences.en: The editorial team of Human Life Monthly Magazine strives to deliver high-quality content every month.

sentences.zh: 在人生月刊的這期特刊中，探討了現代社會中的道德困境。
sentences.en: In this special edition of Human Life Monthly Magazine, moral dilemmas in modern society are explored.

phrase.zh: 人生無量壽 佛教億萬年
phrase.en: Life is ageless; Faith is timeless.

sentences.zh: 人生無量壽，佛教億萬年，這句話讓我深感佛教的智慧可以跨越時空，永恒不變。
sentences.en: Life is ageless; Faith is timeless, this saying makes me deeply appreciate how the wisdom of Buddhism transcends time and remains eternal.

sentences.zh: 生活中，我們應該以人生無量壽和佛教億萬年的理念提醒自己，追求內心的平和。
sentences.en: In life, we should remind ourselves with the concept that life is ageless and faith is timeless, to pursue inner peace.

sentences.zh: 當我面對人生的挑戰時，總是想起人生無量壽，佛教億萬年，覺得一切困難都是暫時的。
sentences.en: When faced with life's challenges, I always recall that life is ageless and faith is timeless, feeling that all difficulties are temporary.

sentences.zh: 這部經典教導我們，人生無量壽，佛教億萬年，應該珍惜當下的每一個瞬間。
sentences.en: This classic teaching reminds us that life is ageless and faith is timeless, urging us to cherish every moment.

phrase.zh: 人生猶似西山日 富貴終如草上霜
phrase.en: Life is like the setting sun in the West; Wealth is nothing but dew on grass.

sentences.zh: 他常常提醒自己，人生猶似西山日，富貴終如草上霜，不該過於執著於物質名利。
sentences.en: He often reminded himself that life is like the setting sun in the West; wealth is nothing but dew on grass, and he should not become too attached to material wealth and fame.

sentences.zh: 禪師告誡弟子們，要將目光放在精神的修養上，而不是短暫的富貴，因為人生猶似西山日，富貴終如草上霜。
sentences.en: The Zen master advised his disciples to focus on spiritual cultivation rather than fleeting riches, for life is like the setting sun in the West; wealth is nothing but dew on grass.

sentences.zh: 面對生活的起伏，她深知人生猶似西山日，富貴終如草上霜，因此努力保持內心的平和。
sentences.en: Facing the ups and downs of life, she knew well that life is like the setting sun in the West; wealth is nothing but dew on grass, thus she strived to maintain inner peace.

sentences.zh: 祖父總是說：'兒孫自有兒孫福，人生猶似西山日，富貴終如草上霜。'他要我們學會知足。
sentences.en: Grandfather always said, 'Each generation has its own fortune; life is like the setting sun in the West; wealth is nothing but dew on grass.' He wanted us to learn contentment.

sentences.zh: 在世間的滾滾紅塵中，我們各自有著不同的人生百事需要完成。
sentences.en: In the tumult of the earthly world, each of us has our own one hundred tasks of life to complete.

sentences.zh: 面對人生百事，他以智慧和勇氣迎接每一個挑戰。
sentences.en: Faced with the one hundred tasks of life, he confronted each challenge with wisdom and courage.

sentences.zh: 隨著歲月流逝，人生百事逐漸成為靈魂的珍貴記憶。
sentences.en: As the years go by, the one hundred tasks of life gradually become precious memories of the soul.

sentences.zh: 人生百事繁多，我們應該學習如何有條不紊地管理時間。
sentences.en: With so many tasks of life, we should learn how to manage our time efficiently.

phrase.zh: 人生要有些什麼? 人生活著要有希望 人生存在要有明天 人生意義要有信仰 人生每天要有工作 人生眼界要有遠見 人生前途要有計劃 人生做事要有觀察 人生方便要有結緣 人生交友要有情義 人生性格要有慈悲 人生發展要有動力 人生處世要有服務 人生行事要有周全 人生存活要有大眾 人生活動要有空間 人生積善要有無私 人生評斷要有明鑑 人生滋長要有忙碌 人生安危要有思量 人生可否要有智慧
phrase.en: The Must Haves in Life We must have hope in order to live. We must have tomorrow in order to exist. We must have faith in order to find meaning. We must have a job to do everyday. We must have perspective in our vision. We must have a plan for the future. We must be observant in completing tasks. We must develop affinities in order to find help. We must show sentiment and loyalty to our friends. We must have compassion in our character. We must find motivation in order to progress. We must offer our service to find our place in this world. We must be considerate in everything we do. We must have affinities in order to survive. We must have space in order to be active. We must be selfless in order to accumulate good. We must be reasonable in our judgment. We must be industrious at growing and improving. We must prepare for sunny and rainy days. We must be wise in saying ‘yes’ and ‘no.’

sentences.zh: 人生要有些什麼? 我們要有信仰才能找到生命的意義。
sentences.en: The must haves in life: We must have faith in order to find meaning.

sentences.zh: 人人都要在每天的生活中找到一個工作，這是人生的每日基準。
sentences.en: We must have a job to do every day; it's the daily basis of life.

sentences.zh: 我們必須為未來做好計劃，以便在面對人生挑戰時能夠胸有成竹。
sentences.en: We must have a plan for the future to face life's challenges confidently.

sentences.zh: 為了生存，我們需要結識朋友、建立良好的關係。
sentences.en: In order to survive, we must develop affinities by making friends and building good relationships.

sentences.zh: 他貪婪地積攢財富，卻不知道這樣的慳貪之人最終將面臨伶仃孤苦的結局。
sentences.en: He hoarded wealth with greed, unaware that such stinginess and greed cause the pain of loneliness in the end.

sentences.zh: 揮霍無度的人常常感受到求不得苦，因為他們的慾望永遠得不到滿足。
sentences.en: Those who live extravagantly often experience the pain of discontent, as their desires are never fully satisfied.

sentences.zh: 他對生活的懈怠導致了千辛萬苦的窘境，懶惰總是帶來不盡的艱難。
sentences.en: His laziness led to the pain of hardship, as laziness always brings about endless difficulties.

sentences.zh: 矯情者往往陷於嘴甜心苦的困境，表面的虛假掩蓋了內心的真實痛苦。
sentences.en: The pretentious often find themselves in the pain of insincerity, where outward sweetness hides inner suffering.

phrase.en: It is hard to be born as a human, and hard to hear the Dharma

sentences.zh: 人生難得，大道難聞，每當我想到自己能有這個機會修習佛法，總是心懷感激。
sentences.en: It is hard to be born as a human, and hard to hear the Dharma. Whenever I think of the opportunity to practice Buddhism, I am filled with gratitude.

sentences.zh: 老師常提醒我們，人生難得，大道難聞，因此應該珍惜每一個學習的機會。
sentences.en: Our teacher often reminds us that it is hard to be born as a human, and hard to hear the Dharma, so we should cherish every opportunity to learn.

sentences.zh: 他了解到人生難得，大道難聞，於是決定全身心投入佛學的研究。
sentences.en: Understanding that it is hard to be born as a human, and hard to hear the Dharma, he decided to devote himself wholeheartedly to the study of Buddhism.

sentences.zh: 聽到這句話，人生難得，大道難聞，我立刻感受到修行的重要性。
sentences.en: Upon hearing the phrase, 'It is hard to be born as a human, and hard to hear the Dharma,' I immediately felt the importance of spiritual practice.

phrase.en: It is important to feel pain and affliction

sentences.zh: 佛教認為，人要知道苦惱才能懂得珍惜幸福，並找到解脫之道。
sentences.en: Buddhism holds that it is important to feel pain and affliction to truly appreciate happiness and find the path to liberation.

sentences.zh: 在人生的旅途中，面對挫折和困難，人要知道苦惱是一種成長的過程。
sentences.en: In the journey of life, when facing setbacks and difficulties, it is important to feel pain and affliction as a process of growth.

sentences.zh: 修行者通過冥想和正念，意識到人要知道苦惱，才能開啓慈悲與智慧。
sentences.en: Practitioners, through meditation and mindfulness, realize that it is important to feel pain and affliction to open the door to compassion and wisdom.

sentences.zh: 了解生命的本質在人要知道苦惱，正如蓮花須在淤泥中生長才能綻放。
sentences.en: Understanding the essence of life lies in the recognition that it is important to feel pain and affliction, just as the lotus must grow in mud to bloom.

phrase.zh: 人貴無求 心安有福
phrase.en: It is Best to Be Desireless; A Peaceful Mind is Naturally Happy

sentences.zh: 人貴無求，心安有福，當我們放下對世俗的貪欲時，內心的平靜帶來真正的快樂。
sentences.en: It is best to be desireless; a peaceful mind is naturally happy, and when we let go of worldly desires, true happiness arises from within.

sentences.zh: 活得知足常樂，人貴無求，心安有福，這是一種生活的智慧。
sentences.en: Living with contentment brings constant joy; it is best to be desireless, as a peaceful mind is naturally happy. This is a wisdom in life.

sentences.zh: 佛教教導我們人貴無求，心安有福，因為過多的欲望只會帶來無盡的煩惱。
sentences.en: Buddhism teaches us that it is best to be desireless; a peaceful mind is naturally happy, for excessive desires only bring endless trouble.

sentences.zh: 追求簡單生活的人往往明白人貴無求，心安有福的道理，享受於心靈的寧靜。
sentences.en: Those who pursue a simple life often understand that it is best to be desireless; a peaceful mind is naturally happy, and they find comfort in the tranquility of their spirits.

sentences.zh: 在人生的旅途中，能夠遇到一個真正理解自己的人，讓我深刻體會到人貴相知的意義。
sentences.en: During the journey of life, meeting someone who truly understands you makes me realize the true meaning of 'Friendship is Precious'.

sentences.zh: 他們雖然分隔兩地，但他們人貴相知，彼此珍惜這段友情。
sentences.en: Though they are miles apart, they appreciate their bond because friendship is precious.

sentences.zh: 這次困難讓我們了解到，無論遇到多大的挑戰，人貴相知的友誼都會給我們力量。
sentences.en: The hardship taught us that, no matter the challenges, the power of friendship is precious and will give us strength.

sentences.zh: 長久的人貴相知勝過一時的榮華富貴，因為真正的友情是無價的。
sentences.en: Long-lasting friendship is precious and surpasses transient wealth and glory because true friendship is invaluable.

phrase.zh: 人貴自知 自知者明
phrase.en: Nobility Comes from Within; It Takes One to Know One

sentences.zh: 人貴自知，了解自己的長處和短處才能活得更理智和清醒。
sentences.en: Nobility comes from within; understanding one's strengths and weaknesses is key to living wisely and clearly.

sentences.zh: 在面對挑戰時，自知者明的她總能以冷靜和理性的方式處理問題。
sentences.en: When facing challenges, her wisdom in knowing herself allows her to handle problems calmly and rationally.

sentences.zh: 他處事謙遜，是因為他深知人貴自知，而非淨仰賴外界的評價。
sentences.en: His humility in conduct stems from his understanding that nobility comes from within, rather than relying solely on external validation.

sentences.zh: 自知者明，於是她能夠在不同的環境中保持真實的自我。
sentences.en: It takes one to know one, thus she is able to maintain her true self in varying circumstances.

sentences.zh: 佛教教導我們在這人間要行善積德，對他人慈悲為懷。
sentences.en: Buddhism teaches us to perform good deeds and practice compassion towards others in the human world.

sentences.zh: 他認為人間雖苦，卻也充滿了無限的可能性和美好。
sentences.en: He believes that although the human world is full of suffering, it is also filled with endless possibilities and beauty.

sentences.zh: 在人間修行是佛教徒的重要課題，因為這是修身養性的最好時機。
sentences.en: Practicing in the human world is an important task for Buddhists, as it is the best opportunity for self-cultivation.

sentences.zh: 許多詩人筆下的人間是一個既夢幻又現實交織的境地。
sentences.en: In the writings of many poets, the human world is a blend of fantasy and reality.

sentences.zh: 只要衣食住行無虞，就好不必追求奢華。
sentences.en: As long as basic needs are met, it is enough to live without seeking luxury.

sentences.zh: 在朋友相處中，互相尊重就好，不必多加要求。
sentences.en: In friendships, mutual respect is enough; there is no need for excessive demands.

sentences.zh: 內心平靜就好，世間事不必過於執著。
sentences.en: Inner peace is enough; there is no need to be overly attached to worldly matters.

sentences.zh: 信任對方就好，不必因小事而懷疑。
sentences.en: Trusting the other is enough without letting small matters lead to suspicion.

phrase.en: Buddha Land in the Human World

sentences.zh: 人們致力於將這座城市打造成為人間佛國，呈現出佛教的和平與慈悲精神。
sentences.en: People are committed to transforming this city into a Buddha Land in the Human World, showcasing the spirit of peace and compassion in Buddhism.

sentences.zh: 佛光山的建立是實現人間佛國理想的一部分，吸引了無數信徒前來參觀。
