phrase.zh: 你我有緣成伴侶 慈悲同心建家門
phrase.en: Affinity has brought you and I together as life companions; With compassion and unity let us build our family.

sentences.zh: 在這個神聖的日子裡，我們相信是佛法讓你我有緣成伴侶，慈悲同心建家門。
sentences.en: On this sacred day, we believe it is the Dharma that has brought us together as life companions; with compassion and unity, let us build our family.

sentences.zh: 經歷過重重困難，我們更加珍惜這段緣分，願你我有緣成伴侶，慈悲同心建家門。
sentences.en: Having overcome numerous difficulties, we cherish this bond even more, wishing that affinity has brought us together as life companions, with compassion and unity to build our family.

sentences.zh: 我們祈求佛祖的加持，讓你我有緣成伴侶，並以慈悲同心的精神來建設我們的家門。
sentences.en: We pray for the blessings of the Buddha, that affinity has brought us together as life companions, and that we may build our family with the spirit of compassion and unity.

sentences.zh: 在未來的日子裡，願我們不忘彼此的承諾，憑藉有緣的伴侶關係和慈悲同心的力量共同建家門。
sentences.en: In the days to come, may we never forget our promises to each other, relying on our bond of affinity as life companions and the strength of compassion and unity to build our family together.

phrase.zh: 你重要，他重要，我不重要
phrase.en: You're important, he's important, I'm not

sentences.zh: 在團隊中，每個人都認為你重要，他重要，我不重要，只是增加我的謙卑和對他人的尊重。
sentences.en: In the team, everyone thinks you're important, he's important, I'm not, which only adds to my humility and respect for others.

sentences.zh: 他們總是告訴我說你重要，他重要，我不重要，但我知道每個人都有自己的價值。
sentences.en: They always tell me you're important, he's important, I'm not, but I know everyone has their own value.

sentences.zh: 在禪修中，我感悟到你重要，他重要，我不重要的心態讓我放下自我，融入眾生。
sentences.en: In meditation, I realized that the mindset of you're important, he's important, I'm not allows me to let go of the self and merge with all beings.

sentences.zh: 當我聽到你說你重要，他重要，我不重要時，我被這種無我而謙卑的精神深深感動。
sentences.en: When I heard you say you're important, he's important, I'm not, I was deeply moved by this selfless and humble spirit.

sentences.zh: 這位使命副校長在南華大學中扮演著關鍵的管理角色，協助校長推動大學各項重要政策。
sentences.en: The Executive Vice President at Nanhua University plays a crucial administrative role, assisting the president in implementing key university policies.

sentences.zh: 使命副校長帶領一個團隊，加強大學與當地社區的合作關係，提升學校的社會影響力。
sentences.en: The Executive Vice President leads a team to strengthen the university's collaboration with the local community, enhancing the school's social impact.

sentences.zh: 作為南華大學的使命副校長，他致力於推動教學創新和學術卓越。
sentences.en: As the Executive Vice President of Nanhua University, he is committed to promoting teaching innovation and academic excellence.

sentences.zh: 她在擔任使命副校長時，成功地推動多個國際交流計劃，增進了學生的全球視野。
sentences.en: During her tenure as Executive Vice President, she successfully promoted several international exchange programs, broadening students' global perspectives.

sentences.zh: 他們相信自己的相遇是來生緣，故而承諾無論多少世也要在一起。
sentences.en: They believe their encounter is due to affinities in future lives, and thus they promised to be together no matter how many lifetimes it takes.

sentences.zh: 法師解釋說，來生緣是由當下的因緣所構成的因果關係。
sentences.en: The master explained that affinities in future lives are created by the karma of current circumstances.

sentences.zh: 理解來生緣可以幫助我們在今生中培養更有意義的關係。
sentences.en: Understanding affinities in future lives can help us cultivate more meaningful relationships in this life.

sentences.zh: 在佛教中，深入了解來生緣有助於增強對生命轉變的洞察。
sentences.en: In Buddhism, a deep understanding of affinities in future lives enhances insight into the transitions of life.

sentences.zh: 在佛堂內，信徒們將新鮮的水果放在祭壇上作為供果，以表達他們的敬意。
sentences.en: In the temple, devotees place fresh fruits on the altar as a fruit offering to express their reverence.

sentences.zh: 每逢節日，家庭會準備各式各樣的供果獻給佛菩薩，祈求平安順遂。
sentences.en: During festivals, families prepare a variety of fruit offerings to present to the Buddhas and Bodhisattvas, praying for peace and prosperity.

sentences.zh: 住持特別強調供果不僅要新鮮，還要整齊擺放以示心意的誠摯。
sentences.en: The abbot emphasized that fruit offerings should not only be fresh but also neatly arranged to reflect the sincerity of the intention.

sentences.zh: 供果的選擇通常包含蘋果、香蕉和葡萄，因為這些水果象徵著吉祥和豐收。
sentences.en: The selection of fruit offerings typically includes apples, bananas, and grapes as these fruits symbolize auspiciousness and abundance.

sentences.zh: 在佛教儀式中，供水被視為一種純潔和恭敬的象徵。
sentences.en: In Buddhist rituals, water offering is regarded as a symbol of purity and reverence.

sentences.zh: 每天早晨，寺廟的僧侶們都會進行供水儀式，以祈求和平與安寧。
sentences.en: Every morning, monks at the temple perform the water offering ceremony to pray for peace and tranquility.

sentences.zh: 供水是一個簡單但意義深遠的行為，象徵著對三寶的尊敬。
sentences.en: Water offering is a simple yet profoundly meaningful act, symbolizing respect for the Three Jewels.

sentences.zh: 她學會了如何進行正確的供水儀式，以便在特殊的佛教節日中貢獻自己的心意。
sentences.en: She learned how to perform the water offering ceremony correctly, so she could contribute her devotion during special Buddhist festivals.

sentences.zh: 每逢法會，寺廟都會準備大量的供眾以饗信徒。
sentences.en: During every Dharma assembly, the temple prepares a large offering for the assembly to honor the devotees.

sentences.zh: 擔心食物不足，他們提前安排了充足的供眾。
sentences.en: Worried about a shortage of food, they arranged ample offering for the assembly in advance.

sentences.zh: 這個供眾象徵著對所有僧眾的尊敬與支持。
sentences.en: This offering for the assembly symbolizes respect and support for all the monks.

sentences.zh: 信徒們慷慨解囊，為此次法會捐獻了大量供眾。
sentences.en: The devotees generously contributed a large offering for the assembly at this Dharma event.

sentences.zh: 佛教徒常常在寺廟裡供養鮮花和水果作為敬奉。
sentences.en: Buddhists often make offerings of fresh flowers and fruits at the temple as a form of worship.

sentences.zh: 在法會期間，信徒們將各種食物供養給僧侶以表達尊敬。
sentences.en: During the Dharma assembly, devotees make offerings of various foods to the monks to show respect.

sentences.zh: 我們應該以真誠的心來供養佛、法、僧三寶。
sentences.en: We should make offerings to the Three Jewels—Buddha, Dharma, and Sangha—with sincerity.

sentences.zh: 她決定每月供養一部分收入來支持慈善事業。
sentences.en: She decided to offer a portion of her monthly income to support charitable causes.

sentences.zh: 當我們以供養心來對待他人時，我們會自然地展現出慈悲與關懷。
sentences.en: When we approach others with a mind of offering, we naturally exhibit compassion and care.

sentences.zh: 修煉供養心可以幫助我們擺脫自私的習氣，培養更多的慈悲。
sentences.en: Cultivating a mind of offering can help us overcome selfish tendencies and develop greater compassion.

sentences.zh: 他的供養心表現在對社區不斷的支持和義工服務上。
sentences.en: His mind of offering is evident in his ongoing support and volunteer service in the community.

sentences.zh: 每天冥想時，他嘗試培養一顆供養心，以利他人的福祉。
sentences.en: During his daily meditation, he tries to cultivate a mind of offering for the welfare of others.

sentences.zh: 佛教徒常常依止於佛法，從中尋找人生的指引和智慧。
sentences.en: Buddhists often depend and rest upon the Dharma to seek guidance and wisdom in life.

sentences.zh: 在學習的旅程中，我們可以依止於智者的教誨，獲得成長。
sentences.en: In our journey of learning, we can depend and rest upon the teachings of the wise to gain growth.

sentences.zh: 草木依止於陽光和雨水，才能茁壯成長。
sentences.en: Plants depend and rest upon sunlight and rain in order to thrive.

sentences.zh: 在困難時期，她依止於朋友的支持，度過了重重難關。
sentences.en: During difficult times, she depended and rested upon the support of her friends to overcome challenges.

sentences.zh: 他的信仰幫助他克服了生活中的種種困難。
sentences.en: His faith helped him overcome various difficulties in life.

sentences.zh: 儘管有許多挑戰，她對佛法的信仰從未減少。
sentences.en: Despite many challenges, her faith in Buddhism never waned.

sentences.zh: 一個人的信仰可以成為他內心的強大支柱。
sentences.en: A person's faith can become a strong pillar within their heart.

sentences.zh: 信仰不僅僅是信念，它還是一種生活方式。
sentences.en: Faith is not just a belief; it is also a way of life.

sentences.zh: 這位佛教信徒每天都誠心禮佛，參加寺廟的所有活動。
sentences.en: This Buddhist devotee pays homage to Buddha every day and participates in all the temple activities.

sentences.zh: 作為一名虔誠的信徒，他經常在冥想中找到平靜和智慧。
sentences.en: As a devoted follower, he often finds peace and wisdom in meditation.

sentences.zh: 教堂裡聚集的信徒們一起吟唱聖歌，氣氛莊嚴而祥和。
sentences.en: The devotees gathered in the church, collectively chanting hymns, creating an atmosphere that was solemn and serene.

sentences.zh: 這位信徒決定跟隨師父的腳步，踏上修行之旅。
sentences.en: This devotee decided to follow in the footsteps of his master and embark on a journey of spiritual practice.

sentences.zh: 信徒中心 (覺華園) 提供了各種靜修和禪修課程，吸引了許多修行者前來參加。
sentences.en: The Reception Center offers various retreats and meditation courses, attracting many practitioners to participate.

sentences.zh: 我們在信徒中心 (覺華園) 體驗到深刻的寧靜和內心的平和。
sentences.en: We experienced profound tranquility and inner peace at the Reception Center.

sentences.zh: 信徒中心 (覺華園) 的工作人員總是親切友善，願意幫助每一位前來的人。
sentences.en: The staff at the Reception Center are always kind and willing to assist every visitor.

sentences.zh: 在信徒中心 (覺華園) 的那段時光，讓我對生命有了全新的見解。
sentences.en: The time spent at the Reception Center gave me a whole new perspective on life.

sentences.zh: 在寺廟的信徒服務中心，志工們熱心回答訪客的所有問題。
sentences.en: At the temple's reception center, volunteers enthusiastically answered all visitors' questions.

sentences.zh: 信徒服務中心提供各種資源，幫助人們深入了解佛教教義。
sentences.en: The reception center provides various resources to help people gain a deeper understanding of Buddhist teachings.

sentences.zh: 訪客可以在信徒服務中心找到有關即將舉行的法會和活動的資訊。
sentences.en: Visitors can find information about upcoming ceremonies and events at the reception center.

sentences.zh: 信徒服務中心每天都有專人值班，以確保能即時協助到場的信眾。
sentences.en: There are staff on duty at the reception center every day to ensure timely assistance for attendees.

sentences.zh: 每年的信徒講習會都會吸引眾多來自各地的信眾，共同學習和交流佛法。
sentences.en: The annual devotee seminar attracts many followers from various regions to learn and exchange Buddhist teachings.

sentences.zh: 這次信徒講習會的主題是如何在日常生活中實踐慈悲與智慧。
sentences.en: The theme of this year's devotee seminar is how to practice compassion and wisdom in daily life.

sentences.zh: 信徒講習會上，法師為大家安排了多場生動的佛學講座。
sentences.en: During the devotee seminar, the master organized several engaging Buddhist lectures for everyone.

sentences.zh: 許多初學者在信徒講習會中找到了解答他們內心問題的啟示。
sentences.en: Many beginners found insights to resolve their inner questions at the devotee seminar.

sentences.zh: 每年的信徒香會，眾多信徒會聚集在寺廟中，參加祈禱和法會。
sentences.en: Every year at the devotees' gathering, many devotees congregate at the temple to participate in prayers and ceremonies.

sentences.zh: 信徒香會是一個增進信仰和社區聯繫的重要活動，吸引了來自各地的人們。
sentences.en: The devotees' gathering is an important event for strengthening faith and community bonds, attracting people from various places.

sentences.zh: 這次信徒香會特別邀請了知名法師來主持，讓參與者感到既榮幸又滿足。
sentences.en: This devotees' gathering specially invited a renowned master to lead, making participants feel both honored and fulfilled.

sentences.zh: 在信徒香會期間，大家一起點燃香火，虔心祈願和平與健康。
sentences.en: During the devotees' gathering, everyone lights incense together, sincerely praying for peace and health.

sentences.zh: 在面臨困境時，保持信心是克服挑戰的關鍵。
sentences.en: Maintaining faith in times of adversity is key to overcoming challenges.

sentences.zh: 對佛法的信心讓他能夠和平地面對生活中的起伏。
sentences.en: His faith in the Dharma allows him to face the ups and downs of life peacefully.

sentences.zh: 她對未來充滿了信心，相信努力最終會帶來好結果。
sentences.en: She is full of faith in the future, believing that hard work will eventually bring good results.

sentences.zh: 信心不僅來自於外在的支撐，也源於內心的堅定。
sentences.en: Faith not only comes from external support but also stems from inner conviction.

sentences.zh: 在修行中，信心門是一個重要的起點，它引領修行者進入更深層次的悟道。
sentences.en: In practice, the Gate of Faith is a crucial starting point, guiding practitioners into deeper realms of enlightenment.

sentences.zh: 當我們面對困難時，通過信心門可以獲得力量和勇氣，保持堅定的信念。
sentences.en: When facing difficulties, passing through the Gate of Faith grants us strength and courage to maintain steadfast belief.

sentences.zh: 信心門象徵著靈性旅程中的一個轉折點，從此走向對佛法更深的理解。
sentences.en: The Gate of Faith symbolizes a turning point in the spiritual journey, leading to a deeper understanding of Dharma.

sentences.zh: 許多人通過信心門體會到了身心的安寧，從而獲得了持久的平和。
sentences.en: Many find peace of mind and body through the Gate of Faith, gaining lasting serenity.

sentences.zh: 他的信念是助人為樂，他一直在慈善機構做志工。
sentences.en: His belief is in helping others, and he has been volunteering at charity organizations.

sentences.zh: 信念能夠驅使人們在困難時保持堅持不懈。
sentences.en: Belief can drive people to remain persistent in times of difficulty.

sentences.zh: 她的宗教信念深深影響了她的生活方式。
sentences.en: Her religious beliefs profoundly influenced her way of life.

sentences.zh: 孩子們從父母那裡獲得基本的道德信念。
sentences.en: Children acquire their basic moral beliefs from their parents.

phrase.en: Faith Is the Root of the Way

sentences.zh: 在佛教中，信為道本，是修行的基礎。
sentences.en: In Buddhism, faith is the root of the way, serving as the foundation of practice.

sentences.zh: 無論面對多少挫折，她始終堅信信為道本，從不動搖。
sentences.en: No matter how many setbacks she faced, she always believed that faith is the root of the way, never wavering.

sentences.zh: 信為道本，如樹之根，使一切修行得以堅固成長。
sentences.en: Faith is the root of the way, like the roots of a tree, allowing all practices to grow strong and firm.

sentences.zh: 老師常教導我們，信為道本，信心能夠引領我們渡過一切困難。
sentences.en: The teacher often told us, faith is the root of the way, and belief can lead us through all difficulties.

sentences.zh: 信眾監院負責管理寺廟的活動，確保所有信眾得到妥善的照顧。
sentences.en: The Devotee Services Department is responsible for managing temple activities, ensuring that all devotees are properly cared for.

sentences.zh: 每月一次，信眾監院會召開會議，聽取信眾的反饋和意見。
sentences.en: Once a month, the Devotee Services Department holds a meeting to gather feedback and opinions from the devotees.

sentences.zh: 信眾監院正在招募志願者，希望能夠為更多的信眾提供服務。
sentences.en: The Devotee Services Department is recruiting volunteers to provide services to more devotees.

sentences.zh: 對於寺廟活動的安排和運作，信眾監院一直扮演著關鍵的角色。
sentences.en: The Devotee Services Department has always played a crucial role in the organization and operation of temple events.

sentences.zh: 在他的領導下，團隊秉持著信義和平的精神，共同努力解決矛盾。
sentences.en: Under his leadership, the team upheld the spirit of righteousness and peace, working together to resolve conflicts.

sentences.zh: 這位傳教士以信義和平的價值觀在社區中推動交流與理解。
sentences.en: The missionary promoted dialogue and understanding in the community with the values of righteousness and peace.

sentences.zh: 她的演講以信義和平為核心，呼籲人們放下仇恨，走向和解。
sentences.en: Her speech centered on righteousness and peace, urging people to let go of hatred and move towards reconciliation.

sentences.zh: 信義和平這一概念在佛教的教義中深受尊重，強調個人德行與社會和諧。
sentences.en: The concept of righteousness and peace is deeply respected in Buddhist teachings, emphasizing personal virtue and social harmony.

phrase.zh: 信解行證; 1. 信 2. 解 3. 行 4. 證
phrase.en: Four Stages of Practice: 1. faith; 2. understanding; 3. practice; 4. realization

sentences.zh: 佛教修行者應該首先具備信仰，在信的基礎上才能建立正確的解。
sentences.en: A practitioner of Buddhism must first have faith, on which the foundation of correct understanding is built.

sentences.zh: 解階段要求修行者深入理解教義，為實踐作準備。
sentences.en: The stage of understanding requires practitioners to deeply comprehend the teachings in preparation for practice.

sentences.zh: 只有通過不斷的行，才能將理論付諸實踐，達到內心的提升。
sentences.en: Only through continuous practice can one put theory into practice and achieve inner elevation.

sentences.zh: 證階段是對前面所有努力的實證，代表著終極目的的實現。
sentences.en: The stage of realization is the validation of all prior efforts, representing the attainment of the ultimate goal.

sentences.zh: 在佛教修行中，信願行三者密不可分，缺一不可。
sentences.en: In Buddhist practice, faith, vow, and practice are inseparable and indispensable.

sentences.zh: 他的信願行非常堅定，每日都會抽時間進行禪修。
sentences.en: His faith, vow, and practice are very steadfast, and he takes time every day for meditation.

sentences.zh: 信願行的堅固能引導修行者達到解脫和覺悟。
sentences.en: The solid foundation of faith, vow, and practice can guide a practitioner to liberation and enlightenment.

sentences.zh: 她將信願行作為人生的指導原則，從不動搖。
sentences.en: She regards faith, vow, and practice as her guiding principles in life, never wavering.

sentences.zh: 修行是靈性成長的重要部分，每日的冥想是其中一種方式。
sentences.en: Cultivation is an important part of spiritual growth, and daily meditation is one of the ways to achieve it.

sentences.zh: 佛教強調內心的修養，以達到內心的平和與幸福。
sentences.en: Buddhism emphasizes inner cultivation in order to achieve peace and happiness within.

sentences.zh: 農夫辛勤耕耘，好比佛教修行者的修心之道。
sentences.en: The farmer's diligent cultivation is akin to a Buddhist practitioner's path of cultivating the mind.

sentences.zh: 修自己的德行，能夠影響周圍的人和社會。
sentences.en: Cultivating one's own virtues can have a positive impact on those around you and society as a whole.

phrase.zh: 修到萬緣少 悟來半句多
phrase.en: Cultivation makes boundless affinities insufficient; Attainment makes even half a sentence redundant.

sentences.zh: 他在修行的過程中，慢慢明白了修到萬緣少，悟來半句多的道理。
sentences.en: Through his spiritual practice, he gradually understood that cultivation makes boundless affinities insufficient; attainment makes even half a sentence redundant.

sentences.zh: 在禪修中，他體會到修到萬緣少，悟來半句多的深意，寧靜地面對生活。
sentences.en: During meditation, he grasped the deep meaning of 'cultivation makes boundless affinities insufficient; attainment makes even half a sentence redundant,' and faced life with serenity.

sentences.zh: 老師常說，修到萬緣少，悟來半句多，真正的智慧在於簡單和自然。
sentences.en: The teacher often said that 'cultivation makes boundless affinities insufficient; attainment makes even half a sentence redundant,' emphasizing that true wisdom lies in simplicity and naturalness.

sentences.zh: 這句話，修到萬緣少，悟來半句多，讓他在繁忙的工作中找到了一種內心的平衡。
sentences.en: This saying, 'cultivation makes boundless affinities insufficient; attainment makes even half a sentence redundant,' helped him find inner balance amidst his busy work life.

sentences.zh: 修心是佛教修行的重要一環，通過觀察和調整自己的心念來提升自我。
sentences.en: Cultivating the mind is an essential part of Buddhist practice, involving the observation and adjustment of one's own thoughts to achieve self-improvement.

sentences.zh: 透過修心，她變得更加平和和有耐心，能夠更好處理生活中的挑戰。
sentences.en: Through cultivating the mind, she has become more peaceful and patient, better equipped to handle life's challenges.

sentences.zh: 修心不僅是個人的修行，也是影響他人和諧的力量來源。
sentences.en: Cultivating the mind is not only a personal practice but also a source of power that influences harmony among others.

sentences.zh: 修心的過程需要持續的努力和自我反省，才能獲得真正的智慧和內心的安寧。
sentences.en: The process of cultivating the mind requires continuous effort and self-reflection in order to attain true wisdom and inner peace.

phrase.en: to attain spiritual progress through the right path

sentences.zh: 他多年來潛心修行，終於修成正果，達到了心靈的平和與滿足。
sentences.en: After years of devoted practice, he finally attained spiritual progress through the right path, achieving peace and fulfillment in his heart.

sentences.zh: 許多佛教徒努力修行，期望能在此生中修成正果。
sentences.en: Many Buddhists strive diligently in their practice, hoping to attain spiritual progress through the right path in this lifetime.

sentences.zh: 修成正果並非一朝一夕的事，需要持之以恆的努力和正確的引導。
sentences.en: Attaining spiritual progress through the right path is not a matter of days; it requires consistent effort and correct guidance.

sentences.zh: 她跟隨師父多年，終於修成正果，獲得了更多的內在智慧。
sentences.en: After following her master's teachings for many years, she finally attained spiritual progress through the right path and gained more inner wisdom.

sentences.zh: 修持佛法需要長時間的堅持和不斷地反思。
sentences.en: Practicing the Dharma requires long-term perseverance and constant reflection.

sentences.zh: 他的修持讓他在生活中獲得了極大的平靜和快樂。
sentences.en: His practice has brought him immense peace and happiness in life.

sentences.zh: 通過修持禪定，他逐漸能夠控制自己的情緒波動。
sentences.en: Through meditation practice, he gradually gained control over his emotional fluctuations.

sentences.zh: 修持慈悲心是學佛者的重要功課，它能改善我們與他人的關係。
sentences.en: Practicing compassion is a crucial task for Buddhist learners as it improves our relationships with others.

sentences.zh: 在佛法中，修行的真義不僅僅是表面的儀式，而是內心的淨化和智慧的增長。
sentences.en: In Buddhism, the essence of practice is not merely about rituals, but about the purification of the mind and the growth of wisdom.

sentences.zh: 導師強調修行的真義在於真實地面對自己的內心，並尋求持續的內在和平。
sentences.en: The teacher emphasizes that the essence of practice lies in truly confronting one's own mind and seeking continuous inner peace.

sentences.zh: 她每日冥想，試圖更深入地理解修行的真義，並將其融入日常生活。
sentences.en: She meditates daily, attempting to gain a deeper understanding of the essence of practice and integrate it into her daily life.

sentences.zh: 修行的真義不是逃避現實，而是學習如何在每個當下找到真正的自由。
sentences.en: The essence of practice is not about escaping reality, but learning how to find true freedom in every moment.

sentences.zh: 這位修道者每天誦經修行，心無旁騖。
sentences.en: This practitioner chants sutras and practices diligently every day, without distraction.

sentences.zh: 作為一名修道者，他對傳統佛教經典有著深入的研究和理解。
sentences.en: As a practitioner, he has a deep study and understanding of the traditional Buddhist scriptures.

sentences.zh: 修道者經常在靜處冥想，以求得內心的平靜與智慧。
sentences.en: Practitioners often meditate in quiet places to seek inner peace and wisdom.

sentences.zh: 這位年輕的修道者已經在佛壇上修行了十年。
sentences.en: The young practitioner has been practicing on the Buddhist altar for ten years.

sentences.zh: 每一位修道人都渴望達到內心的寧靜與智慧的覺醒。
sentences.en: Every spiritual practitioner yearns to attain inner peace and the awakening of wisdom.

sentences.zh: 修道人的日常修行包括打坐、誦經，以及參與寺院的法會活動。
sentences.en: The daily practice of a spiritual practitioner includes meditation, scripture chanting, and participating in monastery rituals.

sentences.zh: 作為一名修道人，他們需要時時刻刻保持對其他眾生的慈悲和仁愛。
sentences.en: As a spiritual practitioner, they need to constantly maintain compassion and benevolence towards all beings.

sentences.zh: 每一位修道人都會面臨挑戰，但這些挑戰使他們在精神修養的道路上更加堅定。
sentences.en: Every spiritual practitioner faces challenges, but these trials make them more steadfast on their path of spiritual cultivation.

sentences.zh: 修行者追求俱解脫，希望在身心兩方面都達到解放和平靜。
sentences.en: Practitioners pursue simultaneous liberation, aiming to achieve freedom and peace both physically and mentally.

sentences.zh: 俱解脫是佛教中一種理想的修行境界，象徵著完全的智慧與慈悲。
sentences.en: Simultaneous liberation is an ideal state of practice in Buddhism, symbolizing complete wisdom and compassion.

sentences.zh: 在俱解脫的境界中，人心不再受到執著和煩惱的束縛。
sentences.en: In the state of simultaneous liberation, the human mind is no longer bound by attachments and afflictions.

sentences.zh: 禪修的最終目的是達到俱解脫，從而實現真正的自在與解脫。
sentences.en: The ultimate goal of meditation is to achieve simultaneous liberation, thereby realizing true freedom and liberation.

sentences.zh: 作為候補宗委，他隨時準備接替正選宗委的職責。
sentences.en: As an alternate board member, he is constantly prepared to take over the responsibilities of a regular board member.

sentences.zh: 這位候補宗委在會議中提供了寶貴的建議，促進了討論的深入。
sentences.en: The alternate board member provided valuable insights during the meeting, facilitating deeper discussions.

sentences.zh: 儘管是候補宗委，他在董事會內部仍保持積極的參與。
sentences.en: Despite being an alternate board member, he remains actively involved within the board.

sentences.zh: 候補宗委可能隨時需要代替無法出席的常任委員。
sentences.en: The alternate board member may be required to step in for an absent regular member at any time.

sentences.zh: 這個世界如夢如幻，佛教教導我們應該了解一切現象都是假有。
sentences.en: This world is like a dream, an illusion; Buddhism teaches us to understand that all phenomena are of nominal existence.

sentences.zh: 事物的真實本質在於空性，所謂的假有只是暫時的顯現。
sentences.en: The true nature of things lies in emptiness, and what we call nominal existence is merely a temporary manifestation.

sentences.zh: 修行者應該認識到我執和法執皆是出於假有的執念。
sentences.en: Practitioners should realize that clinging to self and dharmas arises from attachment to nominal existence.

sentences.zh: 透過禪修，我們可以超越假有，體驗到一切萬法的本來面目。
sentences.en: Through meditation, we can transcend nominal existence and experience the true nature of all phenomena.

sentences.zh: 眾生常常被假相迷惑，而看不清事物的本質。
sentences.en: Beings are often confused by the nominal form and fail to see the true nature of things.

sentences.zh: 佛教教導我們要穿透假相，去體悟真正的實相。
sentences.en: Buddhism teaches us to penetrate the nominal form in order to realize the true reality.

sentences.zh: 一切現象都不過是假相，不可執著於外表。
sentences.en: All phenomena are merely nominal forms and one should not cling to appearances.

sentences.zh: 修行之道在於破除假相，達到心靈的超越。
sentences.en: The path of practice is to break through the nominal form and achieve transcendence of the mind.

sentences.zh: 偉大的佛陀教導我們慈悲和智慧，幫助眾生脫離苦海。
sentences.en: The Great Buddha teaches us compassion and wisdom, guiding all beings away from the ocean of suffering.

sentences.zh: 在這座寺廟中，我們可以感受到偉大的佛陀所賜予的平靜與安寧。
sentences.en: In this temple, we can feel the peace and tranquility bestowed by the Great Buddha.

sentences.zh: 學習偉大的佛陀所傳授的法門，可以讓我們在日常生活中修行佛法。
sentences.en: By learning the teachings of the Great Buddha, we can practice Buddhism in our everyday lives.

sentences.zh: 偉大的佛陀的一生充滿了啟發，成為信徒心中永恆的燈塔。
sentences.en: The life of the Great Buddha is full of inspiration, serving as an eternal beacon in the hearts of his followers.

phrase.en: for each day that I remain a monk, I will continue my duty in tolling the bell

sentences.zh: 他總是堅持著'做一日和尚，撞一日鐘'的態度，即使在逆境中也不放棄自己的責任。
sentences.en: He always held the attitude of 'for each day that I remain a monk, I will continue my duty in tolling the bell,' never abandoning his responsibilities even in adversity.

sentences.zh: 即使退休後，他依然遵循'做一日和尚，撞一日鐘'的原則，繼續服務於他的社區。
sentences.en: Even after retirement, he continued to adhere to the principle of 'for each day that I remain a monk, I will continue my duty in tolling the bell,' and kept serving his community.

sentences.zh: 在這個快速變遷的世界裡，她用'做一日和尚，撞一日鐘'的哲學維持著她的工作熱情和穩定性。
sentences.en: In this rapidly changing world, she maintained her workplace enthusiasm and stability by the philosophy of 'for each day that I remain a monk, I will continue my duty in tolling the bell.'

sentences.zh: 他的生活哲學就是'做一日和尚，撞一日鐘'，相信不論什麼時候都應履行自己的責任。
sentences.en: His life philosophy is 'for each day that I remain a monk, I will continue my duty in tolling the bell,' believing that one should always fulfill their responsibilities no matter the circumstances.

phrase.zh: 做人不能流芳百世，亦當遺臭萬年
phrase.en: one either leaves a good name for a hundred generations or leaves a bad reputation that will long be remembered

sentences.zh: 孔子教導我們修身齊家治國平天下，做人不能流芳百世，亦當遺臭萬年。
sentences.en: Confucius taught us to cultivate ourselves, manage our family, govern the state, and bring peace to the world; one either leaves a good name for a hundred generations or leaves a bad reputation that will long be remembered.

sentences.zh: 在商業活動中，誠信至關重要，否則做人不能流芳百世，亦當遺臭萬年。
sentences.en: In business activities, integrity is crucial; otherwise, one either leaves a good name for a hundred generations or leaves a bad reputation that will long be remembered.

sentences.zh: 一位領導者的決策應該考慮長遠影響，因為做人不能流芳百世，亦當遺臭萬年。
sentences.en: A leader's decision should consider long-term impacts, for one either leaves a good name for a hundred generations or leaves a bad reputation that will long be remembered.

sentences.zh: 在歷史的長河中，很多人物因其行為而名留青史，或是因為相反的原因而成為負面的典範，做人不能流芳百世，亦當遺臭萬年。
sentences.en: Throughout history, many figures are remembered for their deeds, either positively or negatively; one either leaves a good name for a hundred generations or leaves a bad reputation that will long be remembered.

sentences.zh: 讚美是社交的藝術，可以拉近人與人之間的距離。
sentences.en: Praise is an aptitude of socializing and can bring people closer together.

sentences.zh: 輕聲是文明的象徵，展現出對他人的尊重。
sentences.en: Gentleness is a sign of civilization, demonstrating respect for others.

sentences.zh: 微笑是人際的陽光，能夠化解緊張的氣氛。
sentences.en: Smiles are the sunshine of personal relations, capable of diffusing tense atmospheres.

sentences.zh: 誠信是做人的根本，是取得別人信任的不二法門。
sentences.en: Honesty is the basis of being human, the indispensable way to gain others' trust.

phrase.en: Play your role well and act like it

sentences.zh: 在這部話劇中，每個演員都必須做到做什麼要像什麼，才能成功地詮釋角色。
sentences.en: In this play, every actor must play their role well and act like it to successfully interpret their characters.

sentences.zh: 一位出色的老闆總是提醒他的員工，做什麼要像什麼，這樣他們才能在崗位上表現出色。
sentences.en: An excellent boss always reminds his employees to play their role well and act like it, so they can excel in their positions.

sentences.zh: 她在這次領導隊伍中，充分展示了做什麼要像什麼的重要性。
sentences.en: In leading the team this time, she fully demonstrated the importance of playing your role well and acting like it.

sentences.zh: 為了在比賽中脫穎而出，所有參賽者都被要求做什麼要像什麼，展示最佳狀態。
sentences.en: To stand out in the competition, all participants were required to play their role well and act like it, showcasing their best form.

sentences.zh: 在農曆新年期間，許多人會到廟裡做功德，祈求來年的平安與順遂。
sentences.en: During the Lunar New Year, many people go to temples to generate merits, seeking peace and smoothness in the coming year.

sentences.zh: 她每天都在社區服務中心做義工，希望通過做功德來積累福報。
sentences.en: She volunteers at the community service center every day, hoping to accumulate blessings by generating merits.

sentences.zh: 做功德不僅能幫助他人，也可以淨化自己的心靈。
sentences.en: Generating merits not only helps others but also purifies one's own mind.

sentences.zh: 佛教徒相信，做功德之後所獲得的善果能夠影響來世的命運。
sentences.en: Buddhists believe that the good fruits generated from merits can influence one's destiny in future lives.

phrase.zh: 做大事要有魄力 做小事要有細心 做難事要肯忍耐 做善事要有恆心
phrase.en: Accomplish great things with boldness, Tend to details with attentiveness, Confront challenges with patience, Conduct charitable deeds with determination.

sentences.zh: 做大事要有魄力，不然容易被困難打敗。
sentences.en: Accomplish great things with boldness, or you may be easily defeated by obstacles.

sentences.zh: 做小事要有細心，否則可能會出錯。
sentences.en: Tend to details with attentiveness, otherwise mistakes may occur.

sentences.zh: 做難事要肯忍耐，因為耐心是成功的關鍵。
sentences.en: Confront challenges with patience, as patience is the key to success.

sentences.zh: 做善事要有恆心，這才是真正的慈悲。
sentences.en: Conduct charitable deeds with determination, as this is true compassion.

sentences.zh: 在他的生活中，做好事成為了一種習慣，他總是樂於幫助那些有需要的人。
sentences.en: Doing good deeds has become a habit in his life; he is always willing to help those in need.

sentences.zh: 她相信，做好事可以帶來內心的平靜與快樂，因此她經常參加義工活動。
sentences.en: She believes that doing good deeds can bring inner peace and happiness, hence she often participates in volunteer activities.

sentences.zh: 父母從小就教導他們的孩子要常做好事，因為這能夠累積善因。
sentences.en: The parents taught their children from a young age to always do good deeds, as it can accumulate good karma.

sentences.zh: 做好事不僅能幫助別人，還能增強自己的道德價值觀。
sentences.en: Doing good deeds not only helps others but also strengthens one's own moral values.

phrase.en: The One Who Helps You Succeed Is Yourself

sentences.zh: 在面對困境時，她總是提醒自己：做己貴人，努力才是成功的關鍵。
sentences.en: When facing difficulties, she always reminds herself: the one who helps you succeed is yourself, and hard work is the key to success.

sentences.zh: 他相信‘做己貴人’的哲學，認為自己的命運應由自己掌控。
sentences.en: He believes in the philosophy that 'the one who helps you succeed is yourself,' thinking that one's destiny should be controlled by oneself.

sentences.zh: 透過自我反省與學習，她真正理解到‘做己貴人’的重要性。
sentences.en: Through self-reflection and learning, she truly understands the importance of 'the one who helps you succeed is yourself.'

sentences.zh: 告訴自己，做己貴人，便能在每一步中獲得成長和成功。
sentences.en: By telling yourself that the one who helps you succeed is yourself, you can achieve growth and success in every step.

phrase.zh: 做己貴人 努力向上
phrase.en: Be Your Own Mentor, and Strive Forward Zealously

sentences.zh: 他堅信做己貴人的重要性，努力向上，不斷提升自己的能力。
sentences.en: He firmly believes in the importance of being his own mentor, striving forward ceaselessly to enhance his abilities.

sentences.zh: 在逆境中，她選擇做己貴人，努力向上，不斷追求更高的目標。
sentences.en: In adversity, she chose to be her own mentor, striving forward and constantly pursuing higher goals.

sentences.zh: 做己貴人，努力向上，他在職場上贏得了大家的尊敬和高度評價。
sentences.en: By being his own mentor and striving forward, he earned respect and high praise in the workplace.

sentences.zh: 做己貴人並努力向上是他成功的座右銘，時刻指引著他的方向。
sentences.en: Being his own mentor and striving forward is the motto of his success, always guiding his path.

phrase.zh: 做己貴人 希望在前
phrase.en: Be Your Own Mentor, and Hope Lies Right Ahead

sentences.zh: 當面臨逆境時，做己貴人，希望在前，這使得他能夠看見未來的光明。
sentences.en: In the face of adversity, he chose to be his own mentor, and hope lies right ahead, allowing him to see the brightness in the future.

sentences.zh: 佛教教導我們，依靠內在的智慧做己貴人，才能使希望在前，步步踏實。
sentences.en: Buddhism teaches us that by relying on our inner wisdom to be our own mentor, hope lies right ahead, guiding us to walk every step firmly.

sentences.zh: 她相信做己貴人，希望在前，這種信念給予她巨大的力量。
sentences.en: She believes in being her own mentor, and with this hope lies right ahead, giving her immense strength.

sentences.zh: 他們以做己貴人的心態面對挑戰，希望在前，有朝一日能成就理想。
sentences.en: They approached challenges with the mindset of being their own mentors, and with hope lying right ahead, someday they will achieve their dreams.

phrase.zh: 做己貴人 捨我其誰
phrase.en: The One Who Helps You Succeed Is Yourself; Who Else but Me?

sentences.zh: 成功的祕訣在於做己貴人，捨我其誰，唯有自己才能夠帶來持久的改變。
sentences.en: The secret to success lies in being the one who helps yourself succeed; who else but me? Only you can bring about lasting change.

sentences.zh: 在面對挑戰時，我告訴自己，做己貴人 捨我其誰，鼓勵自己勇敢前行。
sentences.en: When facing challenges, I remind myself: the one who helps you succeed is yourself; who else but me? This encouragement empowers me to move forward bravely.

sentences.zh: 她常常對自己的學生說：『要相信做己貴人，捨我其誰的道理，這樣你們才能夠獲得真正的成長。』
sentences.en: She often tells her students, 'Believe in being the one who helps you succeed; who else but me? Only then can you truly grow.'

sentences.zh: 人生的道路上，做己貴人 捨我其誰的信念能夠讓我們克服任何阻礙。
sentences.en: On the journey of life, the belief that the one who helps you succeed is yourself; who else but me, can help us overcome any obstacle.

sentences.zh: 寺廟每年都會為已故的信眾做法會，以祈求他們的靈魂早日得到安息。
sentences.en: The temple holds a Dharma service every year for deceased devotees, praying for their souls to attain peace soon.

sentences.zh: 在法會上，他們唱誦經文，並祈願世界和平。
sentences.en: During the Dharma service, they chant scriptures and pray for world peace.

sentences.zh: 佛學團體計畫在下個月做法會，以慶祝佛陀的誕辰。
sentences.en: The Buddhist group plans to hold a Dharma service next month to celebrate the Buddha’s birthday.

sentences.zh: 許多人來參加做法會，以尋求內心的寧靜和精神的指導。
sentences.en: Many people attend the Dharma service to seek inner peace and spiritual guidance.

phrase.en: to practice without a vow is an aimless gesture

sentences.zh: 佛陀教誨我們，作福無願，無所標立，終究無法到達解脫的彼岸。
sentences.en: The Buddha taught us that to practice without a vow is an aimless gesture, and ultimately cannot lead to liberation.

sentences.zh: 禪修若無願力指引，則如碌碌無為，正是作福無願，無所標立。
sentences.en: Meditation without the guidance of a vow is like aimless routine, which is to practice without a vow and is an aimless gesture.

sentences.zh: 他每天念經，但作福無願，無所標立，心中始終感到空虛。
sentences.en: He recites sutras daily, but to practice without a vow is an aimless gesture, leaving him feeling empty inside.

sentences.zh: 大乘佛教強調願力的重要性，避免作福無願，無所標立的情形發生。
sentences.en: Mahayana Buddhism emphasizes the importance of vows to avoid the situation where to practice without a vow is an aimless gesture.

phrase.zh: 做難做之事 處難處之人
phrase.en: Do the undoable; Treat the untreatable.

sentences.zh: 修行者須時刻準備做難做之事，處難處之人，以證明其慈悲與忍耐。
sentences.en: A practitioner must constantly be prepared to do the undoable and treat the untreatable, to demonstrate their compassion and patience.

sentences.zh: 在菩薩道上，願力使人能做難做之事，處難處之人，因為這是修行的一部分。
sentences.en: On the Bodhisattva path, vows empower one to do the undoable and treat the untreatable, as it is part of spiritual practice.

sentences.zh: 老師總是教導我們要勇敢面對挑戰，甚至要做難做之事，處難處之人。
sentences.en: The teacher always encourages us to bravely face challenges, even to do the undoable and treat the untreatable.

sentences.zh: 外交官的職責常包括做難做之事，處難處之人，以促進國際和諧。
sentences.en: The duties of a diplomat often include doing the undoable and treating the untreatable, to promote international harmony.

sentences.zh: 他在學術界取得的成就使他成為眾多學生的偶像，他們紛紛以他為榜樣。
sentences.en: His achievements in academia have made him a role model for many students, who look up to him as their idol.

sentences.zh: 這位歌手的音樂風格獨具特色，使她成為年輕人的偶像。
sentences.en: The singer's unique style of music has made her an idol among the youth.

sentences.zh: 許多運動員將這位奧運冠軍視為偶像，努力追隨他的腳步。
sentences.en: Many athletes regard this Olympic champion as their role model, striving to follow in his footsteps.

sentences.zh: 他偶像般的魅力和人格激勵著許多人改變自己的生活方式。
sentences.en: His idol-like charisma and personality inspire many to change their lifestyles.

phrase.zh: 傳家有道唯忠厚 處世無奇但率真
phrase.en: The family legacy that endures is loyalty and honesty; Remain genuine despite the world's atrocities.

sentences.zh: 他堅信傳家有道唯忠厚，因此他總是以誠實和信任對待家中的每一個成員。
sentences.en: He firmly believes that the family legacy that endures is loyalty and honesty, hence he always treats every member of the family with sincerity and trust.

sentences.zh: 面對困境，她不改其心，因為她知道處世無奇但率真才是她最大的力量。
sentences.en: Faced with adversities, she remained steadfast because she knew that remaining genuine despite the world's atrocities was her greatest strength.

sentences.zh: 他的家訓是傳家有道唯忠厚，所以他的孩子們從小就被教導要做誠信的好人。
sentences.en: His family motto is that the family legacy that endures is loyalty and honesty, so his children were taught from a young age to be people of integrity.

sentences.zh: 即便社會風潮不斷變遷，她始終堅持處世無奇但率真，用最純樸的心面對每一次挑戰。
sentences.en: Even as societal trends kept changing, she consistently remained genuine despite the world's atrocities, facing every challenge with the purest of hearts.

sentences.zh: 寺廟每年舉行的傳戒儀式吸引了許多信徒前來參加，許多人在此莊嚴的儀式中接受了新的戒律。
sentences.en: The annual conferral of precepts ceremony at the temple attracts many devotees, with many taking on new precepts during this solemn ritual.

sentences.zh: 師父親自主持了這次的傳戒，並為新僧授予了僧人的戒律以示信仰的承諾。
sentences.en: The master personally officiated the conferral of precepts, bestowing monastic precepts on new monks as a commitment to the faith.

sentences.zh: 在佛教中，接受傳戒是一個重要的步驟，代表著個人對持戒生活的追求。
sentences.en: In Buddhism, receiving the conferral of precepts is an important step, symbolizing an individual's pursuit of a life of observance.

sentences.zh: 她在去年的傳戒儀式上感受到了一種全新的責任感，這讓她更加專注於修行。
sentences.en: During last year's conferral of precepts ceremony, she felt a newfound sense of responsibility, which deepened her focus on practice.

sentences.zh: 這座寺廟有著悠久的佛法傳承，其歷史可以追溯至唐朝。
sentences.en: This temple has a long-standing Buddhist lineage, with history tracing back to the Tang Dynasty.

sentences.zh: 禪宗的傳承在不同的佛教派系中有著各自的表現方式。
sentences.en: The lineage of Zen manifests in different forms within various Buddhist sects.

sentences.zh: 他對師門的傳承充滿敬意，努力將其傳遞給下一代。
sentences.en: He holds deep respect for his master's lineage, striving to pass it on to the next generation.

sentences.zh: 在學習中理解傳承的重要性，可以激勵學生更加專注於修行。
sentences.en: Understanding the importance of lineage in study can inspire students to focus more on their practice.

sentences.zh: 他的夢想是成為一位能夠傳法的和尚，為眾生帶來智慧與慈悲。
sentences.en: His dream is to become a monk who can perform Dharma transmission, bringing wisdom and compassion to all beings.

sentences.zh: 禪宗的傳法過程非常重視師徒之間的直接心靈溝通。
sentences.en: The process of Dharma transmission in Zen Buddhism places great emphasis on the direct spiritual communication between master and disciple.

sentences.zh: 寺院舉行了隆重的儀式，慶祝新住持的傳法儀式。
sentences.en: The temple held a grand ceremony to celebrate the new abbot's Dharma transmission.

sentences.zh: 雖然他從未正式接受過傳法，他仍然透過教義的實踐影響著他人。
sentences.en: Even though he has never formally received Dharma transmission, he still influences others through the practice of teachings.

sentences.zh: 在禪宗的歷史中，傳燈象徵著心法的傳承與延續。
sentences.en: In the history of Zen Buddhism, handing down the light symbolizes the inheritance and continuation of the mind's teachings.

sentences.zh: 老師傳燈，把知識和智慧傳遞給下一代學生。
sentences.en: The teacher is handing down the light, passing on knowledge and wisdom to the next generation of students.

sentences.zh: 佛教徒相信，透過不斷的傳燈，他們保持佛法的純粹與光明。
sentences.en: Buddhists believe that by continually handing down the light, they maintain the purity and brightness of the Dharma.

sentences.zh: 每年寺廟舉行的傳燈儀式，提醒人們不忘先祖的智慧。
sentences.en: The annual handing down the light ceremony in the temple reminds people not to forget the wisdom of their ancestors.

phrase.en: Handing Down the Light: The Biography of Venerable Hsing Yun

sentences.zh: 在《傳燈──星雲大師傳》中，我們可以了解到星雲大師的慈悲心和智慧是如何影響了無數人的生活。
sentences.en: In 'Handing Down the Light: The Biography of Venerable Hsing Yun', we can see how Venerable Hsing Yun's compassion and wisdom have impacted countless lives.

sentences.zh: 這本書《傳燈──星雲大師傳》詳細記錄了星雲大師推廣人間佛教的歷程。
sentences.en: The book 'Handing Down the Light: The Biography of Venerable Hsing Yun' meticulously documents Venerable Hsing Yun's journey in promoting Humanistic Buddhism.

sentences.zh: 如果你對佛教的現代發展感興趣，那麼《傳燈──星雲大師傳》是一個不可錯過的啟發性閱讀。
sentences.en: If you are interested in the modern development of Buddhism, then 'Handing Down the Light: The Biography of Venerable Hsing Yun' is an inspirational read not to be missed.

sentences.zh: 《傳燈──星雲大師傳》不僅僅是一部傳記，更是一部啟示錄，引導讀者探索生活的深刻意義。
sentences.en: 'Handing Down the Light: The Biography of Venerable Hsing Yun' is not just a biography, but a revelation that guides readers in exploring the profound meaning of life.

sentences.zh: 每年有大量的信徒來到傳燈樓，參加佛法的學習和實修。
sentences.en: Every year, many devotees visit the Dharma Transmission Center to engage in the study and practice of Buddhist teachings.

sentences.zh: 傳燈樓是弘揚禪宗智慧的重要場所，在這裡講師傳授心靈的啟迪。
sentences.en: The Dharma Transmission Center is a significant place for disseminating Zen wisdom, where instructors impart spiritual insights.

sentences.zh: 傳燈樓的建築設計融合了傳統與現代的元素，營造出一個靜心的氛圍。
sentences.en: The architecture of the Dharma Transmission Center blends traditional and modern elements, creating a serene atmosphere for meditation.

sentences.zh: 他們在傳燈樓的陶藝課程中，學習創作過程如何成為一種禪修的實踐。
sentences.en: In pottery classes at the Dharma Transmission Center, they learn how the creative process can become a practice of meditation.

phrase.en: Handing Down the Light to the World

sentences.zh: 佛教的使命就是傳燈萬方，將智慧的光芒遍灑於世間。
sentences.en: The mission of Buddhism is handing down the light to the world, spreading the rays of wisdom across the globe.

sentences.zh: 大師以慈悲和智慧為引導，一生致力於傳燈萬方，啟迪眾生。
sentences.en: Guided by compassion and wisdom, the master dedicated his life to handing down the light to the world, enlightening countless beings.

sentences.zh: 每一位佛法修行者都有責任，將此燈火傳燈萬方，不辭辛勞地弘法利生。
sentences.en: Every practitioner of Buddhism has the responsibility to hand down the light to the world, spreading the teachings tirelessly to benefit all beings.

sentences.zh: 古往今來，無數的高僧以其教義與德行傳燈萬方，造福後世。
sentences.en: Throughout history, countless venerable monks have handed down the light to the world with their teachings and virtues, benefiting future generations.

sentences.zh: 傳記文學提供了深入理解歷史人物生活和時代背景的窗口。
sentences.en: Biographical literature provides a window into understanding the lives and times of historical figures.

sentences.zh: 在大學課程中，教授要求學生閱讀不同風格的傳記文學以培養他們的批判性思維。
sentences.en: In the university course, the professor required students to read various styles of biographical literature to develop their critical thinking.

sentences.zh: 她的新書屬於傳記文學，詳細描述了著名藝術家的內心世界和創作歷程。
sentences.en: Her new book falls under biographical literature, detailing the inner world and creative journey of a famous artist.

sentences.zh: 研究傳記文學的學者往往需跨學科合作，以確保作品的真實性與完整性。
sentences.en: Scholars researching biographical literature often need to collaborate across disciplines to ensure the authenticity and completeness of their works.

sentences.zh: 老師通過言傳身教來進行傳道，將佛教智慧傳遞給學生。
sentences.en: The teacher engages in the transmission of the Way through both words and actions, passing Buddhist wisdom to the students.

sentences.zh: 在禪宗中，傳道是通過心靈的契合來完成的，而不是依賴於文字。
sentences.en: In Zen Buddhism, the transmission of the Way is accomplished through a meeting of minds, rather than reliance on words.

sentences.zh: 寺院的方丈負責傳道，確保佛教教義能夠代代相傳。
sentences.en: The abbot of the monastery is responsible for the transmission of the Way, ensuring that the Buddhist teachings are passed down through generations.

sentences.zh: 他相信真正的傳道來自於生活中的點滴實踐，而非僅僅口頭的講述。
sentences.en: He believes that true transmission of the Way comes from practicing it in daily life, rather than merely speaking about it.

phrase.en: One Hundred Lessons on Monastery Languages and Affairs

sentences.zh: 這本書《僧事百講》為我們提供了深入了解寺院生活的獨特見解。
sentences.en: The book 'One Hundred Lessons on Monastery Languages and Affairs' provides us with unique insights into monastery life.

sentences.zh: 透過學習《僧事百講》，學生能夠對佛教儀式和習俗有更深刻的理解。
sentences.en: By studying 'One Hundred Lessons on Monastery Languages and Affairs', students can gain a deeper understanding of Buddhist rituals and customs.

sentences.zh: 《僧事百講》是僧人們必須掌握的指南，以便在他們的修行中更好地交流和協作。
sentences.en: 'One Hundred Lessons on Monastery Languages and Affairs' is a guide that monks must master to communicate and collaborate effectively in their practice.

sentences.zh: 許多寺院將《僧事百講》作為培訓材料，以確保新禪修者熟悉基礎用語和日常運作。
sentences.en: Many monasteries use 'One Hundred Lessons on Monastery Languages and Affairs' as training material to ensure new practitioners familiarize themselves with basic terminology and daily operations.

phrase.en: One Hundred Lessons on Monastery Languages and Affairs: Monastery Systems

sentences.zh: 在《僧事百講 1：叢林制度》中，深入探討了寺院內部的組織結構和管理方法。
sentences.en: In 'One Hundred Lessons on Monastery Languages and Affairs: Monastery Systems', the internal organizational structure and management methods of monasteries are explored in depth.

sentences.zh: 僧事百講提供了關於叢林制度的豐富知識，對修行者和研究者都大有幫助。
sentences.en: 'One Hundred Lessons on Monastery Languages and Affairs' offers rich knowledge about monastery systems, beneficial for both practitioners and researchers.

sentences.zh: 讀了僧事百講後，他對叢林制度有了更深的理解，並表示要更努力修行。
sentences.en: After reading 'One Hundred Lessons on Monastery Languages and Affairs', he gained a deeper understanding of monastery systems and expressed a desire to pursue more diligent practice.

sentences.zh: 透過《僧事百講 1：叢林制度》，我們學習到許多關於古代和現代寺院運行的相似之處。
sentences.en: Through 'One Hundred Lessons on Monastery Languages and Affairs: Monastery Systems', we learn about many similarities between ancient and modern monastery operations.

phrase.en: One Hundred Lessons on Monastery Languages and Affairs: Monastic Precepts

sentences.zh: 《僧事百講 2：出家戒法》是一本深入淺出的書籍，詳細介紹了出家修行的戒律和日常生活。
sentences.en: "One Hundred Lessons on Monastery Languages and Affairs: Monastic Precepts" is an insightful book that outlines the precepts and daily life of monastic practice in detail.

sentences.zh: 學習《僧事百講 2：出家戒法》讓我對於僧人的戒律和生活有了更深的理解。
sentences.en: Studying "One Hundred Lessons on Monastery Languages and Affairs: Monastic Precepts" gave me a deeper understanding of the precepts and lives of monks.

sentences.zh: 在《僧事百講 2：出家戒法》中，作者分享了他對於出家生活獨特而珍貴的見解。
sentences.en: In "One Hundred Lessons on Monastery Languages and Affairs: Monastic Precepts," the author shares his unique and valuable insights into the monastic life.

sentences.zh: 《僧事百講 2：出家戒法》提供了一個絕佳的機會，讓初學者了解佛教出家的基本原則和修行方法。
sentences.en: "One Hundred Lessons on Monastery Languages and Affairs: Monastic Precepts" offers an excellent opportunity for beginners to understand the fundamental principles and practices of Buddhist monasticism.

phrase.en: One Hundred Lessons on Monastery Languages and Affairs: Temple Undertakings

sentences.zh: 《僧事百講 3：道場行事》是一本詳細探討佛教寺院內部活動和禮儀的優秀著作。
sentences.en: One Hundred Lessons on Monastery Languages and Affairs: Temple Undertakings is an excellent book that explores in detail the activities and rituals within Buddhist temples.

sentences.zh: 在讀《僧事百講 3：道場行事》時，他對寺院日常運作有了更深入的了解。
sentences.en: While reading One Hundred Lessons on Monastery Languages and Affairs: Temple Undertakings, he gained a deeper understanding of the daily operations of a monastery.

sentences.zh: 這本書《僧事百講 3：道場行事》對於想學習佛教文化的人來說是不可或缺的資源。
sentences.en: This book, One Hundred Lessons on Monastery Languages and Affairs: Temple Undertakings, is an indispensable resource for those who wish to learn about Buddhist culture.

sentences.zh: 透過《僧事百講 3：道場行事》，她首次了解到佛教韻文中的深奧儀式。
sentences.en: Through One Hundred Lessons on Monastery Languages and Affairs: Temple Undertakings, she discovered for the first time the profound rituals in Buddhist liturgies.

phrase.en: One Hundred Lessons on Monastery Languages and Affairs: Cultivation and Gatherings

sentences.zh: 《僧事百講》第四章介紹了如何有效組織集會共修，以促進僧團的和諧與成長。
sentences.en: Chapter Four of 'One Hundred Lessons on Monastery Languages and Affairs' introduces how to effectively organize cultivation and gatherings to promote harmony and growth within the Sangha.

sentences.zh: 在僧事百講的第四講中，我們探討了集會共修的意義，並學習如何實施這些核心活動。
sentences.en: In the fourth lesson of 'One Hundred Lessons on Monastery Languages and Affairs,' we explore the significance of cultivation and gatherings, and learn how to implement these core activities.

sentences.zh: 參加《僧事百講》關於集會共修的課程讓我對僧侶生活的日常有了更深刻的理解。
sentences.en: Attending the course on cultivation and gatherings from 'One Hundred Lessons on Monastery Languages and Affairs' gave me a deeper understanding of the daily life of monks.

sentences.zh: 《僧事百講》第四篇章聚焦於集會共修的重要性，強調在共同修行中相互支持的力量。
sentences.en: The fourth chapter of 'One Hundred Lessons on Monastery Languages and Affairs' focuses on the importance of cultivation and gatherings, emphasizing the power of mutual support in shared practice.

phrase.en: One Hundred Lessons on Monastery Languages and Affairs: Organizational Management

sentences.zh: 《僧事百講 5：組織管理》這本書提供了管理寺院的寶貴資源和實用技巧。
sentences.en: The book 'One Hundred Lessons on Monastery Languages and Affairs: Organizational Management' provides valuable resources and practical skills for managing a monastery.

sentences.zh: 在課程中，《僧事百講 5：組織管理》是必讀的教材之一。
sentences.en: In the course curriculum, 'One Hundred Lessons on Monastery Languages and Affairs: Organizational Management' is one of the required textbooks.

sentences.zh: 他參加了《僧事百講 5：組織管理》的講座，學到了如何提升寺院的運作效率。
sentences.en: He attended the seminar on 'One Hundred Lessons on Monastery Languages and Affairs: Organizational Management' and learned how to improve the operational efficiency of the monastery.

sentences.zh: 透過《僧事百講 5：組織管理》中的原則，僧侶們可以更好地協調日常活動。
sentences.en: Through the principles outlined in 'One Hundred Lessons on Monastery Languages and Affairs: Organizational Management,' monks can better coordinate daily activities.

phrase.en: One Hundred Lessons on Monastery Languages and Affairs: Spread of Buddhism

sentences.zh: 在《僧事百講 6：佛教推展》中，作者詳盡地描述了佛教在亞洲各地的傳播歷史。
sentences.en: In 'One Hundred Lessons on Monastery Languages and Affairs: Spread of Buddhism', the author thoroughly describes the history of Buddhism's spread throughout Asia.

sentences.zh: 《僧事百講 6：佛教推展》揭示了佛教如何適應不同文化的變遷，成為全球受歡迎的宗教。
sentences.en: 'One Hundred Lessons on Monastery Languages and Affairs: Spread of Buddhism' reveals how Buddhism adapted to cultural changes and became a globally popular religion.

sentences.zh: 學者們普遍認為，《僧事百講 6：佛教推展》是研究佛教傳播的重要文獻，提供了寶貴的見解。
sentences.en: Scholars widely regard 'One Hundred Lessons on Monastery Languages and Affairs: Spread of Buddhism' as an important document for studying the spread of Buddhism, offering valuable insights.

sentences.zh: 透過《僧事百講 6：佛教推展》，我們了解到僧侶在推動佛教信仰傳播中所扮演的關鍵角色。
sentences.en: Through 'One Hundred Lessons on Monastery Languages and Affairs: Spread of Buddhism', we learn about the crucial role played by monks in promoting the spread of Buddhist beliefs.

sentences.zh: 僧伽是佛教修行者的群體，共同遵循戒律以求得佛法的解脫。
sentences.en: The sangha is a community of Buddhist practitioners who together observe precepts to seek liberation through the Dharma.

sentences.zh: 在佛教傳統中，僧伽被視為三寶之一，對信徒而言是重要的信仰依靠。
sentences.en: In Buddhist tradition, the sangha is considered one of the Three Jewels, serving as an important source of faith for devotees.

sentences.zh: 加入僧伽意味著承諾過著簡樸和有紀律的生活，致力於弘揚佛法。
sentences.en: Joining the sangha means committing to a life of simplicity and discipline, dedicated to spreading the teachings of the Buddha.

sentences.zh: 僧伽中的成員共同參與日常祈禱和禪修，以深化他們的修行。
sentences.en: Members of the sangha participate together in daily prayers and meditation sessions to deepen their practice.

sentences.zh: 每年各地的僧侶聚集在一起參加僧伽講習會，以交換佛學的最新研究成果。
sentences.en: Every year, monks from different regions gather to participate in the Buddhist Monastic Seminar to exchange the latest research findings on Buddhism.

sentences.zh: 這場僧伽講習會的主題是如何在現代社會中實踐佛法。
sentences.en: The theme of this Buddhist Monastic Seminar is how to practice Buddhism in modern society.

sentences.zh: 僧伽講習會為僧侶提供了一個學習和分享佛教經驗的平台。
sentences.en: The Buddhist Monastic Seminar provides a platform for monks to learn and share their experiences with Buddhism.

sentences.zh: 通過僧伽講習會，各個寺廟的僧侶們可以彼此認識，建立起更廣泛的宗教聯繫網。
sentences.en: Through the Buddhist Monastic Seminar, monks from various temples can get to know each other and establish broader religious connections.

sentences.zh: 這位僧侶在山上的寺廟中修行，實踐著佛教的戒律和修行。
sentences.en: The monastic practices in the mountain temple, adhering to Buddhist precepts and disciplines.

sentences.zh: 參加這次禪修的僧侶來自世界各地，分享他們的智慧和經驗。
sentences.en: The monastics attending the retreat come from all over the world, sharing their wisdom and experiences.

sentences.zh: 他的生活方式極為簡單和樸素，充分體現出僧侶的精神。
sentences.en: His lifestyle is extremely simple and austere, fully embodying the spirit of a monastic.

sentences.zh: 年輕的僧侶每天早晨都會行腳托缽，接受鄉民的供養。
sentences.en: The young monastic engages in alms-round every morning, receiving offerings from the villagers.

sentences.zh: 每年, 許多信徒都會前往僧寶山朝聖, 獲得心靈上的滋養。
sentences.en: Every year, many devotees travel to Sangha Mountain for pilgrimage, gaining spiritual nourishment.

sentences.zh: 僧寶山以其壯麗的景色和悠久的佛教傳統而聞名。
sentences.en: Sangha Mountain is known for its magnificent scenery and rich Buddhist tradition.

sentences.zh: 在僧寶山的禪寺裡, 僧人們每日進行冥想和修行。
sentences.en: In the Zen temple on Sangha Mountain, monks engage in daily meditation and practice.

sentences.zh: 這本書詳細記錄了僧寶山的歷史, 包括其在佛教中的重要性。
sentences.en: This book provides a detailed account of the history of Sangha Mountain, highlighting its significance in Buddhism.

sentences.zh: 每年在僧寶節，全國的佛教徒聚集在寺廟，慶祝出家的僧侶和修行者。
sentences.en: Every year on Sangha Day, Buddhists across the nation gather at temples to celebrate monks and practitioners.

sentences.zh: 僧寶節是一個重要的時刻，讓人們反思僧伽社群在個人修行和社會中的角色。
sentences.en: Sangha Day is an important time for people to reflect on the role of the monastic community in individual practice and society.

sentences.zh: 在僧寶節，信眾們會向僧侶供養食物和必需品，以展現對他們的感激和支持。
sentences.en: On Sangha Day, devotees offer food and necessities to monks as a gesture of gratitude and support.

sentences.zh: 僧寶節的慶祝活動通常包括法會、誦經和分享佛法的討論。
sentences.en: Sangha Day celebrations often include dharma assemblies, chanting, and discussions to share Buddhist teachings.

sentences.zh: 《儒林外史》是一部描繪古代中國士人生活的經典小說，揭示了當時的社會問題。
sentences.en: "The Scholars" is a classic novel depicting the lives of ancient Chinese scholars, shedding light on the social issues of the time.

sentences.zh: 儒林外史以其幽默諷刺的風格，批評了科舉制度和士人階層的虛偽。
sentences.en: The Scholars, with its humorous and satirical style, critiques the civil service examination system and the hypocrisy of the scholar class.

sentences.zh: 儒林外史的作者吳敬梓描繪了一個充滿矛盾與虛榮的文人世界。
sentences.en: The author of The Scholars, Wu Jingzi, depicted a world of scholars full of contradictions and vanity.

sentences.zh: 儒林外史全文寓意深刻，被認為是中國古代諷刺文學的重要代表。
sentences.en: The entire narrative of The Scholars is deeply allegorical and is considered an important representative of ancient Chinese satirical literature.

sentences.zh: 這位優婆塞經常參加寺廟的法會，以增強他的佛學知識。
sentences.en: This upasaka regularly attends temple ceremonies to deepen his understanding of Buddhism.

sentences.zh: 優婆塞是在家信奉佛教的男子，他遵循五戒以修身。
sentences.en: An upasaka is a layman who follows the five precepts to cultivate himself in Buddhism.

sentences.zh: 他以優婆塞的身份，積極參與社區的各項修行活動。
sentences.en: As an upasaka, he actively participates in various cultivation activities within the community.

sentences.zh: 這本書詳細描述了古代優婆塞如何協助推廣佛法。
sentences.en: This book details how ancient upasakas played a role in promoting the Dharma.

sentences.zh: 在佛教的傳統中，優婆夷是一位虔誠的女居士，常常參加寺廟的修行活動。
sentences.en: In Buddhist tradition, an upasika is a devoted female lay follower who often participates in the temple's religious activities.

sentences.zh: 這位優婆夷每天早晨都會念誦佛經，以此來修心養性。
sentences.en: This upasika recites Buddhist scriptures every morning as a practice to cultivate her mind and character.

sentences.zh: 作為一名優婆夷，她發下願心，希望能在未來的生命中繼續修行佛道。
sentences.en: As an upasika, she has made a vow hoping to continue her practice of the Buddha's path in future lives.

sentences.zh: 優婆夷通常遵循五戒，即不殺生、不偷盜、不邪淫、不妄語和不飲酒。
sentences.en: An upasika typically observes the Five Precepts, which are not to kill, steal, engage in sexual misconduct, lie, or consume intoxicants.

sentences.zh: 元亨寺是一座擁有悠久歷史的佛教寺廟，許多信徒都前來這裡祈福。
sentences.en: Yuan Heng Temple is a Buddhist temple with a long history, and many devotees come here to pray for blessings.

sentences.zh: 每年春季，元亨寺都會舉辦盛大的法會，吸引來自各地的參加者。
sentences.en: Every spring, Yuan Heng Temple holds a grand Dharma assembly, attracting participants from various regions.

sentences.zh: 來元亨寺參觀的人可以欣賞到古老的建築和莊嚴的佛像。
sentences.en: Visitors to Yuan Heng Temple can admire the ancient architecture and the solemn Buddha statues.

sentences.zh: 在元亨寺的小徑上散步，能讓人感受到寧靜與祥和。
sentences.en: Walking along the paths of Yuan Heng Temple, one can feel tranquility and peace.

phrase.en: To become an elite, first be of service

sentences.zh: 修行之道在於先做牛馬，再做龍象，這樣才能夠真正提升自我。
sentences.en: The path of spiritual practice lies in first being of service, like an ox or horse, before becoming an elite, like a dragon or elephant, in order to truly elevate oneself.

sentences.zh: 公司強調每位員工都要先做牛馬，再做龍象，以此培養服務精神和領導能力。
sentences.en: The company emphasizes that every employee should first be of service before aspiring to become an elite, to cultivate a spirit of servitude and leadership skills.

sentences.zh: 古往今來，那些偉大的領袖無不遵循著先做牛馬，再做龍象的原則。
sentences.en: Throughout history, great leaders have adhered to the principle of being of service before striving to become an elite.

sentences.zh: 在禪修中，我們學會先做牛馬，再做龍象，這樣才能深入體會生命的本質。
sentences.en: In meditation, we learn to be of service before achieving elite status, in order to deeply understand the essence of life.

sentences.zh: 阿彌陀佛被譽為光壽無量的象徵，代表著無限的慈悲和智慧。
sentences.en: Amitabha Buddha is revered as a symbol of Infinite Light and Infinite Life, representing boundless compassion and wisdom.

sentences.zh: 修習淨土法門的人期望往生到光壽無量的極樂世界。
sentences.en: Practitioners of the Pure Land tradition aspire to be reborn in the blissful realm of Infinite Light and Infinite Life.

sentences.zh: 這座佛像所呈現的光壽無量感召著人們追求內心的平靜與和諧。
sentences.en: This statue embodies Infinite Light and Infinite Life, inspiring people to seek inner peace and harmony.

sentences.zh: 佛教徒相信光壽無量的理念能幫助他們超越生死的界限。
sentences.en: Buddhists believe that the concept of Infinite Light and Infinite Life aids them in transcending the boundaries of birth and death.

sentences.zh: 光大社區大學提供多樣化的課程，讓學生能夠根據自己的興趣和需求選擇學習。
sentences.en: Guang Da Community College offers a diverse range of courses, allowing students to choose based on their interests and needs.

sentences.zh: 很多在光大社區大學就讀的學生都讚揚這裡的教學資源和師資力量。
sentences.en: Many students attending Guang Da Community College praise its educational resources and faculty strength.

sentences.zh: 光大社區大學的校園活動鼓勵學生參與，培養團隊合作和領導能力。
sentences.en: Guang Da Community College's campus activities encourage student participation, fostering teamwork and leadership skills.

sentences.zh: 在光大社區大學完成學業後，許多畢業生成功轉升到四年制大學繼續深造。
sentences.en: After completing their studies at Guang Da Community College, many graduates successfully transfer to four-year universities for further education.

sentences.zh: 在黑暗中行走的人們渴望著內心的光明。
sentences.en: Those who walk in darkness long for the brightness within their hearts.

sentences.zh: 佛教中，智慧被比喻為帶來解脫的光明。
sentences.en: In Buddhism, wisdom is likened to the brightness that brings liberation.

sentences.zh: 她的微笑猶如一縷光明，驅散了我們心頭的陰霾。
sentences.en: Her smile was like a ray of brightness, dispelling the gloom in our hearts.

sentences.zh: 修行者透過冥想尋求內在的光明與安寧。
sentences.en: The practitioner seeks inner brightness and peace through meditation.

sentences.zh: 在佛教的教義中，修行者期望能夠進入光明世界，那是沒有痛苦和煩惱的淨土。
sentences.en: In Buddhist teachings, practitioners aspire to enter a bright world, which is a pure land free from suffering and afflictions.

sentences.zh: 他相信只要每個人都行善積德，我們的社會終將成為一個光明世界。
sentences.en: He believes that as long as everyone practices kindness and virtue, our society will eventually become a bright world.

sentences.zh: 孩子們的純真與夢想讓我們相信未來的光明世界是可以達成的。
sentences.en: The innocence and dreams of children make us believe that a bright world in the future is attainable.

sentences.zh: 在這光明世界裡，無論何時何地都能感受到愛與和平的存在。
sentences.en: In this bright world, love and peace can be felt everywhere at any time.

sentences.zh: 光明大學以其卓越的佛學教育聞名於世。
sentences.en: Guang Ming College is renowned worldwide for its excellent Buddhist studies programs.

sentences.zh: 她選擇在光明大學完成她的碩士學位，因為她對佛教研究有著濃厚的興趣。
sentences.en: She chose to complete her master's degree at Guang Ming College because of her deep interest in Buddhist studies.

sentences.zh: 光明大學的教師來自世界各地，擁有豐富的教學經驗。
sentences.en: The faculty at Guang Ming College comes from around the world, bringing a wealth of teaching experience.

sentences.zh: 每年有許多來自不同國家的學生前來光明大學學習佛教文化。
sentences.en: Every year, many students from different countries come to Guang Ming College to study Buddhist culture.

sentences.zh: 佛寺裡的光明燈象徵著智慧和光明，照亮信徒的心靈。
sentences.en: The lamp of illumination in the temple symbolizes wisdom and light, shining upon the hearts of devotees.

sentences.zh: 他在心中點燃光明燈，讓真理的光輝指引他的修行道路。
sentences.en: He kindled the lamp of illumination in his heart, allowing the radiance of truth to guide his path of practice.

sentences.zh: 在法會上，每位參加者都點燃一盞光明燈，祈願世界和平。
sentences.en: At the Dharma assembly, each participant lit a lamp of illumination, praying for world peace.

sentences.zh: 光明燈照亮了我們前進的方向，使黑暗也無法掩蓋真理的光輝。
sentences.en: The lamp of illumination lights our way forward, rendering the darkness unable to obscure the brilliance of truth.

sentences.zh: 在農曆新年的光明燈法會上，信徒們點燃燈火，祈求一年平安順利。
sentences.en: During the Light Offering Dharma Service at the Lunar New Year, devotees lit lamps to pray for a year of peace and prosperity.

sentences.zh: 光明燈法會提供了一個機會，讓大家共同為世界和平而祈禱。
sentences.en: The Light Offering Dharma Service provided an opportunity for everyone to pray together for world peace.

sentences.zh: 很多信眾每年都參加光明燈法會，希望藉此得到內心的光明與智慧。
sentences.en: Many devotees participate in the Light Offering Dharma Service annually, hoping to gain inner light and wisdom.

sentences.zh: 光明燈法會結束後，寺廟內的小燈仍然閃爍著，象徵著永恆的開悟之光。
sentences.en: After the Light Offering Dharma Service concluded, small lamps continued to flicker in the temple, symbolizing the eternal light of enlightenment.

phrase.zh: 光照大千-絲綢之路佛教藝術特展
phrase.en: Buddhist Art Along the Silk Roads - Light Shines on the Universe

sentences.zh: 光照大千-絲綢之路佛教藝術特展展示了從印度到中國的絢麗佛教藝術品。
sentences.en: The Buddhist Art Along the Silk Roads - Light Shines on the Universe exhibition showcases stunning Buddhist artworks from India to China.

sentences.zh: 這次特展名為『光照大千-絲綢之路佛教藝術特展』，吸引了眾多藝術愛好者參觀。
sentences.en: Titled 'Buddhist Art Along the Silk Roads - Light Shines on the Universe', this exhibition attracted numerous art enthusiasts.

sentences.zh: 光照大千-絲綢之路佛教藝術特展提供了一個探索佛教影響與絲綢之路沿線文化交流的機會。
sentences.en: The Buddhist Art Along the Silk Roads - Light Shines on the Universe offers an opportunity to explore the impact of Buddhism and cultural exchanges along the Silk Roads.

sentences.zh: 參觀光照大千-絲綢之路佛教藝術特展讓人對古代文明的互通有了更深入的理解。
sentences.en: Visiting the Buddhist Art Along the Silk Roads - Light Shines on the Universe gives a deeper understanding of the interconnectedness of ancient civilizations.

sentences.zh: 佛陀的智慧如同無邊的光華，照亮了所有眾生的心靈黑暗。
sentences.en: The wisdom of the Buddha is like boundless illumination, enlightening the darkness in the hearts of all beings.

sentences.zh: 寺廟的燈火在夜晚閃爍著光華，給予人們內心的平靜和安慰。
sentences.en: The temple lights flicker with illumination at night, providing people with inner peace and comfort.

sentences.zh: 他鍥而不舍地追求自我的進步，最終找到了屬於自己的那一份光華。
sentences.en: He persevered in the quest for self-improvement and eventually found his own illumination.

sentences.zh: 在禪定中，那一瞬間的光華讓她感受到真正的自在與解脫。
sentences.en: In meditation, that moment of illumination made her feel true ease and liberation.

sentences.zh: 光雲堂位於山頂，除了舉辦法會，還是僧侶們休養身心的地方。
sentences.en: The Radiant Cloud Office is situated at the mountain summit and serves not only as a venue for rituals but also as a place for monastics to rejuvenate their minds and bodies.

sentences.zh: 每年春季，光雲堂的櫻花盛開，為來訪者帶來無比的寧靜與喜悅。
sentences.en: Every spring, the cherry blossoms at the Radiant Cloud Office bloom, offering visitors unparalleled tranquility and joy.

sentences.zh: 光雲堂的設計靈感來自自然元素，營造出一種與天地合一的氛圍。
sentences.en: The design of the Radiant Cloud Office draws inspiration from natural elements, creating an atmosphere of unity with the universe.

sentences.zh: 僧侶們常常在光雲堂進行冥想，以追求內心的清淨與智慧。
sentences.en: Monastics often meditate in the Radiant Cloud Office to seek inner purity and wisdom.

sentences.zh: 這次佛教祈福法會希望能為所有眾生帶來平安，讓大家免災難。
sentences.en: The Buddhist blessing ceremony hopes to bring peace to all beings, allowing everyone to be free from disasters and calamities.

sentences.zh: 在佛法的庇佑下，這個村莊多以免災難，得以安居樂業。
sentences.en: Under the protection of the Dharma, the village has often been free from disasters and calamities, allowing its residents to live and work in peace.

sentences.zh: 修行者冀望通過祈禱和冥想使自己和他人免災難。
sentences.en: The practitioner hopes to make themselves and others free from disasters and calamities through prayers and meditation.

sentences.zh: 古廟中供奉的護法神被當地人信仰為能使他們免災難的守護者。
sentences.en: The guardian deity worshiped in the ancient temple is believed by the locals to be a protector who keeps them free from disasters and calamities.

phrase.en: Illustrated Sutra of the One Hundred Parables

sentences.zh: 《兒童的百喻經》是一本寓教於樂的書籍，透過生動的故事教導孩童佛教的道理。
sentences.en: The 'Illustrated Sutra of the One Hundred Parables' is an educational book that uses engaging stories to teach children Buddhist principles.

sentences.zh: 老師經常在課堂上引用《兒童的百喻經》中的故事，使學生在學習佛法時感到輕鬆有趣。
sentences.en: The teacher often cites stories from the 'Illustrated Sutra of the One Hundred Parables' in class, making the study of Buddhism light-hearted and fun for students.

sentences.zh: 《兒童的百喻經》中每個喻故事後面都有插圖，幫助小讀者更好地理解故事情節和寓意。
sentences.en: Each parable in the 'Illustrated Sutra of the One Hundred Parables' is accompanied by illustrations that help young readers better understand the plot and moral.

sentences.zh: 通過閱讀《兒童的百喻經》，孩子們學會了重要的品格，如誠實和慈悲。
sentences.en: By reading the 'Illustrated Sutra of the One Hundred Parables', children learn important virtues such as honesty and compassion.

sentences.zh: 修行者每日打坐，期望能夠入三摩地，以達到內心的寧靜與清明。
sentences.en: The practitioner meditates daily, hoping to enter into samadhi to achieve inner peace and clarity.

sentences.zh: 在寺廟的靜室中，他感受到環繞的寂靜，這讓他的心靈更容易入三摩地。
sentences.en: In the quiet chamber of the temple, he felt the encompassing silence, which made it easier for his mind to enter into samadhi.

sentences.zh: 當外界的喧囂不再干擾她的心境時，她才真正體會到入三摩地的境界。
sentences.en: When the clamor of the outside world no longer disturbed her mind, she truly experienced the state of entering into samadhi.

sentences.zh: 通過長時間的專注修煉，他終於能夠在冥想中自如地入三摩地。
sentences.en: Through prolonged focused practice, he finally could effortlessly enter into samadhi during meditation.

sentences.zh: 佛教修行的目的是通過內觀與禪修的練習，最終入不二門，達到超越世俗的境界。
sentences.en: The purpose of Buddhist practice is to ultimately enter the Gate of Non-Duality through meditation and introspection, reaching a transcendental state beyond the mundane.

sentences.zh: 他深入學習佛教經典，不斷精進修行，最終得以入不二門，體悟宇宙的智慧。
sentences.en: Through dedicated study of Buddhist scriptures and diligent practice, he eventually entered the Gate of Non-Duality, perceiving the wisdom of the universe.

sentences.zh: 禪宗的靜坐能使人超越對立的思想，走向入不二門的解脫之路。
sentences.en: Zen meditation allows one to transcend dualistic thinking and walk the liberating path of entering the Gate of Non-Duality.

sentences.zh: 入不二門是修行者心靈昇華的象徵，意味著超脫二元對立的智慧覺醒。
sentences.en: Entering the Gate of Non-Duality symbolizes the spiritual elevation of a practitioner, signifying the awakening of wisdom beyond dualistic oppositions.

sentences.zh: 佛教強調入世修行，鼓勵人在現實生活中實踐佛法。
sentences.en: Buddhism emphasizes this worldly practice, encouraging people to apply the Dharma in real life.

sentences.zh: 他以入世的態度來面對工作中的挑戰，將佛法智慧應用於日常事務中。
sentences.en: He approaches work challenges with a this worldly attitude, applying the wisdom of Dharma to his daily tasks.

sentences.zh: 入世與出世之間找到平衡，是許多人修行的目標。
sentences.en: Finding a balance between this worldly and otherworldly concerns is the goal for many practitioners.

sentences.zh: 入世行善，不僅是在行動中體現慈悲，更是在與他人互動中提升自身。
sentences.en: Practicing altruism in this worldly manner not only manifests compassion but also enhances personal growth in interactions with others.

phrase.zh: 入佛知見 生如來家
phrase.en: Entering the View of the Buddha; Born in the Home of Tathagata

sentences.zh: 通過不斷學習佛經，他最終入佛知見，深刻理解了佛法的精髓。
sentences.en: Through continuous study of the Buddhist scriptures, he eventually entered the view of the Buddha and deeply understood the essence of the Dharma.

sentences.zh: 追隨師父多年，她終於生如來家，心中充滿了慈悲與智慧。
sentences.en: After following her master for many years, she was finally born in the home of Tathagata, her heart filled with compassion and wisdom.

sentences.zh: 朝禮各大佛教聖地，他期望能夠入佛知見，獲得心靈的啟示。
sentences.en: By making pilgrimages to various Buddhist holy sites, he hopes to enter the view of the Buddha and gain spiritual insight.

sentences.zh: 瑜伽士修行，保持內心的寧靜，最終生如來家，體會到真正的自在。
sentences.en: By practicing meditation, the yogi maintains inner peace, and ultimately is born in the home of Tathagata, experiencing true liberation.

sentences.zh: 每天早晨，他都會在禪房入定，練習靜坐與專注。
sentences.en: Every morning, he enters into meditation in the meditation room, practicing stillness and focus.

sentences.zh: 佛陀入定時，感受到內心的平和與寧靜，徹底超越了世俗的煩擾。
sentences.en: When the Buddha entered into meditation, he experienced inner peace and tranquility, completely transcending worldly disturbances.

sentences.zh: 瑜伽課程中，老師帶領學生們一步一步地入定，讓他們放下所有的壓力。
sentences.en: In the yoga class, the teacher guided the students step by step to enter into meditation, allowing them to let go of all stress.

sentences.zh: 僧人們透過日常的入定來深化他們的修行，提高精神境界。
sentences.en: The monks deepen their practice and elevate their spiritual state through daily entering into meditation.

phrase.en: to enter the master's study for examination or instruction

sentences.zh: 經過多年的學習，他終於有機會入室，親自向師父請教。
sentences.en: After years of study, he finally had the opportunity to enter the master's study for examination and instruction.

sentences.zh: 唐代詩人白居易年輕時，即渴望能夠入室以求大師的指點。
sentences.en: During the Tang Dynasty, the poet Bai Juyi longed to enter the master's study to seek guidance from the master.

sentences.zh: 那些被選中入室的弟子，都是經過嚴格考核的精英。
sentences.en: Those chosen to enter the master's study were elites who had undergone rigorous selection.

sentences.zh: 入室對於每位學僧都是莫大的榮譽，象徵著被師父認可。
sentences.en: Entering the master's study is a great honor for every student, symbolizing the master's recognition.

sentences.zh: 在佛教修行中，入流的達成代表著個人已經進入通往涅槃的道路。
sentences.en: In Buddhist practice, achieving the state of Srotapanna signifies that an individual has entered the path leading to Nirvana.

sentences.zh: 一位入流者不再陷於對於輪迴的恐懼，因為他將在七生之內解脫。
sentences.en: A stream-entrant no longer fears the cycle of rebirth, as they will attain liberation within seven lifetimes.

sentences.zh: 入流者已經斷除了三縛結，這表明他們的煩惱已經減少。
sentences.en: A Srotapanna has broken three fetters, indicating a reduction in their mental defilements.

sentences.zh: 成為入流者的修行者會更扎實地持守戒律，增強自己的定力和慧力。
sentences.en: A practitioner who becomes a stream-entrant will adhere more firmly to the precepts, strengthening their concentration and wisdom.

sentences.zh: 佛陀在八十歲時入滅，留下了豐富的精神遺產。
sentences.en: The Buddha entered into nirvana at the age of eighty, leaving behind a rich spiritual legacy.

sentences.zh: 他修行精進，最終在山洞中入滅。
sentences.en: He practiced diligently, eventually entering into nirvana in a cave.

sentences.zh: 追隨者們紀念大師的入滅日，以表達他們的敬仰和懷念。
sentences.en: Followers commemorate the master's day of entering into nirvana to express their admiration and remembrance.

sentences.zh: 在入滅之前，佛陀給弟子們留下了最後的開示。
sentences.en: Before entering into nirvana, the Buddha gave his disciples his final teachings.

sentences.zh: 修行者準備好他的心態並做好充分準備，然後才決定入眾。
sentences.en: The practitioner prepared his mindset and made full preparations before deciding to enter the assembly.

sentences.zh: 在禪修期間，導師引導學生如何專注並無畏地入眾。
sentences.en: During the meditation session, the teacher guided students on how to focus and fearlessly enter the assembly.

sentences.zh: 入眾意味著準備好與他人連結並分享智慧。
sentences.en: To enter the assembly means being ready to connect with others and share wisdom.

sentences.zh: 他覺得自己壓力過大，於是決定暫時不入眾，給自己一些獨處時間。
sentences.en: Feeling overwhelmed, he decided not to enter the assembly for a while, giving himself some time alone.

sentences.zh: 他在生命的關鍵時刻，選擇了入道，從此過上了簡樸而修行的生活。
sentences.en: At a critical moment in his life, he chose to enter the Way, leading a simple and ascetic lifestyle from then on.

sentences.zh: 入道並非一朝一夕之事，需要持續不懈的努力和全心的投入。
sentences.en: To enter the Way is not an overnight matter; it requires continuous effort and wholehearted commitment.

sentences.zh: 很多人渴望入道，但真正能夠做到的少之又少，需要極大的勇氣和信念。
sentences.en: Many aspire to enter the Way, yet only a few truly succeed, as it demands great courage and conviction.

sentences.zh: 師父教導弟子們要誠心入道，不受世俗誘惑所動。
sentences.en: The master instructed his disciples to sincerely enter the Way, remaining unaffected by worldly temptations.

sentences.zh: 他經過多年的修行，終於有機會入選佛場，接受進一步的教導。
sentences.en: After years of practice, he finally had the opportunity to enter the Buddha-Selection Court for further guidance.

sentences.zh: 入選佛場是一種榮譽，意味著你的身心修行已經達到了新的境界。
sentences.en: To enter the Buddha-Selection Court is an honor, signifying that your spiritual practice has reached a new level.

sentences.zh: 她的願望是能夠入選佛場，以便學習更深奧的法門。
sentences.en: Her wish is to enter the Buddha-Selection Court to learn more profound teachings.

sentences.zh: 入選佛場的僧侶承擔重大的責任，必須將學到的智慧分享給更多的人。
sentences.en: Monks who enter the Buddha-Selection Court bear significant responsibility, as they must share the wisdom they learn with others.

sentences.zh: 這本書是專為禪修入門者設計的，內容淺顯易懂。
sentences.en: This book is designed for meditation beginners, presenting the content in an easy-to-understand manner.

sentences.zh: 他剛開始學習瑜伽，所以選擇了入門課程來奠定基礎。
sentences.en: He just started learning yoga, so he chose a beginner course to lay the foundation.

sentences.zh: 經過幾個月的練習，從入門到現在她已經能夠進行更高級的體式。
sentences.en: After several months of practice, she's progressed from a beginner to performing more advanced poses.

sentences.zh: 對於佛教入門者來說，了解四聖諦是非常重要的開始。
sentences.en: For beginners in Buddhism, understanding the Four Noble Truths is a very important start.

phrase.zh: 內心可成瞋恨的黑洞 內心可成焚燒的火窟 內心可成煩惱的牢籠 內心可成毀滅的原由 內心可成勵志的力量 內心可成光明的天地 內心可成喜捨的樂園 內心可成佛國的通道
phrase.en: The mind can turn into an abyss of anger. The mind can turn into a burning furnace. The mind can turn into a prison of affliction. The mind can turn into a cause for destruction. The mind can turn into a power of motivation. The mind can turn into a world of shining light. The mind can turn into a land of joy and generosity. The mind can turn into a path to Buddha land.

sentences.zh: 內心可成瞋恨的黑洞，一旦陷入就難以自拔，須謹慎調伏此心境。
sentences.en: The mind can turn into an abyss of anger, and once trapped, it's hard to escape. It is crucial to carefully tame this state of mind.

sentences.zh: 時時反省自己的內心，避免它變成焚燒的火窟，燒毀自身的安寧。
sentences.en: Constantly reflect on one's mind to prevent it from becoming a burning furnace that destroys one's own peace.

sentences.zh: 若能善加引導，內心也可成勵志的力量，引導我們邁向卓越。
sentences.en: If guided well, the mind can also become a power of motivation, leading us toward excellence.

sentences.zh: 內心的淨化，能使我們走上佛國的通道，抵達自在祥和之境。
sentences.en: The purification of the mind can lead us onto a path to Buddha land, reaching a state of freedom and harmony.

sentences.zh: 每天晚上睡前，她會花一些時間內觀自省，審視自己一天的行為。
sentences.en: Every night before bed, she spends some time in contemplation and self-reflection, reviewing her actions of the day.

sentences.zh: 內觀自省可以幫助我們認識自己的內心狀態，進而改善心理健康。
sentences.en: Contemplation and self-reflection can help us understand our inner states, thereby improving mental health.

sentences.zh: 在靜坐中，他專注於內觀自省，以尋找人生的真正意義。
sentences.en: During meditation, he focuses on contemplation and self-reflection to find the true meaning of life.

sentences.zh: 老師鼓勵學生通過內觀自省來對他們的學習進行深入分析。
sentences.en: The teacher encourages students to engage in contemplation and self-reflection for an in-depth analysis of their learning.

sentences.zh: 每年春節，全家福是我們非常珍視的時刻，是一家團聚的幸福。
sentences.en: Every Lunar New Year, family union is a blessing that we cherish dearly, marking the joy of gathering together.

sentences.zh: 全家福的觀念在亞洲文化中擁有特殊的意義，象徵著和睦和幸福。
sentences.en: The concept of family union is especially significant in Asian cultures, symbolizing harmony and happiness.

sentences.zh: 在佛教中，全家福不僅意味著親人的團聚，也代表著福報的顯現。
sentences.en: In Buddhism, family union signifies not only the gathering of relatives but also the manifestation of karmic blessings.

sentences.zh: 我們藉由全家福的時光，感激過去的共同行旅和未來的惠福。
sentences.en: Through the time of family union, we express gratitude for past shared journeys and future blessings.

sentences.zh: 今年的全民閱讀博覽會將在城市會展中心舉行，預計會吸引成千上萬的書迷前來參加。
sentences.en: This year's National Reading Expo will be held at the City Convention Center and is expected to attract thousands of book lovers.

sentences.zh: 在全民閱讀博覽會上，參與者可以享受多場講座和簽書活動，開闊閱讀視野。
sentences.en: At the National Reading Expo, attendees can enjoy numerous lectures and book signing events, broadening their reading horizons.

sentences.zh: 校方組織了一群學生志願者參加全民閱讀博覽會，以促進年輕一代的閱讀習慣。
sentences.en: The school organized a group of student volunteers to participate in the National Reading Expo to promote reading habits among the younger generation.

sentences.zh: 著名作家在全民閱讀博覽會的主題演講中，分享了他們對未來閱讀趨勢的見解。
sentences.en: Renowned authors shared their insights on future reading trends during the keynote speeches at the National Reading Expo.

phrase.zh: 全球中華文化經典讀誦大會
phrase.en: Global Chinese Cultural Classics Reading Competition

sentences.zh: 全球中華文化經典讀誦大會吸引了來自世界各地的參加者，他們齊聚一堂，共同推廣中華文化。
sentences.en: The Global Chinese Cultural Classics Reading Competition attracted participants from all over the world, gathering together to promote Chinese culture.

sentences.zh: 在全球中華文化經典讀誦大會上，選手們展現了他們對古典文學的深刻理解和流暢朗誦技巧。
sentences.en: At the Global Chinese Cultural Classics Reading Competition, contestants showcased their deep understanding of classical literature and fluent recitation skills.

sentences.zh: 參加全球中華文化經典讀誦大會的學生們，不僅提升了自己的語言能力，也增強了對中華傳統價值的認識。
sentences.en: Students participating in the Global Chinese Cultural Classics Reading Competition not only enhanced their language skills but also gained a deeper understanding of traditional Chinese values.

sentences.zh: 全球中華文化經典讀誦大會提供了一個平臺，讓年輕一代能夠親近和欣賞中華經典之美。
sentences.en: The Global Chinese Cultural Classics Reading Competition provided a platform for the younger generation to connect with and appreciate the beauty of Chinese classics.

phrase.en: When Buddha Meets the Gods” Event

sentences.zh: 今年的兩岸神明聯誼會將在台北舉行，吸引了來自不同地區的佛教徒和地方神明信仰者。
