sentences.en: Monasteries functioning as schools not only preserve religious traditions but also integrate modern technology, greatly benefiting students.

phrase.zh: 隨緣不變 不變隨緣
phrase.en: Remain flexible yet unchanging; remain unchanging yet flexible.

sentences.zh: 在處理複雜的人際關係時，他總是以隨緣不變的態度面對，不輕易被環境所動搖。
sentences.en: When dealing with complex interpersonal relationships, he always adopts a remain flexible yet unchanging attitude, not easily swayed by circumstances.

sentences.zh: 在追求自己的目標時，她保持著不變隨緣的心態，靈活應對各種挑戰，同時堅持自己的核心價值。
sentences.en: In pursuing her goals, she maintains a remain unchanging yet flexible mindset, adapting to various challenges while holding on to her core values.

sentences.zh: 修行之路上，他們學會了隨緣不變，既不執著於外界的變化，也不偏離自己的信仰。
sentences.en: On the path of practice, they learned to remain flexible yet unchanging, neither clinging to external changes nor deviating from their beliefs.

sentences.zh: 面對生活中的不確定性，她常提醒自己要不變隨緣，保持內心的穩定和適應能力。
sentences.en: In the face of life's uncertainties, she often reminds herself to remain unchanging yet flexible, maintaining inner stability and adaptability.

sentences.zh: 台北別院是這個佛教團體在臺灣的主要寺院之一。
sentences.en: The Taipei Branch Temple is one of the primary temples of this Buddhist organization in Taiwan.

sentences.zh: 每年都有數以千計的信徒前來台北別院參拜，參加祈福儀式。
sentences.en: Thousands of devotees visit the Taipei Branch Temple every year to participate in blessing ceremonies.

sentences.zh: 台北別院的建築設計融合了傳統和現代元素，成為市區的一大特色。
sentences.en: The architectural design of the Taipei Branch Temple combines traditional and modern elements, becoming a prominent feature of the city.

sentences.zh: 台北別院的住持定期舉辦佛學講座，吸引了大量對佛法有興趣的民眾前來聆聽。
sentences.en: The abbot of the Taipei Branch Temple regularly hosts Dharma lectures, attracting a large audience interested in Buddhism.

phrase.en: South African Nan Hua Performing Arts Group

sentences.zh: 天龍隊在全世界表演了許多場精彩的佛教舞蹈，吸引了愛好者的目光。
sentences.en: The South African Nan Hua Performing Arts Group has performed many spectacular Buddhist dances around the world, captivating audiences.

sentences.zh: 天龍隊的成員來自不同的背景，但他們因共同的信仰而團結在一起。
sentences.en: The members of the South African Nan Hua Performing Arts Group come from diverse backgrounds, but they are united by a common faith.

sentences.zh: 這個週末，天龍隊將在本地劇院進行兩場公益演出。
sentences.en: This weekend, the South African Nan Hua Performing Arts Group will be performing two benefit shows at the local theater.

sentences.zh: 天龍隊的演出融合了傳統和現代元素，是文化交流的絕佳範例。
sentences.en: The performances by the South African Nan Hua Performing Arts Group blend traditional and contemporary elements, serving as an excellent example of cultural exchange.

sentences.zh: 在天眼網路佛學院，學生可以在線學習不同的佛教經典。
sentences.en: At Tienyen Buddhist eCollege, students can study various Buddhist scriptures online.

sentences.zh: 天眼網路佛學院提供多樣化的課程，包括禪修和佛教哲學。
sentences.en: Tienyen Buddhist eCollege offers a diverse range of courses, including meditation and Buddhist philosophy.

sentences.zh: 他通過天眼網路佛學院取得了佛教研究的學位。
sentences.en: He earned a degree in Buddhist studies through Tienyen Buddhist eCollege.

sentences.zh: 天眼網路佛學院的老師們都是有經驗的佛教學者。
sentences.en: The teachers at Tienyen Buddhist eCollege are all experienced Buddhist scholars.

sentences.zh: 在古代，文殿通常是學子求學與奉祀文昌帝君的地方。
sentences.en: In ancient times, the Scholar’s Shrine was often a place for students to study and to worship the God of Literature, Wenchang Dijun.

sentences.zh: 文殿內陳列著許多古代書畫，吸引了許多學者駐足欣賞。
sentences.en: The Scholar’s Shrine displays many ancient calligraphies and paintings, attracting numerous scholars to stop and admire.

sentences.zh: 每年考試前夕都有許多人前往文殿祈求考運順利。
sentences.en: Every year on the eve of examinations, many people visit the Scholar’s Shrine to pray for good luck in their exams.

sentences.zh: 文殿不僅是祈禱的場所，也是一個文化研究和交流的中心。
sentences.en: The Scholar’s Shrine is not only a place for prayer but also a center for cultural research and exchange.

sentences.zh: 這家佛教文物流通處提供了多種精美的佛教藝術品，以促進信仰的交流。
sentences.en: This Buddhist Artifacts Center provides a variety of exquisite Buddhist artworks to facilitate the exchange of faith.

sentences.zh: 訪客可以在佛教文物流通處找到不同朝代的珍貴法器和經卷。
sentences.en: Visitors can find precious ritual objects and scriptures from different dynasties at the Buddhist Artifacts Center.

sentences.zh: 佛教文物流通處的展覽活動吸引了來自世界各地的觀眾研究和欣賞東方藝術文化。
sentences.en: Exhibitions at the Buddhist Artifacts Center attract audiences worldwide to study and appreciate Eastern art and culture.

sentences.zh: 為保護文化遺產，佛教文物流通處定期進行文物的維護與復修。
sentences.en: To preserve cultural heritage, the Buddhist Artifacts Center regularly conducts maintenance and restoration of artifacts.

sentences.zh: 武殿是一座古老的建築，供奉著歷史上著名的將軍。
sentences.en: The General's Shrine is an ancient structure dedicated to famous generals in history.

sentences.zh: 每年，村民們都會在武殿舉行祭拜儀式以紀念先祖的英勇。
sentences.en: Each year, villagers hold a ceremonial rite at the General's Shrine to honor the bravery of their ancestors.

sentences.zh: 觀光客們對武殿內展示的武器和盔甲展現出極大的興趣。
sentences.en: Tourists show great interest in the weapons and armor displayed inside the General's Shrine.

sentences.zh: 這位將軍的雕像安置在武殿的中央，象徵著不屈的精神。
sentences.en: The statue of the general placed at the center of the General's Shrine symbolizes indomitable spirit.

phrase.en: even the inanimate teaches the Dharma

sentences.zh: 在靜謐的山林中，無情說法，溪水流淌的聲音彷彿在訴說著無常的道理。
sentences.en: In the serene forest, even the inanimate teaches the Dharma, as the sound of the flowing stream seems to speak of the truth of impermanence.

sentences.zh: 佛教徒相信，風中的樹葉輕聲作響，如同無情說法，傳達著生命的智慧。
sentences.en: Buddhists believe that the gentle rustling of leaves in the wind, like even the inanimate teaches the Dharma, conveys the wisdom of life.

sentences.zh: 這座古寺的每一塊石頭都在無情說法，提醒著人們修行的重要性。
sentences.en: Every stone in this ancient temple is teaching the Dharma even through its inanimate presence, reminding people of the importance of spiritual practice.

sentences.zh: 無情說法，佛像在無聲中顯露出深邃的慈悲與智慧。
sentences.en: Even the inanimate Buddha statue, through its silent presence, reveals profound compassion and wisdom, teaching the Dharma.

sentences.zh: 新制定的政策必須經過五院十會的審核和批准，以確保其有效性和正當性。
sentences.en: The newly drafted policy must be reviewed and approved by the Five Councils and Ten Committees to ensure its effectiveness and legitimacy.

sentences.zh: 在佛教歷史上，五院十會是重要的組織架構，用於決策和協調教務。
sentences.en: In the history of Buddhism, the Five Councils and Ten Committees serve as important organizational structures for decision-making and coordination of ecclesiastical affairs.

sentences.zh: 政府的提案在五院十會的共同努力下得到了順利通過。
sentences.en: The government's proposal was successfully passed with the collaborative effort of the Five Councils and Ten Committees.

sentences.zh: 他們決定通過成立五院十會，以更加系統化的方式來處理社區問題。
sentences.en: They decided to establish the Five Councils and Ten Committees to address community issues in a more systematic manner.

sentences.zh: 在送別的宴會上，他們唱起了動人的惜別歌，感慨萬千。
sentences.en: At the farewell banquet, they sang a touching farewell song, feeling overwhelmed with emotions.

sentences.zh: 這首惜別歌讓我想起了我們一起度過的美好時光。
sentences.en: This farewell song reminds me of the wonderful times we spent together.

sentences.zh: 每次聽到這首惜別歌，我的心都充滿了對朋友們的思念。
sentences.en: Every time I hear this farewell song, my heart is filled with longing for my friends.

sentences.zh: 老師在畢業典禮上為學生唱了一首真摯的惜別歌，祝福他們未來的旅程順利。
sentences.en: The teacher sang a heartfelt farewell song for the students at the graduation ceremony, wishing them well on their future journeys.

sentences.zh: 這座寺院的西單是用來舉行特殊法會的地方。
sentences.en: The west wing of the monastery is used for holding special Dharma assemblies.

sentences.zh: 在這座古老的建築中，西單的牆壁上有許多美麗的壁畫。
sentences.en: In this ancient building, the walls of the west wing are adorned with many beautiful murals.

sentences.zh: 西單是一個靜謐的空間，供僧人們進行冥想和學習。
sentences.en: The west wing is a tranquil space for monks to meditate and study.

sentences.zh: 他們正在對寺院的西單進行修繕，以恢復其昔日的光彩。
sentences.en: They are renovating the west wing of the temple to restore its former glory.

phrase.en: University of the West (formerly Hsi Lai University)

sentences.zh: 西來大學是位於美國加州的一所知名佛教學院。
sentences.en: University of the West, formerly Hsi Lai University, is a renowned Buddhist institution located in California, USA.

sentences.zh: 她決定申請西來大學攻讀佛教研究碩士學位。
sentences.en: She decided to apply to the University of the West to pursue a Master's degree in Buddhist Studies.

sentences.zh: 在西來大學學習期間，他們深入了解了多元文化和宗教對話。
sentences.en: During their studies at the University of the West, they gained a deep understanding of multiculturalism and interfaith dialogue.

sentences.zh: 西來大學提供各種課程，包括佛學、心理學和商業等。
sentences.en: University of the West offers a variety of programs, including Buddhist studies, psychology, and business.

sentences.zh: 這個小鎮因為連續獲得最佳居住地的殊榮，被當地人稱為喜慶之家。
sentences.en: This town, repeatedly recognized as the best place to live, is referred to as a home for celebration by locals.

sentences.zh: 老奶奶的家一直是家族聚會的喜慶之家，每次節日大家都會聚在一起。
sentences.en: Grandma's house has always been a home for celebration for family gatherings, with everyone coming together during the holidays.

sentences.zh: 在古代，寺廟經常被認為是社區的喜慶之家，因為各種節慶和儀式常在那裡舉行。
sentences.en: In ancient times, temples were often considered homes for celebration in the community because various festivals and ceremonies were held there.

sentences.zh: 新開的餐廳以其愉悅的氛圍和美食，很快成為城市中的喜慶之家。
sentences.en: The newly opened restaurant quickly became a home for celebration in the city with its delightful atmosphere and exquisite cuisine.

sentences.zh: 香海社團致力於推廣佛教文化，定期舉辦各類講座和禪修活動。
sentences.en: The Gandha Buddhist Society is dedicated to promoting Buddhist culture by regularly organizing various lectures and meditation retreats.

sentences.zh: 參加香海社團的活動讓我覺得身心靈都得到了滋養。
sentences.en: Attending events organized by the Gandha Buddhist Society has made me feel spiritually nourished.

sentences.zh: 香海社團的志願者們經常參與社區服務，傳遞慈悲和智慧。
sentences.en: Volunteers from the Gandha Buddhist Society frequently engage in community service, spreading compassion and wisdom.

sentences.zh: 通過香海社團，我結識了許多志同道合的朋友，並加深了對佛教的理解。
sentences.en: Through the Gandha Buddhist Society, I have made many like-minded friends and deepened my understanding of Buddhism.

sentences.zh: 每年農曆新年，寺廟都會舉辦大型香會，吸引了數以千計的信眾來參加。
sentences.en: Every Chinese New Year, the temple hosts a large devotees' gathering, attracting thousands of participants.

sentences.zh: 在香會期間，信徒們會一起誦經禱告，祈求來年的幸福與平安。
sentences.en: During the devotees' gathering, followers chant sutras and pray together for happiness and peace in the coming year.

sentences.zh: 香會是一個重要的社交活動，讓信眾不僅能夠弘揚佛法，還能彼此交流信仰。
sentences.en: The devotees' gathering is an important social event, allowing followers to not only spread the Dharma but also share their faith with one another.

sentences.zh: 這次香會由當地佛教協會組織，他們計劃安排多個活動來吸引年輕一代的參加。
sentences.en: This devotees' gathering is organized by the local Buddhist association, and they plan to arrange several activities to attract the younger generation.

sentences.zh: 每年都有成千上萬的香客來到佛教寺廟參拜，祈求平安與幸福。
sentences.en: Every year, thousands of pilgrims visit Buddhist temples to pray for peace and happiness.

sentences.zh: 這座佛寺以其宏偉的建築和悠久的歷史吸引了來自世界各地的香客。
sentences.en: This Buddhist temple, with its magnificent architecture and long history, attracts pilgrims from all over the world.

sentences.zh: 香客們通常會帶著供品進入寺廟，以表達他們的虔誠和尊敬。
sentences.en: Pilgrims often bring offerings when entering the temple as a gesture of their devotion and respect.

sentences.zh: 寺廟附近的商人們會為前來的香客準備各種佛教紀念品和供品。
sentences.en: Merchants near the temple prepare various Buddhist souvenirs and offerings for the arriving pilgrims.

sentences.zh: 這次朝聖活動，由經驗豐富的香頭負責安排路線和管理活動。
sentences.en: This pilgrimage activity was organized and managed by an experienced pilgrimage leader who planned the route and managed the events.

sentences.zh: 在旅途中，香頭不僅引導信徒向聖地進行朝聖，還提供了許多精神上的指導。
sentences.en: During the journey, the pilgrimage leader not only guided the devotees to the holy sites but also provided much spiritual guidance.

sentences.zh: 香頭需要具備組織能力及與各方溝通的技巧，以確保朝聖活動的順利進行。
sentences.en: A pilgrimage leader needs to have organizational skills and the ability to communicate effectively with all parties to ensure the smooth execution of the pilgrimage.

sentences.zh: 朝聖結束後，香頭召集所有參加者分享他們的心得和經驗。
sentences.en: After the pilgrimage concluded, the pilgrimage leader gathered all participants to share their insights and experiences.

sentences.zh: 每當進入寺廟時，他總不忘投下香油錢以表敬意。
sentences.en: Whenever he enters a temple, he never forgets to make a donation as a sign of respect.

sentences.zh: 這座寺廟的運營依賴於善心人士的香油錢。
sentences.en: The operation of this temple relies heavily on the donation from kind individuals.

sentences.zh: 她選擇將部分收入捐作香油錢，以支持寺廟的修繕計畫。
sentences.en: She chose to donate a portion of her income as a donation to support the temple's renovation project.

sentences.zh: 僧人感謝每一位施主的香油錢，並為他們祈福。
sentences.en: The monk thanks each benefactor for their donation and offers prayers for them.

phrase.en: The Mind is Like a Painter

sentences.zh: 修行者的心如工畫師，描繪出內心的風景，創造出無數的心靈境界。
sentences.en: The practitioner's mind is like a painter, depicting the landscapes of the inner self and creating numerous realms of the spirit.

sentences.zh: 佛經中，有一段說明心如工畫師，可畫出無邊無際的夢想與幻象。
sentences.en: In the Buddhist scriptures, there is a passage that explains how the mind is like a painter, capable of painting limitless dreams and illusions.

sentences.zh: 心如工畫師，若心存善念，則能創造出和諧與慈悲的畫作。
sentences.en: The mind is like a painter; if it harbors good thoughts, it can create paintings of harmony and compassion.

sentences.zh: 正如世間的一切由心所造，心如工畫師，將形色於意中具體化。
sentences.en: Just as everything in the world is created by the mind, the mind is like a painter that materializes forms and colors in the imagination.

sentences.zh: 今年的信徒大會將於下個月在佛教寺廟舉行，預計將有成千上萬的信徒參加。
sentences.en: This year's Devotees' Gathering will be held at the Buddhist temple next month, expecting thousands of devotees to attend.

sentences.zh: 在信徒大會上，大家分享了彼此的修行體驗和心得，氣氛非常融洽和諧。
sentences.en: During the Devotees' Gathering, everyone shared their spiritual experiences and insights, creating a harmonious and amicable atmosphere.

sentences.zh: 信徒大會提供了一個機會，讓信眾聚集在一起，聆聽高僧大德的開示。
sentences.en: The Devotees' Gathering provided an opportunity for adherents to come together to listen to teachings from revered monks.

sentences.zh: 每年信徒大會上，佛法講座都是最令人期待的環節之一。
sentences.en: The Dharma lecture is one of the most anticipated segments at the annual Devotees' Gathering.

sentences.zh: 這位信徒代表在會議上發言，表達了信眾們的心聲。
sentences.en: The devotees' representative spoke at the meeting, expressing the sentiments of the congregation.

sentences.zh: 經過選舉，他被推選為寺院的信徒代表，負責溝通信眾與僧團之間的事務。
sentences.en: After the election, he was chosen as the devotees' representative for the temple, tasked with mediating between the lay followers and monastic community.

sentences.zh: 作為信徒代表，她的責任包括協調各種宗教活動並確保大家的需求被滿足。
sentences.en: As the devotees' representative, her responsibilities include coordinating various religious activities and ensuring everyone's needs are met.

sentences.zh: 每年，信徒代表都會組織一場大型的慈善活動，以促進更強的社區聯繫。
sentences.en: Every year, the devotees' representative organizes a large charity event to foster stronger community connections.

sentences.zh: 這座寺廟被譽為信徒之家，吸引了來自各地的佛教信仰者前來參拜。
sentences.en: The temple is regarded as a home for devotees, attracting Buddhist followers from all over to come and worship.

sentences.zh: 信徒之家不僅是冥想的聖地，還提供了諸多佛學課程和修行機會。
sentences.en: The home for devotees is not only a sanctuary for meditation but also offers numerous Buddhist courses and practice opportunities.

sentences.zh: 在信徒之家，大家一起分享佛法，彼此鼓勵，共同進步。
sentences.en: At the home for devotees, people share the Dharma, encourage one another, and progress together.

sentences.zh: 無論是新手還是有經驗的修行者，信徒之家都歡迎他們的加入，以促進身心和靈性的成長。
sentences.en: Whether newcomers or experienced practitioners, the home for devotees welcomes them all to foster both personal and spiritual growth.

sentences.zh: 僧侶每天清晨會進行行腳托缽，接受信眾的供養。
sentences.en: Every morning, monks participate in the alms procession, receiving offerings from devotees.

sentences.zh: 行腳托缽是佛教中的一種修行方式，體現了僧侶的簡樸和依賴信眾的生活方式。
sentences.en: The alms procession is a form of practice in Buddhism, reflecting the monk's simplicity and dependence on the community for sustenance.

sentences.zh: 不少觀光客到訪佛教國家時，會觀賞清晨的行腳托缽儀式，體會當地的宗教文化。
sentences.en: Many tourists visiting Buddhist countries watch the early morning alms procession to experience the local religious culture.

sentences.zh: 在泰國，行腳托缽的形式非常普遍，是僧侶每日生活的一部分。
sentences.en: In Thailand, the practice of the alms procession is very common and is part of the monks' daily routine.

sentences.zh: 這位高僧主張行門，他強調理論必須在日常生活中實踐。
sentences.en: The venerable monk advocated teaching in practice, emphasizing that theories must be applied in daily life.

sentences.zh: 禪修不僅是坐禪，還包括在行門中檢驗自己的心境。
sentences.en: Zen meditation is not only about sitting in meditation but also about examining one's mind through teaching in practice.

sentences.zh: 行門是佛教修行的重要部分，幫助修行者從真實經驗中獲得智慧。
sentences.en: Teaching in practice is a crucial part of Buddhist practice, helping practitioners gain wisdom from real-life experiences.

sentences.zh: 他堅持行門超越任何書本知識，因為唯有經驗才能帶來真正的啟迪。
sentences.en: He insists that teaching in practice surpasses any book knowledge, as only experience can bring true enlightenment.

phrase.en: Venerable Master Hsing Yun's One-Stroke Calligraphy

sentences.zh: 星雲大師一筆字展現了他的書法造詣和智慧。
sentences.en: Venerable Master Hsing Yun's one-stroke calligraphy reveals his mastery of calligraphy and wisdom.

sentences.zh: 許多人珍藏星雲大師一筆字，因為它不僅是一種藝術作品，還包含了深刻的佛理。
sentences.en: Many people cherish Venerable Master Hsing Yun's one-stroke calligraphy because it is not only a work of art but also contains profound Buddhist principles.

sentences.zh: 在星雲大師的一筆字中，每一個字都傳達他對於慈悲與和諧的理念。
sentences.en: In Venerable Master Hsing Yun's one-stroke calligraphy, each character conveys his ideals of compassion and harmony.

sentences.zh: 該展覽展示了多幅星雲大師一筆字，吸引了大量書法愛好者參觀。
sentences.en: The exhibition showcased many pieces of Venerable Master Hsing Yun's one-stroke calligraphy, attracting a large number of calligraphy enthusiasts.

sentences.zh: 許多傑出的教育工作者因在教育領域的貢獻而獲得了星雲教育獎。
sentences.en: Many outstanding educators have been awarded the Hsing Yun Education Award for their contributions to the field of education.

sentences.zh: 獲得星雲教育獎是對他多年來在教育創新的肯定。
sentences.en: Receiving the Hsing Yun Education Award is a recognition of his years of educational innovation.

sentences.zh: 星雲教育獎旨在鼓勵和支持全球範圍內的教育改革和進步。
sentences.en: The Hsing Yun Education Award aims to encourage and support educational reform and advancement worldwide.

sentences.zh: 她因其開創性的教學方法而被提名為星雲教育獎的候選人。
sentences.en: She was nominated for the Hsing Yun Education Award for her groundbreaking teaching methods.

sentences.zh: 星雲文學獎自成立以來，鼓勵了無數作家創作出色的作品。
sentences.en: Since its inception, The Hsing Yun Literature Award has encouraged countless writers to create outstanding works.

sentences.zh: 他的小說獲得了今年的星雲文學獎，這是對他多年努力的最大認可。
sentences.en: His novel won this year's Hsing Yun Literature Award, which is the greatest recognition of his years of hard work.

sentences.zh: 星雲文學獎旨在推廣以佛教精神為底蘊的文學創作。
sentences.en: The Hsing Yun Literature Award aims to promote literary creations rooted in Buddhist spirit.

sentences.zh: 每年都有來自世界各地的作家競逐星雲文學獎，希望能獲得這一殊榮。
sentences.en: Every year, writers from around the world compete for The Hsing Yun Literature Award, hoping to earn this prestigious honor.

sentences.zh: 這位行者每天投入數小時進行禪修，尋求內心的平靜與智慧。
sentences.en: The practitioner spends several hours each day in meditation, seeking inner peace and wisdom.

sentences.zh: 那位年輕的行者在佛寺學習佛法，希望最終能成為一名出色的導師。
sentences.en: The young practitioner is studying Buddhism in the monastery, hoping to become an excellent teacher one day.

sentences.zh: 行者們通常會遵循嚴格的道德戒律以提高心靈的純淨度。
sentences.en: Practitioners usually follow strict ethical precepts to enhance their mental purity.

sentences.zh: 許多行者開始他們的修行旅程是為了了解生命的更深層意義。
sentences.en: Many practitioners embark on their spiritual journey to understand the deeper meaning of life.

sentences.zh: 他被大家稱讚為義工的義工，因為他總是為其他義工提供協助和支持。
sentences.en: He is praised as a volunteer's volunteer because he is always there to assist and support other volunteers.

sentences.zh: 在這個活動中，她扮演了義工的義工角色，確保每位參與者都有需要的資源。
sentences.en: During the event, she acted as a volunteer's volunteer, ensuring that each participant had the necessary resources.

sentences.zh: 義工的義工往往是整個團隊的支柱，無私地奉獻時間以協助項目的成功。
sentences.en: A volunteer's volunteer often serves as the backbone of the entire team, selflessly dedicating time to help ensure the project's success.

sentences.zh: 作為義工的義工，他始終堅持查漏補缺，讓每次活動都圓滿進行。
sentences.en: As a volunteer's volunteer, he consistently ensures that all gaps are filled, allowing every event to proceed smoothly.

sentences.zh: 一九五三歌詠隊在禪修營中演唱了感人至深的佛教讚歌。
sentences.en: The 1953 Buddhist Youth Choir performed deeply moving Buddhist hymns at the meditation retreat.

sentences.zh: 寺廟祈福儀式中，一九五三歌詠隊展現了他們的音樂才華。
sentences.en: During the temple's blessing ceremony, the 1953 Buddhist Youth Choir showcased their musical talents.

sentences.zh: 一九五三歌詠隊成立以來，已成為寺廟活動中的一道亮麗風景線。
sentences.en: Since its inception, the 1953 Buddhist Youth Choir has become a highlight at temple events.

sentences.zh: 他們加入了一九五三歌詠隊以傳播佛教的核心教義。
sentences.en: They joined the 1953 Buddhist Youth Choir to spread the core teachings of Buddhism.

sentences.zh: 我們今天見面的這次會議，真是一期一會，希望未來還有機會再相聚。
sentences.en: Our meeting today is truly a case of paths only cross once, and I hope we have the chance to meet again in the future.

sentences.zh: 日本茶道強調一期一會，把每一次聚會都當作唯一的一次機會來珍惜。
sentences.en: The Japanese tea ceremony emphasizes paths only cross once, cherishing each gathering as if it's the only chance.

sentences.zh: 旅行中偶然遇到的人，可能就是一期一會的緣分，所以要學會珍惜每一次相遇。
sentences.en: The people you meet by chance during travels might be paths only cross once, so it's important to cherish each encounter.

sentences.zh: 人生就像一期一會，在不同的人生階段遇到不同的人，而我們應該珍惜這些瞬間。
sentences.en: Life is like paths only cross once, where we meet different people at different stages, and we should cherish these moments.

sentences.zh: 因果福利社販賣的不僅僅是商品，更是一種生活的態度，提醒人們行為與後果之間的關係。
sentences.en: The Cause and Effect Store sells not just products but a lifestyle attitude, reminding people of the relationship between actions and consequences.

sentences.zh: 每一道食材在因果福利社都有著自己獨特的故事，顧客在購物的同時也學習到了因果法則。
sentences.en: Every ingredient at the Cause and Effect Store has its own unique story, allowing customers to learn about the laws of cause and effect while shopping.

sentences.zh: 因果福利社倡導可持續發展和負責任的消費，從而激勵消費者考慮自己的消費選擇對環境的影響。
sentences.en: The Cause and Effect Store advocates sustainable development and responsible consumption, encouraging consumers to consider the impact of their choices on the environment.

sentences.zh: 在因果福利社選購的商品，每一次交易都是一個體現因果法則的機會，讓人們更深刻地思考自己的生活方式。
sentences.en: Every transaction at the Cause and Effect Store is an opportunity to embody the law of cause and effect, prompting people to think more deeply about their lifestyle choices.

sentences.zh: 雲水護智車在寺廟裡提供必要的交通運輸服務，輔助僧人進行每日修行。
sentences.en: The Mentality Protection Center Vehicles provide necessary transportation services within the temple, assisting monks with their daily practices.

sentences.zh: 這些雲水護智車以其低排放和環保而受到大家的讚揚。
sentences.en: These Mentality Protection Center Vehicles are praised for their low emissions and environmental friendliness.

sentences.zh: 寺院捐贈了一批新的雲水護智車，以促進其慈善活動的有效推進。
sentences.en: The monastery donated a fleet of new Mentality Protection Center Vehicles to enhance the effectiveness of its charitable activities.

sentences.zh: 每周末，雲水護智車負責接送來自偏遠地區的信眾，讓他們參加法會。
sentences.en: Every weekend, the Mentality Protection Center Vehicles are responsible for picking up devotees from remote areas to allow them to attend dharma assemblies.

sentences.zh: 雲水樓主是一位有名的禪宗大師，在他的道場中教導眾生修行。
sentences.en: Yunshui Louzhu is a renowned Zen master who teaches beings to cultivate in his monastery.

sentences.zh: 許多人慕名而來，只求一見雲水樓主的風采和智慧。
sentences.en: Many people come from afar, seeking just a glimpse of Yunshui Louzhu's grace and wisdom.

sentences.zh: 在雲水樓主的指導下，弟子們的修行之路更加穩定和平和。
sentences.en: Under the guidance of Yunshui Louzhu, the disciples' path of practice becomes more stable and peaceful.

sentences.zh: 雲水樓主常說，人生如浮雲流水，應隨緣而行，不必強求。
sentences.en: Yunshui Louzhu often says that life is like floating clouds and flowing water; one should go with the flow and not force anything.

phrase.en: Cloud and Water Mobile Library Trucks

sentences.zh: 雲水書車就像一座流動的圖書館，將知識傳遞到偏遠地區。
sentences.en: The Cloud and Water Mobile Library Trucks are like a moving library, delivering knowledge to remote areas.

sentences.zh: 在城鎮看不到的地方，雲水書車成為孩子們閱讀的希望。
sentences.en: In areas not reached by the town libraries, the Cloud and Water Mobile Library Trucks become a beacon of hope for children's reading.

sentences.zh: 許多地方的學生因著雲水書車擁有了他們第一本書。
sentences.en: Many students in different areas received their first book thanks to the Cloud and Water Mobile Library Trucks.

sentences.zh: 雲水書車不僅帶來知識，更是一種心靈的提升。
sentences.en: The Cloud and Water Mobile Library Trucks bring not just knowledge, but also an uplifting of the spirit.

sentences.zh: 雲水書車行動圖書館為偏遠地區的孩子們送去了知識和希望。
sentences.en: The Cloud and Water Mobile Library brought knowledge and hope to children in remote areas.

sentences.zh: 在這座城市，雲水書車行動圖書館已經運行了十多年，成為許多人心中的精神燈塔。
sentences.en: In this city, the Cloud and Water Mobile Library has been running for over a decade, becoming a beacon of inspiration for many.

sentences.zh: 每週，雲水書車行動圖書館巡迴於各個村莊，並與當地學校合作進行閱讀活動。
sentences.en: Each week, the Cloud and Water Mobile Library tours various villages and collaborates with local schools to conduct reading activities.

sentences.zh: 志願者們熱心地支持雲水書車行動圖書館，確保書籍的持續更新和運輸。
sentences.en: Volunteers ardently support the Cloud and Water Mobile Library, ensuring the continuous update and transport of books.

sentences.zh: 雲水書坊駛入小村莊，為居民們帶來了豐富的閱讀資源和文化交流的機會。
sentences.en: The Cloud and Water Mobile Library drove into the small village, bringing abundant reading resources and opportunities for cultural exchange to the residents.

sentences.zh: 孩子們迫不及待地湧向雲水書坊，希望能借到自己喜歡讀的書籍。
sentences.en: The children eagerly rushed to the Cloud and Water Mobile Library, hoping to borrow books they enjoyed reading.

sentences.zh: 這個月雲水書坊的主題是環保，書籍篩選特別注重於環境和可持續發展。
sentences.en: This month's theme for the Cloud and Water Mobile Library is environmental protection, with books selected especially focusing on the environment and sustainability.

sentences.zh: 雲水書坊的志願者熱情地幫助村民們選書，並分享閱讀心得。
sentences.en: Volunteers at the Cloud and Water Mobile Library enthusiastically helped the villagers choose books and shared their reading experiences.

phrase.en: traveling by foot like the flowing water and moving clouds

sentences.zh: 修行僧人以雲水行腳的方式在各地游歷，體驗世間百態。
sentences.en: The itinerant monks traveled by foot like the flowing water and moving clouds, experiencing the diverse aspects of the world.

sentences.zh: 在旅途中，他選擇了雲水行腳的生活方式，追尋內心的寧靜和自由。
sentences.en: On his journey, he chose a lifestyle of traveling by foot like the flowing water and moving clouds, seeking inner peace and freedom.

sentences.zh: 雲水行腳使他能夠與自然和諧共處，並對人生有了更深刻的理解。
sentences.en: Traveling by foot like the flowing water and moving clouds allowed him to live harmoniously with nature and gain a deeper understanding of life.

sentences.zh: 通過雲水行腳，他見識了不同的文化和風俗，豐富了自己的思想。
sentences.en: By traveling by foot like the flowing water and moving clouds, he encountered diverse cultures and customs, enriching his mind.

sentences.zh: 雲水醫療車巡迴各個偏遠地區，提供必要的醫療服務給缺乏資源的社群。
sentences.en: The Cloud and Water Mobile Clinic travels to remote areas, providing essential healthcare services to under-resourced communities.

sentences.zh: 當災難來襲時，雲水醫療車迅速行動，為災民提供緊急醫療協助。
sentences.en: When disasters strike, the Cloud and Water Mobile Clinic quickly mobilizes to provide emergency medical aid to the affected individuals.

sentences.zh: 志願者在雲水醫療車上工作，以確保村莊居民能夠獲得他們所需的醫療保健。
sentences.en: Volunteers work on the Cloud and Water Mobile Clinic to ensure that villagers receive the healthcare they need.

sentences.zh: 透過雲水醫療車的努力，更多的人們了解了健康的重要性和預防疾病的方法。
sentences.en: Through the efforts of the Cloud and Water Mobile Clinic, more people have become aware of the importance of health and methods of disease prevention.

phrase.en: Truthful, Virtuous, and Beautiful Media Awards

sentences.zh: 這位記者因其報導的誠實和正直而榮獲真善美傳播貢獻獎。
sentences.en: The journalist was honored with the Truthful, Virtuous, and Beautiful Media Awards for her honest and integrity in reporting.

sentences.zh: 真善美傳播貢獻獎旨在鼓勵媒體工作者表現出最高標準的道德品質。
sentences.en: The Truthful, Virtuous, and Beautiful Media Awards aim to encourage media professionals to exhibit the highest standards of moral quality.

sentences.zh: 每年，真善美傳播貢獻獎會為那些在媒體行業內傳播正能量的人士頒獎。
sentences.en: Each year, the Truthful, Virtuous, and Beautiful Media Awards are given to individuals who spread positivity in the media industry.

sentences.zh: 她的紀錄片不僅獲得好評，還贏得了今年的真善美傳播貢獻獎。
sentences.en: Her documentary received critical acclaim and also won this year's Truthful, Virtuous, and Beautiful Media Awards.

phrase.en: Truthful, Virtuous, and Beautiful Media Awards

sentences.zh: 他們的紀錄片在今年的真善美媒體貢獻獎中榮獲最佳影片，以其深刻的社會洞察力受到了嘉獎。
sentences.en: Their documentary won Best Picture at this year's Truthful, Virtuous, and Beautiful Media Awards, praised for its profound social insight.

sentences.zh: 該獎項旨在表彰那些在傳播真相、傳遞美德、展現美好中有傑出表現的媒體工作者。
sentences.en: The award aims to recognize media professionals who excel in conveying truth, spreading virtue, and showcasing beauty.

sentences.zh: 她因其在新聞報導中展現的誠懇和正直，第三次獲得真善美媒體貢獻獎。
sentences.en: For the third time, she received the Truthful, Virtuous, and Beautiful Media Award for her sincerity and integrity in news reporting.

sentences.zh: 獲得真善美媒體貢獻獎對於媒體機構而言是一項巨大的榮譽，意味著他們的努力和正向影響得到了肯定。
sentences.en: Receiving the Truthful, Virtuous, and Beautiful Media Award is a great honor for media organizations, signifying recognition of their efforts and positive impact.

sentences.zh: 志開上人在禪修上有深厚的造詣，經常指導信徒深入禪定。
sentences.en: Venerable Master Zhi Kai has profound accomplishments in meditation, often guiding disciples into deep samadhi.

sentences.zh: 許多人慕名前來聆聽志開上人的開示，不僅因為他的智慧，還有那份慈悲心。
sentences.en: Many people come to listen to Venerable Master Zhi Kai's teachings, drawn not only by his wisdom but also by his compassion.

sentences.zh: 志開上人提倡用行動來弘揚佛法，強調身教重於言教。
sentences.en: Venerable Master Zhi Kai advocates for the propagation of Buddhism through actions, emphasizing that leading by example is more impactful than words.

sentences.zh: 在過去的佛學研討會上，志開上人講述了如何在現代生活中找到內心的寧靜。
sentences.en: At the recent Buddhist symposium, Venerable Master Zhi Kai spoke about how to find inner peace in modern life.

sentences.zh: 在寺廟的入口，知客師微笑著迎接每位來訪的客人。
sentences.en: At the entrance of the temple, the receptionist warmly greeted each arriving visitor.

sentences.zh: 知客師的工作是確保寺廟活動的順利進行，並協助信徒解答疑問。
sentences.en: The receptionist's job is to ensure the smooth operation of temple events and assist devotees with their inquiries.

sentences.zh: 當你需要任何幫助時，知客師會很樂意協助你並提供資訊。
sentences.en: If you need any help, the receptionist will be happy to assist you and provide information.

sentences.zh: 寺廟的知客師強調禮儀與和善，是聯繫信眾與佛法的一座橋樑。
sentences.en: The temple receptionist emphasizes courtesy and kindness, acting as a bridge between the laypeople and the Dharma.

phrase.zh: 中國佛教白話經典寶藏
phrase.en: Selected Chinese Buddhist Texts in Modern Language

sentences.zh: 中國佛教白話經典寶藏讓現代人更容易理解和欣賞古老經文的智慧。
sentences.en: The Selected Chinese Buddhist Texts in Modern Language make it easier for contemporary people to understand and appreciate the wisdom of ancient scriptures.

sentences.zh: 她閱讀了中國佛教白話經典寶藏，從中獲得了心靈的啟迪和生活的指引。
sentences.en: She read the Selected Chinese Buddhist Texts in Modern Language and gained spiritual inspiration and guidance for her life.

sentences.zh: 這次研討會的主題是如何將中國佛教白話經典寶藏融入現代社會的日常實踐。
sentences.en: The theme of this seminar is how to integrate Selected Chinese Buddhist Texts in Modern Language into daily practices in modern society.

sentences.zh: 出版中國佛教白話經典寶藏的目的是促進佛教思想的廣泛傳播和交流。
sentences.en: The purpose of publishing Selected Chinese Buddhist Texts in Modern Language is to promote widespread dissemination and exchange of Buddhist thought.

phrase.en: Chunghua Federation of Traditional Religious Associations

sentences.zh: 中華傳統宗教總會在推廣文化交流與宗教和諧方面發揮了重要作用。
sentences.en: The Chunghua Federation of Traditional Religious Associations plays a crucial role in promoting cultural exchange and religious harmony.

sentences.zh: 每年，中華傳統宗教總會都會舉辦一系列傳統節日慶典活動。
sentences.en: Every year, the Chunghua Federation of Traditional Religious Associations organizes a series of traditional festival celebrations.

sentences.zh: 許多宗教學者參與了中華傳統宗教總會的學術研討會，以促進研究合作。
sentences.en: Many religious scholars participate in the academic conferences of the Chunghua Federation of Traditional Religious Associations to foster research collaboration.

sentences.zh: 中華傳統宗教總會致力於保護和傳承中華文化遺產，尤其是宗教相關的慶典和習俗。
sentences.en: The Chunghua Federation of Traditional Religious Associations is committed to preserving and transmitting Chinese cultural heritage, especially religious festivals and customs.

phrase.en: Chunghua Society for Ancient and Modern Humanities

sentences.zh: 中華古今人文協會定期舉辦工作坊，促進對傳統文化的深入了解。
sentences.en: The Chunghua Society for Ancient and Modern Humanities regularly conducts workshops to promote a deeper understanding of traditional culture.

sentences.zh: 加入中華古今人文協會是了解中國歷史的一個很好的途徑。
sentences.en: Joining the Chunghua Society for Ancient and Modern Humanities is a great way to learn about Chinese history.

sentences.zh: 中華古今人文協會的年度會議吸引了來自世界各地的學者與研究者。
sentences.en: The annual conference of the Chunghua Society for Ancient and Modern Humanities attracts scholars and researchers from around the world.

sentences.zh: 中華古今人文協會的宗旨是將古典與現代的人文精神融合在一起。
sentences.en: The mission of the Chunghua Society for Ancient and Modern Humanities is to integrate classical and modern humanistic values.

sentences.zh: 我在圖書館找到了一幅詳細的中華文化歷史系統圖，幫助我更好地理解中國的歷史脈絡。
sentences.en: I found a detailed Chinese cultural and historical chart in the library that helped me better understand the historical context of China.

sentences.zh: 這份中華文化歷史系統圖展示了從遠古到現代各個重要朝代和事件。
sentences.en: This Chinese cultural and historical chart displays significant dynasties and events from ancient times to the modern era.

sentences.zh: 學者利用中華文化歷史系統圖來分析不同時期的文化變遷和影響。
sentences.en: Scholars use the Chinese cultural and historical chart to analyze cultural transitions and influences across different periods.

sentences.zh: 這張中華文化歷史系統圖是我在文化研究課堂上用來展示中華文明演進的重要工具。
sentences.en: This Chinese cultural and historical chart is an important tool I use in my cultural studies class to illustrate the evolution of Chinese civilization.

sentences.zh: 這位老師在教育界一直被視為中流砥柱，他啟發了無數學生。
sentences.en: This teacher has always been regarded as the foundation pillar of society in the field of education, inspiring countless students.

sentences.zh: 在困難時期，工人們成為社會的中流砥柱，確保了日常生活的正常運轉。
sentences.en: During difficult times, workers became the foundation pillar of society, ensuring the smooth running of daily life.

sentences.zh: 這家企業通過其創新和社會責任感，成為了科技界的中流砥柱。
sentences.en: Through its innovation and sense of social responsibility, this company became the foundation pillar of society in the tech industry.

sentences.zh: 醫護人員在疫情期間，再次證明了他們是社會的中流砥柱。
sentences.en: Healthcare workers have once again proven themselves to be the foundation pillar of society during the pandemic.

sentences.zh: 中日佛教促進會致力於促進兩國佛教徒之間的友好交流與合作。
sentences.en: The China-Japan Buddhist Progress Society is committed to promoting friendly exchanges and cooperation between Buddhists of the two countries.

sentences.zh: 作為佛教活動的一部分，中日佛教促進會每年舉辦多次文化交流活動。
sentences.en: As part of its activities, the China-Japan Buddhist Progress Society organizes multiple cultural exchange events annually.

sentences.zh: 中日佛教促進會發布了一本關於兩國佛教歷史的研究報告，受到學術界的高度重視。
sentences.en: The China-Japan Buddhist Progress Society published a research report on the history of Buddhism in both countries, which received high regard from the academic community.

sentences.zh: 在中日佛教促進會的推動下，兩國佛教青年參加了為期一週的研討會，增進了相互了解。
sentences.en: Under the auspices of the China-Japan Buddhist Progress Society, young Buddhists from both countries participated in a week-long seminar to enhance mutual understanding.

sentences.zh: 這次的國際會議強調了宗教融和的重要性，促進不同信仰之間的理解與合作。
sentences.en: The international conference highlighted the importance of interfaith harmony, promoting understanding and cooperation among different faiths.

sentences.zh: 社區活動的主題是宗教融和，並邀請多個宗教領袖參加討論和分享。
sentences.en: The theme of the community event was interfaith harmony, and several religious leaders were invited to participate in discussions and share insights.

sentences.zh: 教育部門正在推行一項宗教融和計劃，以促進學校中學生之間的宗教理解和包容。
sentences.en: The education department is implementing an interfaith harmony program to foster religious understanding and inclusivity among students in schools.

sentences.zh: 在宗教融和的精神指引下，當地的多個宗教團體組織了共同的慈善活動，幫助有需要的人。
sentences.en: Guided by the spirit of interfaith harmony, several local religious groups organized a joint charity event to help those in need.

sentences.zh: 自覺教育是一種啟發內心智慧的過程，使個人能夠更深入地理解自己和周圍的世界。
sentences.en: Education of self-awareness is a process that inspires inner wisdom, enabling individuals to gain deeper understanding of themselves and the world around them.

sentences.zh: 透過自覺教育，他學會了在面對困難時，保持內心的平和與清晰。
sentences.en: Through education of self-awareness, he learned to maintain inner peace and clarity when facing difficulties.

sentences.zh: 自覺教育讓人們更能意識到他們的行為與選擇對他人和環境的影響。
sentences.en: Education of self-awareness helps people become more conscious of how their actions and choices affect others and the environment.

sentences.zh: 老師們開始將自覺教育融入課程，以培養學生的情緒智力和自我反思能力。
sentences.en: Teachers are beginning to integrate education of self-awareness into the curriculum to foster students' emotional intelligence and capacity for self-reflection.

sentences.zh: 他在冥想中獲得了一次深刻的宗教體驗，這改變了他對人生的看法。
sentences.en: He had a profound religious experience during meditation, which changed his outlook on life.

sentences.zh: 參加朝聖被他描述為一種難以言喻的宗教體驗。
sentences.en: Participating in the pilgrimage was described by him as an indescribable religious experience.

sentences.zh: 在那座古寺中，她感受到了一種平和而超然的宗教體驗。
sentences.en: In that ancient temple, she felt a peaceful and transcendent religious experience.

sentences.zh: 對許多人來說，宗教體驗提供了一種新的視角來理解存在的意義。
sentences.en: For many, religious experience provides a new perspective on understanding the meaning of existence.

sentences.zh: 那位受人尊敬的宗教師每週都在寺廟為信徒們講經說法。
sentences.en: The respected religious teacher conducts sermons for the devotees at the temple every week.

sentences.zh: 作為一名宗教師，她的工作是在孩子們中間傳播善良和正直的價值觀。
sentences.en: As a religious teacher, her role is to instill values of kindness and integrity among the children.

sentences.zh: 這位宗教師花了多年時間研究經典，從而成為該領域的權威。
sentences.en: The religious teacher spent years studying the scriptures, becoming an authority in the field.

sentences.zh: 他感謝他的宗教師，因為他指引了他走上了一條充滿意義的生活道路。
sentences.en: He was grateful to his religious teacher for guiding him onto a path of meaningful living.

phrase.en: Office of the Board of Directors

sentences.zh: 在寺廟的行政工作中，宗務堂負責所有重要的決策和管理事宜。
sentences.en: In the temple's administration, the Office of the Board of Directors is responsible for all major decisions and management matters.

sentences.zh: 他獲選為宗務堂的成員，參與寺院的長期規劃。
sentences.en: He was elected as a member of the Office of the Board of Directors to participate in the long-term planning of the monastery.

sentences.zh: 每週，宗務堂都會舉行會議以討論各項重要事務。
sentences.en: The Office of the Board of Directors holds weekly meetings to discuss various important matters.

sentences.zh: 宗務堂最近發佈了一項新決策，影響到寺廟的運營方式。
sentences.en: The Office of the Board of Directors recently announced a new decision that affects the temple's mode of operation.

sentences.zh: 佛光山的宗務委員會在年度會議上討論了未來的發展計劃和策略。
sentences.en: The FGS Board of Directors discussed future development plans and strategies at the annual meeting.

sentences.zh: 作為佛光山宗務委員會的成員，她致力於推動佛教教育和慈善活動。
sentences.en: As a member of the FGS Board of Directors, she is committed to promoting Buddhist education and charitable activities.

sentences.zh: 宗務委員會最近批准了一項新的社區服務計劃，將在全國範圍內展開。
sentences.en: The FGS Board of Directors recently approved a new community service program that will be launched nationwide.

sentences.zh: 在宗務委員會的指導下，佛光山的國際影響力顯著增強。
sentences.en: Under the guidance of the FGS Board of Directors, the international influence of Fo Guang Shan has been significantly strengthened.

sentences.zh: 學習佛教經典時，了解宗要至關重要，以把握其中的精髓。
sentences.en: When studying Buddhist scriptures, understanding the core teachings is crucial to grasp their essence.

sentences.zh: 這堂課將幫助你掌握佛教的宗要，幫助你增進信仰。
sentences.en: This course will help you grasp the core teachings of Buddhism, enhancing your faith.

sentences.zh: 佛陀的宗要旨在引導眾生走向解脫之道。
sentences.en: The core teachings of the Buddha aim to guide sentient beings towards the path of liberation.

sentences.zh: 在傳播佛法的過程中，佛教徒常會引用經典以強調其宗要。
sentences.en: In the process of propagating the Dharma, Buddhists often quote scriptures to emphasize their core teachings.

sentences.zh: 每隔一段時間，寺廟會在祖師堂舉行大規模的法會，吸引了許多信眾前來參加。
sentences.en: Periodically, the temple holds grand ceremonies in the Patriarch Hall, attracting many devotees to participate.

sentences.zh: 祖師堂是禪宗寺院中非常重要的建築，供奉著歷代祖師的牌位。
sentences.en: The Patriarch Hall is a very important structure in Zen monasteries, housing the memorial tablets for successive patriarchs.

sentences.zh: 在祖師堂裡打坐冥想可以讓人更接近祖師當年的修行境界。
sentences.en: Meditating in the Patriarch Hall allows one to feel closer to the spiritual practice of the patriarchs of old.

sentences.zh: 遊客們參觀祖師堂時，對其莊嚴的氣氛和歷史深感震撼。
sentences.en: Visitors to the Patriarch Hall are often moved by its solemn atmosphere and rich history.

sentences.zh: 參悟祖師西來意需要深刻的內心修行與體悟。
sentences.en: Understanding the meaning of Bodhidharma coming from the West requires deep internal practice and realization.

sentences.zh: 有關祖師西來意的公案常用於引導禪修者領悟無字真經。
sentences.en: The koan regarding Bodhidharma coming from the West is often used to guide meditators to understand the unwritten sutra.

sentences.zh: 禪師問僧人：『如何是祖師西來意？』以測試他的悟性。
sentences.en: The Zen master asked the monk, 'What is the meaning of Bodhidharma coming from the West?' to test his understanding.

sentences.zh: 對於祖師西來意，每個人可能會在各自的修行階段獲得不同的體會。
sentences.en: Regarding the meaning of Bodhidharma coming from the West, each person may gain different insights at various stages of their practice.

sentences.zh: 在民主社會中，尊重異己的觀點是促進自由對話和進步的重要基石。
sentences.en: In a democratic society, respecting dissidents' views is a crucial cornerstone for fostering free dialogue and progress.

sentences.zh: 佛教教導我們應該尊重異己，因為每個生命都具有其獨特的價值和觀點。
sentences.en: Buddhism teaches us to respect dissidents, as every life has its unique value and perspective.

sentences.zh: 尊重異己的做法可以幫助消除誤解和偏見，並促成彼此之間的和諧共處。
sentences.en: Practicing respect for dissidents can help eliminate misunderstandings and prejudices and foster harmonious coexistence.

sentences.zh: 政府應該制定政策以更好地保護和尊重異己，以維護多元化和包容性。
sentences.en: Governments should implement policies to better protect and respect dissidents, maintaining diversity and inclusiveness.

sentences.zh: 孩子們在課堂上做中學，通過實踐活動加深對知識的理解。
sentences.en: The students are learning through experience in the classroom by engaging in hands-on activities to deepen their understanding.

sentences.zh: 這位年輕的僧侶相信做中學的力量，他努力將佛教教義融入日常生活中。
sentences.en: The young monk believes in the power of learning through experience and strives to integrate Buddhist teachings into his daily life.

sentences.zh: 老和尚強調做中學，鼓勵弟子們在實際修行中鍛鍊智慧。
sentences.en: The elder monk emphasizes learning through experience, encouraging his disciples to cultivate wisdom through actual practice.

sentences.zh: 工作中，做中學是一種有效增進技能的方法，許多專業人士都積極採用。
sentences.en: In the workplace, learning through experience is an effective method to enhance skills, and many professionals actively adopt this approach.

sentences.zh: 修行佛法可以幫助我們做自己的主人，而不被外界的誘惑所支配。
sentences.en: Practicing the Dharma can help us be masters of ourselves and not be controlled by external temptations.

sentences.zh: 在生活中，我們應該學會做自己的主人，勇敢面對挑戰，不隨波逐流。
sentences.en: In life, we should learn to be masters of ourselves, courageously facing challenges instead of going with the flow.

sentences.zh: 當心靈平靜，我們才能真正做自己的主人，聽從內心的聲音。
sentences.en: Only when our mind is tranquil can we truly be masters of ourselves, listening to our inner voice.

sentences.zh: 做自己的主人意味著擁有自控力，能夠在困難面前保持清醒和決斷。
sentences.en: Being masters of ourselves means having self-control, staying clear and decisive in the face of difficulties.

sentences.zh: 每年他們都會在祖庭舉行重要的宗族祭祀活動，以紀念祖先的功德。
sentences.en: Every year, they hold significant clan rituals at the ancestral temple to honor the deeds of their ancestors.

sentences.zh: 在這座古老的祖庭裡，可以看到家族歷史的豐富文物和珍貴的文獻。
sentences.en: In this ancient ancestral temple, you can see rich artifacts and treasured documents of the family's history.

sentences.zh: 孩子們在祖庭裡學習到不少關於他們家族過去的有趣故事。
sentences.en: The children learned many interesting stories about their family's past within the ancestral temple.

sentences.zh: 祖庭不僅是宗教活動的中心，也是凝聚家族成員的情感紐帶。
sentences.en: The ancestral temple is not only a center for religious activities but also a bond that unites family members emotionally.

sentences.zh: 庵主在早課後帶領眾人一起打坐冥想，使整個庵堂靜謐而充滿法喜。
sentences.en: The Head of the Nunnery led everyone in meditation after the morning prayers, bringing an air of tranquility and spiritual joy to the sanctuary.

sentences.zh: 這位庵主多年來悉心指導年輕的比丘尼，將她們培養成為慈悲和智慧兼具的人。
sentences.en: The Head of the Nunnery has carefully guided the young nuns for many years, nurturing them to become compassionate and wise individuals.

sentences.zh: 庵主決定在庵堂後院建立一個有機菜園，供應所有居士和遊客的日常膳食。
sentences.en: The Head of the Nunnery decided to establish an organic vegetable garden in the monastery's backyard to provide daily meals for all residents and visitors.

sentences.zh: 每當遇到庵堂的重大決策，庵主總會廣泛徵詢其他人的意見和建議。
sentences.en: Whenever there is a major decision to be made at the nunnery, the Head of the Nunnery always seeks the opinions and suggestions of others.

sentences.zh: 每到週末，全寺的僧侶都會一起出普坡，共同維持寺廟的清潔與秩序。
sentences.en: Every weekend, all the monks participate in monastery-wide chores to maintain the cleanliness and order of the temple.

sentences.zh: 即使是修行精進的高僧，依然會與其他僧侶一起出普坡，以示平等共行。
sentences.en: Even the highly cultivated monks join the monastery-wide chores with others to demonstrate equality and communal practice.

sentences.zh: 出普坡時，各人分攤不同的責任，務必完成整個寺廟的打掃和修繕工作。
sentences.en: During monastery-wide chores, each person takes on different responsibilities to ensure the entire temple is cleaned and maintained.

sentences.zh: 僧人們在出普坡的過程中，學習團隊合作以及尊重彼此的奉獻精神。
sentences.en: Monks learn teamwork and mutual respect for each other's dedication during the monastery-wide chores.

sentences.zh: 在寺廟的大殿中，裝飾著五彩繽紛的幢蓋，增添了莊嚴與神聖的氛圍。
sentences.en: In the main hall of the temple, colorful banners and canopies decorated the space, adding to the solemn and sacred atmosphere.

sentences.zh: 這些幢蓋在佛教儀式中具有象徵意義，代表著祈禱與祝福。
sentences.en: These banners and canopies carry symbolic meaning in Buddhist ceremonies, representing prayers and blessings.

sentences.zh: 在盛大的法會上，僧侶們在幢蓋底下進行誦經和禮拜活動。
sentences.en: During the grand Dharma assembly, the monks performed chanting and worship activities under the banners and canopies.

sentences.zh: 幢蓋的製作過程精細，每一針一線都蘊含著工匠的智慧與信仰。
sentences.en: The process of making banners and canopies is meticulous, with every stitch imbued with the artisans' wisdom and devotion.

sentences.zh: 佛光山佛陀紀念館是台灣著名的佛教文化中心，吸引了來自世界各地的遊客。
sentences.en: FGS Buddha Museum is a renowned Buddhist cultural center in Taiwan, attracting visitors from all over the world.

sentences.zh: 在佛光山佛陀紀念館，遊客可以親眼看到許多珍貴的佛教文物。
sentences.en: At the FGS Buddha Museum, visitors can witness a vast collection of valuable Buddhist artifacts.

sentences.zh: 佛光山佛陀紀念館的建築設計融合了傳統與現代，展現出佛教的智慧與慈悲。
sentences.en: The architectural design of the FGS Buddha Museum combines traditional and modern elements, showcasing the wisdom and compassion of Buddhism.

sentences.zh: 每年的佛誕節，佛光山佛陀紀念館會舉辦盛大的慶典，吸引了成千上萬的信徒參加。
sentences.en: Every year on the Buddha's Birthday, the FGS Buddha Museum hosts grand celebrations that attract thousands of devotees.

phrase.en: Association of Ancient and Modern Humanities

sentences.zh: 古今人文協會致力於促進對歷史和現代文化的理解與交流。
sentences.en: The Association of Ancient and Modern Humanities is dedicated to fostering understanding and exchange between historical and contemporary cultures.

sentences.zh: 他在古今人文協會的講座中分享了他對文學演變的研究。
sentences.en: He shared his research on the evolution of literature at a lecture hosted by the Association of Ancient and Modern Humanities.

sentences.zh: 古今人文協會組織了一系列講座，探討東西方文化的交融。
sentences.en: The Association of Ancient and Modern Humanities organized a series of lectures exploring the integration of Eastern and Western cultures.

sentences.zh: 加入古今人文協會能夠使我更深入地了解不同時代的文化思想。
sentences.en: Joining the Association of Ancient and Modern Humanities allowed me to gain deeper insights into the cultural thoughts of different eras.

phrase.en: Buddha's Light International Association World Headquarters (BLIA World Headquarters)

sentences.zh: 國際佛光會世界總會在推廣佛教和平理念方面發揮著重要作用。
sentences.en: The Buddha's Light International Association World Headquarters (BLIA World Headquarters) plays a significant role in promoting the Buddhist ideals of peace.

sentences.zh: 佛光山寺經常舉辦大型慶典，由國際佛光會世界總會協助籌辦。
sentences.en: Fo Guang Shan Temple frequently holds grand celebrations, organized with the assistance of the Buddha's Light International Association World Headquarters (BLIA World Headquarters).

sentences.zh: 國際佛光會世界總會的成員遍布全球，致力於文化交流和慈善活動。
sentences.en: Members of the Buddha's Light International Association World Headquarters (BLIA World Headquarters) are spread across the globe, dedicated to cultural exchange and charitable activities.

sentences.zh: 她被任命為國際佛光會世界總會的代表，以推動佛教教育。
sentences.en: She was appointed as a representative of the Buddha's Light International Association World Headquarters (BLIA World Headquarters) to promote Buddhist education.

sentences.zh: 國際佛光會中華總會的使命是推廣佛教的慈悲和智慧，促進世界和平。
sentences.en: The mission of the BLIA Chunghua Headquarters is to promote the compassion and wisdom of Buddhism, fostering world peace.

sentences.zh: 上週，國際佛光會中華總會舉辦了一場衆多信眾參加的年度佛學研討會。
sentences.en: Last week, the BLIA Chunghua Headquarters hosted an annual Buddhist symposium attended by a multitude of devotees.

sentences.zh: 國際佛光會中華總會旨在提供一個平台，讓年輕一代學習和發揚佛教文化。
sentences.en: The BLIA Chunghua Headquarters aims to provide a platform for the younger generation to learn and propagate Buddhist culture.

sentences.zh: 參訪國際佛光會中華總會的來賓對其熱心推廣佛教的努力讚不絕口。
sentences.en: Visitors to the BLIA Chunghua Headquarters praised their enthusiastic efforts in promoting Buddhism.

phrase.en: Buddha's Light International Association Young Adult Division (BLIA-YAD)

sentences.zh: 國際佛光會青年總團每年舉辦各種活動，以培養青年人的佛學智慧和社會責任。
sentences.en: Buddha's Light International Association Young Adult Division (BLIA-YAD) organizes various activities annually to cultivate Buddhist wisdom and social responsibility among young adults.

sentences.zh: 加入國際佛光會青年總團能讓青年人拓展國際視野並建立跨文化友誼。
sentences.en: Joining the Buddha's Light International Association Young Adult Division (BLIA-YAD) enables young people to broaden their international perspective and build cross-cultural friendships.

sentences.zh: 國際佛光會青年總團以其創意和活力著稱，激勵青年參與佛教社群活動。
sentences.en: The Buddha's Light International Association Young Adult Division (BLIA-YAD) is known for its creativity and vibrancy, inspiring youth to participate in Buddhist community activities.

sentences.zh: 通過國際佛光會青年總團的培訓，青年可以學習到寶貴的領導能力和團隊合作技巧。
sentences.en: Through the training provided by the Buddha's Light International Association Young Adult Division (BLIA-YAD), young adults can learn invaluable leadership skills and teamwork abilities.

sentences.zh: 歐陽脩是北宋時期著名的政治家和文學家，他對古文運動的貢獻不可忽視。
sentences.en: Ouyang Xiu was a renowned statesman and writer during the Northern Song Dynasty, and his contributions to the Classical Prose Movement cannot be overlooked.

sentences.zh: 除了他的政治生涯，歐陽脩還以其詩歌和散文作品著稱。
sentences.en: Apart from his political career, Ouyang Xiu was also known for his poetry and prose works.

sentences.zh: 《醉翁亭記》是歐陽脩的一篇著名文章，展現了他對山水風光的熱愛。
sentences.en: 'The Pavilion of the Drunken Old Man' is a famous essay by Ouyang Xiu that showcases his love for natural scenery.

sentences.zh: 歐陽脩在他的作品中提倡簡約和自然，這種風格影響了後來的文學家。
sentences.en: In his works, Ouyang Xiu advocated for simplicity and naturalness, a style that influenced later writers.

sentences.zh: 人間佛教讀書會每週聚集一次，分享對佛法的見解和啟示。
sentences.en: The Humanistic Buddhism Reading Group meets weekly to share insights and revelations about Dharma.

sentences.zh: 參加人間佛教讀書會讓我更深入地理解佛教如何應用於現實生活中。
sentences.en: Joining the Humanistic Buddhism Reading Group has deepened my understanding of how Buddhism can be applied in real life.

sentences.zh: 人間佛教讀書會的成員來自各個行業，大家共同探討佛教經典。
sentences.en: The members of the Humanistic Buddhism Reading Group come from various professions, united in discussing Buddhist classics.

sentences.zh: 透過人間佛教讀書會的討論，我們學習到如何將佛教教義融入日常生活。
sentences.en: Through discussions in the Humanistic Buddhism Reading Group, we learn how to integrate Buddhist teachings into our daily lives.

sentences.zh: 這位人間佛教宣講員在會議上分享了佛教如何與現代生活相結合的觀點。
sentences.en: The Humanistic Buddhism Speaker shared insights at the conference on how Buddhism integrates with modern life.

sentences.zh: 她作為人間佛教宣講員，自願在小學教授基本的佛教價值觀。
sentences.en: As a Humanistic Buddhism Speaker, she volunteered to teach basic Buddhist values at the elementary school.

sentences.zh: 人間佛教宣講員的重要任務是將佛法應用於解決日常生活中的問題。
sentences.en: The vital role of a Humanistic Buddhism Speaker is to apply Buddhist teachings to solve everyday issues.

sentences.zh: 通過他的演講，這位人間佛教宣講員啟發了許多人追求內心的平和與慈悲。
sentences.en: Through his lectures, the Humanistic Buddhism Speaker inspired many to seek inner peace and compassion.

sentences.zh: 他以真誠的態度對待每一個人，因此贏得了大家的尊重。
sentences.en: He treats everyone with sincerity, therefore earning everyone's respect.

sentences.zh: 在佛教修行中，真誠是一種重要的德行，能夠促進心靈的成長。
sentences.en: In Buddhist practice, sincerity is an important virtue that promotes spiritual growth.

sentences.zh: 她的真誠表達使對方感動，化解了雙方之間的不和。
sentences.en: Her sincere expression moved the other party, resolving the discord between them.

sentences.zh: 真誠的溝通有助於建立更強的信任和理解。
sentences.en: Sincere communication helps in building stronger trust and understanding.

phrase.zh: 中華人間佛教聯合總會
phrase.en: United Association of Humanistic Buddhism, Chunghua

sentences.zh: 中華人間佛教聯合總會致力於推廣佛教文化和價值觀。
sentences.en: The United Association of Humanistic Buddhism, Chunghua is dedicated to promoting Buddhist culture and values.

sentences.zh: 中華人間佛教聯合總會舉辦了多場國際研討會，促進跨文化交流。
sentences.en: The United Association of Humanistic Buddhism, Chunghua has hosted numerous international conferences to foster cross-cultural exchanges.

sentences.zh: 中華人間佛教聯合總會成立的目的是加強佛教團體之間的合作。
sentences.en: The purpose of the United Association of Humanistic Buddhism, Chunghua's establishment is to enhance cooperation among Buddhist organizations.

sentences.zh: 中華人間佛教聯合總會的成員來自世界各地，形成了一個多元化的聯合體。
sentences.en: Members of the United Association of Humanistic Buddhism, Chunghua come from all over the world, creating a diverse coalition.

sentences.zh: 這次七誡籃球義賽旨在籌集資金幫助當地的無家可歸者，呼籲大家一起參與，實踐慈悲。
sentences.en: The Seven Virtues Basketball Fundraiser aims to raise money to help local homeless people, inviting everyone to participate and practice compassion.

sentences.zh: 選手們在七誡籃球義賽中展現了無畏精神和團結合作的美德。
sentences.en: The players demonstrated the virtues of fearlessness and teamwork during the Seven Virtues Basketball Fundraiser.

sentences.zh: 透過七誡籃球義賽，他們不僅提高了籃球技巧，還學會了如何在現實生活中應用誡命。
sentences.en: Through the Seven Virtues Basketball Fundraiser, they not only improved their basketball skills but also learned how to apply the precepts in real life.

sentences.zh: 七誡籃球義賽在社區中喚起了大家對慈善和道德行為的重視。
sentences.en: The Seven Virtues Basketball Fundraiser has raised awareness in the community about charity and moral actions.

sentences.zh: 星雲大師是佛光山的創辦人，以其智慧和慈悲影響了世界各地的信眾。
sentences.en: Master Hsing Yun is the founder of Fo Guang Shan and has influenced followers worldwide with his wisdom and compassion.

sentences.zh: 星雲大師的教導強調人間佛教，鼓勵信眾在日常生活中實踐佛法。
sentences.en: Master Hsing Yun's teachings emphasize Humanistic Buddhism, encouraging practitioners to apply Buddhist principles in their daily lives.

sentences.zh: 在星雲大師的領導下，佛光山成為全球最具影響力的佛教組織之一。
sentences.en: Under the leadership of Master Hsing Yun, Fo Guang Shan has become one of the most influential Buddhist organizations worldwide.

sentences.zh: 多年來，星雲大師致力於推動和平與理解，他的努力獲得了國際社會的廣泛讚譽。
sentences.en: For many years, Master Hsing Yun has been dedicated to promoting peace and understanding, earning widespread acclaim from the international community.

sentences.zh: 寺廟每逢佛誕日都吸引成千上萬的信眾前來參拜。
sentences.en: The temple attracts thousands of devotees every Buddha's birthday for worship.

sentences.zh: 這位住持舉辦了一場講座，吸引了很多信眾前來聆聽他深刻的見解。
sentences.en: The abbot held a lecture which attracted many devotees eager to hear his profound insights.

sentences.zh: 信眾們會定期參加寺廟的修持活動，以培養內心的平和。
sentences.en: Devotees regularly participate in temple practices to cultivate inner peace.

sentences.zh: 這座古老的佛像是信眾們心中的神聖象徵，許多人經常前來供奉。
sentences.en: The ancient Buddha statue is a sacred symbol for the devotees, and many frequently come to make offerings.

sentences.zh: 這位聖者的智慧讓人們敬佩，他的教誨深入人心。
sentences.en: The wisdom of this sage commands respect, and his teachings deeply resonate with people.

sentences.zh: 許多人前來向這位聖者請教生活中的困惑，希望找到解答。
sentences.en: Many people come to seek counsel from the sage on life's dilemmas, hoping to find answers.

sentences.zh: 在歷史上，有許多聖者以其崇高的精神水平而為人尊敬。
sentences.en: Throughout history, many sages have been revered for their high spiritual standing.

sentences.zh: 聖者的存在讓這個社區充滿了祥和與智慧。
sentences.en: The presence of the sage brings peace and wisdom to the community.

sentences.zh: 佛世時，許多弟子追隨釋迦牟尼，學習佛法的智慧。
sentences.en: During the Buddha’s time, many disciples followed Shakyamuni to learn the wisdom of the Dharma.

sentences.zh: 在佛世時，釋迦牟尼佛親自講授四諦法，啟發眾生覺醒。
sentences.en: During the Buddha’s time, Shakyamuni Buddha personally taught the Four Noble Truths, inspiring the awakening of sentient beings.

sentences.zh: 佛世時的社會結構和風俗與現代截然不同，仍有許多值得研究的地方。
sentences.en: The social structure and customs during the Buddha’s time were vastly different from the modern day, providing much material for research.

sentences.zh: 佛世時，佛陀的慈悲與智慧吸引了來自各地的尋道者。
sentences.en: During the Buddha’s time, the compassion and wisdom of the Buddha attracted seekers from all regions.

sentences.zh: 在佛教興起的時代，六師外道是最主要的哲學學派之一，對當時的思想形成有著深遠的影響。
sentences.en: During the rise of Buddhism, the Six Non-Buddhist schools were among the major philosophical schools, significantly influencing the intellectual landscape of the time.

sentences.zh: 六師外道所傳授的教義主要關注宇宙的本質和人生的意義，與佛教的核心信仰形成鮮明對比。
sentences.en: The doctrines taught by the Six Non-Buddhist schools primarily focused on the nature of the universe and the meaning of life, contrasting sharply with the core beliefs of Buddhism.

sentences.zh: 雖然六師外道與佛教有著不同的信仰體系，但跨學派的討論促進了古印度哲學的繁榮發展。
sentences.en: Although the Six Non-Buddhist schools had different belief systems from Buddhism, cross-school debates stimulated the flourishing development of ancient Indian philosophy.

sentences.zh: 研究六師外道的思想有助於更好地理解早期佛教教義的劃分及其特殊意義。
sentences.en: Studying the philosophies of the Six Non-Buddhist schools aids in better understanding the demarcation and distinctive significance of early Buddhist doctrines.

sentences.zh: 研究成實論可以幫助我們深入理解佛教的教義和修行的本質。
sentences.en: Studying the Treatise of Establishing Reality can help us to deeply understand the teachings and the essence of practice in Buddhism.

sentences.zh: 成實論闡述了諸法實相，探索了真理的本質。
sentences.en: The Treatise of Establishing Reality explains the true nature of phenomena and explores the essence of truth.

sentences.zh: 學者們常常引用成實論來支持他們的佛學研究。
sentences.en: Scholars often cite the Treatise of Establishing Reality to support their research in Buddhist studies.

sentences.zh: 成實論是佛教經典中的重要著作之一，對於後世的佛教發展產生了深遠的影響。
sentences.en: The Treatise of Establishing Reality is one of the significant works in Buddhist scriptures, having a profound impact on the development of Buddhism in later generations.

sentences.zh: 在禪修期間，參加者會進行跑香，以幫助心靈平靜和專注。
sentences.en: During the meditation retreat, participants engage in walking meditation to help calm the mind and enhance concentration.

sentences.zh: 老師教導學生如何通過跑香來提升他們的正念和專注能力。
sentences.en: The teacher instructed students on how walking meditation could enhance their mindfulness and concentration skills.

sentences.zh: 每天的跑香練習讓她在繁忙的工作生活中保持平衡和放鬆。
sentences.en: Daily walking meditation practice helps her stay balanced and relaxed amid her busy work life.

sentences.zh: 跑香是一種讓人能夠與自然聯繫的靜心方式，適合在戶外進行。
sentences.en: Walking meditation is a form of mindfulness that allows individuals to connect with nature, making it perfect for outdoor practice.

phrase.zh: 仁和安康 富樂吉祥
phrase.en: May Benevolence and Harmony Bring Peaceful Wellbeing, Let Abundance and Joy Yield Auspiciousness in Our Lives

sentences.zh: 家庭的和睦與仁慈是我們追求仁和安康的基礎。
sentences.en: Family harmony and benevolence are the foundation for us to pursue a life of peaceful wellbeing.

sentences.zh: 願世間繁榮富庶，各國人民都能享受富樂吉祥的美好生活。
sentences.en: May the world flourish in abundance, and may all people live a life filled with joy and auspiciousness.

sentences.zh: 在傳統節日中，人們常常祈求仁和安康，心想事成。
sentences.en: During traditional festivals, people often pray for benevolence and peaceful wellbeing, hoping that their wishes will come true.

sentences.zh: 公司文化強調仁和安康，鼓勵員工共同追求富樂吉祥的目標。
sentences.en: The company culture emphasizes benevolence and peaceful wellbeing, encouraging employees to jointly pursue the goal of abundance and joy bringing auspiciousness.

phrase.zh: 阿鼻地獄 極端痛苦

sentences.zh: 按佛教教義，阿鼻地獄是犯下極大惡業者所遭受極端痛苦的地方。
sentences.en: According to Buddhist teachings, Avici Hell is a place where those who have committed grave sins experience extreme sufferings.

sentences.zh: 他將自己描述為生活在阿鼻地獄，遭受著精神上的極端痛苦而難以忍受。
sentences.en: He described himself as living in Avici Hell, enduring unbearable extreme sufferings in his mind.

sentences.zh: 佛陀教導眾生如何避免墮入阿鼻地獄，避免遭受極端痛苦。
sentences.en: The Buddha taught beings how to avoid falling into Avici Hell and enduring extreme sufferings.

sentences.zh: 在經典中，阿鼻地獄被描繪為一個充滿火焰和冰冷的地方，象徵著極端痛苦。
sentences.en: In the scriptures, Avici Hell is depicted as a place filled with flames and freezing conditions, symbolizing extreme sufferings.

sentences.zh: 信仰阿彌陀佛的人期待通過念佛來往生極樂世界。
sentences.en: Believers in Amitabha Buddha aspire to be reborn in the Pure Land through chanting his name.

sentences.zh: 在佛教儀式中，人們常常會誦念阿彌陀佛的名號以表達祈願。
sentences.en: During Buddhist ceremonies, people often chant the name of Amitabha Buddha to express their prayers.

sentences.zh: 阿彌陀佛被視為一位象徵無量光和壽命的佛陀。
sentences.en: Amitabha Buddha is regarded as a deity symbolizing infinite light and longevity.

sentences.zh: 許多佛教徒在冥想中觀想阿彌陀佛以達到內心的寧靜。
sentences.en: Many Buddhists visualize Amitabha Buddha during meditation to achieve inner peace.

phrase.zh: 阿彌陀佛　萬德洪名
phrase.en: Amitabha Buddha; Name of boundless merit

sentences.zh: 佛教信徒常常念誦阿彌陀佛，萬德洪名以求得內心的平靜與智慧。
sentences.en: Buddhist practitioners often chant the name 'Amitabha Buddha, Name of boundless merit' to seek inner peace and wisdom.

sentences.zh: 在佛法中，阿彌陀佛被尊崇為萬德洪名，其慈悲和智慧無遠弗屆。
sentences.en: In Buddhism, Amitabha Buddha is revered as the Name of boundless merit, with compassion and wisdom that knows no bounds.

sentences.zh: 阿彌陀佛，萬德洪名代表著無量光和無量壽，象徵著無盡的生命和光明。
sentences.en: Amitabha Buddha, Name of boundless merit, represents infinite light and life, symbolizing endless vitality and illumination.

sentences.zh: 修行者通過專注於阿彌陀佛，萬德洪名，能夠達到心靈的淨化和解脫。
sentences.en: Through focusing on Amitabha Buddha, Name of boundless merit, practitioners can attain spiritual purification and liberation.

phrase.zh: 阿僧祇劫　不可計數

sentences.zh: 佛教經典中提到，佛成佛以來已經經歷了阿僧祇劫般的時間。
sentences.en: Buddhist scriptures mention that the Buddha has been enlightened for immeasurable eons like an Asamkya Kalpa.

sentences.zh: 思考宇宙的壽命，就如同試圖理解阿僧祇劫般的時間跨度。
sentences.en: Contemplating the lifespan of the universe is akin to attempting to understand the immeasurable span of an Asamkya Kalpa.

sentences.zh: 在這成長的過程中，我們有時感到時間過得無比緩慢，就像經歷一個阿僧祇劫。
sentences.en: During the process of growth, we sometimes feel that time passes exceedingly slowly, akin to experiencing an Asamkya Kalpa.

sentences.zh: 無論是精神上還是物質上的追求，都可能需要超過阿僧祇劫般的耐心和努力。
sentences.en: Whether in spiritual or material pursuits, one may need immeasurable patience and effort, surpassing even an Asamkya Kalpa.

phrase.zh: 愛見煩惱; 飛蛾投火
phrase.en: Clinging and Vexation; Like a moth in the fire

sentences.zh: 由於愛見煩惱，他陷入了一段困難的關係中，如同飛蛾投火，無法自拔。
sentences.en: Due to clinging and vexation, he found himself in a difficult relationship, like a moth in the fire, unable to extricate himself.

sentences.zh: 她的執著使她不斷重蹈覆轍，每次都像飛蛾投火般走向困境。
sentences.en: Her attachment led her to repeatedly make the same mistakes, each time like a moth in the fire heading towards trouble.

sentences.zh: 愛見煩惱讓人如同飛蛾投火般追求短暫的快樂，卻不知會因此受到傷害。
sentences.en: Clinging and vexation make people pursue fleeting pleasures like a moth in the fire, unaware that it may lead to harm.

sentences.zh: 在面對欲望的時候，我們常常如飛蛾投火般迷失在愛見煩惱中。
sentences.en: When facing desires, we often become lost in clinging and vexation, like moths in the fire.

phrase.en: Strive in Order to Win: strive hard to succeed

sentences.zh: 他相信愛拼才會贏努力成功，所以每天都勤奮地工作。
sentences.en: He believes that to strive in order to win, one must strive hard to succeed, so he works diligently every day.

sentences.zh: 成功來自於不懈的努力，因為愛拼才會贏努力成功。
sentences.en: Success comes from relentless effort because to strive in order to win, you must strive hard to succeed.

sentences.zh: 即使面臨挫折，她依然堅持，因為她明白愛拼才會贏努力成功的道理。
sentences.en: Even in the face of setbacks, she perseveres because she understands that to strive in order to win, one must strive hard to succeed.

sentences.zh: 愛拼才會贏努力成功是他一生奉行的信念，因此他從不輕言放棄。
sentences.en: Strive in order to win and strive hard to succeed is a creed he has followed all his life, so he never gives up easily.

phrase.en: Love: you and I, heart-to-heart affinities

sentences.zh: 在愛中你我同心緣夢的旅程，我們學會了如何更好地包容與理解。
sentences.en: In the journey of love: you and I, heart-to-heart affinities, we have learned to better embrace and understand each other.

sentences.zh: 愛中你我同心緣夢，使我們的關係更加堅固，即使面對挑戰。
sentences.en: Love: you and I, heart-to-heart affinities, has strengthened our relationship even in the face of challenges.

sentences.zh: 他們因愛中你我同心緣夢的力量，不斷追求彼此的成長。
sentences.en: Through the power of love: you and I, heart-to-heart affinities, they continuously pursue mutual growth.

sentences.zh: 愛中你我同心緣夢，讓我們在這段關係中找到了真正的幸福。
sentences.en: Love: you and I, heart-to-heart affinities, has allowed us to find true happiness in our relationship.

phrase.zh: 矮子看戲　人云亦云
phrase.en: Blocked View of the Stage; To blindly cheer along with others

sentences.zh: 正如矮子看戲，他總是在意識不到全局時，人云亦云地對這次決策表示支持。
sentences.en: Just like having a blocked view of the stage, he blindly cheered along with others in support of the decision without seeing the bigger picture.

sentences.zh: 在這個問題上，他猶如矮子看戲，只是聽人云亦云，沒有自己的見解。
sentences.en: On this issue, he is like someone with a blocked view of the stage, blindly parroting others without having his own insights.

sentences.zh: 會議上，他如矮子看戲一樣，只是隨著大流人云亦云，缺乏獨立思考。
sentences.en: In the meeting, he was like someone with a blocked view of the stage, simply cheering along with others without independent thought.

sentences.zh: 他的意見常常被認為是矮子看戲，人云亦云，因為他沒有發表獨立的觀點。
sentences.en: His opinions are often seen as having a blocked view of the stage, as he tends to blindly cheer along with others without expressing an independent perspective.

phrase.en: Abide By the Path and Fulfill One's Duty

sentences.zh: 他一生安份守道，無論何時何地都謹守本分，從不偏離正道。
sentences.en: He spent his life abiding by the path and fulfilling his duty, always adhering to his responsibilities and never straying from the righteous way.

sentences.zh: 在困難的時刻，她選擇安份守道，而不是追求短暫的利得。
sentences.en: In difficult times, she chose to abide by the path and fulfill her duty, rather than chase fleeting gains.

sentences.zh: 父親常常教導我們要安份守道，這樣才能得到心靈的安寧。
sentences.en: Our father often taught us to abide by the path and fulfill one's duty, as it leads to peace of mind.

sentences.zh: 這位老師以身作則，安份守道地教育學生，成為他們的榜樣。
sentences.en: The teacher set an example by abiding by the path and fulfilling his duty, becoming a role model for his students.

phrase.zh: 安家樂業　恬淡知足
phrase.en: Settled at Home, Satisfied at Work; Content with a simple life.

sentences.zh: 他在鄉村安家樂業，享受著恬淡知足的生活。
sentences.en: He is settled at home and satisfied at work in the countryside, enjoying a simple and content life.

sentences.zh: 即使沒有奢華的生活，他也能夠安家樂業，恬淡知足。
sentences.en: Even without a luxurious life, he is able to be settled at home and satisfied at work, content with simplicity.

sentences.zh: 在這個喧囂的城市，她選擇了一條安家樂業，恬淡知足的路。
sentences.en: In this bustling city, she chose a path where she is settled at home and satisfied at work, content with simplicity.

sentences.zh: 他的夢想是找到一個地方可以安家樂業，過著恬淡知足的日子。
sentences.en: His dream is to find a place where he can be settled at home, satisfied at work, and live a content and simple life.

phrase.en: Silent but Loud: movement and stillness are the same

sentences.zh: 在禪修中，達到『安靜在沸騰動靜一樣』的境界是一種深層的內心平和，無論外界多麼喧鬧，內心卻能保持寧靜安穩。
sentences.en: In meditation, reaching the state of 'Silent but Loud: movement and stillness are the same' is a profound inner peace, where one retains tranquility despite external chaos.

sentences.zh: 他的作畫方式讓人想起『安靜在沸騰動靜一樣』的境界，每一筆都如同瞬間的律動般完美，卻又充滿靜謐之美。
sentences.en: His way of painting reminds one of the state 'Silent but Loud: movement and stillness are the same', where every stroke is as perfect as a fleeting motion, yet filled with serene beauty.

sentences.zh: 在那次音樂會中，音樂家們展現了一種『安靜在沸騰動靜一樣』的表演，讓觀眾感受到音樂的力量和內在的平靜。
sentences.en: During the concert, the musicians exhibited a 'Silent but Loud: movement and stillness are the same' performance, allowing the audience to feel the power and inner calm of the music.

sentences.zh: 修習太極拳幫助他理解『安靜在沸騰動靜一樣』的哲理，每一套拳法都在靜中有動，動中有靜。
sentences.en: Practicing Tai Chi helped him understand the philosophy of 'Silent but Loud: movement and stillness are the same', where each form contains stillness in motion and motion in stillness.

sentences.zh: 修行者追求內心的安樂富足，以脫離世俗的煩惱與苦惱。
sentences.en: Practitioners seek inner peace, joy, wealth, and abundance to transcend worldly troubles and sorrows.

sentences.zh: 佛法教導我們如何達到心靈的安樂富足，而不被物質的缺乏所困擾。
sentences.en: The Dharma teaches us how to attain spiritual peace, joy, wealth, and abundance without being troubled by material scarcity.

sentences.zh: 她的人生目標是追求安樂富足，而不僅僅是追求物質上的成功。
sentences.en: Her life goal is to achieve peace, joy, wealth, and abundance, rather than merely pursuing material success.

sentences.zh: 在佛陀的教導中，真正的安樂富足來自於慈悲和智慧的圓滿。
sentences.en: In the Buddha's teachings, true peace, joy, wealth, and abundance come from the perfection of compassion and wisdom.

sentences.zh: 在這個忙碌的世界中，找到安寧變得愈發重要。
sentences.en: In this busy world, finding tranquility has become increasingly important.

sentences.zh: 禪修幫助他在心中找到了一片安寧。
sentences.en: Meditation helped him find a space of tranquility within his mind.

sentences.zh: 她喜歡在山間小屋中度過周末，享受那裡的安寧與靜謐。
sentences.en: She enjoys spending weekends at the cabin in the mountains, relishing the tranquility and peace there.

sentences.zh: 大自然的懷抱總是讓人感受到安寧。
sentences.en: The embrace of nature always brings a sense of tranquility.

sentences.zh: 在禪修中，我們常常追求內心的安平，尋求心靈的穩定與和諧。
sentences.en: In meditation practice, we often seek inner safety and peace, aiming for mental stability and harmony.

sentences.zh: 僧侶們祈禱國家的長治安平，並為世人帶來更多的祥和。
sentences.en: The monks pray for the nation's long-lasting safety and peace, bringing more harmony to the world.

sentences.zh: 這個社區以其安平的環境聞名，是人們生活和工作的理想之地。
sentences.en: The community is known for its safety and peace, making it an ideal place for living and working.

sentences.zh: 安平是許多宗教追求的終極目標之一，代表著心靈的安穩和無憂。
sentences.en: Safety and peace are among the ultimate goals pursued by many religions, symbolizing mental stability and a worry-free state.

sentences.zh: 在禪坐中，他感受到了安然一如的平靜，心境仿佛回到了最初的純淨狀態。
sentences.en: During meditation, he experienced peace in its true form, as if his mind returned to its original pure state.

sentences.zh: 無論面對再多的困難，她總是能保持安然一如的心態，不被外界所動搖。
sentences.en: No matter how many challenges she faced, she always maintained peace in its true form, unshaken by external disturbances.

sentences.zh: 這片寧靜的森林勾起了他心中安然一如的感受，彷彿已經遠離了世俗的喧囂。
sentences.en: The tranquil forest evoked a sense of peace in its true form within him, as if removed from the clamor of the mundane world.

sentences.zh: 在佛陀的教導下，他學會如何在喧鬧的城市中找到安然一如的心境。
sentences.en: Under the Buddha's teachings, he learned how to find peace in its true form amidst the bustling city life.

phrase.en: At Perfect Ease With Being Good

sentences.zh: 他的生活態度是安善自得，無論環境如何，他總是能夠和善地對待周遭的人。
sentences.en: His approach to life is at perfect ease with being good, always able to treat others kindly regardless of circumstances.

sentences.zh: 在這個小村莊，她過著安善自得的生活，村民們都尊敬她的願和善行。
sentences.en: In this small village, she lived a life at perfect ease with being good, and the villagers respected her for her compassion and kind deeds.

sentences.zh: 你能夠感受到他內心的平和，彷彿他的本性就是真正安善自得。
sentences.en: You can feel the peace within him, as if his true nature is genuinely at perfect ease with being good.

sentences.zh: 修行佛法使他心靈獲得了安善自得，他寧靜地接受人生的所有遭遇。
sentences.en: Practicing Buddhism brought him to a state of being at perfect ease with being good, enabling him to serenely accept all of life's experiences.

phrase.zh: 安身立命　寄託心要
phrase.en: Settle Oneself and Establish One's Duties; To trust the core teachings.

sentences.zh: 修行之途在於安身立命，寄託心要，方能見得光明。
sentences.en: The path of practice lies in settling oneself and establishing one's duties; to trust the core teachings in order to see the light.

sentences.zh: 當面對人生困難時，他總是安身立命，寄託心要，從不動搖。
sentences.en: In the face of life's challenges, he always settles himself and establishes his duties; he trusts the core teachings and never wavers.

sentences.zh: 老師教導我們，唯有安身立命，寄託心要，才能獲得內心的真正安寧。
sentences.en: The teacher instructed us that only by settling oneself and establishing one's duties, and by trusting the core teachings, can one achieve true inner peace.

sentences.zh: 她的生活哲學是安身立命，寄託心要，這使她在變幻無常的世界中保持穩定。
sentences.en: Her philosophy of life is to settle oneself and establish one's duties; to trust the core teachings, which keeps her steady in an ever-changing world.

phrase.en: A Peaceful Mind Brings Perfect Ease

sentences.zh: 通過靜坐冥想，他終於找到了安心自在的狀態，心靈得到了深刻的平靜。
sentences.en: Through meditation, he finally found a state of tranquility where a peaceful mind brings perfect ease, allowing his heart to achieve profound calmness.

sentences.zh: 即使在繁忙喧囂的城市中，她也能保持著安心自在，因為她學會了不受外界影響。
sentences.en: Even in the bustling city, she maintained a peaceful mind that brought perfect ease because she learned not to be affected by external chaos.

sentences.zh: 心中雜念消失之後，生活變得安心自在，充滿了幸福與寧靜。
sentences.en: Once the mind was free from distractions, life became one where a peaceful mind brought perfect ease, filled with happiness and serenity.

sentences.zh: 禪的修行在於找到安心自在的喜樂，這需要長期的練習和自我反省。
sentences.en: The practice of Zen is about finding the joy that comes when a peaceful mind brings perfect ease, which requires long-term discipline and self-reflection.

sentences.zh: 在家庭生活中，他們總是安於無諍，以和平解決所有的分歧。
sentences.en: In their family life, they always settle with no disputes, resolving all disagreements peacefully.

sentences.zh: 這個團隊的成功秘訣在於成員之間的默契和安於無諍的合作精神。
sentences.en: The secret to the team's success lies in the members' synergy and a spirit of settling with no disputes.

sentences.zh: 禪修讓他學會安於無諍，對於生活中的各種變化保持一顆平靜的心。
sentences.en: Meditation taught him to settle with no disputes, keeping a calm heart amidst life's various changes.

sentences.zh: 她在職場上善於安於無諍，因此贏得了同事們的尊敬與信任。
sentences.en: She excelled at settling with no disputes in the workplace, gaining the respect and trust of her colleagues.

phrase.en: Settle the Body and Mind in Peace

sentences.zh: 打坐是讓人安住身心的重要方法，使心靈平靜，遠離煩惱。
sentences.en: Meditation is an important method to settle the body and mind in peace, allowing the spirit to calm and be free from distractions.

sentences.zh: 在瑜伽的練習中，老師指導學員如何安住身心，專注於當下。
sentences.en: During yoga practice, the instructor guides students on how to settle the body and mind in peace and focus on the present moment.

sentences.zh: 他透過每日的祈禱和冥想，逐漸學會安住身心，面對日常生活中的壓力。
sentences.en: Through daily prayers and meditation, he gradually learned to settle the body and mind in peace, confronting the pressures of everyday life.

sentences.zh: 禪修讓人能夠在繁忙的城市生活中找到片刻的安寧，確保身心安住。
sentences.en: Zen practice allows one to find a moment of tranquility amidst the busy city life, ensuring the body and mind settle in peace.

phrase.zh: 安住身心　不為境轉
phrase.en: Settle the Body and Mind in Peace; Undisturbed by one's surroundings

sentences.zh: 在面對紛繁複雜的世界時，我們需要學習安住身心，不為境轉，以保持內心的平靜。
sentences.en: Facing the complexities of the world, we need to learn to settle the body and mind in peace, remaining undisturbed by our surroundings, to maintain inner tranquility.

sentences.zh: 他經常進行冥想，以安住身心，不為周圍環境所轉，從而達到了更高的明察力。
sentences.en: He often meditates to settle the body and mind in peace, undisturbed by his surroundings, thereby achieving a higher level of insight.

sentences.zh: 即使在逆境中，她依然能夠保持安住身心，不為境轉，這是她長期修行的成果。
sentences.en: Even in adversity, she can settle her body and mind in peace, undisturbed by her surroundings, which is the result of her long-term practice.

sentences.zh: 安住身心，不為境轉，使他在人群中脫穎而出，顯示出非凡的沉著與智慧。
sentences.en: Settling the body and mind in peace, undisturbed by his surroundings, made him stand out in the crowd, displaying remarkable composure and wisdom.

phrase.zh: 八大金剛　佛門護法

sentences.zh: 八大金剛是佛門的重要護法，他們守護著寺廟及修行者，維護佛教世界的和平。
sentences.en: The Eight Great Vajras are significant Dharma protectors in Buddhism, safeguarding temples and practitioners, and maintaining peace within the Buddhist realm.

sentences.zh: 在佛教儀式中，人們常會祈求八大金剛的護佑，以便修行能順利進行。
sentences.en: During Buddhist ceremonies, people often pray for the protection of the Eight Great Vajras to ensure their practices proceed smoothly.

sentences.zh: 八大金剛各具不同的力量和象徵，代表了佛法的智慧和無量的守護力量。
sentences.en: Each of the Eight Great Vajras embodies distinct powers and symbols, representing the wisdom of the Dharma and immense protective energy.

sentences.zh: 故事中描述八大金剛如何襲擊邪惡勢力，成為修行者的堅強後盾。
sentences.en: Stories depict how the Eight Great Vajras attack evil forces, serving as a strong support for practitioners.

phrase.en: Help Others Be Accomplished in Every Aspect

sentences.zh: 在他的領導下，公司上下無不八方成全，致力於幫助每一位員工達到自己的目標。
sentences.en: Under his leadership, the entire company strives to help others be accomplished in every aspect, aiming to aid each employee in achieving their goals.

sentences.zh: 她在社區中以八方成全的精神組織各種活動，提升鄰里的整體素質。
sentences.en: She organizes various events in the community to help others be accomplished in every aspect, enhancing the overall quality of the neighborhood.

sentences.zh: 他信奉八方成全的強大力量，常常無私地支持別人的夢想。
sentences.en: He believes in the powerful force of helping others be accomplished in every aspect, often selflessly supporting others' dreams.

sentences.zh: 當我們實踐八方成全的理念，我們創造了一個更具關懷與合作的社會。
