sentences.en: Through spiritual guidance, this teacher helps students understand the importance of harmony between self and others.

phrase.en: No Boundaries Between You and Me

sentences.zh: 在這個和諧的社區裡，人我無間，鄰居們彼此支持，共同面對挑戰。
sentences.en: In this harmonious community, there are no boundaries between you and me, as neighbors support each other and face challenges together.

sentences.zh: 佛教教導我們修行慈悲，達到人我無間，使眾生都能感受愛和關懷。
sentences.en: Buddhism teaches us to cultivate compassion and reach a state where there are no boundaries between you and me, allowing all beings to feel love and care.

sentences.zh: 他們的友誼深厚，早已達到人我無間，無論發生什麼事，都會彼此幫助。
sentences.en: Their friendship is deep, having reached a point where there are no boundaries between you and me, and they will support each other no matter what happens.

sentences.zh: 在這次合作中，團隊成員彼此信任，實現了人我無間的默契。
sentences.en: During this collaboration, team members trusted each other, achieving a tacit understanding with no boundaries between you and me.

sentences.zh: 佛教教導人我一如的理念，鼓勵我們在日常生活中對他人保持慈悲與同理心。
sentences.en: Buddhism teaches the principle of unity between self and others, encouraging us to maintain compassion and empathy towards others in our daily lives.

sentences.zh: 在冥想中體驗到人我一如，可以幫助我們減少自我中心的思考模式。
sentences.en: Experiencing unity between self and others during meditation can help reduce self-centered thinking patterns.

sentences.zh: 通過理解人我一如的概念，我們能夠更容易地與他人建立深刻的聯繫。
sentences.en: By understanding the concept of unity between self and others, we can more easily forge deep connections with others.

sentences.zh: 這個社群以人我一如的原則運作，每個成員都致力於彼此的幸福與成長。
sentences.en: This community operates on the principle of unity between self and others, with each member committed to the happiness and growth of one another.

sentences.zh: 在面對任何困難時，他始終堅持要人正心中，絕不偏袒非正義之事。
sentences.en: When faced with any adversity, he always insists on having a righteous heart, never siding with unjust causes.

sentences.zh: 佛教教導我們修心養性，以便在人正心中，無愧於世。
sentences.en: Buddhism teaches us to cultivate our mind and character, so that we may have a righteous heart and live without guilt in the world.

sentences.zh: 她以人正心中為指導原則，帶領團隊走向成功。
sentences.en: She guided her team to success by adhering to the principle of having a righteous heart.

sentences.zh: 人正心中，天必佑之，這是他一直信奉的人生格言。
sentences.en: Having a righteous heart brings heavenly protection; this has always been his life motto.

phrase.zh: 人之常情　自然反應

sentences.zh: 面對困難時出現恐懼是人之常情，自然反應不代表懦弱。
sentences.en: Feeling fear in the face of difficulties is human nature; to react naturally does not signify weakness.

sentences.zh: 對於漂亮的風景讚嘆是人之常情，這也是一種自然反應。
sentences.en: Being awed by beautiful scenery is human nature; it is also a natural reaction.

sentences.zh: 當聽到好消息時感到高興是人之常情，這種自然反應能帶來內心的愉悅。
sentences.en: Feeling joy upon hearing good news is human nature; such a natural reaction brings inner happiness.

sentences.zh: 面對失敗而感到挫折是人之常情，但自然反應不應成為放棄的理由。
sentences.en: Feeling frustration in the face of failure is human nature; to react naturally should not become a reason to give up.

phrase.zh: 人中獅子　才能出眾
phrase.en: A Lion Among Humans; To have outstanding abilities

sentences.zh: 他在人群中如同人中獅子，才能出眾，令人敬佩。
sentences.en: He is like a lion among humans, possessing outstanding abilities and commanding admiration.

sentences.zh: 她在藝術界被譽為人中獅子，其才能出眾，無人能敵。
sentences.en: In the art world, she is praised as a lion among humans, her outstanding abilities unparalleled.

sentences.zh: 能在這麼多競爭者中脫穎而出，他的確是人中獅子，才能出眾。
sentences.en: To stand out amongst so many competitors, he truly is a lion among humans with his outstanding abilities.

sentences.zh: 在學術界，他被認為是人中獅子，因為他的才能出眾，思想深邃。
sentences.en: In academia, he is considered a lion among humans because of his outstanding abilities and profound thinking.

phrase.zh: 任性逍遙　隨緣自在
phrase.en: To Heed One's Nature Freely; Follow conditions with perfect ease

sentences.zh: 他一直以來都以任性逍遙的方式生活，無拘無束，享受當下的自由。
sentences.en: He has always lived by heeding his nature freely, embracing a carefree lifestyle and enjoying the freedom of the present moment.

sentences.zh: 在面對生活中的困難時，她選擇隨緣自在，接受所有的挑戰而不失去內心的平和。
sentences.en: When facing life's challenges, she chooses to follow conditions with perfect ease, accepting all adversities without losing her inner peace.

sentences.zh: 這位僧人一直教導他的學生要任性逍遙，但同時不忘慈悲和智慧。
sentences.en: The monk has constantly taught his students to heed their nature freely while never forgetting compassion and wisdom.

sentences.zh: 不論未來如何變化，他總是能隨緣自在地適應，令身邊的人充滿敬佩。
sentences.en: No matter how the future changes, he is always able to follow conditions with perfect ease, earning admiration from those around him.

phrase.zh: 任運騰騰　隨順自然
phrase.en: Let Things Be; Let nature take its course

sentences.zh: 他選擇任運騰騰，隨順自然地面對生活中的起伏，不讓壓力攝住他的心。
sentences.en: He chose to let things be, allowing nature to take its course as he faced the ups and downs of life without letting stress grip his heart.

sentences.zh: 在這個決策上，她決定不過多干涉，反而任運騰騰，隨順自然地觀察情況的發展。
sentences.en: In this decision, she decided not to intervene too much, but rather to let things be and observe how the situation unfolds naturally.

sentences.zh: 園丁相信植物會任運騰騰，隨順自然成長，而不需過多的人為干預。
sentences.en: The gardener believes the plants will grow best by letting things be, allowing them to thrive naturally without excessive human intervention.

sentences.zh: 在尋求內心的平和時，他明白到有時候放下控制，讓一切任運騰騰，隨順自然，是抵達寧靜的最佳途徑。
sentences.en: In seeking inner peace, he understood that sometimes letting go of control and allowing things to be, letting nature take its course, is the best path to tranquility.

phrase.en: A Life Like the Rising Sun

sentences.zh: 他的生活態度如同日出人生，充滿了希望和活力。
sentences.en: His approach to life is like the rising sun, full of hope and vitality.

sentences.zh: 她相信應該過一個日出人生，每天都要迎接新的開始。
sentences.en: She believes in living a life like the rising sun, welcoming each day as a new beginning.

sentences.zh: 在困境中，他總是抱著日出人生的信念，相信明天會更好。
sentences.en: In times of adversity, he always holds on to the belief of a life like the rising sun, trusting that tomorrow will be better.

sentences.zh: 他用日出人生的精神感染了周圍的人，帶來了正能量。
sentences.en: He inspired those around him with the spirit of a life like the rising sun, bringing positive energy.

sentences.zh: 修行中，禪師常說「日日好日」，提醒我們要心存感恩，珍惜每一天。
sentences.en: In practice, the Zen master often says 'Everyday is a Good Day', reminding us to be grateful and cherish each day.

sentences.zh: 即使遇到挫折和困難，他依然保持著「日日好日」的心態，積極面對人生挑戰。
sentences.en: Even when faced with setbacks and difficulties, he maintains the mindset that 'Everyday is a Good Day', actively facing life's challenges.

sentences.zh: 我們應該學會把握當下，因為在真正的禪修中，每一刻都是「日日好日」。
sentences.en: We should learn to embrace the present moment because in true Zen practice, every moment is 'Everyday is a Good Day'.

sentences.zh: 他的生活哲學是「日日好日」，崇尚簡單平和，活在當下。
sentences.en: His philosophy of life is 'Everyday is a Good Day', advocating simplicity and peace, living in the present.

sentences.zh: 在佛教信仰中，日日吉祥象徵著心靈的安寧與日常生活的圓滿。
sentences.en: In Buddhist belief, 'Everyday is Auspicious' symbolizes spiritual peace and fulfillment in daily life.

sentences.zh: 即使遇到困難，他仍然相信日日吉祥，內心保持著積極的力量。
sentences.en: Even when facing difficulties, he believes that everyday is auspicious, maintaining a positive strength within.

sentences.zh: 無論外在環境如何變化，保持日日吉祥的心態能讓我們樂觀面對生活的挑戰。
sentences.en: Regardless of external changes, maintaining the mindset that everyday is auspicious allows us to face life's challenges optimistically.

sentences.zh: 在忙碌的都市生活中，學會尋找日日吉祥的智慧能帶來內心的平靜。
sentences.en: In the bustling urban life, learning to find the wisdom that 'Everyday is Auspicious' can bring inner peace.

sentences.zh: 他遵循著日日生息的原則，在學習上不斷進步，最終取得了驚人的成績。
sentences.en: He followed the principle of making a steady progress everyday, continuously improving in his studies and eventually achieving remarkable results.

sentences.zh: 這項工程依靠工人們的日日生息，終於如期完工，品質也相當令人滿意。
sentences.en: The project relied on the workers making a steady progress everyday, and was completed on time with quality that was quite satisfactory.

sentences.zh: 透過日日生息的訓練，這位年輕運動員的實力逐日增強，開始在比賽中脫穎而出。
sentences.en: Through steady progress everyday in training, the young athlete's skills improved daily, and he began to stand out in competitions.

sentences.zh: 在日常生活中持續性地自我提升，使她的個人生活和職業生涯都日日生息。
sentences.en: Consistently making a steady progress everyday in her personal growth has enriched both her personal life and professional career.

sentences.zh: 在他看來，人生的每一天都應該是日日是好日，因為每一刻他都能找到感恩的理由。
sentences.en: In his view, every day in life should be a good day because he can find reasons to be grateful in every moment.

sentences.zh: 他總是保持著日日是好日的心態，以微笑面對生活中的挑戰。
sentences.en: He always maintains the mindset of 'everyday is a good day,' facing life's challenges with a smile.

sentences.zh: 即使遇到逆境，她仍然相信日日是好日，努力從中學習並成長。
sentences.en: Even when faced with adversity, she still believes that everyday is a good day, striving to learn and grow from the experience.

sentences.zh: 師父教導我們日日是好日，提醒我們珍惜每一個平凡的早晨。
sentences.en: The master taught us that everyday is a good day, reminding us to cherish each ordinary morning.

sentences.zh: 修行者應以日日增上的心態，持續精進，提升自我。
sentences.en: Practitioners should maintain a mindset of making daily improvements, consistently striving to better themselves.

sentences.zh: 他相信透過日日增上，最終能達到心靈的圓滿與智慧。
sentences.en: He believes that by making daily improvements, he will eventually achieve spiritual fulfillment and wisdom.

sentences.zh: 在學習過程中，我們應該把重點放在日日增上，而不是一夕之間的突破。
sentences.en: In the learning process, we should focus on making daily improvements rather than overnight breakthroughs.

sentences.zh: 生活中的每一個小步驟都能累積成巨大的改變，這就是日日增上的力量。
sentences.en: Every small step in life can accumulate into significant changes, and this is the power of making daily improvements.

phrase.zh: 日上三竿　時光不待
phrase.en: The Sun Is Three Poles High; Time waits for no one.

sentences.zh: 他遲遲不肯開始工作，等到他醒悟時，才發現已經是日上三竿，時光不待。
sentences.en: He delayed starting his work, and by the time he realized, the sun was already three poles high; time waits for no one.

sentences.zh: 我們應該珍惜時間，日上三竿，時光不待，如果不抓緊，就來不及完成計畫。
sentences.en: We should cherish our time; the sun is already three poles high, and time waits for no one. If we don't act fast, we'll miss the opportunity to complete our plans.

sentences.zh: 對於那些浪費時間的人，日上三竿，時光不待是最好的忠告。
sentences.en: For those who waste their time, 'the sun is three poles high; time waits for no one' is the best piece of advice.

sentences.zh: 即使困難重重，我們也要努力向前，因為日上三竿，時光不待。
sentences.en: Despite the challenges, we must push forward, because the sun is three poles high and time waits for no one.

phrase.en: Brilliance of the Sun and Moon

sentences.zh: 佛經中描述的境界如同日月光華，令人心生嚮往。
sentences.en: The realms described in the Buddhist scriptures are like the brilliance of the sun and moon, inspiring a sense of longing in the heart.

sentences.zh: 這位禪師的智慧如日月光華，為眾生指引方向。
sentences.en: The sage's wisdom is like the brilliance of the sun and moon, guiding the way for all beings.

sentences.zh: 他的慈悲心如日月光華般照耀四方。
sentences.en: His compassion shines forth like the brilliance of the sun and moon, illuminating all directions.

sentences.zh: 修行者的境界超然，如同日月光華，無瑕而潔淨。
sentences.en: The practitioner's attainment is transcendent, akin to the brilliance of the sun and moon, flawless and pure.

phrase.en: The Sun and Moon of the Mind

sentences.zh: 在禪修中，他努力尋找內心的日月心辰，希望能夠找到永恆的智慧和安寧。
sentences.en: In meditation, he strives to find the sun and moon of the mind, hoping to discover eternal wisdom and peace.

sentences.zh: 日月心辰的平衡是心靈平和的關鍵，讓我們能夠以清晰的思維面對生活的挑戰。
sentences.en: The balance of the sun and moon of the mind is key to mental tranquility, allowing us to face life's challenges with clarity.

sentences.zh: 老師教導我們如何通過冥想來調諧內在的日月心辰，從而達到心緒的穩定。
sentences.en: The teacher instructs us on how to harmonize the sun and moon of the mind through meditation to achieve emotional stability.

sentences.zh: 他相信，當日月心辰相合時，能夠激發出人與人之間最深的理解與和諧。
sentences.en: He believes that when the sun and moon of the mind align, it sparks the deepest understanding and harmony between people.

phrase.en: The Sun Shining on the World

sentences.zh: 早晨的日照人間，喚醒了一切沉睡的生命。
sentences.en: The morning sun shining on the world awakened all the slumbering lives.

sentences.zh: 佛陀的智慧如同日照人間，給予我們指引與啟發。
sentences.en: The wisdom of the Buddha is like the sun shining on the world, providing us with guidance and inspiration.

sentences.zh: 日照人間使得大地煥發生機，一切事物都開始了新的循環。
sentences.en: The sun shining on the world brings vitality to the earth, and everything begins a new cycle.

sentences.zh: 她的微笑如同日照人間，溫暖了我們的心靈。
sentences.en: Her smile, like the sun shining on the world, warmed our hearts.

sentences.zh: 不同的宗教信仰通過融和共處，共同創造了一個和平的社會氛圍。
sentences.en: Different religious beliefs have created a peaceful social environment by coexisting in harmony.

sentences.zh: 生態系統中動植物的融和共處對維持生態平衡至關重要。
sentences.en: The coexisting in harmony of plants and animals in an ecosystem is crucial to maintaining ecological balance.

sentences.zh: 在全球化的世界裡，各種文化必須學會融和共處，以促進世界和平。
sentences.en: In a globalized world, various cultures must learn to coexist in harmony to promote world peace.

sentences.zh: 經過多年的努力，那些曾經對立的社區終於達成了融和共處的局面。
sentences.en: After years of efforts, communities that were once in conflict finally achieved a state of coexisting in harmony.

sentences.zh: 在這座寺廟中，僧眾之間的交流總是融和無礙，各界信眾在這裡找到心靈的共鳴。
sentences.en: In this temple, communication among monks is always smooth and without obstructions, and people from all walks of life find spiritual resonance here.

sentences.zh: 當人們彼此理解和尊重時，社會的運作就如同融和無礙般順暢。
sentences.en: When people understand and respect each other, society operates as smoothly as if harmony has no obstructions.

sentences.zh: 藝術家們在創作過程中追求心靈的融和無礙，這樣的作品才更能感動人心。
sentences.en: Artists seek to achieve a state where creativity flows with no obstructions, making their work more profound and moving.

sentences.zh: 通過靜坐和冥想，他達到了內心世界的融和無礙，精神上感到極大的安寧。
sentences.en: Through meditation, he achieved inner peace where harmony has no obstructions, and found a great sense of tranquility.

phrase.en: Under the Banyan Tree: affinities, compassion are the basis

sentences.zh: 在這座小鎮上，人們相信榕樹下緣份慈心為本，因此常常在這裡聚會以交流善意。
sentences.en: In this small town, people believe that under the banyan tree, affinities and compassion are the basis, so they often gather here to share goodwill.

sentences.zh: 這位僧人常在榕樹下講經，他說緣份慈心為本，是修行的重要基石。
sentences.en: This monk often gives teachings under the banyan tree, stating that affinities and compassion are the basis, forming an essential foundation of practice.

sentences.zh: 榕樹的庇蔭象徵著緣份慈心為本，吸引許多人來這裡冥想和反思。
sentences.en: The shade of the banyan tree symbolizes that affinities and compassion are the basis, attracting many to meditate and reflect here.

sentences.zh: 在榕樹下，人們學會了如何把緣份慈心為本的理念應用到日常生活中。
sentences.en: Under the banyan tree, people learned how to apply the principle that affinities and compassion are the basis in their daily lives.

phrase.zh: 肉身不壞　全身舍利

sentences.zh: 佛教徒相信，有些高僧的肉身不壞，最終成為全身舍利。
sentences.en: Buddhists believe that some eminent monks achieve an indestructible body, eventually becoming whole-body relics.

sentences.zh: 他的德行和智慧讓人們相信他會成為未來的肉身不壞，全身舍利。
sentences.en: His virtue and wisdom lead people to believe that he will become an indestructible body, a whole-body relic in the future.

sentences.zh: 寺廟保存了那位聖僧的全身舍利，證明了他的肉身不壞。
sentences.en: The temple preserved the whole-body relic of the sainted monk, proving his indestructible body.

sentences.zh: 這些肉身不壞和全身舍利成為了佛教信徒心中的聖物。
sentences.en: These indestructible bodies and whole-body relics have become sacred objects in the hearts of Buddhist devotees.

phrase.zh: 肉身菩薩　金身不壞
phrase.en: The Bodhisattva's Body; Golden and indestructible.

sentences.zh: 他努力修行，期望有一天能夠成為肉身菩薩，金身不壞，普渡眾生。
sentences.en: He strives in his practice, hoping to one day become a Bodhisattva's body, golden and indestructible, and to deliver all sentient beings.

sentences.zh: 據說古代有高僧圓寂後，其肉身菩薩，金身不壞，歷經數百年仍不腐爛。
sentences.en: It is said that in ancient times, after a high monk passed away, his body became the Bodhisattva's body, golden and indestructible, remaining intact for hundreds of years without decay.

sentences.zh: 在寺院中，信徒們對於那些看似肉身菩薩，金身不壞的歷代高僧法體充滿敬意。
sentences.en: In the temple, devotees hold great reverence for the bodies of past high monks, which appear to be the Bodhisattva's body, golden and indestructible.

sentences.zh: 他以肉身菩薩的精神，金身不壞的追求面對世間種種困難和挑戰。
sentences.en: He faces the various difficulties and challenges of the world with the spirit of the Bodhisattva's body and the pursuit of being golden and indestructible.

phrase.en: Through the Naked Eyes of a Fool; Shallow knowledge.

sentences.zh: 他對這個複雜的理論只有肉眼愚眉的理解，見識淺陋，無法看到問題的深層次。
sentences.en: His understanding of this complex theory is through the naked eyes of a fool, shallow knowledge that fails to grasp the deeper issues.

sentences.zh: 當科學家們討論新技術時，他感到自己的見解就像是肉眼愚眉，見識淺陋，跟不上進度。
sentences.en: When the scientists discussed the new technology, he felt his insights were through the naked eyes of a fool; shallow knowledge unable to keep pace.

sentences.zh: 她自嘲自己的英語能力只是肉眼愚眉，見識淺陋，仍需進一步深入學習。
sentences.en: She self-deprecatingly remarked that her English skills were through the naked eyes of a fool, shallow knowledge, requiring further in-depth study.

sentences.zh: 在藝術欣賞方面，他承認自己只是肉眼愚眉，見識淺陋，無法理解其中的細膩之美。
sentences.en: In terms of art appreciation, he admitted his perspective was through the naked eyes of a fool, shallow knowledge that could not comprehend the subtle beauty.

sentences.zh: 禪修者努力修行，期望有一天能夠入不二門，體驗一切皆空的真理。
sentences.en: The practitioner diligently practices meditation, hoping one day to enter the Gate of Non-Duality and experience the truth of emptiness in all things.

sentences.zh: 在大乘佛教中，入不二門象徵著超越二元對立，達到無分別的智慧。
sentences.en: In Mahayana Buddhism, entering the Gate of Non-Duality symbolizes transcending dualistic oppositions to attain wisdom free from discrimination.

sentences.zh: 老師鼓勵學生放下分別心，勇敢地嘗試入不二門以獲得更高層次的靈性覺醒。
sentences.en: The teacher encourages students to let go of discriminating thoughts and bravely attempt to enter the Gate of Non-Duality to achieve a higher level of spiritual awakening.

sentences.zh: 經由入不二門，修行者能夠從根本上理解宇宙的合一性，超越個人的小我。
sentences.en: By entering the Gate of Non-Duality, practitioners can fundamentally comprehend the oneness of the universe, transcending the limitations of the individual ego.

phrase.en: Enter the Ground of No Regression

sentences.zh: 修行到達入不退地，是佛教修行者達到不再退轉的境界。
sentences.en: Reaching the state of 'Enter the Ground of No Regression' signifies a Buddhist practitioner's attainment of a stage where they no longer regress.

sentences.zh: 在這個階段，菩薩一旦入不退地，他的信心和精進便不會再蒙受損失。
sentences.en: At this stage, once a Bodhisattva enters the Ground of No Regression, their faith and diligence will no longer suffer any setbacks.

sentences.zh: 入不退地是修行者獲得堅定信心與不動搖意志的重要標誌。
sentences.en: Entering the Ground of No Regression is an important milestone for practitioners in gaining steadfast confidence and unwavering determination.

sentences.zh: 當他們入不退地，他們的慈悲心和智慧就會穩固成長，不再動搖。
sentences.en: When they enter the Ground of No Regression, their compassion and wisdom will grow steadily and will no longer be shaken.

phrase.en: Entering the View of the Buddha

sentences.zh: 通過不斷地修行與學習，他終於在冥想中達到了入佛知見的境界。
sentences.en: Through constant practice and study, he finally attained the state of entering the view of the Buddha during meditation.

sentences.zh: 入佛知見讓她對人生的無常有了更深刻的理解，從而減少了對世俗事物的執著。
sentences.en: Entering the view of the Buddha gave her a deeper understanding of life's impermanence, reducing her attachment to worldly things.

sentences.zh: 在禪修退靜中，參加者學習如何入佛知見，以獲得內心的平靜與智慧。
sentences.en: During the meditation retreat, participants learn how to enter the view of the Buddha to gain inner peace and wisdom.

sentences.zh: 老師提到，入佛知見並不是一蹴而就的，需要耐心及不懈的修行。
sentences.en: The teacher mentioned that entering the view of the Buddha is not achieved overnight and requires patience and persistent practice.

phrase.zh: 入佛知見 與佛相應
phrase.en: Entering the View of the Buddha; Resonating with the Buddha

sentences.zh: 通過靜坐冥想，他逐漸入佛知見，與佛相應，體會到生命的真諦。
sentences.en: Through meditative practices, he gradually entered the view of the Buddha and resonated with the Buddha, discovering the true essence of life.

sentences.zh: 她的一生致力於證悟菩提心，力求入佛知見，與佛相應。
sentences.en: Her life's work is dedicated to realizing the Bodhi mind, striving to enter the view of the Buddha and resonate with the Buddha.

sentences.zh: 在讀誦經典時，他深刻感受到與佛心靈相應，這種入佛知見的體驗改變了他的人生。
sentences.en: While reciting the scriptures, he deeply felt his soul resonating with the Buddha, this experience of entering the view of the Buddha changed his life.

sentences.zh: 通過實踐佛法，我們能逐漸入佛知見，與佛相應，提高我們的精神境界。
sentences.en: By practicing the Buddha's teachings, we can gradually enter the view of the Buddha and resonate with the Buddha, elevating our spiritual state.

phrase.zh: 入海算沙　深廣難測
phrase.en: Counting Sands in the Sea; Profound, boundless, and immeasurable.

sentences.zh: 如同入海算沙，這項工程的複雜性深廣難測，令人難以預料全貌。
sentences.en: Just like counting sands in the sea, the complexity of this project is profound, boundless, and immeasurable, making it difficult to grasp the full scope.

sentences.zh: 佛法的智慧如入海算沙，其深廣難測需用心去體悟。
sentences.en: The wisdom of Buddhism is like counting sands in the sea; it is profound, boundless, and immeasurable, requiring deep contemplation to comprehend.

sentences.zh: 要了解宇宙的奧秘如同入海算沙，科學家們面對的是一個深廣難測的挑戰。
sentences.en: Understanding the mysteries of the universe is like counting sands in the sea, presenting scientists with a profound, boundless, and immeasurable challenge.

sentences.zh: 他的知識如此淵博，就像入海算沙，讓人深廣難測。
sentences.en: His knowledge is so extensive, it is like counting sands in the sea, making it profound, boundless, and immeasurable.

phrase.en: Enter the Home of the Tathagata

sentences.zh: 修行者經過長期的修煉，最終進入如來家，體會到真正的佛法意境。
sentences.en: After long periods of cultivation, the practitioner finally entered the Home of the Tathagata, experiencing the true essence of the Dharma.

sentences.zh: 大乘佛教教導信徒要懷著慈悲之心，努力修持，以便早日入如來家。
sentences.en: Mahayana Buddhism teaches its followers to cultivate compassion and strive diligently to enter the Home of the Tathagata soon.

sentences.zh: 佛陀宣示，唯有具備清淨智慧者才能夠真正地入如來家。
sentences.en: The Buddha declared that only those who possess pure wisdom can truly enter the Home of the Tathagata.

sentences.zh: 在深入修悟後，他感受到如來家的無上平靜和安樂。
sentences.en: After deep practice and enlightenment, he felt the supreme peace and joy of the Home of the Tathagata.

phrase.en: Enter the Wisdom of the Tathagata

sentences.zh: 修行者努力學習和冥想，期望最終能入如來智，達到究竟的智慧。
sentences.en: The practitioner strives to learn and meditate, hoping to eventually enter the Wisdom of the Tathagata and attain ultimate enlightenment.

sentences.zh: 經典中記載要想入如來智，必須放下所有執著與偏見。
sentences.en: Scriptures state that to enter the Wisdom of the Tathagata, one must let go of all attachments and biases.

sentences.zh: 佛陀教導弟子如何通過戒定慧三學來入如來智。
sentences.en: The Buddha taught his disciples how to enter the Wisdom of the Tathagata through the threefold training of morality, concentration, and wisdom.

sentences.zh: 他在老師的指導下逐漸入如來智，感受到前所未有的內心寧靜。
sentences.en: Under his teacher's guidance, he gradually entered the Wisdom of the Tathagata and experienced an unprecedented inner peace.

sentences.zh: 在冥想中，他感受到心靈的寧靜與祥和，彷彿漸漸入三摩地。
sentences.en: During meditation, he felt a sense of peace and tranquility, as if he were entering into samadhi.

sentences.zh: 修行者需要多年的修煉才能穩定地入三摩地，達到真正的內心平靜。
sentences.en: It requires years of practice for a practitioner to enter into samadhi steadily, achieving true inner peace.

sentences.zh: 當你專注於呼吸時，你會發現自己更容易入三摩地。
sentences.en: By focusing on your breath, you may find it easier to enter into samadhi.

sentences.zh: 入三摩地的境界被描述為心如止水，不受外界干擾。
sentences.en: The state of entering into samadhi is described as the mind being as still as water, undisturbed by external influences.

phrase.zh: 入鄉隨俗　順應人情
phrase.en: When in Rome, Do as the Romans Do; Adapt to local customs.

sentences.zh: 旅行時，入鄉隨俗是必須的，這樣才能真正融入當地文化。
sentences.en: When traveling, it is essential to adapt to local customs in order to fully integrate into the culture.

sentences.zh: 他在新公司工作時，入鄉隨俗，努力理解和適應公司的文化和流程。
sentences.en: At his new job, he made an effort to adapt to the local customs by understanding and adjusting to the company's culture and processes.

sentences.zh: 為了在新的城市生活得更好，我學會了入鄉隨俗，習慣於當地人的日常習慣。
sentences.en: In order to live better in the new city, I have learned to adapt to local customs and get used to the daily habits of the locals.

sentences.zh: 他在外國留學期間，入鄉隨俗地參加了不少傳統活動，這讓他更加了解當地文化。
sentences.en: During his studies abroad, he adapted to local customs by participating in many traditional activities, which helped him understand the local culture better.

phrase.zh: 入主出奴　涇渭分明
phrase.en: Masters and Slaves; To make a clear distinction

sentences.zh: 大乘佛法中，智慧和慈悲的角色如同涇渭分明，入主出奴般明確。
sentences.en: In Mahayana Buddhism, the roles of wisdom and compassion are as clear-cut as masters and slaves, making a clear distinction.

sentences.zh: 在修行中，我們要入主出奴，清楚區分哪些是助益於道，哪些是障礙。
sentences.en: In practice, we must distinguish like masters and slaves, clearly identifying what aids our path and what hinders it.

sentences.zh: 生活中有些原則需要像涇渭分明般把握，要有入主出奴的決心。
sentences.en: There are certain principles in life that need to be grasped with clear distinctions, with the determination of masters and slaves.

sentences.zh: 禪定中，心念的選擇必須做到入主出奴，涇渭分明，才能真正達到寧靜。
sentences.en: In meditation, the choice of thoughts must be distinct like masters and slaves, making a clear distinction to truly attain tranquility.

sentences.zh: 禪師教導我們應該如空能容，容納一切經驗與情感，而不執著於其中。
sentences.en: The Zen master taught us to be like the all-encompassing emptiness, accepting all experiences and emotions without clinging to them.

sentences.zh: 他的心胸如空能容，能夠包容不同的意見和想法，達到真正的和諧。
sentences.en: His mind is like the all-encompassing emptiness, able to embrace diverse opinions and ideas to achieve true harmony.

sentences.zh: 修行者的心靈應當如空能容，在面對逆境時也能保持平靜和開放。
sentences.en: A practitioner's mind should be like the all-encompassing emptiness, remaining calm and open even in adversity.

sentences.zh: 在冥想中，我們練習讓思緒如空能容地流動，既不抓住也不推開。
sentences.en: In meditation, we practice allowing thoughts to flow like the all-encompassing emptiness, neither grasping nor pushing them away.

sentences.zh: 所有的信徒都盼望著能夠進入如來之家，獲得心靈的平安與啟示。
sentences.en: All devotees yearn to enter the Home of Tathagata, seeking peace and enlightenment for their souls.

sentences.zh: 古老的經典描述如來之家是一個充滿智慧和慈悲的境界。
sentences.en: The ancient scriptures describe the Home of Tathagata as a realm filled with wisdom and compassion.

sentences.zh: 修行者努力修煉自己的心智，以期最終抵達如來之家。
sentences.en: Practitioners strive to cultivate their minds with the aim of eventually reaching the Home of Tathagata.

sentences.zh: 在靜坐中，他感受到如來之家的溫暖與神聖，內心充滿了安寧。
sentences.en: During meditation, he felt the warmth and sacredness of the Home of Tathagata, filling his heart with serenity.

sentences.zh: 如滿禪師偈描述佛陀的來去皆依因緣，是對佛法無常性的認知。
sentences.en: The Verse by Chan Master Ruman describes the Buddha's coming and going, dependent on causes and conditions, as an understanding of the impermanent nature of Dharma.

sentences.zh: 在如滿禪師偈中，法身的存在如同虛空，是超越生滅的。
sentences.en: In the Verse by Chan Master Ruman, the existence of the Dharmakaya is likened to space, transcending birth and death.

sentences.zh: 如滿禪師偈教導我們，智者應該善於思維，無須懷疑佛法的真理。
sentences.en: The Verse by Chan Master Ruman teaches us that the wise should contemplate diligently, without doubting the truths of Buddhism.

sentences.zh: 透過如滿禪師偈，我們可以領悟空性的深意，即無生無滅的安穩自然。
sentences.en: Through the Verse by Chan Master Ruman, we can grasp the profound meaning of emptiness, where there is a natural stability beyond birth and death.

sentences.zh: 聽了師父的教誨後，我感覺如沐春風，心靈變得更加清淨。
sentences.en: After hearing the master's teachings, I felt as if I were bathing in the spring breeze, with my mind becoming clearer and more peaceful.

sentences.zh: 那位法師的慈悲話語，讓在場的信眾如沐春風，倍感溫暖。
sentences.en: The compassionate words of the Dharma master made the believers present feel as if they were bathing in the spring breeze, deeply warmed.

sentences.zh: 她的微笑就像春風拂面，讓人如沐春風，心情愉悅。
sentences.en: Her smile was like a gentle spring breeze, making people feel as if they were bathing in the spring breeze, and uplifting their spirits.

sentences.zh: 這本書充滿智慧，讀起來讓人如沐春風，獲益匪淺。
sentences.en: This book is full of wisdom, and reading it makes one feel as if they were bathing in the spring breeze, gaining immense benefit.

phrase.zh: 如喪考妣 父母雙亡
phrase.en: Grief-Stricken; As if both parents have passed away.

sentences.zh: 失去愛犬後，他如喪考妣，沉浸在悲痛中許久不能自拔。
sentences.en: After losing his beloved dog, he was grief-stricken, as if both parents have passed away, and remained engulfed in sorrow for a long time.

sentences.zh: 公司破產後，他的情緒跌到了最低谷，如喪考妣，無法振作。
sentences.en: After the company's bankruptcy, his spirits hit rock bottom, and he was grief-stricken, as if both parents have passed away, unable to recover.

sentences.zh: 參加摯友的葬禮時，她的淚水止不住，如喪考妣。
sentences.en: At her dear friend's funeral, she couldn't stop her tears, feeling grief-stricken, as if both parents have passed away.

sentences.zh: 當年少時候的老師離世的消息傳來，他如喪考妣，心中滿是悲痛和懷念。
sentences.en: When news of his childhood teacher's passing came, he felt grief-stricken, as if both parents have passed away, filled with sorrow and remembrance.

phrase.zh: 如是我聞　照樣宣說
phrase.en: Thus Have I Heard; To proclaim what was said.

sentences.zh: 佛陀教法的傳承過程中，常以『如是我聞　照樣宣說』的方式保存其正確性。
sentences.en: In the process of transmitting the Buddha's teachings, the phrase 'Thus Have I Heard; To proclaim what was said' is commonly used to preserve its accuracy.

sentences.zh: 在佛典中，阿難尊者常以『如是我聞』開頭，以示其所聞之教法保持原汁原味。
sentences.en: In the Buddhist scriptures, Venerable Ananda often begins with 'Thus Have I Heard' to show that the teaching is preserved in its original form.

sentences.zh: 經典的開頭常見『如是我聞，照樣宣說』，這代表著聽者忠實地重現過去所聞。
sentences.en: The beginning of the sutras often features 'Thus Have I Heard; To proclaim what was said', indicating the listener faithfully re-presenting what was heard in the past.

sentences.zh: 這句『如是我聞，照樣宣說』不僅是一種表達方式，也是一種信仰的傳承象徵。
sentences.en: The phrase 'Thus Have I Heard; To proclaim what was said' is not only a mode of expression but also a symbol of the transmission of faith.

phrase.en: Like Melting Snow with Hot Water

sentences.zh: 這次的考試對他來說如湯沃雪，完全不費吹灰之力。
sentences.en: The exam was like melting snow with hot water for him, requiring absolutely no effort.

sentences.zh: 她解決問題的能力讓棘手的情況變得如湯沃雪，絲毫不感到困難。
sentences.en: Her problem-solving skills made the tricky situation become like melting snow with hot water, with no difficulty at all.

sentences.zh: 這次比賽他如湯沃雪般地取得了勝利，幾乎沒有遇到任何挑戰。
sentences.en: He won the competition like melting snow with hot water, encountering almost no challenges.

sentences.zh: 他的演講如湯沃雪般地吸引了觀眾的注意，讓人不覺時間飛逝。
sentences.en: His speech captured the audience's attention like melting snow with hot water, making time fly by effortlessly.

sentences.zh: 在新年的時候，人們互祝如意吉祥，希望來年一切順利。
sentences.en: During the New Year, people wish each other luck and auspiciousness, hoping for a smooth year ahead.

sentences.zh: 這尊佛像被視為如意吉祥的象徵，經常被擺放在家中以祈求平安。
sentences.en: This Buddha statue is regarded as a symbol of luck and auspiciousness, often placed in homes to pray for peace.

sentences.zh: 如意吉祥是許多人在重要場合常常掛在嘴邊的祝福語。
sentences.en: Luck and auspiciousness is a common blessing many people mention during important occasions.

sentences.zh: 在這場慶典中，舞獅表演象徵著為大家帶來如意吉祥。
sentences.en: In this celebration, the lion dance symbolizes bringing luck and auspiciousness to everyone.

phrase.zh: 如飲醍醐　聞道法喜
phrase.en: As if Having the Finest Cream; Joy from hearing the Dharma.

sentences.zh: 聽完那位大師的開示後，他感到如飲醍醐，聞道法喜，心生無比的快樂。
sentences.en: After listening to the master's teaching, he felt as if having the finest cream, experiencing joy from hearing the Dharma, and his heart was filled with immense happiness.

sentences.zh: 弟子們聚精會神地聆聽，浸染在如飲醍醐，聞道法喜的靈性喜悅中。
sentences.en: The disciples listened attentively, immersed in the spiritual joy as if having the finest cream, deriving joy from hearing the Dharma.

sentences.zh: 那天他對佛法的領悟讓他感到如飲醍醐，聞道法喜，從此心境豁然開朗。
sentences.en: His realization of the Dharma that day made him feel as if having the finest cream, experiencing joy from hearing the Dharma, and his mind opened up with clarity.

sentences.zh: 在禪修期間，她感受到如飲醍醐，聞道法喜的純粹與平靜。
sentences.en: During the meditation retreat, she experienced the purity and tranquility as if having the finest cream and finding joy from hearing the Dharma.

sentences.zh: 善惡業力如影隨形，無論你走到哪裡，它們都會伴隨著你。
sentences.en: The karma of wholesome and unwholesome deeds is like shadows following the body, accompanying you wherever you go.

sentences.zh: 佛陀教導我們要注意自己的行為，因為善惡業力會如影隨形地影響我們未來的命運。
sentences.en: The Buddha taught us to be mindful of our actions, as the karma of wholesome and unwholesome deeds will follow us closely, affecting our future destiny.

sentences.zh: 他深信自己所作的每個善行或惡行都會如影隨形，最終回報於自己。
sentences.en: He firmly believes that each good or bad deed he performs will be like shadows following the body, eventually returning to himself.

sentences.zh: 修習正念能幫助我們了解業力如影隨形的道理，讓我們更加小心翼翼地選擇行為。
sentences.en: Practicing mindfulness helps us understand the principle that karma follows us like shadows, encouraging us to choose our actions more carefully.

phrase.en: Appearing united, but divided at heart

sentences.zh: 雖然他們表面上是合作夥伴，但實際上是貌合神離，各有各的打算。
sentences.en: Although they appeared to be partners, in reality, they were united in appearance but divided at heart, each with their own agendas.

sentences.zh: 這個團隊看似團結，其實成員之間經常貌合神離。
sentences.en: The team appeared united, but in fact, the members were often divided at heart.

phrase.zh: 若能轉悟即如來，春至山花處處開；自有一雙慈悲手，摸得人心一樣平。
phrase.en: One who can turn to enlightenment is a tathagata, Upon spring, mountain flowers bloom everywhere; Inherent are those compassionate hands, That reach out and make every heart just as fair.

sentences.zh: 若能轉悟即如來，春至山花處處開，意味著悟道的人成為如來，迎接生命中的每個美好時刻。
sentences.en: One who can turn to enlightenment is a tathagata, upon spring, mountain flowers bloom everywhere, symbolizes that the enlightened become a tathagata, welcoming every beautiful moment in life.

sentences.zh: 自有一雙慈悲手，摸得人心一樣平，這句話提醒我們要用愛心對待別人，使每個人都能感受到平和與關懷。
sentences.en: Inherent are those compassionate hands, that reach out and make every heart just as fair. This phrase reminds us to treat others with love, so that everyone can feel peace and care.

sentences.zh: 春至山花處處開，象徵著轉悟後的心境豐富多彩，宛若大自然的萬物復甦。
sentences.en: Upon spring, mountain flowers bloom everywhere, symbolizes the rich and colorful state of mind after enlightenment, akin to the rejuvenation of nature.

sentences.zh: 悟道者如如來，自有一雙慈悲手，這樣的人能感化身邊的人，使社會更加和諧美好。
sentences.en: An enlightened one is as a tathagata, inherent are those compassionate hands, such a person can influence those around them, making society more harmonious and beautiful.

phrase.zh: 若人欲拿金碧峯，除非鐵鍊鎖虛空。虛空若能鎖得住，再來拿我金碧峯。
phrase.en: Capture the Peak of Golden Blue? First chain down the void of emptiness. Only when emptiness is ball and chain, Then seek to capture this Peak of Golden Blue.

sentences.zh: 若人欲拿金碧峯，除非鐵鍊鎖虛空。
sentences.en: Capture the Peak of Golden Blue? First chain down the void of emptiness.

sentences.zh: 虛空若能鎖得住，再來拿我金碧峯。
sentences.en: Only when emptiness is ball and chain, Then seek to capture this Peak of Golden Blue.

sentences.zh: 在禪宗中，想要捉住或征服某些無形的東西，就像想要拿下金碧峯一樣不可能。
sentences.en: In Zen, attempting to grasp or conquer something intangible is as impossible as trying to capture the Peak of Golden Blue.

sentences.zh: 這句詩用虛空比喻難以捉摸的真理，道出只有在掌握了不可能後，才能取得真正的境界。
sentences.en: This verse uses emptiness as a metaphor for elusive truths, conveying that only by mastering the impossible can one obtain the true state.

phrase.zh: 弱肉強食　也是無奈
phrase.en: The Weak are Prey to the Strong; Helplessness.

sentences.zh: 在這個競爭激烈的工作環境中，弱肉強食也是無奈，有些人根本沒有機會站穩腳跟。
sentences.en: In this highly competitive work environment, the weak are prey to the strong; it's a helpless situation, as some people have no chance of gaining a footing.

sentences.zh: 面對不斷變化的市場，許多小企業在弱肉強食的現實下陷入無奈，難以與大型企業競爭。
sentences.en: Facing the ever-changing market, many small businesses are helpless in the reality where the weak are prey to the strong, struggling to compete with large corporations.

sentences.zh: 在自然界中，弱肉強食也是無奈的規律，生物必須適應才能生存。
sentences.en: In the natural world, the principle of the weak being prey to the strong is an inescapable reality, and organisms must adapt to survive.

sentences.zh: 弱肉強食也是無奈，這句話在社會中各個階層間發人深省。
sentences.en: The phrase 'the weak are prey to the strong; helplessness' is thought-provoking among various social strata.

phrase.zh: 灑灑落落　任運自在
phrase.en: Easy and Frank; Be at perfect ease when following conditions.

sentences.zh: 在漫步於鄉間小路時，他感到灑灑落落，任運自在，仿若天地間一塊飄浮的白雲。
sentences.en: While strolling along the country path, he felt easy and frank, at perfect ease, like a white cloud floating in the great expanse.

sentences.zh: 面對人生的起落，他總能保持灑灑落落，任運自在，像一位智者般從容面對一切。
sentences.en: In the face of life's ups and downs, he always remained easy and frank, at perfect ease, facing everything with the poise of a sage.

sentences.zh: 她的心境總是灑灑落落，任運自在，與環境和諧共處，從不感到壓力。
sentences.en: Her temperament was always easy and frank, at perfect ease, living harmoniously with her surroundings, never feeling stressed.

sentences.zh: 即便在繁忙的工作中，他也能保持灑灑落落，任運自在，處事泰然自若。
sentences.en: Even in the midst of hectic work, he managed to stay easy and frank, at perfect ease, handling matters with calm composure.

sentences.zh: 在佛前的三寶放光儀式中，信眾們聚集祈福，祝願世界和平。
sentences.en: During the ceremony of the Radiating Triple Gem in front of the Buddha, devotees gathered to pray for world peace.

sentences.zh: 修行者心中視三寶放光如光明的指南，指引他們走向正道。
sentences.en: Practitioners view the Radiating Triple Gem in their hearts as a beacon that guides them towards the righteous path.

sentences.zh: 每當三寶放光，佛教徒們感受到心靈的安定與喜悅。
sentences.en: Whenever the Triple Gem radiates, Buddhists feel a sense of peace and joy in their hearts.

sentences.zh: 老師在課堂上詳述三寶放光的意義，讓學生們更深刻理解信仰的力量。
sentences.en: The teacher elaborated on the significance of the Radiating Triple Gem in class, helping students gain a deeper understanding of the power of faith.

sentences.zh: 儒家思想提到三不朽，分別是立德、立功、立言，這三者皆留名於後世。
sentences.en: Confucian thought mentions the Three Imperishables: establishing virtue, achieving accomplishments, and making contributions through words, all of which leave a legacy for future generations.

sentences.zh: 老師教導學生應該努力追求三不朽，使自己的生命更有意義。
sentences.en: The teacher advises students to strive for the Three Imperishables, making their lives more meaningful.

sentences.zh: 在追求三不朽的路上，人們經常需要承擔許多挑戰和責任。
sentences.en: On the path to achieving the Three Imperishables, individuals often have to take on numerous challenges and responsibilities.

sentences.zh: 許多古代聖賢都致力於實現三不朽，成為後人敬仰的榜樣。
sentences.en: Many ancient sages dedicated themselves to achieving the Three Imperishables, becoming revered examples for future generations.

phrase.zh: 三德六味　典座美德
phrase.en: Three Virtues and Six Tastes; Virtues of a Chef

sentences.zh: 這位廚師一直遵循三德六味的原則，確保每道菜都能呈現出典座美德。
sentences.en: The chef always adheres to the principles of three virtues and six tastes, ensuring each dish exemplifies the virtues of a chef.

sentences.zh: 理解三德六味的精髓，可以使廚師在料理中傳遞更深厚的文化底蘊。
sentences.en: Understanding the essence of the three virtues and six tastes allows a chef to convey a deeper cultural richness through their cuisine.

sentences.zh: 年輕學徒在學習如何掌握三德六味時，得到了大師的悉心指導。
sentences.en: The young apprentice received careful guidance from the master while learning to master the three virtues and six tastes.

sentences.zh: 品味一道好菜，需要從三德六味去感受廚師的用心。
sentences.en: To fully appreciate a well-crafted dish, one must sense the chef's dedication through the three virtues and six tastes.

sentences.zh: 佛教的三法印是無常、無我和涅槃，揭示了宇宙的基本真理。
sentences.en: The Three Dharma Seals in Buddhism are impermanence, non-self, and Nirvana, which reveal the fundamental truths of the universe.

sentences.zh: 理解三法印能幫助修行者突破對自我的執著，從而達到解脫。
sentences.en: Understanding the Three Dharma Seals can help practitioners overcome attachment to the self, thus achieving liberation.

sentences.zh: 三法印中的無常告訴我們所有現象皆在變化，不應執著不變的事物。
sentences.en: The impermanence in the Three Dharma Seals teaches us that all phenomena are subject to change, and we should not cling to unchanging things.

sentences.zh: 修行者常常反思三法印，以培養對現實的正確見解和覺悟。
sentences.en: Practitioners often reflect on the Three Dharma Seals to cultivate correct insight and enlightenment concerning reality.

phrase.en: Kneel Three Times, Kowtow Nine Times

sentences.zh: 這次的祭祀儀式上，他們遵循著三跪九叩的古禮，表達對祖先的深切敬意。
sentences.en: During the ceremony, they observed the ancient rite of 'Kneel Three Times, Kowtow Nine Times' to show profound respect for their ancestors.

sentences.zh: 在拜見皇帝時，官員們必須完成三跪九叩，以示忠誠和敬畏。
sentences.en: When meeting the emperor, officials had to perform the ritual of 'Kneel Three Times, Kowtow Nine Times' to demonstrate their loyalty and reverence.

sentences.zh: 三跪九叩不僅是對統治者的敬意，還是一種表達對天地鬼神尊崇的儀式。
sentences.en: The act of 'Kneel Three Times, Kowtow Nine Times' was not only a gesture of respect towards rulers but also a ritual of reverence for the heavens, earth, and spirits.

sentences.zh: 他們在舊廟前履行了三跪九叩，以遵循古人的禮數。
sentences.en: They performed the ritual of 'Kneel Three Times, Kowtow Nine Times' in front of the old temple to adhere to the customs of their ancestors.

sentences.zh: 王家被鄰居們稱為三好人家，因為他們總是行善、做好事、說好話。
sentences.en: The Wang family is known among their neighbors as a Three Acts of Goodness Family because they are always doing good deeds, speaking kind words, and thinking good thoughts.

sentences.zh: 他決定以三好人家的原則來教育他的孩子，希望他們在生活中做個有德行的人。
sentences.en: He decided to educate his children with the principles of a Three Acts of Goodness Family, hoping they would grow up to be virtuous individuals.

sentences.zh: 社區舉辦活動，鼓勵大家向三好人家學習，以營造更和諧的社會環境。
sentences.en: The community organized an event to encourage everyone to learn from the Three Acts of Goodness Family in order to create a more harmonious social environment.

sentences.zh: 老師表揚小明的家庭是三好人家，因為他們經常參與慈善義工，幫助有需要的人。
sentences.en: The teacher praised Xiaoming's family as a Three Acts of Goodness Family because they frequently participate in charity work and help those in need.

phrase.en: A Life Lived in the Three Acts of Goodness

sentences.zh: 他一生都在實踐三好人生的理念，努力做好事、說好話、存好心。
sentences.en: He dedicated his life to the philosophy of a life lived in the three acts of goodness, striving to do good deeds, speak good words, and harbor good intentions.

sentences.zh: 安娜在學校推廣三好人生，帶領同學們參加各種慈善活動。
sentences.en: Anna promotes a life lived in the three acts of goodness at school, leading her classmates in various charitable activities.

sentences.zh: 三好人生讓小鎮的居民相互支持，形成了和諧的社區。
sentences.en: A life lived in the three acts of goodness has led the townspeople to support each other, forming a harmonious community.

sentences.zh: 社會運動家呼籲每個人追求三好人生，以共創更加美好的未來。
sentences.en: The social activist called upon everyone to pursue a life lived in the three acts of goodness to create a better future for all.

phrase.en: A Family that Follows the Three Acts of Goodness

sentences.zh: 這個社區以三好之家為榜樣，推動每個家庭都實踐良好的品德、言行和心念。
sentences.en: The community uses families that follow the Three Acts of Goodness as models, encouraging every household to practice good deeds, words, and thoughts.

sentences.zh: 身為三好之家的一員，小明時刻自我檢討，努力在日常生活中表現出善良和關懷。
sentences.en: As a member of a family that follows the Three Acts of Goodness, Xiao Ming constantly self-reflects and strives to exhibit kindness and care in everyday life.

sentences.zh: 佛教倡導創建三好之家，以傳遞正向價值觀給下一代。
sentences.en: Buddhism advocates for the establishment of families that follow the Three Acts of Goodness to impart positive values to the next generation.

sentences.zh: 他們的家庭因遵循三好之家原則而被社區表彰，成為眾人的楷模。
sentences.en: Their family was recognized by the community for following the principles of a family that follows the Three Acts of Goodness, becoming a role model for others.

phrase.zh: 三教九流　各項各業
phrase.en: Three Religions and Nine Schools; People from all walks of life

sentences.zh: 在古代中國，三教九流包括儒教、佛教、道教以及各種學派。
sentences.en: In ancient China, the Three Religions and Nine Schools included Confucianism, Buddhism, Taoism, and various schools of thought.

sentences.zh: 這個大型的城市中充滿了各項各業的人們，他們共同創造了豐富的文化氛圍。
sentences.en: The bustling city is filled with people from all walks of life, creating a rich cultural atmosphere together.

sentences.zh: 三教九流的學者常聚在一起進行思想交流，推動知識的進步。
sentences.en: Scholars from the Three Religions and Nine Schools often gathered for intellectual exchanges, promoting the advancement of knowledge.

sentences.zh: 各項各業的專家齊聚一堂，探討未來技術的發展趨勢。
sentences.en: Experts from all walks of life gathered to discuss the future trends in technology development.

phrase.en: The Three Realms Are All a State of Mind

sentences.zh: 在佛教中，求證三界為心的觀念可以幫助人們理解一切現象的本質是空的。
sentences.en: In Buddhism, realizing the concept that 'the Three Realms are all a state of mind' can help people understand that the nature of all phenomena is emptiness.

sentences.zh: 她深刻地悟到了三界為心的意義，看清了生活中許多困惑的真相。
sentences.en: She profoundly understood the meaning of 'the Three Realms are all a state of mind,' gaining clarity on the truth behind many confusions in life.

sentences.zh: 透過禪修，他體會到三界為心的智慧、心得到了心靈的平靜。
sentences.en: Through meditation, he experienced the wisdom of 'the Three Realms are all a state of mind,' and found peace within his soul.

sentences.zh: 這句話提醒我們，外在的世界是受到我們心境影響的，正是三界為心的體現。
sentences.en: This phrase reminds us that the external world is influenced by our mindset, exemplifying that the Three Realms are all a state of mind.

phrase.en: Splendid Stars Within the Three Realms

sentences.zh: 在夜空中所展示的三界星華，讓人感受到宇宙的廣闊與神秘。
sentences.en: The splendid stars within the three realms displayed in the night sky evoke a sense of the universe's vastness and mystery.

sentences.zh: 禪師講述了佛陀期間三界星華的故事，讓在座的信徒深受啟發。
sentences.en: The Zen master narrated the story of the splendid stars within the three realms during the Buddha's time, profoundly inspiring the attending devotees.

sentences.zh: 在冥想時，我觀想著三界星華，感到身心的寧靜與和諧。
sentences.en: During meditation, I visualize the splendid stars within the three realms, experiencing a sense of peace and harmony in body and mind.

sentences.zh: 藝術家以鮮豔的顏色描繪出三界星華，展現了其心目中的崇高美景。
sentences.en: The artist depicted the splendid stars within the three realms in vibrant colors, showcasing the sublime beauty as envisioned in his mind.

sentences.zh: 在佛法修行中，達到三覺圓被視為終極的目標，這意味著徹底的覺悟與解脫。
sentences.en: In the practice of Buddhism, achieving the Perfection of Three Awakenings is considered the ultimate goal, signifying complete enlightenment and liberation.

sentences.zh: 他研究了一生，以期深化對三覺圓的理解，並在教義上獲得更深刻的洞察力。
sentences.en: He dedicated his life to study in hopes of deepening his understanding of the Perfection of Three Awakenings and gaining deeper insights into the doctrines.

sentences.zh: 三覺圓的概念讓修行者在智慧、慈悲和力量上達到平衡的完美狀態。
sentences.en: The concept of Perfection of Three Awakenings allows practitioners to achieve a balanced state of perfection in wisdom, compassion, and power.

sentences.zh: 大乘佛教強調三覺圓，並認為這是菩薩道的核心之一。
sentences.en: Mahayana Buddhism emphasizes the Perfection of Three Awakenings, considering it a core part of the Bodhisattva path.

phrase.zh: 三輪體空　物我俱忘
phrase.en: Emptiness of the Three Aspects of Giving; Seeing the object and self as non-substantial.

sentences.zh: 修行者應該達到三輪體空的境界，物我俱忘，才能真正步入涅槃的道路。
sentences.en: A practitioner should attain the level of Emptiness of the Three Aspects of Giving, seeing the object and self as non-substantial, in order to truly embark on the path to Nirvana.

sentences.zh: 佛陀教導我們，在修行佈施時應該持有三輪體空的心態，物我俱忘，不著相於所施、受者或施者。
sentences.en: Buddha taught us that when practicing giving, one should maintain the mindset of Emptiness of the Three Aspects, seeing the object and self as non-substantial, and not attaching to the donor, the recipient, or the act of giving.

sentences.zh: 當他深入禪定，領悟到三輪體空的深意，物我俱忘，他的心境超越了凡塵的束縛。
sentences.en: When he went deep into meditation and realized the profound meaning of the Emptiness of the Three Aspects, seeing the object and self as non-substantial, his state of mind transcended the bonds of worldly attachments.

sentences.zh: 在禪修中悟得三輪體空，物我俱忘，可以幫助我們超越自我束縛，達到心靈的解脫。
sentences.en: Realizing the Emptiness of the Three Aspects in Zen meditation, seeing the object and self as non-substantial, can help us transcend self-imposed limitations and achieve spiritual liberation.

sentences.zh: 在禪修中，他達到了三摩地的境界，感受到無比的安寧與清明。
sentences.en: During meditation, he reached the state of Samadhi, experiencing unparalleled peace and clarity.

sentences.zh: 佛陀教導弟子們通過修習三摩地來發現內在的智慧和光明。
sentences.en: The Buddha taught his disciples to practice Samadhi in order to uncover inner wisdom and light.

sentences.zh: 三摩地是瑜伽修行中的一個至關重要的階段，有助於靜心與自我實現。
sentences.en: Samadhi is a critical stage in the practice of yoga that aids in inner stillness and self-realization.

sentences.zh: 經由不斷的冥想練習，她逐漸能夠在日常生活中保持三摩地的平和狀態。
sentences.en: Through continuous meditation practice, she gradually became able to maintain a state of Samadhi in daily life.

phrase.en: Three Birds Flying in the Sky

sentences.zh: 在深秋的早晨，三鳥飛空，呈現出一幅美麗的畫面。
sentences.en: On an early autumn morning, three birds flying in the sky created a beautiful scene.

sentences.zh: 儘管陰雲密佈，三鳥飛空的景象帶來了一絲陽光。
sentences.en: Despite the overcast skies, the sight of three birds flying in the sky brought a ray of sunlight.

sentences.zh: 三鳥飛空時，他們展現了非凡的協調和美感。
sentences.en: While the three birds were flying in the sky, they exhibited extraordinary coordination and grace.

sentences.zh: 她抬頭望去，正好看到三鳥飛空，感到心靈的祥和。
sentences.en: She looked up and saw three birds flying in the sky, feeling a sense of peace in her heart.

phrase.zh: 三鳥飛空 各有遠近
phrase.en: Three Birds Flying in the Sky; Distance is relative.

sentences.zh: 三鳥飛空，各有遠近，象徵著人生旅程的不同速度和方向。
sentences.en: Three birds flying in the sky, each with its own distance, symbolizes the varied pace and directions of life's journey.

sentences.zh: 就如同三鳥飛空，各有遠近，不同的人在修行中會有不同的步伐和路徑。
sentences.en: Just like three birds flying in the sky with various distances, different people will have different paces and paths in their spiritual practice.

sentences.zh: 觀察三鳥飛空，各有遠近，我們能夠體會到萬物的相對性及其個別特質。
sentences.en: By observing the three birds flying with different distances, we can appreciate the relativity of all things and their unique characteristics.

sentences.zh: 師父提醒我們，三鳥飛空，各有遠近，修行不必攀比，心無旁鶩。
sentences.en: The master reminds us that as three birds fly with different distances, there is no need to compare in our practice; we should stay focused and undistracted.

phrase.zh: 三千大千　時空無限
phrase.en: Three Thousand-fold World System; Infinite time and space.

sentences.zh: 在佛教經典中，三千大千世界被描述為一個龐大且充滿無限可能的宇宙。
sentences.en: In Buddhist scriptures, the Three Thousand-fold World System is depicted as a vast universe full of infinite possibilities.

sentences.zh: 禪修時，我們試圖超越時空無限，進入一種超越時間和空間的寧靜狀態。
sentences.en: During meditation, we attempt to transcend the infinite time and space, entering a state of tranquility beyond time and space.

sentences.zh: 學無止境，就如同處於無限的三千大千世界中，總有新的知識等待我們去探索。
sentences.en: Learning is endless, much like being in the infinite Three Thousand-fold World System, where new knowledge always awaits our exploration.

sentences.zh: 大乘佛教的理念中，三千大千世界和時空無限被視作佛法普度眾生的範圍。
sentences.en: In Mahayana Buddhism, the Three Thousand-fold World System and infinite time and space are considered the scope for the Dharma to universally liberate sentient beings.

phrase.zh: 三生有幸　宿世好運
phrase.en: Blessings from the Past Three Lifetimes; Good fortune from one's past lives.

sentences.zh: 能遇見這位智者，實在是三生有幸，宿世好運，為我開啟了新的見解。
sentences.en: Meeting this wise man is truly blessings from the past three lifetimes; good fortune from my past lives, as it has opened up new insights for me.

sentences.zh: 她對他說，他們的相遇是三生有幸，宿世好運，像是命中註定的安排。
sentences.en: She told him that their meeting was blessings from the past three lifetimes; good fortune from one's past lives, as if it were a predestined arrangement.

sentences.zh: 擁有這樣的團隊，讓我感受到三生有幸，宿世好運，大家彼此都非常支持。
sentences.en: Having such a team makes me feel like it's blessings from the past three lifetimes; good fortune from one's past lives, as everyone is very supportive of each other.

sentences.zh: 那些一直支持我的朋友們，我真是三生有幸，宿世好運，能與他們結緣。
sentences.en: For those friends who have always supported me, I am truly blessed from the past three lifetimes; good fortune from one's past lives to have made connections with them.

phrase.zh: 三十年來尋劍客，幾回落葉又抽枝；自從一見桃花後，直至如今更不疑。

sentences.zh: 三十年來尋劍客，幾回落葉又抽枝；自從一見桃花後，直至如今更不疑。
sentences.en: For thirty years I have searched for a swordsman, many times the leaves have fallen and budded again; Ever since seeing peach blossoms, until now I have never doubted again.

sentences.zh: 這首詩表達了一位修行者至見桃花後即明悟真理，再無疑惑的境界。
sentences.en: This poem expresses the state of a practitioner who attains enlightenment upon seeing peach blossoms, never doubting the truth again.

sentences.zh: 在寒冬中，樹枝上仍有幾片桃花綻放，讓師父回憶起『三十年來尋劍客』的詩句。
sentences.en: In the cold winter, a few peach blossoms still bloomed on the branches, reminding the master of the verse 'For thirty years I have searched for a swordsman.'

sentences.zh: 那一瞬間的領悟，如同詩中『自從一見桃花後』，讓他再無徬徨。
sentences.en: That moment of enlightenment was like in the poem 'Ever since seeing peach blossoms', leaving him with no more hesitation.

sentences.zh: 佛經中提到三十三天天外天，是一個超越物質界的領域。
sentences.en: The Buddhist scriptures mention that above the Thirty-Three Heavens is a realm transcending the physical plane.

sentences.zh: 修行者夢想在三十三天天外天找到終極的智慧和安寧。
sentences.en: Practitioners dream of attaining ultimate wisdom and peace above the Thirty-Three Heavens.

sentences.zh: 三十三天天外天被認為是菩薩和聖人居住的地方。
sentences.en: Above the Thirty-Three Heavens is considered the abode of bodhisattvas and sages.

sentences.zh: 三十三天之上，天外天象徵著一種超越性的靈性境界。
sentences.en: Above the Thirty-Three Heavens symbolizes a transcendent spiritual realm.

phrase.en: Three Periods and the Ten Directions

sentences.zh: 佛教信徒相信佛陀的智慧遍及三世十方，這意味著在任何時間和空間中都有其影響。
sentences.en: Buddhist followers believe that the wisdom of the Buddha permeates the Three Periods and the Ten Directions, meaning it has an influence across all times and spaces.

sentences.zh: 在三世十方中，一切眾生都可以因此而獲得超越時空的平等利益。
sentences.en: In the Three Periods and the Ten Directions, all beings can thus receive equal benefits beyond time and space.

sentences.zh: 漢傳佛教常用‘三世十方’來指示宇宙的無邊廣大和時間的無窮流轉。
sentences.en: In Chinese Buddhism, 'Three Periods and the Ten Directions' is often used to denote the vastness of the universe and the endless flow of time.

sentences.zh: 修行者的願望是能夠在三世十方中利樂一切眾生。
sentences.en: The practitioner's aspiration is to benefit and bring happiness to all beings in the Three Periods and the Ten Directions.

phrase.zh: 三世因果 輪迴不止
phrase.en: Karma of the Three Time Periods; Endless cycle of birth and death.

sentences.zh: 他的行為顯示他相信三世因果，認為今生的努力將影響未來的命運。
sentences.en: His actions reflect his belief in the karma of the three time periods, thinking that efforts in this life will impact future destiny.

sentences.zh: 佛教教義強調要了脫輪迴不止，通過修行來達到解脫。
sentences.en: Buddhist teachings emphasize escaping the endless cycle of birth and death through practices that lead to liberation.

sentences.zh: 學習三世因果，可以幫助我們理解現在生活中的困難源自過去的業力。
sentences.en: Studying the karma of the three time periods can help us understand that current life difficulties stem from past actions.

sentences.zh: 懸崖上的佛像讓人反思人生，逃脫輪迴不止的重要性。
sentences.en: The cliff-edge Buddha statue prompts reflection on life, highlighting the importance of escaping the endless cycle of birth and death.

phrase.zh: 三世有緣　關係無限
phrase.en: Affinities of Past, Present, and Future; Endless connections.

sentences.zh: 我們之所以能相遇，是因為三世有緣，關係無限。
sentences.en: The reason we could meet is due to the affinities of past, present, and future; endless connections.

sentences.zh: 在修行佛法的過程中，我們不斷與眾生建立三世有緣，關係無限的連結。
sentences.en: In the practice of the Dharma, we continuously establish affinities of past, present, and future; endless connections with all sentient beings.

sentences.zh: 她相信他們的友情是三世有緣，關係無限，因此更加珍惜每一次相聚。
sentences.en: She believes their friendship is due to affinities of past, present, and future; endless connections, and thus cherishes every moment together.

sentences.zh: 許多宗教信仰中都有類似三世有緣，關係無限的觀念，表示人生無數的因果聯系。
sentences.en: Many religious beliefs contain concepts similar to affinities of past, present, and future; endless connections, indicating the innumerable karmic links in life.

phrase.zh: 三獸渡河　各有深淺
phrase.en: Three Animals Crossing the River; Depth is relative.

sentences.zh: 在這個故事中，三獸渡河，各有深淺，展現了對不同個體在面對相同挑戰時之不同應對方式的智慧。
sentences.en: In this story, the three animals crossing the river, each with its own depth, illustrates the wisdom of different responses by individuals facing the same challenge.

sentences.zh: 三獸渡河，各有深淺，這個比喻經常用來描述各人經歷相同事件卻有不同體會。
sentences.en: The metaphor of three animals crossing the river, each with its own depth, is often used to describe how people experience the same event differently.

sentences.zh: 面對人生的考驗，我們如三獸渡河，各有深淺，需要根據自己的優勢來調整方法。
sentences.en: Facing the trials of life, we are like the three animals crossing the river, each with its own depth, needing to adjust our methods according to our strengths.

sentences.zh: 三獸渡河，各有深淺，提醒我們即使在困境中，也要認識到自己的獨特能力與優勢。
sentences.en: Three animals crossing the river, each with its own depth, reminds us that even in adversity, we must recognize our unique abilities and strengths.

phrase.zh: 三頭六臂　神通廣大
phrase.en: Having Three Heads and Six Arms; Great supernatural power

sentences.zh: 在眾人的眼中，他就像擁有三頭六臂，神通廣大，能夠解決所有困難。
sentences.en: In the eyes of many, he seemed to have three heads and six arms, with great supernatural power, capable of solving any problem.

sentences.zh: 那位大師展現出如同三頭六臂般的神通廣大，讓所有在場的人都驚嘆不已。
sentences.en: The master displayed great supernatural power, akin to having three heads and six arms, astonishing everyone present.

sentences.zh: 面對如此繁多的挑戰，她需要有三頭六臂和神通廣大才能應付。
sentences.en: Faced with such numerous challenges, she needed to have three heads and six arms, and great supernatural power to cope.

sentences.zh: 這位修行佛法多年的人，修得宛如三頭六臂般的神通廣大，令世人敬仰。
sentences.en: This person, who has been practicing Buddhism for many years, has acquired great supernatural power, like having three heads and six arms, earning the admiration of the world.

phrase.en: Clear Attainment of the Three Minds

sentences.zh: 修行多年後，他終於達到了三心已明的境界，智慧與慈悲更加圓滿。
sentences.en: After years of practice, he finally achieved the clear attainment of the three minds, with wisdom and compassion becoming more complete.

sentences.zh: 佛陀教導弟子們如何修煉以達到三心已明的狀態，這是通向解脫的重要一步。
sentences.en: The Buddha taught his disciples how to cultivate for the clear attainment of the three minds, which is a significant step towards liberation.

sentences.zh: 在禪修中，她感受到心智的澄澈，彷彿已經接近三心已明的境界。
sentences.en: In meditation, she felt her mind clearing, as if she was approaching the clear attainment of the three minds.

sentences.zh: 達成三心已明需要長時間的修煉和對自我深入的認識。
sentences.en: Achieving the clear attainment of the three minds requires long-term practice and deep self-awareness.

phrase.en: Equal Attainment of the Three Kinds of Existence

sentences.zh: 他修行多年，終於達到三有均資的境界，能夠在三種存在中自由地轉換。
sentences.en: After many years of practice, he finally achieved the equal attainment of the three kinds of existence, allowing him to freely transition among them.

sentences.zh: 三有均資是一種高度的修行境界，需要持續的努力和深刻的智慧。
sentences.en: The equal attainment of the three kinds of existence is a high level of spiritual practice that requires continual effort and profound wisdom.

sentences.zh: 佛教的目標之一是達到三有均資，超越生死的束縛。
sentences.en: One of the goals in Buddhism is to achieve the equal attainment of the three kinds of existence, transcending the bonds of birth and death.

sentences.zh: 修行者在參透三有均資後，可以進入一個更高的認知層次，增進對自我和宇宙的理解。
sentences.en: Upon realizing the equal attainment of the three kinds of existence, a practitioner can enter a higher state of awareness, enhancing their understanding of self and the universe.

phrase.zh: 三月裏的小雨流水不停
phrase.en: Gentle Rain in March: unstopping rain

sentences.zh: 三月裏的小雨流水不停，滋潤著大地的每一寸土地。
sentences.en: Gentle rain in March, the unstopping rain nourishes every inch of the earth.

sentences.zh: 佛經中常用三月裏的小雨流水不停來比喻佛法的滋潤不斷。
sentences.en: In the Buddhist scriptures, the gentle rain in March, the unstopping rain, is often used as a metaphor for the continuous nourishment of the Dharma.

sentences.zh: 村民們說，三月裏的小雨流水不停預示著一個豐收的年景。
sentences.en: The villagers say that the gentle rain in March, the unstopping rain, foretells a bountiful harvest year.

sentences.zh: 在三月裏，外頭的小雨細細流水不停，讓人心情平和。
sentences.en: In March, the gentle rain outside, unstopping, brings a sense of peace to the heart.

phrase.zh: 森羅萬象　包容一切
phrase.en: Every Myriad Form; Able to embrace all

sentences.zh: 大自然的美妙在於它能展現森羅萬象，包容一切，無論是山川湖海還是生靈萬物。
sentences.en: The wonder of nature lies in its ability to present every myriad form, able to embrace all, whether it be mountains, rivers, lakes, seas, or living beings.

sentences.zh: 佛教教義強調人的心靈應該像宇宙一樣，森羅萬象，包容一切，不執著於一個形象或概念。
sentences.en: Buddhist teachings emphasize that one's mind should be like the universe, every myriad form, able to embrace all, without attachment to a single image or concept.

sentences.zh: 藝術家的作品反映了他對世界的觀察，全然森羅萬象，包容一切，表現出對生命的不同層次的理解。
sentences.en: The artist's work reflects his observations of the world, completely every myriad form, able to embrace all, expressing an understanding of the various layers of life.

sentences.zh: 這位哲學家主張我們應該接受人生的森羅萬象，包容一切，不歧視任何也不排斥任何。
sentences.en: This philosopher advocates that we should accept every myriad form of life, able to embrace all, neither discriminating against nor rejecting any.

phrase.en: Many Monastics, Limited Congee; Not enough to go around.

sentences.zh: 每次大法會期間，寺廟的食物供應常常是僧多粥少的狀況。
sentences.en: During major dharma gatherings, the temple often faces a situation of many monastics, limited congee, indicating not enough food to go around.

sentences.zh: 疫情期間，醫療物資僧多粥少，醫護人員不得不優先考慮急需的病人。
sentences.en: During the pandemic, medical supplies were many monastics, limited congee; healthcare workers had to prioritize patients in urgent need.

sentences.zh: 由於經濟蕭條，公司內部資源分配問題顯得僧多粥少。
sentences.en: Due to the economic downturn, resource allocation within the company appears to be many monastics, limited congee.

sentences.zh: 教育資源的配置在某些地區呈現僧多粥少的局面，導致學生面臨嚴重的資源短缺。
sentences.en: In certain areas, the distribution of educational resources shows a situation of many monastics, limited congee, leading to severe shortages for students.

phrase.zh: 沙裏淘金　事倍功半
phrase.en: Panning Sand for Gold; Twice the effort for half the result

sentences.zh: 這個計劃就像是沙裏淘金，事倍功半，我們需要更有效的策略來實現目標。
sentences.en: This plan is like panning sand for gold; it results in twice the effort for half the result. We need a more effective strategy to achieve our goals.

sentences.zh: 他在這個研究項目上所付出的努力猶如沙裏淘金，事倍功半，最後的進展非常緩慢。
sentences.en: His efforts in this research project were like panning sand for gold; it was twice the effort for half the result, and progress was very slow.

sentences.zh: 無論他多麼努力地工作，最終的結果卻是沙裏淘金，事倍功半，令人挫折。
sentences.en: No matter how hard he worked, the end result was like panning sand for gold; twice the effort for half the result, which was frustrating.

sentences.zh: 與其在這個無效的系統上浪費時間，成為沙裏淘金，事倍功半，我們應該尋找更好的方法。
sentences.en: Instead of wasting time on this inefficient system, resulting in panning sand for gold and twice the effort for half the result, we should look for better methods.

sentences.zh: 在生命的旅途中，山不轉水轉峯迴路轉，總能找到新的方向。
sentences.en: In the journey of life, with the turning of twists and turns, one can always find a new direction.

sentences.zh: 即便前路困難重重，記住山不轉水轉峯迴路轉，必能度過難關。
sentences.en: Even when the road ahead is fraught with difficulties, remember that with twists and turns, you will surely overcome obstacles.

sentences.zh: 她在事業中遇到挫折，但是憑藉山不轉水轉峯迴路轉的精神，她最終找到了新的機會。
sentences.en: She faced setbacks in her career, but with the spirit of turning twists and turns, she eventually found new opportunities.

sentences.zh: 他們明白，山不轉水轉峯迴路轉，現存的問題隨著時間將會解決。
sentences.en: They understand that with turning twists and turns, the current issues will be resolved over time.

sentences.zh: 每當我看到山茶花時，它那貴氣的姿態總使我心內難忘。
sentences.en: Whenever I see the camellia, its extravagant bearing is always unforgettable.

sentences.zh: 她的氣質如山茶花般貴氣，令人心內難忘。
sentences.en: Her charm is as extravagant as the camellia, leaving an unforgettable impression.

sentences.zh: 這幅畫作中，山茶花的貴氣襯托出自然的和諧，令人心內難忘。
sentences.en: In this painting, the extravagance of the camellia highlights the harmony of nature, creating an unforgettable impression.

sentences.zh: 山茶花的香氣飄逸，貴氣十足，令人心內難忘。
sentences.en: The aroma of the camellia is rich and extravagant, leaving an unforgettable impression.

phrase.zh: 山重重又水重重，透出重重重見功；重重妙義重重意，不管東西南北風。
phrase.en: Over mountains, across rivers, Time and time again, we endure; Levels of wonder, and layers of meaning, East, West, North, South, just let the winds blow.

sentences.zh: 登山望遠，山重重又水重重，讓人感受到自然的偉大和渺小。
sentences.en: Climbing to the summit, over mountains and across rivers, one realizes the grandeur and humbleness of nature.

sentences.zh: 面臨挑戰，我們需要透出重重重見功的勇氣與毅力。
sentences.en: Facing challenges, we need the courage and perseverance to endure time and time again.

sentences.zh: 經過層層遞進的思考，我們才能觸及重重妙義重重意的深度。
sentences.en: Through progressive contemplation, we can reach the depths of levels of wonder, and layers of meaning.

sentences.zh: 不管東西南北風，心若堅定，便能無畏迎接每一步。
sentences.en: Whether the winds blow east, west, north, or south, with a steadfast heart, we fearlessly embrace each step.

phrase.zh: 山頂上黑狗兄歌聲誘人

sentences.zh: 山頂上黑狗兄歌聲誘人，吸引了眾人的注意。
sentences.en: The Fine Alpine Milkman's beautiful voices on the mountaintop attracted everyone's attention.

sentences.zh: 在那寧靜的夜晚，山頂上黑狗兄歌聲誘人的故事廣為流傳。
sentences.en: On that tranquil night, stories of the Fine Alpine Milkman's beautiful voices on the mountaintop spread far and wide.

sentences.zh: 山頂上黑狗兄歌聲誘人，引來了山谷中的回聲，令人沉醉。
sentences.en: The Fine Alpine Milkman's beautiful voices on the mountaintop led to echoes in the valley, enchanting all who listened.

sentences.zh: 每當清晨，山頂上黑狗兄歌聲誘人，伴隨初升的陽光喚醒整座山坡。
sentences.en: Every dawn, the Fine Alpine Milkman's beautiful voices on the mountaintop, along with the rising sun, awakened the whole hillside.

sentences.zh: 在山間，孩子們唱著山歌小放牛，體驗著農家樂趣。
sentences.en: In the mountains, children sing 'Little Shepherd', experiencing the joys of farming.

sentences.zh: 這首山歌小放牛讓人聯想到農村生活的純樸和田園樂趣。
sentences.en: The song 'Little Shepherd' evokes the simplicity of rural life and the joys of farming.

sentences.zh: 每當唱起山歌小放牛，人們都會想起那些充滿農家樂趣的時光。
sentences.en: Whenever 'Little Shepherd' is sung, people remember the times full of the joys of farming.

sentences.zh: 在那片田野上，山歌小放牛成為了表達農家樂趣的旋律。
sentences.en: 'Little Shepherd' has become the melody expressing the joys of farming in those fields.

phrase.zh: 山光水色 風景如畫
phrase.en: Beautiful Mountains and Rivers; Picturesque landscapes

sentences.zh: 這個地區以山光水色、風景如畫而著稱，是攝影師的天堂。
sentences.en: This area is renowned for its beautiful mountains and rivers; picturesque landscapes, making it a paradise for photographers.

sentences.zh: 她提到那裡的山光水色、風景如畫，讓人感覺如曾經出現在夢境中。
sentences.en: She mentioned that the beautiful mountains and rivers; picturesque landscapes there felt like something out of a dream.

sentences.zh: 坐在山頂，可以俯瞰整片山光水色、風景如畫的美景，讓人心曠神怡。
sentences.en: Sitting at the mountain top, you can overlook the entire beautiful mountains and rivers; picturesque landscapes, which refresh the spirit.

sentences.zh: 畫家試圖在他的畫中捕捉那山光水色、風景如畫的壯麗景色。
sentences.en: The painter tried to capture the beautiful mountains and rivers; picturesque landscapes in all their grandeur in his paintings.

phrase.en: Wisdom Like the Mountain and Ocean

sentences.zh: 他的山海慧心讓他面對困難時總能從容應對，像高山般穩重，像大海般包容。
sentences.en: His wisdom like the mountain and ocean allows him to face difficulties with calmness, as stable as a mountain and as embracing as the ocean.

sentences.zh: 大師以其山海慧心，教化眾生，指引方向，令人敬畏。
sentences.en: With his wisdom like the mountain and ocean, the master educates sentient beings, providing guidance and earning reverence.

sentences.zh: 她的山海慧心使她在複雜的人際關係中游刃有餘，無論環境如何變化，她都能找到和諧之道。
sentences.en: Her wisdom like the mountain and ocean allows her to navigate complex human relationships with ease, finding harmony regardless of changing circumstances.

sentences.zh: 佛經中常提到山海慧心，希望修行者能具備如山般堅定與如海般廣闊的智慧。
sentences.en: Buddhist scriptures often mention wisdom like the mountain and ocean, hoping for practitioners to possess wisdom as steadfast as a mountain and as vast as the ocean.

sentences.zh: 《山居偶成四首（其二）》描寫了詩人遠離塵世喧囂，居於山中的孤寂心情。
sentences.en: "Four Random Works in Reclusion (2)" describes the poet's feeling of solitude residing in the mountains, away from worldly chaos.

sentences.zh: 這首詩《山居偶成四首（其二）》讓人沉思，思考生活中的選擇與歸屬。
sentences.en: This poem, "Four Random Works in Reclusion (2)", invites contemplation on the choices and belonging in life.

sentences.zh: 在《山居偶成四首（其二）》中，詩人表達了對故鄉的深切思念，透過空曠的雲和夕陽。
sentences.en: In "Four Random Works in Reclusion (2)", the poet expresses deep nostalgia for home through the imagery of vast clouds and twilight.

sentences.zh: 吟誦《山居偶成四首（其二）》，令人感受到一種寧靜與遙遠的思緒。
sentences.en: Reciting "Four Random Works in Reclusion (2)" evokes a sense of tranquility and distant contemplation.

phrase.en: Thirteen Poems on Life in the Mountains (6)

sentences.zh: 雪老蒼松古，僧閒水石清；坐來忘百慮，眼見一身輕。
sentences.en: Aging snow, green pines, A free monk, and crystalline creeks; Sit away the world’s worries, Look upon a life utterly free.

sentences.zh: 古時的詩人喜愛描繪自然景色，比如《山居十三首（其六）》中的雪與松。
sentences.en: Ancient poets loved to depict natural scenery, such as the snow and pines in 'Thirteen Poems on Life in the Mountains (6)'.

sentences.zh: 這首詩《山居十三首（其六）》在靜謐的山間描繪了一個修行僧的悠閒生活。
sentences.en: This poem, 'Thirteen Poems on Life in the Mountains (6)', describes the serene life of a meditating monk in the tranquil mountains.

sentences.zh: 《山居十三首（其六）》表達了對悠閒山居生活的嚮往。
sentences.en: 'Thirteen Poems on Life in the Mountains (6)' expresses a yearning for the leisurely life in the mountains.

phrase.en: Thirteen Poems on Life in the Mountains (12)

sentences.zh: 日月如飛鳥，乾坤似轉丸；浮生忙裏度，誰向靜中看。
sentences.en: The sun and moon like flying birds, the universe a rotating orb; a whole life lived in vain, who has ever looked into the quietude.

sentences.zh: 在這首詩中，詩人以『日月如飛鳥』來表達時間流逝快速如飛鳥掠過。
sentences.en: In this poem, the poet uses 'the sun and moon like flying birds' to express the swift passage of time, like birds swooping by.

sentences.zh: 『浮生忙裏度，誰向靜中看』提醒我們在繁忙的生活中，別忘了停下來欣賞內心的寧靜。
sentences.en: 'A whole life lived in vain, who has ever looked into the quietude' reminds us not to forget to stop and appreciate the inner peace amidst the busy life.

sentences.zh: 詩人在『乾坤似轉丸』中比喻宇宙運行如旋轉的圓球，顯示出宇宙無盡且持續的變化。
sentences.en: In 'the universe a rotating orb,' the poet metaphorically compares the operation of the universe to a spinning sphere, indicating the endless and continuous change of the cosmos.

phrase.en: Thirteen Poems on Life in the Mountains (13)

sentences.zh: 長明一盞燈，夜對心更寂。
sentences.en: An undying lamp set alight, The heart of night is made more calm.

sentences.zh: 多少醉眠人，夢中狂未息。
sentences.en: Just ponder those drunken minds, Restless they remain in the dream of night.

sentences.zh: 山中歲月靜好，唯有一燈常伴。
sentences.en: In the mountains, the years pass peacefully, with only a single lamp as a constant companion.

sentences.zh: 夜深人靜時，獨聞心燈長明。
sentences.en: In the stillness of night, one hears the undying lamp of the heart.

phrase.en: Thirteen Poems on Life in the Mountains (11)

sentences.zh: 獨坐長松下，悠然太古心。
sentences.en: Beneath a pine tree I sit, carefree and timeless is mine heart.

sentences.zh: 高山流水意，誰復是知音。
sentences.en: Those flowing hearts of rivers from up high, who will come to know that heart of mine?

sentences.zh: 在巍峨的山岳中，得到了心靈的安寧與寧靜。
sentences.en: Amidst the towering mountains, I have found peace and tranquility of heart.

sentences.zh: 每當置身於山中，那古樸的心境就會自然而然地浮現出來。
sentences.en: Whenever I am in the mountains, that ancient simplicity of mind emerges effortlessly.

phrase.en: Thirteen Poems on Life in the Mountains (5)

sentences.zh: 在這首詩中，詩人以一枕黃粱夢描繪出生命如夢般短暫。
sentences.en: In this poem, the poet uses the image of a dream to depict the fleeting nature of life.

sentences.zh: 千秋汗血功象徵著人們為理想而付出的不懈努力。
sentences.en: Ageless merit by blood and sweat symbolizes the relentless effort people put into achieving their ideals.

sentences.zh: 詩人反思永恆的概念，指出秪知常不朽只是一種幻想。
sentences.en: The poet reflects on the concept of eternity, stating that to say that nothing is forever is merely an illusion.

sentences.zh: 這句誰信轉頭空道出人生的無常，讓人不得不正視現實。
sentences.en: The line 'Who would believe all is but a dream' speaks to the impermanence of life, forcing one to confront reality.

sentences.zh: 這個地方的風景如畫，真是山明水秀，讓人流連忘返。
sentences.en: The scenery of this place is picturesque, truly with beautiful mountains and clear water, making one reluctant to leave.

sentences.zh: 他們遠離城市喧囂，來到一片山明水秀的鄉村追尋內心的寧靜。
sentences.en: They escaped the city hustle and bustle to seek inner peace in a countryside with beautiful mountains and clear water.

sentences.zh: 這幅畫把山明水秀的自然景色描繪得活靈活現。
sentences.en: This painting vividly depicts the natural scenery of beautiful mountains and clear water.

sentences.zh: 禪宗僧侶喜歡選擇山明水秀的地方修行，以達到心靈的祥和。
sentences.en: Zen monks prefer to practice in places with beautiful mountains and clear water to achieve peace of mind.

phrase.en: A Life of Mountain and Water

sentences.zh: 他選擇了一種山水人生，遠離城市的喧囂，過著簡單的田園生活。
sentences.en: He chose a life of mountain and water, away from the bustling city, living a simple pastoral life.

sentences.zh: 在這本書中，作者描繪了一幅山水人生的畫面，充滿了自然的靜謐與和諧。
sentences.en: In this book, the author paints a picture of a life of mountain and water, filled with the tranquility and harmony of nature.

sentences.zh: 他的作品反映出對山水人生的嚮往，希望在自然中找到內心的平靜。
sentences.en: His works reflect a longing for a life of mountain and water, hoping to find inner peace in nature.

sentences.zh: 在這趟旅行中，她切身感受到了山水人生的魅力，決定重新思考自己的生活方式。
sentences.en: During this trip, she personally experienced the charm of a life of mountain and water, deciding to rethink her lifestyle.

sentences.zh: 他的生命如同山水人生，經歷過起伏與蜿蜒，最終達到平靜的彼岸。
sentences.en: His life is like the landscape of life, with its ups and downs and winding paths, ultimately reaching a tranquil shore.

sentences.zh: 禪者認為，山水人生中隱藏著深刻的智慧，教導人們如何與自然和諧共處。
sentences.en: Zen practitioners believe that the landscape of life holds profound wisdom, teaching people how to coexist harmoniously with nature.

sentences.zh: 在他的畫作中，山水人生的概念被呈現得淋漓盡致，讓人感受到生命的每一次脈動。
sentences.en: In his paintings, the concept of the landscape of life is vividly portrayed, allowing one to feel every pulse of life.

sentences.zh: 旅行途中，我驀然領悟到，山水人生不在於目的地，而在於欣賞旅程中的每一刻。
sentences.en: During my travels, I suddenly realized that the landscape of life is not about the destination but about appreciating every moment of the journey.

phrase.zh: 山也空來水也空，隨緣變現體無窮；青山綠水依然在，為人疑忌難相容。
phrase.en: Empty are the mountains, also the water, Everchanging conditions, endless potentials; Still the green mountains and verdant water, Only by doubtful minds are they rejected.

sentences.zh: 山也空來水也空，這提醒我們世間萬物皆屬無常，不應執著於表象。
sentences.en: Empty are the mountains, also the water, reminding us that all things in the world are impermanent and we should not cling to appearances.

sentences.zh: 隨緣變現體無窮，意味著當我們順應因緣時，生命的潛力是無窮無盡的。
sentences.en: Everchanging conditions, endless potentials, signifies that when we adapt to circumstances, the possibilities of life are limitless.

sentences.zh: 青山綠水依然在，表示自然之美恆常，無論世事如何變化。
sentences.en: Still the green mountains and verdant water, symbolize the constant beauty of nature, regardless of the changes in the world.

sentences.zh: 為人疑忌難相容，提醒我們內心的懷疑常常遮蔽真實的理解。
sentences.en: Only by doubtful minds are they rejected, reminding us that our inner doubts often obscure true understanding.

phrase.zh: 善財難捨　吝於布施
phrase.en: Deep Pockets and Short Arms; To give stingily

sentences.zh: 面對那些需要幫助的人，他總是善財難捨，吝於布施。
sentences.en: When faced with those in need, he always has deep pockets and short arms, giving stingily.

sentences.zh: 儘管他擁有豐厚的財富，他對慈善捐款總是善財難捨，吝於布施。
sentences.en: Despite possessing considerable wealth, he is deep pockets and short arms when it comes to charitable donations.

sentences.zh: 她被譴責為善財難捨，因為她在分發必需品時吝於布施。
sentences.en: She was criticized for having deep pockets and short arms because she gave stingily when distributing essentials.

sentences.zh: 公司被批評為善財難捨，因為它不願意增加其在社區服務方面的資金投入，吝於布施。
sentences.en: The company was criticized for having deep pockets and short arms as it was unwilling to increase its funding for community services, giving stingily.

sentences.zh: 他的修行以善慈覺悟為目標，努力在日常生活中展現慈悲与智慧。
sentences.en: His practice aims for pure compassion and enlightenment, striving to exhibit kindness and wisdom in daily life.

sentences.zh: 佛教教導我們通過善慈覺悟來超越自我，幫助他人擺脫苦難。
sentences.en: Buddhism teaches us to transcend the self through pure compassion and enlightenment, helping others to overcome their suffering.

sentences.zh: 修習善慈覺悟能夠讓我們體會到內心的平靜與祥和。
sentences.en: Practicing pure compassion and enlightenment allows us to experience inner peace and harmony.

sentences.zh: 她以善慈覺悟對待每一個眾生，無論種族或背景，均平等相待。
sentences.en: She treats every living being with pure compassion and enlightenment, showing equal regard regardless of race or background.

phrase.zh: 善惡有報　業報昭然
phrase.en: Good and Evil Have Their Retributions; Karmic retributions manifest as such.

sentences.zh: 在佛教的教義中，善惡有報是一個重要的觀念，即一個人所做的善行或惡行最終都會受到相應的回報。
sentences.en: In Buddhist teachings, good and evil have their retributions is an important concept, meaning that one's good or bad deeds will eventually be rewarded accordingly.

sentences.zh: 業報昭然之下，人們應該謹慎行事，因為每一個行為都將帶來相應的後果。
sentences.en: Under the principle that karmic retributions manifest as such, people should act cautiously, as every action will bring corresponding consequences.

sentences.zh: 他始終相信，善惡有報，並因此努力行善，以期得到美好的回報。
sentences.en: He firmly believes that good and evil have their retributions, and thus strives to do good in hopes of receiving positive rewards.

sentences.zh: 業報昭然揭示了一個真理：人應該以正直和慈悲的心對待他人，因為這將塑造他們的未來。
sentences.en: Karmic retributions manifest as such reveals a truth: one should treat others with integrity and compassion, as this will shape their future.

sentences.zh: 通過修持慈悲心，善根增長，自然會影響周遭的人。
sentences.en: By cultivating compassion, one enhances the root of wholesomeness, naturally influencing those around them.

sentences.zh: 在禪修中，我們努力尋求自我提升，以達成善根增長的目標。
sentences.en: In meditation, we strive for self-improvement aiming to enhance the root of wholesomeness.

sentences.zh: 許多人相信，閱讀佛經能幫助他們善根增長，提升心靈境界。
sentences.en: Many believe that reading Buddhist scriptures helps them enhance the root of wholesomeness and elevate their spiritual realm.

sentences.zh: 參加這個慈善活動是增進善根增長的一種方式，因為它培養了人們的利他精神。
sentences.en: Participating in this charity event is a way to enhance the root of wholesomeness, as it nurtures people's altruistic spirit.

sentences.zh: 他通過多年的修行和學習，終於能夠善解佛意，領悟到佛陀教誨中的深意。
sentences.en: Through years of practice and study, he was finally able to understand the Buddha's intentions correctly and comprehend the profound teachings of the Buddha.

sentences.zh: 老師不僅自己能夠善解佛意，還逐步引導學生去體會經典中的智慧。
sentences.en: The teacher not only understands the Buddha's intentions correctly but also gradually guides students to appreciate the wisdom in the scriptures.

sentences.zh: 修行者必須靜心冥想，才能夠善解佛意，並將其應用於日常生活中。
