sentences.en: As I walked into the old library, I was immediately enveloped by the fragrance of books, feeling a profound sense of peace and fulfillment.

sentences.zh: 她喜歡在書店工作，因為每天都能嗅到那令人陶醉的書香氣。
sentences.en: She loves working in the bookstore because she gets to inhale the captivating fragrance of books every day.

sentences.zh: 在他看書的角落，總有一股淡淡的書香氣，讓人心神安穩。
sentences.en: In his reading nook, there was always a faint fragrance of books that calmed the mind.

sentences.zh: 即使是數位時代，他仍然偏愛紙本書，因為只有紙頁才能釋放出那獨特的書香氣。
sentences.en: Even in the digital age, he still prefers physical books because only paper pages release that unique fragrance of books.

phrase.en: A Family Filled With the Fragrance of Books

sentences.zh: 他們家是個書香人家，家中的藏書足以讓任何讀書人驚嘆。
sentences.en: Their home is a family filled with the fragrance of books, with a collection that would astonish any book lover.

sentences.zh: 在書香人家中長大，她從小就培養了深厚的閱讀習慣。
sentences.en: Growing up in a family filled with the fragrance of books, she cultivated a deep reading habit from a young age.

sentences.zh: 書香人家給了他們對學問的熱愛，成為他們一生的遺產。
sentences.en: The family filled with the fragrance of books instilled in them a love for learning that became their lifelong legacy.

sentences.zh: 書香人家的生活氛圍，讓每個成員都對知識有著堅定的追求。
sentences.en: The atmosphere of a family filled with the fragrance of books inspired each member with a steadfast pursuit of knowledge.

phrase.zh: 束裝就道　準備上路
phrase.en: To Pack and Set Off; Ready to go.

sentences.zh: 他在凌晨四點束裝就道，準備上路參加朝聖之旅。
sentences.en: At four in the morning, he was packed and ready to set off for his pilgrimage journey.

sentences.zh: 在離開家之前，她已經束裝就道，準備上路去新的城市生活。
sentences.en: Before leaving home, she had packed and was ready to set off to start her life in a new city.

sentences.zh: 經過數周的計畫和準備，探險隊終於束裝就道，準備上路到南極探險。
sentences.en: After weeks of planning and preparation, the expedition team finally packed and set off for their adventure to Antarctica.

sentences.zh: 老師告訴學生們束裝就道，準備上路去學校組織的野外考察。
sentences.en: The teacher told the students to pack and get ready to set off for the school-organized field trip.

phrase.zh: 水到渠成　因緣具足
phrase.en: When Water Flows, a Channel is Formed; The causes and conditions are present.

sentences.zh: 在工作中，他深信只要努力學習和提升自己，總有一天水到渠成，因緣具足。
sentences.en: At work, he firmly believes that as long as he keeps learning and improving himself, when the water flows, a channel will be formed, and the causes and conditions will be present.

sentences.zh: 她的事業成功是因為她準備充分，當機會來臨時水到渠成，因緣具足。
sentences.en: Her business success came because she prepared thoroughly, so when the opportunity arose, water flowed, and a channel was formed; the causes and conditions were present.

sentences.zh: 許多成功的企業家都明白，創業需要等待時機，當水到渠成，因緣具足時，再行動。
sentences.en: Many successful entrepreneurs understand that starting a business requires waiting for the right moment, and when water flows, a channel forms; the causes and conditions are present, then it's time to act.

sentences.zh: 他的觀點是，一份好的關係需要時間經營，只要互相包容理解，總會水到渠成，因緣具足。
sentences.en: His viewpoint is that a good relationship takes time to cultivate, and as long as there is mutual tolerance and understanding, eventually, water will flow and the channel will form; the causes and conditions will be present.

sentences.zh: 在月明之夜，他吟誦著《水調歌頭東坡再生》，心中思念不已。
sentences.en: On a moonlit night, he recited 'Thinking of You: Dongpo returns', filled with longing in his heart.

sentences.zh: 這首《水調歌頭東坡再生》是為紀念蘇東坡而創作的，充滿對過往的懷念。
sentences.en: The poem 'Thinking of You: Dongpo returns' was composed to commemorate Su Dongpo, brimming with nostalgia.

sentences.zh: 他的音樂會以演奏《水調歌頭東坡再生》為亮點，吸引了許多古典文學愛好者。
sentences.en: His concert highlighted the performance of 'Thinking of You: Dongpo returns', attracting many classical literature enthusiasts.

sentences.zh: 當他開始唱《水調歌頭東坡再生》時，觀眾們都安靜下來，享受那悠揚的旋律。
sentences.en: When he began to sing 'Thinking of You: Dongpo returns', the audience fell silent, absorbing the melodious tune.

phrase.en: Pouring Water Over a Duck's Back; As if nothing happened.

sentences.zh: 儘管遭遇了重重困難，他卻像水澆鴨背，若無其事地繼續前行。
sentences.en: Despite facing numerous challenges, he continued as if nothing happened, like pouring water over a duck's back.

sentences.zh: 她總是那麼樂觀，任何批評都像水澆鴨背，若無其事地被她忽略。
sentences.en: She is always so optimistic that any criticism rolls off her like pouring water over a duck's back, as if nothing happened.

sentences.zh: 對於流言蜚語，他一向是水澆鴨背，若無其事地過好自己的生活。
sentences.en: When it comes to rumors, he lets them pass over him like pouring water over a duck's back and lives his life as if nothing happened.

sentences.zh: 孩子在學校受挫，但他回到家卻像水澆鴨背，若無其事地笑著講起今天的趣事。
sentences.en: The child faced setbacks at school, but once home, he carried on like pouring water over a duck's back, laughing as if nothing happened and sharing stories of the day's happenings.

phrase.en: Moon is Reflected in Clear Water

sentences.zh: 信心如水清月現，內心澄澈時自然而然地顯現智慧。
sentences.en: Faith is like the moon reflected in clear water; when the mind is clear, wisdom naturally appears.

sentences.zh: 他的思想就像水清月現，無所掛礙，閃爍著清晰的洞察力。
sentences.en: His thoughts are like the moon reflected in clear water, unburdened and gleaming with clear insight.

sentences.zh: 在安靜的湖畔，水清月現，美景如詩，讓人心靈寧靜。
sentences.en: By the tranquil lakeside, the moon is reflected in the clear water, a poetic scene that brings peace to the soul.

sentences.zh: 修行如水清月現，唯有持之以恆，方能見真如本性。
sentences.en: Practice is like the moon reflected in clear water, only through perseverance can one see the true nature.

phrase.zh: 水乳交融 和合無間
phrase.en: Water and Milk Melded Together; To get along swimmingly.

sentences.zh: 這對兄弟之間的關係就像水乳交融，和合無間，彼此之間沒有絲毫的隔閡。
sentences.en: The relationship between the brothers was like water and milk melded together; they got along swimmingly, with no trace of discord.

sentences.zh: 經過長時間的磨合後，這個團隊的成員們水乳交融，和合無間，共同創造了一個成功的項目。
sentences.en: After a long period of adjustment, the team members melded like water and milk, getting along swimmingly to create a successful project together.

sentences.zh: 他們在職場上的合作如同水乳交融，和合無間，幾乎從不產生衝突。
sentences.en: Their collaboration at the workplace was like water and milk melded together; they got along swimmingly, almost never experiencing conflict.

sentences.zh: 夫妻倆的關係水乳交融，和合無間，彼此的理解和支持令人稱讚。
sentences.en: The couple's relationship was like water and milk melded together; they got along swimmingly, with mutual understanding and support that was admirable.

phrase.en: Waterlily: growing and blooming in the new year

sentences.zh: 在寒冷的冬季裡，水仙花悄然成長，等待新年的開放。
sentences.en: In the cold of winter, the waterlily quietly grows, waiting to bloom in the new year.

sentences.zh: 水仙花成為新年的象徵，預示著新的開始和希望。
sentences.en: The waterlily becomes a symbol of the new year, signifying new beginnings and hope.

sentences.zh: 每逢新年，水仙花都會如期開放，展示它驚人的美麗。
sentences.en: Every new year, the waterlily blooms as expected, showcasing its astonishing beauty.

sentences.zh: 園藝師精心照料水仙花，確保它在新年之際完美開放。
sentences.en: The gardener carefully tends to the waterlilies to ensure they bloom perfectly in the new year.

phrase.en: A Golden Appearance Like Moon and Water

sentences.zh: 在那寂靜的湖面上，她的倒影如同水月金容般，給人一種神秘而靜謐的美感。
sentences.en: On the tranquil surface of the lake, her reflection appeared like a golden appearance akin to moon and water, evoking a sense of mysterious tranquility.

sentences.zh: 佛教徒常用水月金容來形容佛陀的慈悲與智慧，因為它象徵著無垢的清淨和圓滿。
sentences.en: Buddhists often use 'a golden appearance like moon and water' to describe the compassion and wisdom of the Buddha, as it symbolizes immaculate purity and perfection.

sentences.zh: 在晨曦中，寺廟的金頂如水月金容般，閃爍著神聖而莊嚴的光芒。
sentences.en: In the morning light, the golden roof of the temple shimmered with a sacred, majestic glow, like a golden appearance akin to moon and water.

sentences.zh: 水月金容的美是短暫而轉瞬即逝的，它提醒人們珍惜當下的每一個瞬間。
sentences.en: The beauty of a golden appearance like moon and water is fleeting and ephemeral, reminding people to cherish each moment in the present.

phrase.en: Life is Like the Moon in the Water

sentences.zh: 他經常提醒自己，水月人生，不必過於執著於短暫的得失。
sentences.en: He often reminds himself that life is like the moon in the water, no need to cling too tightly to temporary gains and losses.

sentences.zh: 在經歷了種種變幻之後，她終於悟出水月人生的道理，心境變得更加平和。
sentences.en: After experiencing many changes, she finally understood that life is like the moon in the water, and her state of mind became more serene.

sentences.zh: 水月人生的概念告訴我們要欣賞當下的美好，因為一切都是瞬息即逝的。
sentences.en: The concept that life is like the moon in the water teaches us to appreciate the present moment, as everything is fleeting.

sentences.zh: 他在退休後開創了自己的天地，深知水月人生的真諦，每天都過得十分充實。
sentences.en: After retirement, he created his own paradise, fully understanding that life is like the moon in the water, and each day is lived to the fullest.

phrase.en: A Mind Like the Moon In the Water

sentences.zh: 他在禪修中達到了水月心情，無論周圍如何喧囂，他的心境如同水中之月，寧靜而清澈。
sentences.en: During his meditation, he achieved a mind like the moon in the water; no matter how noisy the surroundings, his mind remained tranquil and clear.

sentences.zh: 老師教導我們在面對逆境時要保持水月心情，才能從容應對一切挑戰。
sentences.en: Our teacher taught us to maintain a mind like the moon in the water when facing adversity, so we can calmly handle any challenge.

sentences.zh: 這幅畫描繪了一種水月心情的境界，令人感受到內心的平和與自然的和諧。
sentences.en: This painting depicts a state of a mind like the moon in the water, evoking a sense of inner peace and natural harmony.

sentences.zh: 修習禪定多年後，他終於能夠無時無刻保持水月心情，面對人生起伏也能淡然處之。
sentences.en: After years of practicing meditation, he was finally able to constantly maintain a mind like the moon in the water, approaching life's ups and downs with serenity.

phrase.zh: 水漲船高　行情提升
phrase.en: The Tide Rises, The Boat Floats; Heightening values

sentences.zh: 隨著市場需求的增加，水漲船高，行情提升，公司的股票價格也不斷上升。
sentences.en: As market demand increases, the tide rises, the boat floats; heightening values, and the company's stock price continues to climb.

sentences.zh: 在經濟繁榮的時期，各行業的企業都會感受到水漲船高，行情提升的好處。
sentences.en: During times of economic prosperity, businesses across all industries experience the benefits of the tide rising and the boat floating; heightening values.

sentences.zh: 隨著該地區旅遊業的興盛，水漲船高，行情提升，當地酒店的入住率也大幅增加。
sentences.en: With the burgeoning tourism in the region, the tide rises, the boat floats; heightening values, significantly boosting local hotel occupancy rates.

sentences.zh: 他的房地產投資因為近來水漲船高，行情提升而獲得了不錯的回報。
sentences.en: His real estate investments have yielded substantial returns as the tide rises, the boat floats; heightening values recently.

phrase.en: Flower in the Water: sad about the never-returning beautiful scenery

sentences.zh: 隨著時代的推移，故鄉的變遷讓他感到水中花感懷美景不再的惆悵。
sentences.en: As time passes and his hometown changes, he feels the melancholy of a flower in the water, sad about the never-returning beautiful scenery.

sentences.zh: 看著漸漸消逝的大自然景觀，她心中升起了水中花感懷美景不再的無奈。
sentences.en: Witnessing the gradual disappearance of natural landscapes, she felt an inevitable sadness of a flower in the water for the never-returning beautiful scenery.

sentences.zh: 過去的純樸生活如今僅存在於他的記憶中，讓他不禁水中花感懷美景不再。
sentences.en: The simple life of the past now only exists in his memory, causing him to be sad like a flower in the water about the never-returning beautiful scenery.

sentences.zh: 昔日的樂園已成為高樓大廈的海洋，讓人不禁水中花感懷美景不再。
sentences.en: The once paradise has become a sea of skyscrapers, prompting one to feel like a flower in the water, sad about the never-returning beautiful scenery.

phrase.zh: 水中撈月　空費心思
phrase.en: Fishing for the Moon; Futile efforts.

sentences.zh: 他嘗試用不切實際的方法解決問題，結果只是在水中撈月，空費心思。
sentences.en: He tried to solve the problem with impractical methods, but it was like fishing for the moon; a futile effort.

sentences.zh: 這項計劃在沒有充足資源的情況下推進，如同水中撈月，空費心思。
sentences.en: Pushing forward with this plan without adequate resources is like fishing for the moon; a futile endeavor.

sentences.zh: 她表弟花費很多時間去贏得那場比賽，卻是水中撈月，空費心思。
sentences.en: Her cousin spent a lot of time trying to win that game, but it was like fishing for the moon; a futile effort.

sentences.zh: 如果不改變戰略，這種努力就像是在水中撈月，只是空費心思。
sentences.en: Without changing strategies, such efforts are akin to fishing for the moon; it’s simply futile.

phrase.zh: 順水推舟　乘勢而為
phrase.en: Push the Boat with the Current; Strike while the iron is hot.

sentences.zh: 看到市場需求的增長，我們決定順水推舟，乘勢而為，果斷地推出新產品。
sentences.en: Seeing the growth in market demand, we decided to push the boat with the current and strike while the iron is hot by launching a new product.

sentences.zh: 面對競爭對手的退步，我們應該順勢而起，乘勢而為，把握商機。
sentences.en: Faced with our competitors' decline, we should rise with the momentum and strike while the iron is hot to seize the business opportunity.

sentences.zh: 當大家都贊成這個計劃時，我們就順水推舟，乘勢而為，使決策迅速通過。
sentences.en: When everyone agreed with the plan, we pushed the boat with the current to strike while the iron is hot, allowing the decision to pass swiftly.

sentences.zh: 他很擅長把握機會，順水推舟，乘勢而為，不斷獲得成功。
sentences.en: He is very adept at seizing opportunities and pushing the boat with the current, striking while the iron is hot, and continuously achieving success.

sentences.zh: 在佛教中，理解四大皆空是認識一切事物無常本質的重要一環。
sentences.en: In Buddhism, understanding that the Four Elements are empty is crucial to realizing the impermanent nature of all things.

sentences.zh: 他透過冥想逐漸體驗到四大皆空的真諦，感受到自我存在的空寂。
sentences.en: Through meditation, he gradually experienced the true essence of the Four Elements being empty, feeling the void of self-existence.

sentences.zh: 這位僧人教導弟子們四大皆空的理念，幫助他們解脫執著和煩惱。
sentences.en: The monk taught his disciples the concept that the Four Elements are empty, helping them to free themselves from attachments and troubles.

sentences.zh: 在面對生死無常時，四大皆空的智慧讓她活得更加自在和淡定。
sentences.en: When confronting the impermanence of life and death, the wisdom that the Four Elements are empty allowed her to live more freely and calmly.

phrase.en: The Four Elements Are Empty; Manifestations of all existence.

sentences.zh: 佛教教義指出四大皆空，提醒我們一切物質都是暫時的。
sentences.en: Buddhist teachings state that the four elements are empty, reminding us that all material things are temporary.

sentences.zh: 在人生中領悟四大皆空，可以讓我們放下執著，活得更加自在。
sentences.en: Realizing that the four elements are empty in life can help us release attachments and live more freely.

sentences.zh: 菩薩以其智慧示現諸有，幫助眾生領悟宇宙真理。
sentences.en: Bodhisattvas, with their wisdom, manifest all existence to help sentient beings understand the truths of the universe.

sentences.zh: 透過觀照四大皆空與示現諸有，我們可以達到精神的升華。
sentences.en: Through contemplating the emptiness of the four elements and manifestations of all existence, we can achieve spiritual elevation.

phrase.zh: 四大天王 護寺安僧
phrase.en: The Four Heavenly Kings; Protectors of the temple and Sangha.

sentences.zh: 四大天王常被供奉在寺廟的門口，象徵護寺安僧，保護廟宇免受邪惡侵害。
sentences.en: The Four Heavenly Kings are often enshrined at the temple entrance, symbolizing their role as protectors of the temple and the Sangha, safeguarding the sanctuary from evil forces.

sentences.zh: 在佛教藝術中，四大天王被描繪成豪勇的戰士，代表掌管四方、並具備護持佛法的職責。
sentences.en: In Buddhist art, the Four Heavenly Kings are depicted as mighty warriors, representing the guardianship of the four cardinal directions and the duty to uphold the Dharma.

sentences.zh: 每年佛誕節，信徒會在四大天王像前上香祈願，祈求護寺安僧，福佑平安。
sentences.en: During the annual Buddha's birthday celebrations, devotees offer incense and prayers before the statues of the Four Heavenly Kings, seeking their protection for the temple and Sangha, and blessings of peace.

sentences.zh: 據說，四大天王會夜巡人間，探查邪魔動向，以確保寺廟和僧團的安全。
sentences.en: It is said that the Four Heavenly Kings patrol the earthly realm at night, monitoring the movements of demons to ensure the safety of temples and the Sangha.

phrase.zh: 四大由來造化功，有聲全貴裏頭空；莫嫌不語凡夫說，只為宮商調不同。
phrase.en: Skilfully crafted from the Four Great Elements, Emitting sounds due to the emptiness within. Do not fault them for not conversing with the masses, Simply because royalty and merchants sing different tunes.

sentences.zh: 這場音樂會展現了『四大由來造化功』的魅力，彷彿能感受到樂器間的對話，儘管它們看似無聲。
sentences.en: The concert showcased the charm of 'Skilfully crafted from the Four Great Elements,' as if one could feel the conversation between the instruments despite their seemingly silent nature.

sentences.zh: 正如詩句所言，『有聲全貴裏頭空』，聲音在空間中迴蕩，有時沉默也是一種有力的表達方式。
sentences.en: As the verse states, 'Emitting sounds due to the emptiness within,' sound resonates in space, and sometimes silence is also a powerful form of expression.

sentences.zh: 藝術家常常面對『莫嫌不語凡夫說』的誤解，人們未必能即時理解他們寧靜中的深邃意義。
sentences.en: Artists often encounter the misunderstanding of 'Do not fault them for not conversing with the masses,' as people may not immediately grasp the profound meanings hidden in their silence.

sentences.zh: 『只為宮商調不同』，就好像不同的文化在全球各地都有其獨特的音樂風格。
sentences.en: 'Simply because royalty and merchants sing different tunes,' much like how different cultures around the world have their unique musical styles.

sentences.zh: 佛教徒常常反思「四恩總報」，以此為指引來報答父母、國家與社會的恩德。
sentences.en: Buddhists often reflect on the 'Four Ways of Repaying Kindness' as a guide to repay the kindness of their parents, the country, and society at large.

sentences.zh: 通過行善和幫助他人，我們實踐『四恩總報』的教義。
sentences.en: By doing good deeds and helping others, we practice the teachings of 'Four Ways of Repaying Kindness'.

sentences.zh: 在僧團中，學習如何實現『四恩總報』是每個修行者的重要課程。
sentences.en: In the monastic community, learning how to fulfill the 'Four Ways of Repaying Kindness' is a crucial part of every practitioner's course.

sentences.zh: 『四恩總報』提醒我們要珍惜和感恩生命中每一份恩情。
sentences.en: The 'Four Ways of Repaying Kindness' remind us to cherish and be grateful for every kindness in our lives.

sentences.zh: 在修行過程中，四給的實踐可以幫助我們培養無私的愛和慈悲。
sentences.en: In the practice of cultivation, the Four Givings can help us develop selfless love and compassion.

sentences.zh: 佛教教導我們透過四給來消除自私，增進與眾生的連結。
sentences.en: Buddhism teaches us to eliminate selfishness and enhance our connection with all beings through the Four Givings.

sentences.zh: 四給包括施予財物、知識、勇氣和無所畏懼，這些皆是成就大乘精神的要素。
sentences.en: The Four Givings include giving wealth, knowledge, courage, and fearlessness, which are essential elements of achieving the Mahayana spirit.

sentences.zh: 修行者應該每天實踐四給，這不僅提升自己的德行，還能影響身邊的人。
sentences.en: Practitioners should engage in the Four Givings daily, as it not only enhances one's own virtues but also influences those around them.

phrase.zh: 四光喻智　光智不二
phrase.en: Four Similes of Lights For Wisdom; Light and wisdom are one.

sentences.zh: 佛教經典中，四光喻智表示智慧如同四種光芒，照亮凡間。
sentences.en: In Buddhist scriptures, the Four Similes of Lights for Wisdom suggest that wisdom shines like four kinds of light, illuminating the mundane world.

sentences.zh: 智者以四光喻智為指導，追求真理。
sentences.en: The wise follow the Four Similes of Lights for Wisdom as a guide to seeking truth.

sentences.zh: 光智不二，智慧的光亮可以引導我們走出無明。
sentences.en: Light and wisdom are one; the brightness of wisdom can guide us out of ignorance.

sentences.zh: 修行者應該理解光智不二的道理，以達到更高的覺悟。
sentences.en: Practitioners should comprehend the principle that light and wisdom are one to attain higher enlightenment.

sentences.zh: 佛教倡導四海一家，提倡不同國家和民族之間的和諧共處。
sentences.en: Buddhism promotes the idea that we are family, advocating for harmonious coexistence between different nations and ethnicities.

sentences.zh: 在四海一家的精神下，志願者們在國際災難救援中彼此支持。
sentences.en: Under the spirit of 'we are family,' volunteers support each other during international disaster relief efforts.

sentences.zh: 老師告訴學生，無論來自哪裡，大家都是四海一家，要相互扶持。
sentences.en: The teacher told the students that regardless of where they come from, we are family and should support one another.

sentences.zh: 四海一家的理念在全球化的世界中尤為重要，提醒我們要超越國界的限制。
sentences.en: The concept of 'we are family' is especially important in a globalized world, reminding us to transcend national boundaries.

phrase.en: Song of Four Seasons: joy of the four seasons

sentences.zh: 寺廟裡的僧人常常吟唱《四季紅歡樂春夏秋冬》，頌讚自然的循環和生命的和諧。
sentences.en: The monks in the temple often chant the 'Song of Four Seasons: joy of the four seasons', praising the cycle of nature and the harmony of life.

sentences.zh: 這首歌名為《四季紅歡樂春夏秋冬》，象徵著季節輪換帶來的無窮無盡的快樂。
sentences.en: This song, titled 'Song of Four Seasons: joy of the four seasons', symbolizes the endless joy brought by the changing of the seasons.

sentences.zh: 訪客們沉醉於《四季紅歡樂春夏秋冬》的旋律中，感受到生命的豐富多彩。
sentences.en: Visitors are captivated by the melody of the 'Song of Four Seasons: joy of the four seasons', feeling the richness and diversity of life.

sentences.zh: 在春天的慶典上，大家一起唱起了《四季紅歡樂春夏秋冬》，慶祝新一年的到來。
sentences.en: During the spring festival, everyone sang the 'Song of Four Seasons: joy of the four seasons', celebrating the arrival of a new year.

sentences.zh: 在那片樂土上，氣候宜人，真可謂是四季皆春。
sentences.en: In that paradise, the climate is so pleasant that it truly feels like four seasons of spring.

sentences.zh: 佛國淨土如詩如畫，四季皆春，充滿著祥和的氣息。
sentences.en: The Pure Land of Buddha is picturesque, with four seasons of spring, filled with an atmosphere of peace.

sentences.zh: 在他的內心世界裡，無論外界如何變遷，他總能保持四季皆春的安寧。
sentences.en: In his inner world, regardless of external changes, he always maintains the tranquility of four seasons of spring.

sentences.zh: 這個花園設計得如此巧妙，即使在寒冬，仍然給人一種四季皆春的感覺。
sentences.en: The garden is so ingeniously designed that even in winter, it gives a sense of four seasons of spring.

phrase.en: Peace Be With All Four Seasons

sentences.zh: 我們在新年的祝詞中寫下了四季平安，希望親友此刻至明年都過得平安喜樂。
sentences.en: We wrote 'Peace Be With All Four Seasons' in our New Year's wishes, hoping that family and friends will be safe and joyful from now until next year.

sentences.zh: 祈求四季平安，是我每年初夏前往寺廟重要的祈願項目之一。
sentences.en: Praying for 'Peace Be With All Four Seasons' is one of my essential rituals when visiting the temple at the beginning of summer each year.

sentences.zh: 在這部詩集中，四季平安被詩人用來表達對歲月如梭中恒常和平的嚮往。
sentences.en: In this poetry collection, 'Peace Be With All Four Seasons' is used by the poet to express a longing for perpetual peace amidst the passage of time.

sentences.zh: 四季平安的祝福在長輩的生日宴會上，總是被祝頌為無限的期盼和祝福。
sentences.en: The blessing of 'Peace Be With All Four Seasons' is always celebrated as a profound hope and blessing at elders' birthday banquets.

sentences.zh: 這座寺廟如同仙境，常年四季生春，總是充滿活力與綠意。
sentences.en: The temple is like a paradise, with four seasons of spring, always full of vitality and greenery.

sentences.zh: 在他的心中住著一個四季生春的花園，帶給他無窮的靈感和創造力。
sentences.en: In his heart dwells a garden of four seasons of spring, providing him with endless inspiration and creativity.

sentences.zh: 經書中描述的淨土世界就像是一個四季生春的地方，充滿著永恆的和平與美好。
sentences.en: The pure land described in the scriptures is like a place of four seasons of spring, filled with eternal peace and beauty.

sentences.zh: 這幅畫作中，藝術家形象地展現了四季生春的景象，彷彿讓觀者親歷其中。
sentences.en: In this painting, the artist vividly depicts the scene of four seasons of spring, as if allowing the viewer to experience it firsthand.

phrase.zh: 四面八方　虛空宇宙
phrase.en: In All Directions; The vast emptiness of the universe.

sentences.zh: 風吹雨打，傳來四面八方的聲音彷彿響徹於虛空宇宙。
sentences.en: The wind and rain carried sounds in all directions, reverberating through the vast emptiness of the universe.

sentences.zh: 四面八方的信徒聚集於寺廟，心中祈禱著虛空宇宙的和平。
sentences.en: Devotees from all directions gathered at the temple, praying for peace in the vast emptiness of the universe.

sentences.zh: 他常常仰望星空，感受到虛空宇宙的浩瀚和四面八方的神秘。
sentences.en: He often gazed at the starry sky, feeling the vastness of the universe and the mystery in all directions.

sentences.zh: 在冥想中，她進入了一種境界，彷彿四面八方都是虛空宇宙的包圍。
sentences.en: In meditation, she entered a state as if surrounded by the vast emptiness of the universe in all directions.

phrase.zh: 四聖六凡　聖凡一會
phrase.en: Four Sages and Six Ordinary Beings; A gathering of the ordinary and sagely.

sentences.zh: 在佛教教義中，四聖六凡的概念代表了不同的修行階段和眾生的層次。
sentences.en: In Buddhist doctrines, the concept of 'Four Sages and Six Ordinary Beings' represents different stages of cultivation and levels of sentient beings.

sentences.zh: 這場盛大的法會象徵著聖凡一會，是信眾與高僧交流智慧的寶貴機會。
sentences.en: This grand Dharma assembly symbolizes a gathering of the ordinary and sagely, offering a valuable opportunity for followers to exchange wisdom with the learned monks.

sentences.zh: 經過長期的修行，他希望能從凡夫轉為四聖中的一員。
sentences.en: Through long-term practice, he hopes to transform from an ordinary being into one of the Four Sages.

sentences.zh: 在那一刻，聖凡一會的境界讓他感受到佛法的無窮奧妙。
sentences.en: In that moment, the realization of a gathering of the ordinary and sagely allowed him to feel the infinite profundity of the Dharma.

phrase.en: Instructions on Lunar April 8th by Master Cheng Zhao

sentences.zh: 四月八日示澄照大師的詩歌探討了內心的淨化與塵垢的來源。
sentences.en: The poem 'Instructions on Lunar April 8th by Master Cheng Zhao' explores the purification of the heart and the origin of defilements.

sentences.zh: 四月八日示澄照大師在這一天提醒信徒反思清淨心的重要性。
sentences.en: On this day, 'Instructions on Lunar April 8th by Master Cheng Zhao' reminds followers to reflect on the importance of a pure heart.

sentences.zh: 今朝浴佛事如何？這是澄照大師在四月八日的教導中提出的深刻問題。
sentences.en: 'How went the bathing of the Buddha this morning?' is a profound question posed in the teachings of Master Cheng Zhao on Lunar April 8th.

sentences.zh: 四月八日示澄照大師鼓勵人們去探尋生活中的覺悟與自我淨化之旅。
sentences.en: The 'Instructions on Lunar April 8th by Master Cheng Zhao' encourages people to seek enlightenment and embark on a journey of self-purification in life.

sentences.zh: 在面對困難時，他始終保持思敏力行的態度，冷靜分析問題，並果斷採取行動。
sentences.en: When faced with challenges, he always maintained an attitude of thinking wisely and acting steadfastly, calmly analyzing the issues and taking decisive actions.

sentences.zh: 我們應該在生活中實踐思敏力行的理念，以便做出明智的決策和有效的執行。
sentences.en: We should practice the concept of thinking wisely and acting steadfastly in our lives to make wise decisions and execute them effectively.

sentences.zh: 領導者以思敏力行的方式引導團隊，確保每個成員都能發揮所長。
sentences.en: The leader guided the team by thinking wisely and acting steadfastly, ensuring that every member could play to their strengths.

sentences.zh: 學生在準備考試時應該思敏力行，制定計劃並嚴格執行，以達到最佳的學習效果。
sentences.en: Students should think wisely and act steadfastly when preparing for exams, by making plans and executing them strictly to achieve optimal learning outcomes.

sentences.zh: 經過思前想後，他決定接受這份工作，儘管壓力很大。
sentences.en: After careful deliberation, he decided to accept the job despite the high pressure.

sentences.zh: 在作出任何重大決策之前，我們都應該經過思前想後以免遺憾。
sentences.en: Before making any major decision, we should engage in careful deliberation to avoid regrets.

sentences.zh: 她思前想後地分析了所有可能的後果，才做出自己的選擇。
sentences.en: She analyzed all possible outcomes with careful deliberation before making her choice.

sentences.zh: 這是一筆龐大的投資, 需要經過長時間的思前想後才能有穆必的行動方案。
sentences.en: This is a substantial investment, requiring a long period of careful deliberation to come up with a concrete action plan.

phrase.zh: 思前想後　再三考慮

sentences.zh: 經過思前想後，再三考慮，他終於做出了最適合的決定。
sentences.en: After careful deliberation and repeated reconsideration, he finally made the most suitable decision.

sentences.zh: 她思前想後，再三考慮這份工作的優缺點，最終選擇接受。
sentences.en: She engaged in careful deliberation, repeatedly reconsidering the pros and cons of the job, and eventually decided to accept it.

sentences.zh: 思前想後，再三考慮後，我們決定延期這個計劃以確保最佳成果。
sentences.en: After careful deliberation and repeated reconsideration, we decided to postpone the project to ensure the best outcomes.

sentences.zh: 老師告訴我們，在做出重大決定前，要先思前想後，再三考慮，以免後悔。
sentences.en: The teacher advised us to engage in careful deliberation and repeated reconsideration before making major decisions to avoid regrets.

sentences.zh: 佛教強調透過冥想和思維來達到內心的平靜。
sentences.en: Buddhism emphasizes achieving inner peace through meditation and thinking.

sentences.zh: 他的思維方式總是能夠帶來新的觀點和創意。
sentences.en: His way of thinking always brings new perspectives and ideas.

sentences.zh: 在探討這個問題時，批判性思維是必不可少的。
sentences.en: Critical thinking is essential when exploring this issue.

sentences.zh: 思維的力量可以改變一個人的命運。
sentences.en: The power of thinking can change a person's destiny.

phrase.en: Thinking Back: ballads of Hengchun and Fenggang

sentences.zh: 每當我聽到這首思想起民謠恆春楓港，就會回想起童年在鄉村過的那些快樂時光。
sentences.en: Whenever I hear 'Thinking Back: ballads of Hengchun and Fenggang', I reminisce about the joyful times of my childhood spent in the countryside.

sentences.zh: 這場音樂會呈現了一系列的傳統音樂，其中包括了思想起民謠恆春楓港，深受觀眾的喜愛。
sentences.en: The concert featured a series of traditional music, including 'Thinking Back: ballads of Hengchun and Fenggang', which was well-received by the audience.

sentences.zh: 老師在課堂上播放了思想起民謠恆春楓港，讓學生們更了解地方文化的韻味。
sentences.en: The teacher played 'Thinking Back: ballads of Hengchun and Fenggang' in class to help the students better understand the local culture's nuances.

sentences.zh: 這部紀錄片中，思想起民謠恆春楓港以其動人的旋律串連起了許多感人的故事。
sentences.en: In the documentary, 'Thinking Back: ballads of Hengchun and Fenggang' tied together many touching stories with its moving melodies.

phrase.zh: 死去活來　悲痛欲絕

sentences.zh: 他在父親去世後，一整個月都處於死去活來、悲痛欲絕的狀態。
sentences.en: After his father's passing, he was in a state of agonizing distress and inconsolable sorrow for an entire month.

sentences.zh: 這位母親因為失去孩子而悲痛欲絕，日夜以淚洗面。
sentences.en: The mother was in agonizing distress and inconsolable sorrow due to the loss of her child, washing her face with tears day and night.

sentences.zh: 她對於摯愛的寵物的突然離世感到死去活來，悲痛欲絕，無法自拔。
sentences.en: She felt an agonizing distress and inconsolable sorrow over the sudden loss of her beloved pet, unable to pull herself together.

sentences.zh: 遭遇這樣的人生巨變，他只能沉浸在死去活來、悲痛欲絕的深淵之中。
sentences.en: Facing such a drastic change in his life, he could only immerse himself in the abyss of agonizing distress and inconsolable sorrow.

sentences.zh: 他希望能過上松柏人生，始終保持青春與活力，面對生活的挑戰。
sentences.en: He hopes to lead a life like an evergreen, always retaining youth and vitality in facing life's challenges.

sentences.zh: 這位老人用他的松柏人生激勵了許多後輩，展現了堅定不屈的精神。
sentences.en: This elder inspired many younger generations with his life like an evergreen, showing a spirit of perseverance.

sentences.zh: 在追求松柏人生的過程中，我學會了如何應對人生的起伏與困難。
sentences.en: In the pursuit of a life like an evergreen, I learned how to deal with life's ups and downs and difficulties.

sentences.zh: 一位真正有智慧的人會選擇過松柏人生，適應季節變化，保持恆久不變的根基。
sentences.en: A truly wise person chooses to live a life like an evergreen, adapting to seasonal changes while maintaining an enduring foundation.

phrase.zh: 松間枕石眠，夢對白雲坐；擬問雲起居，松風忽吹破。
phrase.en: Sleeping beneath pine trees, pillowing on rocks, Dreaming on sitting face-to-face with the clouds; As I began asking about the clouds’ life, Suddenly I am awakened by the piney winds.

sentences.zh: 在修行旅途中，他常常松間枕石眠，沉浸在大自然的懷抱中。
sentences.en: During his spiritual journey, he often slept beneath pine trees, pillowing on rocks, immersed in the embrace of nature.

sentences.zh: 一日，他夢中與白雲對坐，內心充滿了平和與喜悅。
sentences.en: One day, in his dream, he sat face-to-face with the clouds, his heart filled with peace and joy.

sentences.zh: 正當他準備開口詢問白雲的生活時，松風忽然吹來，將他的夢打斷。
sentences.en: Just as he was about to ask about the clouds' life, a sudden piney wind blew in, breaking his dream.

sentences.zh: 這段經歷使他明白了自然無常的重要性，常在心中謙卑地記住。
sentences.en: This experience taught him the importance of nature's impermanence, which he humbly remembered in his heart.

phrase.en: Whispering Pine: deep and profound love

sentences.zh: 在寂靜的夜晚，松林的低語深情萬里，如同戀人間耳語般溫柔而深刻。
sentences.en: In the silent night, the whispering pines expressed a deep and profound love, gentle and profound like whispers between lovers.

sentences.zh: 松林的低語深情萬里，讓我想起故鄉的山谷，充滿思念與懷舊。
sentences.en: The whispering of the pines, with a deep and profound love, reminds me of my hometown valleys, filled with nostalgia and longing.

sentences.zh: 在這片古老的森林中，松林的低語深情萬里，訴說著大自然的無言之愛。
sentences.en: In this ancient forest, the whispering pine with its deep and profound love narrates the silent affection of nature.

sentences.zh: 每當微風拂過，松林的低語深情萬里，讓人感受到大地間的靜謐與和諧。
sentences.en: Whenever the breeze gently blows, the whispering pine with deep and profound love makes one feel the serenity and harmony of the earth.

phrase.en: Comprehensive Collection of the Chan School's Verses on Ancient Precedents that are a String of Jewels

sentences.zh: 《頌古聯珠通集》是禪宗重要的經典，其中收錄了許多古德的頌讚詩。
sentences.en: The 'Comprehensive Collection of the Chan School's Verses on Ancient Precedents that are a String of Jewels' is an important classic of the Chan school, containing many verses praising ancient sages.

sentences.zh: 透過研讀《頌古聯珠通集》，修行者可以更加深入理解禪宗的精髓。
sentences.en: By studying the 'Comprehensive Collection of the Chan School's Verses on Ancient Precedents that are a String of Jewels', practitioners can gain a deeper understanding of the essence of Chan Buddhism.

sentences.zh: 這本頌古聯珠通集彙編了許多禪宗大師的智慧珠玉，讓人受益匪淺。
sentences.en: This Comprehensive Collection of the Chan School's Verses on Ancient Precedents strings together the jewel-like wisdom of many Chan masters, providing great benefit to those who read it.

sentences.zh: 在學習禪宗時，《頌古聯珠通集》經常被推薦為指導心靈修行的重要參考書。
sentences.en: When studying Chan Buddhism, the 'Comprehensive Collection of the Chan School's Verses on Ancient Precedents that are a String of Jewels' is often recommended as an essential guide for spiritual practice.

phrase.en: Farewell My Love One: parting must eventually be

sentences.zh: 雖然送君千里終須一別，但我相信我們的友誼會一直延續下去。
sentences.en: Although farewell my loved one: parting must eventually be, I believe our friendship will continue to endure.

sentences.zh: 送君千里終須一別這個道理提醒我們珍惜每一次的相聚。
sentences.en: Farewell my loved one: parting must eventually be, this truth reminds us to cherish every moment we spend together.

sentences.zh: 每次送君千里終須一別，我都覺得自己更加堅強，因為我知道我們還會再見。
sentences.en: Every time we farewell my loved one: parting must eventually be, I feel stronger, because I know we will meet again.

sentences.zh: 送君千里終須一別讓我明白，分開是人生的一部分，也是一種成長。
sentences.en: Farewell my loved one: parting must eventually be taught me that separation is a part of life and a form of growth.

phrase.zh: 送您一把泥土聊解鄉愁
phrase.en: Here Is a Handful of Home Soil: a taste of home

sentences.zh: 他朋友從故鄉寄來了一包泥土，送您一把泥土聊解鄉愁，讓他在異鄉也能感受到家的氣息。
sentences.en: His friend sent him a package of soil from his hometown, saying, 'Here is a handful of home soil: a taste of home', allowing him to feel the presence of home even in a foreign land.

sentences.zh: 每次思念故鄉，她都會取出那袋泥土，輕輕嗅著，送您一把泥土聊解鄉愁，這樣的舉動讓她平靜。
sentences.en: Every time she missed her hometown, she would take out that bag of soil and gently inhale it, as a gesture of 'Here is a handful of home soil: a taste of home', which gave her peace.

sentences.zh: 當他返回故鄉時，從行李中拿出來那把土，笑著對母親說，送您一把泥土聊解鄉愁，以表達他帶著鄉愁回家。
sentences.en: When he returned to his hometown, he took out that handful of soil from his luggage and said to his mother with a smile, 'Here is a handful of home soil: a taste of home', expressing that he brought his longing for home back with him.

sentences.zh: 爺爺坐在椅子上，摸著他的手心裏的泥土，笑著對孫子說，送您一把泥土聊解鄉愁，讓這片土地永遠陪伴著你。
sentences.en: Grandfather sat in his chair, touching the soil in his palm, and said to his grandson with a smile, 'Here is a handful of home soil: a taste of home', ensuring that this land will always accompany him.

phrase.zh:
送龐婆
剎剎西來意，塵塵古佛心；
眉毛為道侶，鼻孔做知音。
phrase.en:
For Pang
The intention from the West reaches untold lands.
In particles of dust is the mind of old Buddha found;
Eyebrows are one’s companions on the Path,
The nose, my like-minded friend.

sentences.zh: 送龐婆，剎剎西來意，表現了對佛教智慧的深刻探求與向往。
sentences.en: For Pang, the intention from the West represents a profound quest and longing for Buddhist wisdom.

sentences.zh: 在塵塵古佛心中，隨處可得佛性的啟悟。
sentences.en: In particles of dust is the mind of old Buddha found, where one can attain insights into the Buddha nature everywhere.

sentences.zh: 眉毛為道侶，意指修行路上的陪伴與支持。
sentences.en: Eyebrows are one’s companions on the Path, symbolizing the companionship and support on the journey of practice.

sentences.zh: 鼻孔做知音，比喻對佛理深具理解的知己。
sentences.en: The nose, my like-minded friend, is a metaphor for someone who deeply understands the principles of Buddhism.

phrase.zh: 素面相呈　示人本相
phrase.en: Without Makeup; Revealing one's original form

sentences.zh: 她在親密的朋友面前總是素面相呈，示人本相，這讓她感到輕鬆自在。
sentences.en: She always appears without makeup, revealing her original form to her close friends, which makes her feel relaxed and at ease.

sentences.zh: 和尚講解佛法的時候，總是強調要素面相呈，示人本相，這樣才能真正認識自我。
sentences.en: When the monk explains the teachings of Buddhism, he always emphasizes appearing without makeup, revealing one's original form, as this is essential to truly know oneself.

sentences.zh: 這幅肖像畫捕捉到了她素面相呈時的自然美，示人本相的樸實無華。
sentences.en: This portrait captures her natural beauty when she is without makeup, revealing her original form in all its simplicity and authenticity.

sentences.zh: 他選擇素面相呈，示人本相地參加這次會議，想要以誠信打動對方。
sentences.en: He chose to attend the meeting without makeup, revealing his original form, intending to impress the other party with his sincerity.

phrase.zh: 宿世善根　累刼有修
phrase.en: Virtuous Roots Planted in Past Lives; Kalpas of Cultivation

sentences.zh: 他的智慧和慈悲源自宿世善根，累刼有修，自然流露出來。
sentences.en: His wisdom and compassion stem from virtuous roots planted in past lives and kalpas of cultivation, naturally radiating from him.

sentences.zh: 菩薩的耐心和毅力是由於宿世善根　累刼有修，才能達到這樣的境界。
sentences.en: The Bodhisattva's patience and perseverance are due to virtuous roots planted in past lives and kalpas of cultivation, achieving such a state.

sentences.zh: 她在逆境中顯示出的堅毅，是因為她有宿世善根，累刼有修。
sentences.en: The resilience she demonstrates in the face of adversity is because of her virtuous roots planted in past lives and kalpas of cultivation.

sentences.zh: 他的道德價值觀深植於宿世善根，累刼有修，使他作出明智的選擇。
sentences.en: His moral values are deeply rooted in virtuous roots planted in past lives and kalpas of cultivation, guiding him to make wise decisions.

phrase.zh: 宿世因緣　前世今生
phrase.en: Bound by Causes and Conditions; Affinity across past and present lifetimes

sentences.zh: 他們的相遇似乎是宿世因緣的結果，彼此之間有著難以言喻的熟悉感。
sentences.en: Their meeting seemed to be the result of being bound by causes and conditions, with an indescribable familiarity between them.

sentences.zh: 在前世今生的觀點下，我們當前的生活和選擇是由以往的緣分所塑造。
sentences.en: From the perspective of affinity across past and present lifetimes, our current lives and choices are shaped by past connections.

sentences.zh: 佛教認為，我們應該感謝宿世因緣，讓我們在今生能夠修行與成長。
sentences.en: Buddhism suggests that we should be grateful for being bound by causes and conditions, which allow us to practice and grow in this lifetime.

sentences.zh: 前世今生的因果關係教導我們珍惜現有的每一個機會與緣分。
sentences.en: The cause-and-effect relationship across past and present lifetimes teaches us to cherish every opportunity and connection we have.

phrase.zh: 宿世有緣　緣份極深
phrase.en: Affinity Across Past Lives; Strong affinity

sentences.zh: 他們彼此宿世有緣，緣份極深，所以今生再次相遇，感情非常深厚。
sentences.en: They have an affinity across past lives with a strong bond, so when they met again in this life, their connection was notably profound.

sentences.zh: 這種緣份極深的感情讓我相信，即使在過去無數世間，我們也是一再相伴的知己。
sentences.en: This strong affinity makes me believe that even across countless past lives, we have been kindred spirits time and again.

sentences.zh: 法師說我和這個地方宿世有緣，所以在這裡修行特別有感應。
sentences.en: The monk said I have an affinity across past lives with this place, which is why my spiritual practice here is particularly resonant.

sentences.zh: 他們之間的緣份極深，即使分隔千里，心中仍能感受到彼此的存在。
sentences.en: Their strong affinity is such that, even when separated by thousands of miles, they can still feel each other's presence in their hearts.

phrase.en: Su Wu Herding Sheep: loyal and patriotic

sentences.zh: 蘇武牧羊忠勇愛國的故事激勵了許多後人，讓他們明白堅持和忠誠的重要性。
sentences.en: The story of Su Wu herding sheep, loyal and patriotic, has inspired many, teaching them the importance of perseverance and loyalty.

sentences.zh: 在異國他鄉，蘇武牧羊忠勇愛國的精神讓人們又一次感受到什麼是真正的愛國情懷。
sentences.en: In a foreign land, the spirit of Su Wu herding sheep, loyal and patriotic, reminds people of what true patriotism feels like.

sentences.zh: 這幅畫描繪了蘇武牧羊忠勇愛國的場景，突顯出他對國家的深厚感情和堅強的意志力。
sentences.en: This painting depicts the scene of Su Wu herding sheep, loyal and patriotic, highlighting his deep affection for the country and his strong willpower.

sentences.zh: 蘇武牧羊忠勇愛國的傳奇廣為流傳，成為了歷史上不屈不撓精神的象徵。
sentences.en: The legend of Su Wu herding sheep, loyal and patriotic, has been widely told and stands as a symbol of indomitable spirit in history.

sentences.zh: 在蘇州河邊漫步時，那段難忘的回憶總是會浮現。
sentences.en: While strolling by the Suzhou River, those unforgettable memories always resurface.

sentences.zh: 他們的相遇就在蘇州河邊不會遺忘之處，為他們的生活留下了深刻的印記。
sentences.en: Their encounter happened by the Suzhou River: unforgettable, leaving a deep impression on their lives.

sentences.zh: 每次看到蘇州河邊的風景，他總能回想起那些不會遺忘的時光。
sentences.en: Every time he sees the scenery by the Suzhou River, he recalls those unforgettable times.

sentences.zh: 對她來說，蘇州河邊的黃昏有著一種無法遺忘的魔力。
sentences.en: For her, the twilight by the Suzhou River holds an unforgettable charm.

phrase.zh: 隨波逐流　不能自主
phrase.en: Go with the Tide; Unable to decide on one's own.

sentences.zh: 他經常隨波逐流，不能自主，結果生活缺乏方向和目標。
sentences.en: He often goes with the tide, unable to decide on his own, resulting in a life lacking direction and purpose.

sentences.zh: 在人生的重大決定中，隨波逐流　不能自主可能會導致後悔。
sentences.en: In major life decisions, going with the tide and being unable to decide on one's own can lead to regret.

sentences.zh: 許多人在壓力之下會選擇隨波逐流　不能自主，這樣會喪失個人的價值觀。
sentences.en: Under pressure, many choose to go with the tide, unable to decide on their own, risking the loss of personal values.

sentences.zh: 她意識到隨波逐流　不能自主只會帶來短暫的安逸，而非真正的滿足。
sentences.en: She realized that going with the tide and being unable to decide on her own would only bring temporary comfort, not true fulfillment.

phrase.zh: 隨方就圓 順應自如
phrase.en: Be a Square, or a Circle; Adjust with ease

sentences.zh: 修行者應學會隨方就圓，順應自如，以適應生活中的每一個挑戰。
sentences.en: A practitioner should learn to be a square or a circle, adjusting with ease to meet every challenge in life.

sentences.zh: 面對不斷變化的環境，他們總是能夠隨方就圓，順應自如。
sentences.en: In the face of an ever-changing environment, they always manage to be a square or a circle, adjusting with ease.

sentences.zh: 隨方就圓，順應自如是智慧的表現，讓你無論情況如何都能保持平靜。
sentences.en: Being a square or a circle, adjusting with ease is a sign of wisdom, allowing you to remain calm regardless of the situation.

sentences.zh: 在團隊合作中，能夠隨方就圓，順應自如的人總是能提升工作效率。
sentences.en: In team collaboration, those who can be a square or a circle, adjusting with ease, always enhance work efficiency.

phrase.zh: 隨高就低　謙和尊重
phrase.en: Whether High or Low; Be humble and respectful.

sentences.zh: 他在人際交往中總是隨高就低，謙和尊重，令大家都十分敬佩。
sentences.en: He is always humble and respectful, whether dealing with people of high or low status, earning everyone's admiration.

sentences.zh: 在佛教修行中，我們要隨高就低，謙和尊重，以平等心對待一切眾生。
sentences.en: In Buddhist practice, we should be humble and respectful whether high or low, treating all beings with equal heart.

sentences.zh: 領導者應該隨高就低，謙和尊重，才能獲得團隊的信任和支持。
sentences.en: A leader should be humble and respectful, whether high or low, to earn the trust and support of the team.

sentences.zh: 生活中，我們要學會隨高就低，謙和尊重，這樣才能建立良好的人際關係。
sentences.en: In life, we should learn to be humble and respectful, whether high or low, to build good relationships.

phrase.zh: 隨機應變　靈活處理
phrase.en: Play it by Ear; Adapt to changing circumstances

sentences.zh: 在這種不可預測的商業環境中，能夠隨機應變　靈活處理是非常關鍵的。
sentences.en: In this unpredictable business environment, being able to play it by ear and adapt to changing circumstances is crucial.

sentences.zh: 面對突如其來的挑戰，他憑藉著隨機應變的能力成功化解危機。
sentences.en: When faced with sudden challenges, he successfully navigated the crisis by playing it by ear and adapting to the situation.

sentences.zh: 她總是能夠在旅行中隨機應變，靈活處理不期而遇的麻煩，確保旅程順利。
sentences.en: She always manages to play it by ear during her travels, flexibly handling unforeseen troubles to ensure a smooth journey.

sentences.zh: 團隊成員們學會了如何在項目變化中隨機應變，並靈活處理不斷出現的新挑戰。
sentences.en: The team members learned how to play it by ear as the project evolved, adapting flexibly to the new challenges that constantly emerged.

sentences.zh: 在面對生活中的挑戰時，有時最好的做法就是隨他去，靜觀其變。
sentences.en: When facing life's challenges, sometimes the best approach is to let it be and watch how things unfold.

sentences.zh: 當你無法改變事情時，學會隨他去可以幫助你減少壓力和焦慮。
sentences.en: When you can't change things, learning to let it be can help reduce stress and anxiety.

sentences.zh: 與其試圖控制每一個細節，不如隨他去，讓生命沿著自然的軌跡運行。
sentences.en: Instead of trying to control every detail, let it be and allow life to follow its natural course.

sentences.zh: 他明白事情終將會好轉，於是決定隨他去，專注於當下。
sentences.en: He understood that things would eventually get better, so he decided to let it be and focus on the present moment.

phrase.en: Rejoice in the Merits of Others; Give others joy.

sentences.zh: 他總是隨喜功德，給人歡喜，看到別人的成功時，心中充滿了喜悅。
sentences.en: He always rejoices in the merits of others, giving them joy, and feels genuine happiness when witnessing others' success.

sentences.zh: 在佛教修行中，隨喜功德，給人歡喜，是一種培養慈悲心的重要方法。
sentences.en: In Buddhist practice, rejoicing in the merits of others and giving them joy is an essential way to cultivate compassion.

sentences.zh: 她隨喜功德，給人歡喜，善於稱讚同事的努力，促進了和諧的工作環境。
sentences.en: She rejoices in the merits of others and gives them joy by praising her colleagues' efforts, fostering a harmonious work environment.

sentences.zh: 隨喜功德，給人歡喜，不僅能增進友情，也能提升自己的心靈修養。
sentences.en: Rejoicing in the merits of others and giving them joy not only strengthens friendships but also enhances one's own spiritual cultivation.

sentences.zh: 在山中閉關修行的時候，他感到隨心自在，仿佛脫離了俗世的束縛。
sentences.en: While meditating in seclusion in the mountains, he felt carefree as you wish, as if he had escaped the confines of the mundane world.

sentences.zh: 她喜歡的生活方式是隨心自在，不受任何繁瑣規則的限制。
sentences.en: Her preferred lifestyle is carefree as you wish, unrestricted by any tedious rules.

sentences.zh: 孩子們在草地上奔跑玩耍，享受著無拘無束、隨心自在的童年時光。
sentences.en: The children ran and played on the grass, enjoying their carefree as you wish childhood.

sentences.zh: 在藝術創作中，他總是追求一種隨心自在的創作狀態，不被任何技法束縛。
sentences.en: In his artistic creations, he always seeks a state of being carefree as you wish, unbound by any technical constraints.

phrase.zh: 隨緣不變　真如自性
phrase.en: To Follow Conditions While Remaining Unmoved; The perfection of our intrinsic nature.

sentences.zh: 在面對困難時，他隨緣不變地堅持著自己的信念，顯示出真如自性的完美。
sentences.en: When facing challenges, he follows conditions while remaining unmoved, demonstrating the perfection of his intrinsic nature.

sentences.zh: 修行者應學會隨緣不變，以保持心境的平和和真如自性的完美展現。
sentences.en: Practitioners should learn to follow conditions while remaining unmoved to maintain peace of mind and perfectly manifest their intrinsic nature.

sentences.zh: 隨緣不變是修行的重要理念，它幫助我們實現真如自性的圓滿。
sentences.en: Following conditions while remaining unmoved is a vital principle of practice that helps us achieve the perfection of our intrinsic nature.

sentences.zh: 她的生活態度總是隨緣不變，這讓她能夠展現出真如自性的智慧和慈悲。
sentences.en: Her approach to life is always to follow conditions while remaining unmoved, allowing her to manifest the wisdom and compassion of her intrinsic nature.

sentences.zh: 他總是以隨緣生活的態度面對人生，不強求，不執著。
sentences.en: He always approaches life with a mindset of living by following the conditions, demanding nothing and staying unattached.

sentences.zh: 在面對變化無常的世界時，她選擇隨緣生活，珍惜每一刻的當下。
sentences.en: When facing the ever-changing world, she chooses to live by following the conditions, cherishing each present moment.

sentences.zh: 隨緣生活並不意味著消極，而是接受生命中的種種變化，用心過好每一天。
sentences.en: Living by following the conditions doesn’t mean being passive; it means accepting the changes in life and mindfully making the most of each day.

sentences.zh: 在學習隨緣生活之後，他感覺內心更加平和，壓力也減少了。
sentences.en: After learning to live by following the conditions, he feels a greater inner peace and reduced stress.

sentences.zh: 祝你在新的工作中一切順利，所求如意。
sentences.en: May your new job go smoothly and all your wishes be fulfilled.

sentences.zh: 他向佛祖祈求他的願望能夠所求如意。
sentences.en: He prayed to the Buddha that his wishes may be fulfilled.

sentences.zh: 在這特別的日子裡，祝願你心想事成，所求如意。
sentences.en: On this special day, may you achieve what you desire and may your wishes be fulfilled.

sentences.zh: 新的一年，希望大家事事順心，所求如意。
sentences.en: In the new year, I hope everyone finds satisfaction in all things and may their wishes be fulfilled.

phrase.zh: 太阿在握　掌握權柄

sentences.zh: 他的策略巧妙，仿佛已經太阿在握，掌握權柄。
sentences.en: His strategy was astute, as if he was seizing Excalibur, all-powerful.

sentences.zh: 在那公司裡，她的地位不斷提升，如今已太阿在握，掌握權柄。
sentences.en: Her position in the company kept rising, and now she is seizing Excalibur, all-powerful.

sentences.zh: 他們通過談判技巧，取得了太阿在握，掌握權柄的優勢。
sentences.en: Through negotiation skills, they gained the advantage of seizing Excalibur, all-powerful.

sentences.zh: 這位領導者的決策讓人們感到，他仿佛太阿在握，掌握著無上的權柄。
sentences.en: The leader's decisions made people feel as though he was seizing Excalibur, wielding all-powerful authority.

phrase.en: The Taipei Sky: undying memories of home

sentences.zh: 每當我仰望台北的天空，那些鄉情難忘的回憶便如潮水般湧來。
sentences.en: Every time I look up at the Taipei sky, undying memories of home flood back like the tide.

sentences.zh: 在異鄉的日子裡，台北的天空和鄉情難忘成為了我心靈的慰藉。
sentences.en: During my days abroad, the Taipei sky and undying memories of home became a solace for my soul.

sentences.zh: 無論我身在何處，台北的天空那鄉情難忘的韻味始終在我心中。
sentences.en: No matter where I am, the undying memories of home beneath the Taipei sky remain ever present in my heart.

sentences.zh: 每次我觀看日落，台北的天空帶著鄉情難忘的情感讓我感受到家的溫暖。
sentences.en: Every time I watch the sunset, the Taipei sky with its undying memories of home fills me with a warmth of belonging.

sentences.zh: 即使在面對挑戰時，他仍能泰然自若，冷靜應對。
sentences.en: Even when facing challenges, he can act with perfect composure and respond calmly.

sentences.zh: 她泰然自若地完成了演講，讓觀眾印象深刻。
sentences.en: She acted with perfect composure during her speech, leaving a strong impression on the audience.

sentences.zh: 在緊急情況下，保持泰然自若是至關重要的。
sentences.en: In an emergency, acting with perfect composure is crucial.

sentences.zh: 他的泰然自若幫助他在複雜的談判中取得成功。
sentences.en: His ability to act with perfect composure helped him succeed in complex negotiations.

sentences.zh: 面對困境，他總是泰然自在，這讓周圍的人備受鼓舞。
sentences.en: In the face of adversity, he always remains calm and at ease, which greatly inspires those around him.

sentences.zh: 學習佛法讓她能在生活中更加泰然自在，不再為小事煩憂。
sentences.en: Studying Buddhism has enabled her to remain calm and at ease in life, no longer worried about trivial matters.

sentences.zh: 在激烈的辯論中，他依然泰然自在，表現出了非凡的智慧和沉著。
sentences.en: During the heated debate, he remained calm and at ease, displaying extraordinary wisdom and composure.

sentences.zh: 儘管天氣惡劣，船長依然泰然自在地指揮船隻，確保所有人都安全。
sentences.en: Despite the rough weather, the captain remained calm and at ease while directing the ship, ensuring everyone's safety.

phrase.en: Testing the Waters; Evaluating one's depth

sentences.zh: 在做出最終決定之前，他決定先探竿影草，了解一下市場的動向。
sentences.en: Before making the final decision, he decided to test the waters by getting a sense of the market trends.

sentences.zh: 這次會議是一次探竿影草的機會，讓我們了解合作夥伴的真實想法。
sentences.en: This meeting is an opportunity to test the waters, allowing us to understand the true thoughts of our partners.

sentences.zh: 在推廣新產品前，公司先以小範圍試點計劃探竿影草，以便評估客戶反應。
sentences.en: Before launching the new product, the company decided to test the waters with a small-scale pilot program to evaluate customer reactions.

sentences.zh: 他用一些假設性的問題來探竿影草，試圖看清對方的立場。
sentences.en: He used hypothetical questions to test the waters, trying to discern the other party's stance.

phrase.en: Ten Sighs: sad song about hardship and misery

sentences.zh: 那首名為『嘆十聲悲歌苦難哀愁』的曲子讓所有聽眾心生共鳴，感受到生命中的艱辛。
sentences.en: The piece titled 'Ten Sighs: sad song about hardship and misery' resonated with all listeners, making them feel the struggles of life.

sentences.zh: 作者用音樂表達了他的內心，透過『嘆十聲悲歌苦難哀愁』揭示了世界的不易。
sentences.en: The composer expressed his inner feelings through music, revealing the world's hardships with 'Ten Sighs: sad song about hardship and misery'.

sentences.zh: 每次聆聽『嘆十聲悲歌苦難哀愁』，我都不禁反思人生的困難和挑戰。
sentences.en: Each time I listen to 'Ten Sighs: sad song about hardship and misery', I cannot help but reflect on life's difficulties and challenges.

sentences.zh: 嘆十聲悲歌苦難哀愁是那位詩人一生的寫照，充滿了哀嘆與對命運的不滿。
sentences.en: Ten Sighs: sad song about hardship and misery is a reflection of the poet's life, filled with laments and discontent with fate.

sentences.zh: 生命就像曇花一現，時光短暫而珍貴。
sentences.en: Life is like the night-blooming cactus, momentary and precious.

sentences.zh: 在朋友聚會中，我們都感慨曇花一現的美好時光。
sentences.en: At the gathering with friends, we all marveled at the momentary beauty of the night-blooming cactus.

sentences.zh: 成功可能很短暫，就像曇花一現般稍縱即逝。
sentences.en: Success may be fleeting, just like the night-blooming cactus, it comes and goes quickly.

sentences.zh: 這幅畫捕捉到了曇花一現的瞬間，讓觀者感受到時光的短暫。
sentences.en: This painting captures the momentary beauty of the night-blooming cactus, making the viewer feel the brevity of time.

phrase.zh: 談空說有　論及真理
phrase.en: Speaking of Emptiness and Existence; Discourse on reality.

sentences.zh: 在學術會議上，許多學者聚集一堂，談空說有，論及真理，希望能更深入理解佛教的核心思想。
sentences.en: At the academic conference, many scholars gathered to speak of emptiness and existence, and discourse on reality, hoping to gain a deeper understanding of the core teachings of Buddhism.

sentences.zh: 這本書以其深入淺出的方式，談空說有，論及真理，成為佛學入門的經典讀物。
sentences.en: This book, with its accessible approach, speaks of emptiness and existence, and discourses on reality, becoming a classic introductory text in Buddhist studies.

sentences.zh: 他在講座中強調，談空說有並非只是哲學思辨，而是指引我們理解人生本質的重要途徑。
sentences.en: In his lecture, he emphasized that speaking of emptiness and existence is not merely philosophical speculation, but a crucial path to understanding the essence of life.

sentences.zh: 禪師的開示總是在簡單的對話中，巧妙地談空說有，論及真理，使聽眾感到豁然開朗。
sentences.en: The Zen master's teachings always subtly speak of emptiness and existence, and discourse on reality in simple conversations, leaving the audience with profound clarity.

phrase.en: Endless Greed and Craving; Insatiable discontent

sentences.zh: 他活在一種貪欲無厭，永不知足的狀態中，無論擁有多少財富都不滿足。
sentences.en: He lived in a state of endless greed and craving; insatiable discontent, never satisfied no matter how much wealth he possessed.

sentences.zh: 貪欲無厭，永不知足是痛苦的根源之一，讓人無法享受現有的幸福。
sentences.en: Endless greed and craving; insatiable discontent is one of the roots of suffering, preventing people from enjoying current happiness.

sentences.zh: 在這個物欲橫流的時代，許多人面對貪欲無厭，永不知足的挑戰。
sentences.en: In this materialistic era, many people face the challenge of endless greed and craving; insatiable discontent.

sentences.zh: 佛陀教導弟子們要避免貪欲無厭，永不知足，以達到心靈的平和。
sentences.en: The Buddha taught his disciples to avoid endless greed and craving; insatiable discontent, in order to achieve spiritual peace.

phrase.zh: 桃花依舊笑春風百花羨慕
phrase.en: Miss Your Smile in Spring: the envy of flowers

sentences.zh: 每當春風拂面，桃花依舊笑春風百花羨慕，讓人心醉神迷。
sentences.en: Every time the spring breeze caresses, I miss your smile in spring: the envy of flowers, enchanting everyone around.

sentences.zh: 她的微笑就像桃花依舊笑春風百花羨慕，總能在困難時給人希望。
sentences.en: Her smile is like 'Miss Your Smile in Spring: the envy of flowers', always bringing hope in times of difficulty.

sentences.zh: 在這明媚的春天，桃花依舊笑春風百花羨慕，讓一切煩憂都顯得渺小。
sentences.en: In this bright springtime, 'Miss Your Smile in Spring: the envy of flowers' makes all worries seem insignificant.

sentences.zh: 即使是春天最美的百花，也無法與那桃花依舊笑春風百花羨慕的笑容相比。
sentences.en: Even the most beautiful flowers of spring cannot compare with 'Miss Your Smile in Spring: the envy of flowers.'

phrase.zh: 剃除眉毛　不落思維
phrase.en: Shave Off One's Eyebrows; To break free from thinking

sentences.zh: 禪宗僧人有時會剃除眉毛，不落思維，以示對俗世觀念的超越。
sentences.en: Zen monks sometimes shave off their eyebrows to break free from thinking, symbolizing transcendence over worldly concepts.

sentences.zh: 剃除眉毛　不落思維，是修行者追求精神自由的象徵。
sentences.en: Shaving off one's eyebrows, to break free from thinking, symbolizes the seeker's pursuit of spiritual freedom.

sentences.zh: 在某些宗教儀式中，剃除眉毛意味著放下執著和不落思維使心智清晰。
sentences.en: In certain religious rituals, shaving off one's eyebrows signifies letting go of attachments and breaking free from thinking for mental clarity.

sentences.zh: 他決定剃除眉毛作為開啟新生活的象徵，這也是一種不落思維的嘗試。
sentences.en: He decided to shave off his eyebrows as a symbol of starting anew, an attempt to break free from thinking.

phrase.en: Pick Up and Let Go in Perfect Ease

sentences.zh: 修行者應該學會提放自如，這樣在面對人生的變故時才能泰然自若。
sentences.en: Practitioners should learn to pick up and let go in perfect ease, so they can remain calm in the face of life's changes.

sentences.zh: 他的心境達到了可以提放自如的境地，不被外在環境所影響。
sentences.en: His mind reached a state where he could pick up and let go in perfect ease, unaffected by external circumstances.

sentences.zh: 在工作中提放自如，讓她能夠有效地應對各種挑戰和壓力。
sentences.en: Being able to pick up and let go in perfect ease allowed her to effectively handle various challenges and pressures at work.

sentences.zh: 禪修多年，讓他在面對困難時能夠提放自如，不再感到恐懼或焦慮。
sentences.en: Years of meditation practice enabled him to pick up and let go in perfect ease when facing difficulties, eliminating fear and anxiety.

phrase.zh: 醍醐灌頂　有所體悟
phrase.en: Anointing the Head with the Finest Cream; To be inspired and enlightened.

sentences.zh: 在他聽完師父的講經後，感受到如醍醐灌頂，心中頓時有所體悟。
sentences.en: After listening to the master's sermon, he felt as if anointed with the finest cream, suddenly gaining inspiration and enlightenment.

sentences.zh: 她在閱讀佛經時，時常感到醍醐灌頂，並能有所體悟，潛心修持。
sentences.en: While reading the Buddhist scriptures, she often felt anointed with the finest cream and was inspired and enlightened, devoted to cultivation.

sentences.zh: 那次講座讓他如醍醐灌頂，有所體悟，對於人生有了新的看法。
sentences.en: The lecture anointed him with the finest cream, providing inspiration and enlightenment, giving him a new perspective on life.

sentences.zh: 他的建議猶如醍醐灌頂，讓我頓時有所體悟，認識到自己的不足。
sentences.en: His advice was like anointing the head with the finest cream, instantly inspiring and enlightening me to recognize my shortcomings.

phrase.en: A Wall Inscription in Xilin Temple

sentences.zh: 橫看成嶺側成峰，這句詩刻在了題西林壁上，讓人感受到景物的多樣性。
sentences.en: A mass from across but a peak from the side; this line inscribed on the wall in Xilin Temple evokes the diversity of perspectives.

sentences.zh: 遠近高低各不同，這不僅描繪了廬山的形態，也反映了人生的不同視角。
sentences.en: Far, near, high, low, each is a view of sight; this describes not only the form of Mount Lu but also reflects the different perspectives in life.

sentences.zh: 不識廬山真面目，因為我們常常需要退一步看清全貌，這也是題西林壁的智慧所在。
sentences.en: Why fail to see the real face of Mount Lu? Sometimes, we need to take a step back to see the whole picture, which is the wisdom behind 'A Wall Inscription in Xilin Temple'.

sentences.zh: 只緣身在此山中，用於指我們在近距離時往往看不清事物的全貌。
sentences.en: Because right inside the Mountain of Lu is where you are at; it illustrates that up close, we often cannot see the entirety of a situation.

phrase.en: On Climbing Mount Song Near the Southern Capital

sentences.zh: 題中嶽山的詩句描繪了一個人獨自攀登高峰的心境。
sentences.en: The poem 'On Climbing Mount Song Near the Southern Capital' depicts the solitude of a person climbing a high peak.

sentences.zh: 在他的作品〈題中嶽山〉中，他生動地描寫了登臨絕峯的旅程。
sentences.en: In his work 'On Climbing Mount Song Near the Southern Capital,' he vividly describes the journey to the mountain's peak.

sentences.zh: 〈題中嶽山〉中的詩句展現了自然的壯麗與禪意。
sentences.en: The verses in 'On Climbing Mount Song Near the Southern Capital' showcase the majesty of nature and a sense of Zen.

sentences.zh: 讀〈題中嶽山〉讓人感受到詩人與山水之間的默契。
sentences.en: Reading 'On Climbing Mount Song Near the Southern Capital' allows one to feel the poet's harmony with the landscapes.

phrase.zh: 填溝塞壑 無所不包

sentences.zh: 佛法的智慧填溝塞壑，無所不包，無論在哪個國家都能找到其深遠的影響。
sentences.en: The wisdom of Buddhism permeates every nook and cranny, leaving a profound impact in every country.

sentences.zh: 這位偉大的老師的教導就像春風化細雨，填溝塞壑，無所不包，覆蓋在學生們心靈的各個角落。
sentences.en: The teachings of this great teacher are like a gentle spring breeze, penetrating every nook and cranny of the students' minds.

sentences.zh: 塵世的佈局看似紛亂，但神聖的力量填溝塞壑，無所不包，讓事情自有其平衡。
sentences.en: The mundane world may seem chaotic, but divine energy fills every nook and cranny, maintaining an inherent balance.

sentences.zh: 在慈善活動中，他總是填溝塞壑，無所不包，體現了他對社會的全心投入。
sentences.en: In charitable activities, he always fills every nook and cranny, embodying his wholehearted commitment to society.

phrase.en: The Chan Mind of Heaven and Earth

sentences.zh: 在寧靜的山林中，他感受到天地禪心的啟迪，內心充滿了平和與安寧。
sentences.en: In the tranquil forest, he felt the inspiration of the Chan Mind of Heaven and Earth, his heart filled with peace and serenity.

sentences.zh: 修行者必須經常與天地禪心同在，才能夠達到真正的內心覺醒。
sentences.en: Practitioners must consistently abide with the Chan Mind of Heaven and Earth to attain true inner enlightenment.

sentences.zh: 老師教導學生每天靜坐，體驗天地禪心，以穩定心神。
sentences.en: The teacher instructed students to meditate daily to experience the Chan Mind of Heaven and Earth, for stabilizing the mind.

sentences.zh: 天地禪心的概念在佛教文學中常被用來表示宇宙的和諧與心靈的純淨。
sentences.en: The concept of the Chan Mind of Heaven and Earth is often used in Buddhist literature to denote the harmony of the cosmos and the purity of the soul.

phrase.en: Swan Lake: world-renowned ballet and music

sentences.zh: 柴可夫斯基所譜寫的《天鵝湖舞曲》風靡全球，是古典音樂與芭蕾舞的不朽經典。
sentences.en: Tchaikovsky's 'Swan Lake' is world-renowned, an immortal classic of both classical music and ballet.

sentences.zh: 《天鵝湖舞曲》以其優雅的旋律和迷人的故事，征服了全球觀眾。
sentences.en: Swan Lake's elegant melodies and enchanting storyline have captivated audiences worldwide.

sentences.zh: 在世界各地的歌劇院，《天鵝湖舞曲》的演出經常座無虛席，證明其持久的人氣。
sentences.en: Performances of Swan Lake frequently play to sold-out audiences in opera houses across the globe, demonstrating its enduring popularity.

sentences.zh: 《天鵝湖舞曲》不僅是芭蕾舞者的重要挑戰，也是音樂家夢寐以求的演奏曲目。
sentences.en: Swan Lake is not only a significant challenge for ballet dancers but also a repertoire masterpiece desired by musicians.

phrase.zh: 天翻地覆　巨大變化
phrase.en: Sky and Earth Overturned; Immense change

sentences.zh: 在佛教修行的過程中，有時會經歷內心的天翻地覆，體驗到巨大的變化與轉化。
sentences.en: In the process of Buddhist practice, one might experience a sky and earth overturned internally, undergoing immense change and transformation.

sentences.zh: 這個國家的經濟政策變革帶來了天翻地覆的巨大變化，影響了每一位公民的生活。
sentences.en: The sweeping economic policy reforms brought about a sky and earth overturned immense change, impacting every citizen's life.

sentences.zh: 隨著科技的迅速進步，我們的生活方式正經歷著天翻地覆的巨大變化。
sentences.en: With the rapid advancement of technology, our way of life is undergoing a sky and earth overturned immense change.

sentences.zh: 當領導者隨著時代的要求改變政策時，組織文化必須適應這種天翻地覆的巨大變化。
sentences.en: As leaders change policies to meet the demands of the times, organizational culture must adapt to the sky and earth overturned immense change.

phrase.zh: 天花亂墜　花雨繽紛

sentences.zh: 他的演講雖然辭藻華麗，但卻有些天花亂墜，缺乏實質內容。
sentences.en: His speech, though rich in language, tended towards over-exaggeration and lacked substantial content.

sentences.zh: 這位畫家的作品用色如同花雨繽紛，令人驚嘆不已。
sentences.en: The artist's work is an extravagant adornment of colors, leaving the audience in awe.

sentences.zh: 這份合約的描述好像天花亂墜，實際上卻沒有太多的利益。
sentences.en: The contract's description seems like over-exaggeration, but in reality, offers little benefit.

sentences.zh: 婚禮現場如同花雨繽紛，裝飾得非常華麗。
sentences.en: The wedding venue was an extravagant adornment, lavishly decorated with flowers.

sentences.zh: 打開窗戶，映入眼簾的是天寬水清的美景，讓人心曠神怡。
sentences.en: Opening the window revealed the breathtaking scenery of open sky and clear water, bringing a sense of tranquility.

sentences.zh: 禪修中的冥想引導我們在心中創造一個天寬水清的意境，達到內心的平靜。
sentences.en: The meditation in Zen practice guides us to create a mental state of open sky and clear water, achieving inner peace.

sentences.zh: 山上的景色就如詩中所描繪的那樣，天寬水清，令人流連忘返。
sentences.en: The view from the mountain was just like the poem described, open sky and clear water, making one reluctant to leave.

sentences.zh: 畫家以細膩的筆觸捕捉了湖邊天寬水清的美麗景象，讓人彷彿置身其間。
sentences.en: The artist captured the beautiful scene of open sky and clear water by the lake with delicate brushstrokes, making one feel as though they are there.

phrase.zh: 天龍八部　護法神祇
phrase.en: The Eight Guardian Generals; Heavenly Dharma protectors

sentences.zh: 在佛教中，天龍八部　護法神祇被視為保護佛法的神聖力量。
sentences.en: In Buddhism, the Eight Guardian Generals; Heavenly Dharma protectors are considered divine forces safeguarding the Dharma.

sentences.zh: 寺廟的壁畫上描繪了天龍八部　護法神祇，他們的任務是守護修行者。
sentences.en: The murals in the temple depict the Eight Guardian Generals; Heavenly Dharma protectors, whose task is to watch over practitioners.

sentences.zh: 每當佛教法會進行時，人們都祈求天龍八部　護法神祇的守護與祝福。
sentences.en: Whenever a Buddhist assembly is held, people pray for the protection and blessings of the Eight Guardian Generals; Heavenly Dharma protectors.

sentences.zh: 天龍八部　護法神祇象徵著正義與力量，他們的形象常見於佛教藝術中。
sentences.en: The Eight Guardian Generals; Heavenly Dharma protectors symbolize righteousness and strength, often featured in Buddhist art.

phrase.zh: 天女散花　美妙風姿
phrase.en: Celestial Rain of Flowers; Wondrous grace

sentences.zh: 在佛教典故中，天女散花象徵著佛法廣被十方，展現出無比的美妙風姿。
sentences.en: In Buddhist legends, the celestial rain of flowers symbolizes the spread of Dharma in all directions, showcasing an indescribable wondrous grace.

sentences.zh: 佛經描述天女散花的過程充滿了莊嚴與美妙，如同佛教徒對佛陀教法的無比欽仰。
sentences.en: The sutras describe the celestial rain of flowers as an occasion filled with solemnity and wondrous grace, akin to the deep admiration Buddhists have for the Buddha's teachings.

sentences.zh: 當禪師講解經典時，弟子們感受到如天女散花般的智慧和美妙風姿。
sentences.en: When the Zen master explained the scriptures, the disciples felt the wisdom and wondrous grace, much like a celestial rain of flowers.

sentences.zh: 那場演出的舞蹈如天女散花，傳達出一種超凡脫俗的美妙風姿。
sentences.en: The dance performance was like a celestial rain of flowers, conveying an otherworldly wondrous grace.

sentences.zh: 在古代哲學中，天人合一是理想的境界，象徵著自然與人類的和諧。
sentences.en: In ancient philosophy, the unity of heaven and humanity is an ideal state, symbolizing the harmony between nature and mankind.

sentences.zh: 通過修行和冥想，他感受到了一種天人合一的平靜與安寧。
sentences.en: Through practice and meditation, he felt a sense of tranquility and serenity in the unity of heaven and humanity.

sentences.zh: 藝術家試圖在他的畫作中表達出天人合一的美學理念。
sentences.en: The artist tried to express the aesthetic concept of the unity of heaven and humanity in his paintings.

sentences.zh: 天人合一的思想提醒人們珍視自然，追求內心的和諧與平衡。
sentences.en: The idea of the unity of heaven and humanity reminds people to cherish nature and pursue inner harmony and balance.

phrase.en: Extensive Lamp Record from the Tiansheng Era

sentences.zh: 《天聖廣燈錄》記載了眾多禪宗大師的語錄與公案，成為後人學習禪宗思想的重要資料。
sentences.en: The 'Extensive Lamp Record from the Tiansheng Era' documents numerous sayings and koans of Chan masters, serving as an important resource for later generations to study Chan Buddhism thought.

sentences.zh: 研究者常引用《天聖廣燈錄》來探討宋代禪宗的演化與發展。
sentences.en: Researchers often reference the 'Extensive Lamp Record from the Tiansheng Era' to explore the evolution and development of Chan Buddhism during the Song Dynasty.

sentences.zh: 《天聖廣燈錄》的編撰者力圖通過收集禪師的智慧之燈，照亮後來修行者的心靈。
sentences.en: The compilers of the 'Extensive Lamp Record from the Tiansheng Era' endeavored to illuminate the hearts of future practitioners by collecting the wisdom lamps of Zen masters.

sentences.zh: 《天聖廣燈錄》不僅是禪學的寶庫，也是了解古代思想傳播的重要文獻。
sentences.en: The 'Extensive Lamp Record from the Tiansheng Era' is not only a treasure trove of Zen studies but also an important document for understanding the transmission of ancient thought.

phrase.en: The Mind of Heaven Showers Flowers

sentences.zh: 佛陀入定時，仿佛天心雨華，滿室生香，所有弟子都感受到祥和的氣氛。
sentences.en: When the Buddha entered meditation, it was as if the mind of heaven showered flowers; the room was filled with fragrance, and all disciples felt a sense of peace.

sentences.zh: 每當講經完成，天心雨華般的靈氣彌漫開來，讓人心神寧靜。
sentences.en: After each sermon, a spirit akin to the mind of heaven showering flowers permeated the air, bringing tranquility to all.

sentences.zh: 他深知修行的果實，宛如天心雨華，默然滋養著內心的智慧。
sentences.en: He deeply understood that the fruits of cultivation are like the mind of heaven showering flowers, silently nurturing inner wisdom.

sentences.zh: 禪師總是說，真實的平和就如同天心雨華，是從心中自然流出的祥和。
sentences.en: The Zen master always said that true peace is like the mind of heaven showering flowers, a serenity that naturally flows from within.

phrase.en: The Mind is as Bright as the Moon

sentences.zh: 在靜坐中，他感受到天心月明的境界，心靈從煩惱中解脫出來。
sentences.en: During meditation, he experienced a state where the mind is as bright as the moon, freeing his spirit from troubles.

sentences.zh: 這本書描述了如何通過修行使心靈達到天心月明的光明境界。
sentences.en: The book describes how practice can lead the mind to a state as bright as the moon.

sentences.zh: 當她解決了長期困擾她的問題後，感覺天心月明，世界也變得清晰。
sentences.en: After solving a problem that had troubled her for a long time, her mind was as bright as the moon, and the world seemed clearer.

sentences.zh: 老師講述了儀式如何幫助我們保持天心月明的心態，儘管生活充滿挑戰。
sentences.en: The teacher explained how rituals help us maintain a mind as bright as the moon, despite life's challenges.

phrase.zh: 天旋地轉 頭昏眼花
phrase.en: The Sky Spins, The Earth Turns; Vertigo inducing

sentences.zh: 當他站起來時，感受到了一陣天旋地轉，頭昏眼花，幾乎無法保持平衡。
sentences.en: When he stood up, he felt as if the sky was spinning and the earth was turning, inducing vertigo and making it nearly impossible to maintain his balance.

sentences.zh: 這場過山車帶來的速度感，使每個人都陷入天旋地轉，頭昏眼花。
sentences.en: The speed of the roller coaster sent everyone into a vertigo-inducing whirl, making them feel as if the sky was spinning and the earth was turning.

sentences.zh: 她因為壓力過大而感到天旋地轉，頭昏眼花，急需一點時間來放鬆自己。
sentences.en: Due to overwhelming stress, she felt like the sky was spinning and the earth was turning, causing vertigo and an urgent need to relax.

sentences.zh: 連續的長途旅行讓他感到天旋地轉，頭昏眼花，需要好好休息才能恢復。
sentences.en: The consecutive long journeys made him feel as if the sky was spinning and the earth was turning, inducing vertigo that required proper rest to recover.

phrase.zh: 天衣無縫　渾然天成
phrase.en: Seamless Celestial Garment; The highest quality, as if heaven made.

sentences.zh: 這幅藝術作品被譽為天衣無縫，渾然天成，完美地融入了自然之中。
sentences.en: This piece of art is praised as a seamless celestial garment, perfectly blending into nature as if heaven made.

sentences.zh: 他的演奏如同行雲流水，天衣無縫，渾然天成，令人陶醉。
sentences.en: His performance was as fluid as flowing clouds and water, seamless celestial garment, leaving the audience entranced as if heaven made.

sentences.zh: 這篇文章結構嚴謹，語言優美，如同天衣無縫，渾然天成的作品。
sentences.en: The structure of this essay is rigorous, and the language is exquisite, akin to a seamless celestial garment, of the highest quality as if heaven made.

sentences.zh: 這座建築的設計宛如天衣無縫，渾然天成，與周圍環境和諧一致。
sentences.en: The design of this building is akin to a seamless celestial garment, in harmony with its surroundings as if of the highest quality heaven made.

phrase.en: When the Iron Tree Blooms; An extremely rare occurrence.

sentences.zh: 公司員工們戲稱，老闆親自下廚的情況可說是鐵樹開花，非常罕見希有。
sentences.en: The employees joked that the boss cooking for them was like when the iron tree blooms, an extremely rare occurrence.

sentences.zh: 在這個地方能看到這種瀕危鳥類，猶如鐵樹開花，真是罕見希有。
sentences.en: Seeing this endangered bird in this area is akin to when the iron tree blooms, truly an extremely rare occurrence.

sentences.zh: 他們和好的情況，簡直是鐵樹開花，誰也沒想到會發生。
sentences.en: Their reconciliation was like when the iron tree blooms; no one expected it to happen.

sentences.zh: 這位藝術家的作品在如此短時間內獲得世界性的認可，真是鐵樹開花的罕見現象。
sentences.en: The artist's work gaining worldwide recognition in such a short time is an extremely rare occurrence, like when the iron tree blooms.

phrase.en: Listen to the Sea: heart-moving sounds of waves

sentences.zh: 在海邊靜靜地坐著，聽海潮音美妙樂章，如同自然界的交響樂震撼心靈。
sentences.en: Sitting quietly by the seaside, listening to the sea: heart-moving sounds of waves, like the symphony of nature touching the soul.

sentences.zh: 她喜歡每天清晨散步，聽海潮音美妙樂章，這是她一天中最愉悅的時光。
sentences.en: She loves her morning walks, listening to the sea: heart-moving sounds of waves, which is the most delightful time of her day.

sentences.zh: 旅行的最後一站，他們選擇了海邊，享受聽海潮音美妙樂章帶來的心靈寧靜。
sentences.en: For the last stop of their journey, they chose the seaside to enjoy the heart-moving sounds of waves that brought peace to their minds.

sentences.zh: 在繁忙的城市生活中，偶爾需要停下腳步，聆聽海潮音美妙樂章，感受自然的撫慰。
sentences.en: In the busy city life, it's sometimes necessary to pause and listen to the sea: heart-moving sounds of waves, and feel the soothing touch of nature.

phrase.en: Childhood: dreaming of Brother Ox’s cartoons

sentences.zh: 在童年時期，他常常沉浸在牛哥漫畫的世界中，這份熱愛深深地影響了他的一生。
sentences.en: During his childhood, he often immersed himself in the world of Brother Ox’s cartoons, a passion that deeply influenced his life.

sentences.zh: 童年的夢想之一，就是能見到創作牛哥漫畫的偉大藝術家。
sentences.en: One of the dreams of his childhood was to meet the great artist who created Brother Ox's cartoons.

sentences.zh: 牛哥漫畫在他的童年中占據了重要的位置，激發了他對繪畫的濃厚興趣。
sentences.en: Brother Ox's cartoons held a significant place in his childhood, sparking a profound interest in drawing.

sentences.zh: 她經常回憶起那段無憂無慮的童年，當時牛哥漫畫給她帶來了無限的歡樂。
sentences.en: She often recalls those carefree childhood days when Brother Ox’s cartoons brought endless joy to her.

phrase.zh: 同床異夢　各懷心思
phrase.en: Different Dreams in the Same Bed; Each to their own thoughts.

sentences.zh: 夫妻倆雖然同住一個屋簷下，但經常出現同床異夢　各懷心思的情況，對未來各有不同的計劃。
sentences.en: The couple, although living under the same roof, often have different dreams in the same bed; each to their own thoughts regarding the future.

sentences.zh: 這項合作案在執行過程中暴露出了同床異夢　各懷心思的問題，各方都在為自己的利益打算。
sentences.en: The project exposed the issue of different dreams in the same bed; each party to their own thoughts, calculating their own benefits.

sentences.zh: 在處理團隊問題時，領導者應避免讓成員之間有同床異夢　各懷心思的現象，確保共同的目標和價值觀。
sentences.en: When managing team issues, a leader should avoid the phenomenon of different dreams in the same bed; each to their own thoughts and ensure shared goals and values.

sentences.zh: 他們的合作計畫因為雙方同床異夢　各懷心思而最終失敗，缺乏共同的願景和信任。
sentences.en: Their collaboration plan eventually failed due to different dreams in the same bed; each to their own thoughts, lacking a shared vision and trust.

phrase.zh: 同登彼岸　都能得度
phrase.en: Together to the Other Shore; All can be liberated.

sentences.zh: 在這場法會中，我們希望能同登彼岸，都能得度，達到心靈的解脫。
sentences.en: In this Dharma assembly, we hope to journey together to the other shore, where all can be liberated, achieving spiritual liberation.

sentences.zh: 師父教導我們如何以慈悲心帶領眾生同登彼岸，都能得度。
sentences.en: The master taught us how to lead sentient beings with compassion, so we can together reach the other shore, where all can be liberated.

sentences.zh: 在這個修行的過程中，大家互相扶持，一同朝向彼岸的光明，都能得度。
sentences.en: Throughout this practice, everyone supports each other, moving together towards the light of the other shore, where all can be liberated.

sentences.zh: 佛陀的教誨指引我們，同登彼岸並期望所有眾生都能得度。
sentences.en: The teachings of the Buddha guide us to journey together to the other shore, in hopes that all sentient beings can be liberated.

phrase.zh: 同體共生　人我無別
phrase.en: Oneness and Coexistence; No differences between self and others.

sentences.zh: 在這個社會中，我們應該實踐同體共生的理念，體現人我無別的真諦。
sentences.en: In this society, we should practice the concept of oneness and coexistence, embodying the true essence of no differences between self and others.

sentences.zh: 她深刻理解同體共生的哲學，因此能夠輕易感受並關懷他人的痛苦，做到人我無別。
sentences.en: She deeply understands the philosophy of oneness and coexistence, thus she can easily empathize with and care for others' sufferings, achieving no differences between self and others.

sentences.zh: 生態學的研究強調同體共生的原則，人類與自然界間應該人我無別，相互理解與尊重。
sentences.en: Ecological studies emphasize the principle of oneness and coexistence, indicating that there should be no differences between self and others in the relationship between humans and nature, with mutual understanding and respect.

sentences.zh: 當我們能夠放下自我，體會到同體共生的人我無別，我們就能生活得更加和諧與幸福。
sentences.en: When we are able to let go of ego and realize the oneness and coexistence with no differences between self and others, we can live more harmoniously and happily.

sentences.zh: 他在冥想中體驗到一種同體含光的感覺，就像一切都籠罩在祥和的光芒中。
sentences.en: He experienced a sense of all encompassing light during his meditation, as if everything was enveloped in a peaceful glow.

sentences.zh: 佛經中描述的境界如同體含光，讓人感受到宇宙間無處不在的智慧與慈悲。
sentences.en: The state described in the sutras is like an all encompassing light, making one feel the omnipresent wisdom and compassion in the universe.

sentences.zh: 禪修者努力達到同體含光的境界，這意味著對世界的全面理解與接納。
sentences.en: Zen practitioners strive to reach a state of all encompassing light, signifying complete understanding and acceptance of the world.

sentences.zh: 這幅畫作以同體含光的主題，象徵著無限的潛能和人類心靈的啟示。
sentences.en: This artwork features the theme of all encompassing light, symbolizing boundless potential and the revelation of the human spirit.

sentences.zh: 在這個困難的時期，團隊成員同心同德，共同面對挑戰，尋求最佳的解決方案。
sentences.en: During this difficult time, team members shared the same mind and same virtue, working together to face challenges and seek the best solutions.

sentences.zh: 夫妻之間若能同心同德，便能攜手走過人生中的風風雨雨。
sentences.en: If spouses can share the same mind and same virtue, they can walk hand in hand through the storms of life.

sentences.zh: 這個社區的人們同心同德，為建設更美好的生活環境而努力。
sentences.en: The people in this community have the same mind and same virtue, striving to build a better living environment.

sentences.zh: 在佛教團體中，同心同德是一種強大的力量，促進團結與和諧。
sentences.en: In Buddhist communities, having the same mind and same virtue is a powerful force that encourages unity and harmony.

phrase.zh: 通天徹地　無所不能

sentences.zh: 他被譽為通天徹地的工程師，總能想出解決複雜問題的方法。
sentences.en: He is hailed as an omnipotent engineer, always able to come up with solutions to complex problems.

sentences.zh: 這位大師以通天徹地的智慧引導弟子，讓他們相信無所不能的力量。
sentences.en: The master guided his disciples with omnipotent wisdom, helping them believe in the power of nothing being impossible.

sentences.zh: 在這個傳奇故事中，主角擁有通天徹地的能力，迎接著各種考驗。
sentences.en: In this legendary tale, the protagonist possesses omnipotent abilities, facing various challenges.

sentences.zh: 他常常激勵團隊，強調無所不能的精神來跨越各種障礙。
sentences.en: He often motivates the team, emphasizing the omnipotent spirit to overcome any obstacles.

phrase.zh: 頭上安頭　重複多餘
phrase.en: Reinventing the Wheel; Redundant and unnecessary

sentences.zh: 在這個會議中，他們的提案被批評為頭上安頭，重複多餘，因為相同的概念已經在先前的計劃中成功實現。
sentences.en: In the meeting, their proposal was criticized for reinventing the wheel; redundant and unnecessary, as the same concept had already been successfully implemented in previous projects.

sentences.zh: 開發團隊不想頭上安頭，重複多餘，所以他們仔細檢查了現有的技術解決方案。
sentences.en: The development team didn't want to reinvent the wheel; redundant and unnecessary, so they carefully examined existing technological solutions.

sentences.zh: 我們應該避免頭上安頭，重複多餘的行為，而是要學習和改進現有的方法。
sentences.en: We should avoid reinventing the wheel; redundant and unnecessary actions, and instead focus on learning and improving existing methods.

sentences.zh: 他的建議雖然有創意，但被認為是頭上安頭，重複多餘，因為未能提供新的價值。
sentences.en: Although his proposal was creative, it was considered reinventing the wheel; redundant and unnecessary since it failed to offer any new value.

phrase.zh: 頭頭是道　有條不紊
phrase.en: Clear and Logical; Orderly and systematically.

sentences.zh: 他的演講頭頭是道，讓聽眾們對複雜的議題有了更清晰的理解。
sentences.en: His speech was clear and logical, providing the audience with a better understanding of the complex issues.

sentences.zh: 她整理行李時總是有條不紊，每一件物品都精確放置在合適的位置。
sentences.en: She packs her luggage in an orderly and systematic way, placing each item precisely in its proper place.

sentences.zh: 這份報告頭頭是道，能夠有效地傳達研究的發現和建議。
