sentences.zh: 古人常說，一點靈光照耀天地，正因為小小的啟示往往能帶來巨大的變革。
sentences.en: The ancients often said, 'One flash of inspiration illuminates the world,' because even a small revelation can lead to tremendous change.

sentences.zh: 科學家們經過多年的研究，終於在某一瞬間獲得了一點靈光，這一點靈光照耀天地，突破了長期存在的難題。
sentences.en: After years of research, the scientists finally had a flash of inspiration in a single moment, illuminating the world and breaking through a longstanding impasse.

phrase.en: One meeting of minds: to be connected by heart.

sentences.zh: 他們兩人一點靈犀心意相通，不需多言就能理解彼此的想法。
sentences.en: The two of them had one meeting of minds, able to understand each other's thoughts without needing to say much.

sentences.zh: 在這次團隊合作中，他們展現了一點靈犀心意相通的默契，完成了複雜的任務。
sentences.en: During this teamwork, they demonstrated a meeting of minds to complete the complex task.

sentences.zh: 老朋友重逢時，他們瞬間一點靈犀心意相通，仿佛多年未見也不曾生疏。
sentences.en: When the old friends met, they instantly had a meeting of minds, as if the years had not distanced them.

sentences.zh: 此次會議上，他們的觀點出奇地一致，真是一點靈犀心意相通。
sentences.en: During the meeting, their views remarkably aligned, truly a meeting of minds.

phrase.en: One drop of water ink: a start of auspicious signs.

sentences.zh: 書法家在宣紙上落下了一點水墨，似乎瞬間就化成了龍鳳呈祥的圖畫。
sentences.en: The calligrapher dropped a bit of water ink on the rice paper, and it seemed to instantly transform into a picture of dragon and phoenix, a start of auspicious signs.

sentences.zh: 這幅畫的筆法極具靈性，僅憑一點水墨便讓人感受到龍鳳呈祥的意境。
sentences.en: The strokes in this painting are highly spirited, and with just one drop of water ink, it evokes the auspicious spirit of dragon and phoenix.

sentences.zh: 藝術家說，創作這幅作品時，他以一點水墨為起點，冀望於帶來龍鳳呈祥的好兆頭。
sentences.en: The artist said that he started with just a drop of water ink when creating this piece, hoping to usher in the auspicious signs of dragon and phoenix.

sentences.zh: 在中國傳統文化中，一點水墨往往被視為靈感的萌發，如龍鳳呈祥般帶來好運。
sentences.en: In traditional Chinese culture, one drop of water ink is often seen as the sprouting of inspiration, bringing good fortune akin to the auspicious signs of dragon and phoenix.

phrase.en: One bit and one drop: all are wondrous teachings.

sentences.zh: 學佛的人懂得在一點一滴皆成妙諦中領悟生命的真諦，無論是日常小事還是重大抉擇。
sentences.en: Those who practice Buddhism understand the wondrous teachings in every bit and drop, realizing the true meaning of life through both everyday trivialities and significant decisions.

sentences.zh: 老師常說，一點一滴皆成妙諦，勉勵學生從生活中的每個細節中吸取教訓。
sentences.en: The teacher often says, 'One bit and one drop, all are wondrous teachings,' encouraging students to learn lessons from every detail of life.

sentences.zh: 在修行的道路上，我們須要明白一點一滴皆成妙諦，細細品味每個經驗教會我們的道理。
sentences.en: On the path of cultivation, we must understand that each bit and drop embodies wondrous teachings, savoring the lessons taught by every experience.

sentences.zh: 他深信一點一滴皆成妙諦，因此從日常生活中的小事物中體會智慧。
sentences.en: He firmly believes that every bit and drop holds wondrous teachings, thus gaining wisdom from the small things in daily life.

phrase.en: One past event: still fresh in memory

sentences.zh: 那次旅行是他人生中一段往事記憶猶新，仿佛昨天才發生一樣。
sentences.en: That trip is one past event still fresh in his memory, as if it happened just yesterday.

sentences.zh: 她常常回憶起那段往事記憶猶新，尤其是在寂靜的夜晚。
sentences.en: She often recalls that past event, still fresh in her memory, especially on quiet nights.

sentences.zh: 這件事情雖然已經過去多年，但對於他來說卻是一段往事記憶猶新。
sentences.en: Although this happened many years ago, for him, it's one past event still fresh in memory.

sentences.zh: 當他再次走進那個老房子時，過去的畫面一段往事記憶猶新，湧上心頭。
sentences.en: As he stepped into the old house once more, the past scene, still fresh in his memory, surged into his mind.

phrase.en: One pair of ears: listen not to gossip.

sentences.zh: 修行者應該學會一對耳朵不聽是非，才能專注於內心的寧靜。
sentences.en: A practitioner should learn to have one pair of ears and listen not to gossip in order to focus on inner peace.

sentences.zh: 明明常提醒自己一對耳朵不聽是非，因此他的人際關係變得更加和諧。
sentences.en: Mingming often reminds himself to have one pair of ears and listen not to gossip, thus making his interpersonal relationships more harmonious.

sentences.zh: 在這個充滿流言蜚語的世界裡，保持一對耳朵不聽是非的心態是修行中的重要課題。
sentences.en: In a world filled with rumors, maintaining an attitude of one pair of ears and listening not to gossip is an important practice in cultivation.

sentences.zh: 老師告訴學生們要一對耳朵不聽是非，專注於學業。
sentences.en: The teacher told the students to have one pair of ears and listen not to gossip, focusing on their studies instead.

phrase.en: One pile of garbage: recycling material

sentences.zh: 每當看到一堆垃圾資源回收的機會，我們都應該積極參與，為環保盡一份力。
sentences.en: Whenever we see a chance to recycle one pile of garbage, we should actively participate and contribute to environmental protection.

sentences.zh: 那一堆垃圾資源回收之後被製成了新的紙張和塑料產品。
sentences.en: That one pile of garbage, once recycled, was turned into new paper and plastic products.

sentences.zh: 市政部門強調一堆垃圾資源回收的重要性，以減少填埋場的壓力。
sentences.en: The municipal department emphasized the importance of recycling one pile of garbage to reduce the pressure on landfills.

sentences.zh: 我們在校園裡設置了專用的回收箱，以確保每一堆垃圾資源回收得到妥善處理。
sentences.en: We have set up dedicated recycling bins on campus to ensure each pile of garbage is properly recycled.

sentences.zh: 在禪修中，修行者常常參悟到一多不二的真諦，體會到宇宙萬物相互交織的關聯性。
sentences.en: In meditation practice, practitioners often realize the truth of 'One is Many, Not Two,' experiencing the interconnectedness of all things in the universe.

sentences.zh: 老師用一多不二的概念來解釋世界如何在多樣性中保持統一。
sentences.en: The teacher used the concept 'One is Many, Not Two' to explain how the world maintains unity within diversity.

sentences.zh: 佛法教導我們，一多不二的智慧能帶來真實的覺悟和平靜。
sentences.en: Buddhism teaches us that the wisdom of 'One is Many, Not Two' can lead to true enlightenment and peace.

sentences.zh: 對於複雜的人際關係，一多不二的觀點能幫助我們更好地理解彼此的立場。
sentences.en: Regarding complex interpersonal relationships, the perspective of 'One is Many, Not Two' can help us better understand each other's positions.

phrase.en: One rose: a symbol of love.

sentences.zh: 在情人節，他送給她一朵玫瑰象徵愛情的忠貞不渝。
sentences.en: On Valentine's Day, he gave her one rose, a symbol of unwavering love.

sentences.zh: 這一朵玫瑰象徵愛情的純潔與美麗。
sentences.en: This one rose symbolizes the purity and beauty of love.

sentences.zh: 她臉上的微笑就像一朵玫瑰象徵愛情般溫暖人心。
sentences.en: Her smile is as heartwarming as one rose, a symbol of love.

sentences.zh: 一朵玫瑰象徵愛情，常被用來傳達深深的情感。
sentences.en: One rose symbolizes love, often used to convey deep emotions.

sentences.zh: 孩子們開始學數數，一二三四地念得不亦樂乎。
sentences.en: The children began learning to count, chanting one, two, three, four joyfully.

sentences.zh: 音樂老師讓學生們隨著旋律一二三四地拍手。
sentences.en: The music teacher instructed the students to clap along with the rhythm, one, two, three, four.

sentences.zh: 舞者跟著音樂節拍一二三四，跳出流暢的舞步。
sentences.en: The dancer followed the music's beat of one, two, three, four, executing smooth dance steps.

sentences.zh: 在新數學課上，你會學習從一數到一二三四。
sentences.en: In the new math lesson, you will learn to count from one to one, two, three, four.

phrase.en: One strip of hair: a part that may affect the whole body

sentences.zh: 在複雜的系統中，即使是微小的改變也可能像一髮牽動影響全局般引發連鎖反應。
sentences.en: In complex systems, even minor changes can trigger a chain reaction, like one strip of hair affecting the whole body.

sentences.zh: 他的行為在這個團隊中起到了關鍵作用，一髮牽動影響全局般，改變了整個計畫的方向。
sentences.en: His actions played a crucial role in the team, changing the direction of the entire project like a strip of hair affecting the whole body.

sentences.zh: 在政治局勢中，一次小小的失誤有可能一髮牽動影響全局，導致不穩定的情況。
sentences.en: In political situations, a minor mistake may affect the entire body of governance, like one strip of hair altering the stability.

sentences.zh: 管理層的一個決定可能看似微不足道，但卻可能一髮牽動影響全局，深遠影響公司的未來。
sentences.en: A management decision, seemingly insignificant, may affect the future of the company like one strip of hair impacting the whole structure.

phrase.en: One critical situation: in imminent peril

sentences.zh: 在一髮千鈞情況危急之下，消防隊及時趕到，成功解救被困住的居民。
sentences.en: In one critical situation, when everyone was in imminent peril, the fire brigade arrived in time and successfully rescued the trapped residents.

sentences.zh: 當飛機遭遇引擎故障時，機組人員面對一髮千鈞情況危急，冷靜地實施了緊急降落。
sentences.en: When the plane suffered an engine failure, the crew faced a critical situation and imminent peril, and calmly executed an emergency landing.

sentences.zh: 每個人都知道他們處於一髮千鈞情況危急中，然而全隊上下仍然保持著高度的專業精神。
sentences.en: Everyone knew they were in a critical situation and in imminent peril, yet the whole team maintained a high level of professionalism.

sentences.zh: 即使在一髮千鈞情況危急中，醫護人員也毫無懼色，熱心敬業地提供援助。
sentences.en: Even in a critical situation with imminent peril, the healthcare workers remained fearless and dedicated, offering their assistance enthusiastically.

phrase.en: One unusual act: other than normal.

sentences.zh: 他今天的行為一反常態必不正常，讓同事們都感到驚訝。
sentences.en: His behavior today was one unusual act: other than normal, which surprised his colleagues.

sentences.zh: 天氣一反常態必不正常，竟然在這個季節下起了大雪。
sentences.en: The weather was one unusual act: other than normal, with heavy snowfall occurring in this season.

sentences.zh: 當面對危機時，她的一反常態必不正常的冷靜使得團隊很快找到了解決方案。
sentences.en: When facing the crisis, her one unusual act: other than normal calmness helped the team quickly find a solution.

sentences.zh: 那位平時謹慎的演說家一反常態必不正常，突然在演講中開懷大笑。
sentences.en: The usually cautious speaker had one unusual act: other than normal, suddenly bursting into laughter during the speech.

phrase.en: One smooth sailing: to get home happily

sentences.zh: 他祝願他的家人在旅程中一帆風順快樂回家。
sentences.en: He wished his family one smooth sailing: to get home happily during their journey.

sentences.zh: 這次的旅行雖然充滿挑戰，但最終他們能夠一帆風順快樂回家。
sentences.en: Despite the challenges of the trip, they were finally able to have one smooth sailing: to get home happily.

sentences.zh: 在過去的一年中，他努力工作以確保家庭能夠一帆風順快樂回家。
sentences.en: Throughout the past year, he worked hard to ensure that the family could have one smooth sailing: to get home happily.

sentences.zh: 在終於完成了長久的目標後，她感受到一帆風順快樂回家的滿足感。
sentences.en: After finally achieving her long-term goal, she felt the satisfaction of one smooth sailing: to get home happily.

phrase.en: One painstaking effort: must not go to waste.

sentences.zh: 他投資的每一分錢，都是辛勤工作的一番心血不能白費。
sentences.en: Every penny he invested is the result of his hard work and painstaking effort: it must not go to waste.

sentences.zh: 這部傑作是她多年來努力不懈的成果，也是一番心血不能白費。
sentences.en: This masterpiece is the result of her years of relentless effort and is one painstaking effort: it must not go to waste.

sentences.zh: 為了團隊的成功，我們所有成員的一番心血不能白費。
sentences.en: For the success of the team, the painstaking efforts of all our members must not go to waste.

sentences.zh: 他最後的演講是多年的研究成果，一番心血不能白費。
sentences.en: His final lecture was the culmination of years of research, a painstaking effort that must not go to waste.

phrase.en: One newspaper: a window to the world.

sentences.zh: 通過閱讀一份報紙知悉世界，你能每天了解全球發生的重大事件。
sentences.en: By reading one newspaper, a window to the world, you can stay updated on major global events every day.

sentences.zh: 一份報紙知悉世界，它能擴展你的視野並提供多樣的觀點。
sentences.en: One newspaper, a window to the world, can expand your perspective and provide diverse viewpoints.

sentences.zh: 對於住在偏遠地區的人們來說，一份報紙知悉世界，提供一個接觸外界的途徑。
sentences.en: For people living in remote areas, one newspaper is a window to the world, offering a way to connect with the outside.

sentences.zh: 即便數位時代來臨，許多人仍然喜歡翻閱紙質版的一份報紙知悉世界，感受其獨特的魅力。
sentences.en: Even in the digital age, many people still enjoy flipping through the paper version of a newspaper, a window to the world, appreciating its unique charm.

phrase.en: One bit of effort: one bit of gain.

sentences.zh: 在學習中，我們應該相信一分耕耘一分收穫，只要持之以恆，必定能取得好成績。
sentences.en: In studying, we should believe that one bit of effort means one bit of gain; with perseverance, good results will surely follow.

sentences.zh: 農民知道一分耕耘一分收穫的道理，春天辛勤播種，秋天便能獲得豐收。
sentences.en: Farmers understand the principle of one bit of effort means one bit of gain; they sow diligently in spring to reap a bountiful harvest in autumn.

sentences.zh: 企業家堅信著一分耕耘一分收穫，通過不懈的努力將小公司發展成了行業的領頭羊。
sentences.en: The entrepreneur firmly believes that one bit of effort means one bit of gain, and through relentless effort, he grew his small company into an industry leader.

sentences.zh: 她深知一分耕耘一分收穫的價值，因此每天都努力工作，期望能夠改變自己的命運。
sentences.en: She knows well the value of one bit of effort means one bit of gain, so she works hard every day, hoping to change her fate.

phrase.en: One buddha appears: all buddhas will support and protect.

sentences.zh: 當一佛出世萬佛護持，意味著每一位覺悟者將獲得宇宙智慧的支援和加持。
sentences.en: When one buddha appears, all buddhas will support and protect, signifying that every enlightened being will receive the support and blessings of universal wisdom.

sentences.zh: 在困難的時刻，她相信一佛出世萬佛護持的力量，並找到了內心的平靜。
sentences.en: In challenging times, she believed in the power that one buddha appears, all buddhas will support and protect, and found peace within herself.

sentences.zh: 當我們學習佛法時，一佛出世萬佛護持的教義能激勵我們的修行之路。
sentences.en: As we study the Dharma, the teaching that one buddha appears, all buddhas will support and protect, can inspire our path of practice.

sentences.zh: 領悟一佛出世萬佛護持的真理，使他成為生活中堅韌不拔的力量源泉。
sentences.en: Realizing the truth that one buddha appears, all buddhas will support and protect, became a source of unwavering strength in his life.

phrase.zh: 一佛出世　希有難得
phrase.en: A Buddha Appears in the World; Rare and difficult to come by.

sentences.zh: 聖者的出現如一佛出世，真是希有難得的福報。
sentences.en: The appearance of a sage is like a Buddha appearing in the world; it is truly a rare and difficult blessing to come by.

sentences.zh: 這部經典的流傳彷彿是一佛出世，是何等的希有難得。
sentences.en: The dissemination of this scripture is like a Buddha appearing in the world, highlighting how rare and difficult it is to come by.

sentences.zh: 在人的一生中，遇到這樣的良師益友可謂一佛出世，實在希有難得。
sentences.en: In one's lifetime, encountering such a good teacher and friend is akin to a Buddha appearing in the world; truly rare and difficult to come by.

sentences.zh: 他被譽為當代的一佛出世，因為他的智慧和慈悲心是希有難得的。
sentences.en: He is hailed as a Buddha appearing in the world of our time because his wisdom and compassion are rare and difficult to come by.

phrase.en: One Buddha Pure Land: endless buddha lands.

sentences.zh: 修行者經常祈願能夠往生一佛淨土十方佛國，到達那裡便能夠避開世間的煩惱和痛苦。
sentences.en: Practitioners often wish to be reborn in one Buddha Pure Land: endless buddha lands, where they can escape the troubles and sufferings of the mundane world.

sentences.zh: 一佛淨土十方佛國的概念強調了無數佛土的純淨與清淨，每個佛國都有著其獨特的莊嚴和慈悲。
sentences.en: The concept of one Buddha Pure Land: endless buddha lands emphasizes the purity and clarity of countless buddha lands, each with its own unique magnificence and compassion.

sentences.zh: 在佛教經典中，描述一佛淨土十方佛國的境界是圓滿無瑕的，充滿無量的善美和歡樂。
sentences.en: In Buddhist scriptures, the realm of one Buddha Pure Land: endless buddha lands is described as perfectly flawless, filled with boundless goodness and joy.

sentences.zh: 一佛淨土十方佛國讓信眾有了追求終極解脫的願景，那裡沒有苦惱，只有安寧與自在。
sentences.en: One Buddha Pure Land: endless buddha lands offer devotees the vision of ultimate liberation, free from distress, where peace and ease prevail.

phrase.en: One man of courage makes a majority

sentences.zh: 在危機時刻，他以一夫當關萬夫莫敵的勇氣，帶領團隊逆轉了困境。
sentences.en: In times of crisis, he led the team to turn the tide with the courage of one man of courage making a majority.

sentences.zh: 她的頑強和決心使團隊成員相信一夫當關萬夫莫敵的力量，並激勵他們持續奮鬥。
sentences.en: Her tenacity and determination inspired the team members to believe in the power that one man of courage makes a majority, motivating them to keep striving.

sentences.zh: 以他在艱難時期的領導力，他真正詮釋了什麼是一夫當關萬夫莫敵。
sentences.en: Through his leadership during difficult times, he truly embodied what it means to be one man of courage making a majority.

sentences.zh: 儘管挑戰重重，他的勇氣不減，證明了一夫當關萬夫莫敵的名言。
sentences.en: Despite numerous challenges, his courage remained undiminished, proving the adage that one man of courage makes a majority.

phrase.en: One husband and one wife: a happy family

sentences.zh: 在傳統文化中，一夫一妻家庭美滿被視為幸福生活的一個理想典範。
sentences.en: In traditional culture, one husband and one wife: a happy family is seen as an ideal model of a happy life.

sentences.zh: 現代社會中，越來越多人重視一夫一妻家庭美滿的重要性，追求穩定的婚姻關係。
sentences.en: In modern society, more and more people value the importance of one husband and one wife: a happy family, seeking stable marital relationships.

sentences.zh: 一夫一妻家庭美滿不僅是婚姻的目標，也對子女的成長有著積極的影響。
sentences.en: One husband and one wife: a happy family is not only a goal of marriage, but also has a positive impact on the growth of children.

sentences.zh: 他們經營了多年的一夫一妻家庭美滿，成為了社區中羨慕的對象。
sentences.en: Their many years of one husband and one wife: a happy family have made them the envy of the community.

phrase.en: One pair of glasses: helps you see clearly

sentences.zh: 他戴上了一副眼鏡，終於能夠清晰地看清前方的景象。
sentences.en: He put on a pair of glasses and was finally able to clearly see the scenery ahead.

sentences.zh: 這副眼鏡讓她在開車時能更清晰地看清前方的道路。
sentences.en: This pair of glasses helps her see the road ahead more clearly while driving.

sentences.zh: 一副好的眼鏡不僅能讓你看清前方，還能保護你的眼睛。
sentences.en: A good pair of glasses not only helps you see clearly ahead but also protects your eyes.

sentences.zh: 戴上一副合適的眼鏡，仿佛能夠使你清楚地看清人生的方向。
sentences.en: Wearing a suitable pair of glasses can seemingly help you clearly see the direction of life.

sentences.zh: 展覽中的那一幅山水美不勝收，讓所有觀眾都讚不絕口。
sentences.en: That landscape painting in the exhibition is sheer beauty, leaving all the viewers in awe.

sentences.zh: 她房間的牆上掛著一幅山水美不勝收的畫，每天都讓她放鬆心情。
sentences.en: On her wall hangs a landscape painting of sheer beauty, helping her to relax every day.

sentences.zh: 藝術家耗費多年完成的一幅山水美不勝收的作品，如今成為館內的鎮館之寶。
sentences.en: The artist spent years completing a landscape painting of sheer beauty, which is now the centerpiece of the museum.

sentences.zh: 在那幅山水美不勝收的畫作前，遊客們都紛紛駐足欣賞，驚嘆其精妙。
sentences.en: Visitors stopped in front of the landscape painting of sheer beauty, marveling at its exquisite details.

phrase.en: One piece of oil painting: Mona Lisa

sentences.zh: 博物館裡最著名的展示品之一是一幅油畫蒙納麗莎，吸引了無數遊客前來欣賞。
sentences.en: One of the most famous exhibits in the museum is a piece of oil painting: Mona Lisa, attracting countless visitors.

sentences.zh: 導遊告訴我們，這幅油畫蒙納麗莎擁有極高的藝術價值和歷史意義。
sentences.en: The tour guide told us that the piece of oil painting: Mona Lisa, holds immense artistic value and historical significance.

sentences.zh: 畫家列奧納多·達·芬奇創作的這幅油畫蒙納麗莎，以她神祕的微笑聞名全球。
sentences.en: This piece of oil painting: Mona Lisa, created by Leonardo da Vinci, is famous worldwide for her enigmatic smile.

sentences.zh: 在藝術課上，老師詳細講解了一幅油畫蒙納麗莎的細節和背景故事。
sentences.en: In art class, the teacher explained in detail the aspects and background story of the piece of oil painting: Mona Lisa.

phrase.en: One nose through which all breathe: to sing the same tune

sentences.zh: 在會議上，他們所有的建議都似乎是一個鼻孔同聲出氣，沒有絲毫的不同意見。
sentences.en: In the meeting, all their suggestions seemed to come from one nose through which all breathe, without a hint of dissent.

sentences.zh: 在這場辯論中，支持者們一個鼻孔同聲出氣，共同展現出強大的團結力量。
sentences.en: In the debate, the supporters sang the same tune, demonstrating a powerful sense of unity.

sentences.zh: 對於那個政策，政府的高層似乎是從一個鼻孔同聲出氣，沒有任何反對的聲音。
sentences.en: Regarding the policy, the government officials appeared to breathe through one nose, with no voices of opposition.

sentences.zh: 他的團隊成員總是一個鼻孔同聲出氣，這使得他們在所有企劃上都非常一致。
sentences.en: His team members always sing the same tune, which makes them extremely consistent in all their projects.

phrase.en: One innovation: years of hard work.

sentences.zh: 這項發明正是他的心血結晶，一個創意多年苦思的結果。
sentences.en: This invention is truly the fruit of his labor, an innovation resulting from years of hard work.

sentences.zh: 他的公司能夠成功推出這項產品，背後是一個創意多年苦思的艱辛過程。
sentences.en: His company was able to successfully launch the product after a grueling process of years of hard work for one innovation.

sentences.zh: 當感受到成功的喜悅時，他明白這一切都基於一個創意多年苦思的努力。
sentences.en: When he felt the joy of success, he realized that it was all based on years of hard work for one innovation.

sentences.zh: 每次看到產品的成功面世，他都不禁想起那一個創意多年苦思的艱辛歷程。
sentences.en: Every time he saw the product successfully hit the market, he couldn’t help but recall the hard journey of years put into one innovation.

sentences.zh: 這個電影講述了一個故事感人至深，讓所有觀眾都流下了眼淚。
sentences.en: The movie tells one story: extremely touching, leaving all the audience in tears.

sentences.zh: 她向我們分享了一個故事感人至深，讓我重新思考了生命的意義。
sentences.en: She shared with us one story: extremely touching, which made me rethink the meaning of life.

sentences.zh: 在那本書中，有一個故事感人至深，令我回味無窮。
sentences.en: In that book, there is one story: extremely touching, leaving me with endless reflections.

sentences.zh: 那老師告訴我們一個故事感人至深，啟發了我去做更多的善行。
sentences.en: The teacher told us one story: extremely touching, which inspired me to do more good deeds.

sentences.zh: 他們把家打造得就像一個家園快樂天地，讓每個人感到無比的溫暖和幸福。
sentences.en: They created their home to be one family: a paradise, making everyone feel incredibly warm and joyful.

sentences.zh: 在正念的指導下，他們的日子就像是一個家園快樂天地，充滿了和諧與喜悅。
sentences.en: Under the guidance of mindfulness, their days resemble one family: a paradise, filled with harmony and joy.

sentences.zh: 孩子們在花園裡嬉戲，這裡簡直是一個家園快樂天地，洋溢著歡聲笑語。
sentences.en: The children play in the garden, and it truly is one family: a paradise, filled with laughter and joy.

sentences.zh: 我們共同努力讓這個村莊成為一個家園快樂天地，每個人都能享有平靜和愛。
sentences.en: We strive together to make this village one family: a paradise, where everyone can enjoy peace and love.

phrase.en: One toilet seat: a doctoral degree earned.

sentences.zh: 他常戲稱自己的博士學位為一個馬桶博士學位，因為是在許多不眠之夜中坐在書桌前獲得的。
sentences.en: He often jokingly refers to his doctoral degree as 'one toilet seat: a doctoral degree earned,' because it was achieved through many sleepless nights sitting at his desk.

sentences.zh: 在他的家裡，掛著一個標誌著一個馬桶博士學位的幽默海報，象徵著多年的艱辛努力。
sentences.en: In his home, there's a humorous poster indicating 'one toilet seat: a doctoral degree earned,' symbolizing years of hard work.

sentences.zh: 每當研究工作變得困難時，他總是笑著提到，只要努力，就能獲得一個馬桶博士學位。
sentences.en: Whenever research gets tough, he laughs and mentions that with effort, one can earn 'one toilet seat: a doctoral degree earned.'

sentences.zh: 朋友們經常開玩笑說，他的成就是靠無數個一個馬桶博士學位換來的，這讓他倍感驕傲。
sentences.en: His friends often joke that his achievements were traded for countless 'one toilet seat: a doctoral degree earned,' which makes him very proud.

sentences.zh: 這個疾病的爆發證明了一個細菌蔓延傳染的速度之快，讓醫護人員感到震驚。
sentences.en: The outbreak of the disease demonstrated the fast spread of one single bacteria: highly contagious, astonishing healthcare workers.

sentences.zh: 研究人員發現，一個細菌蔓延傳染的情況下，無法及時制止可能會造成大規模的疫情。
sentences.en: Researchers found that if not promptly contained, one single bacteria: highly contagious, could lead to a widespread epidemic.

sentences.zh: 社區的公共衛生措施在阻止一個細菌蔓延傳染方面發揮了重要作用。
sentences.en: The community’s public health measures played a crucial role in halting the spread of one single bacteria: highly contagious.

sentences.zh: 科學家致力於研發新的疫苗，以應對這一個細菌蔓延傳染的挑戰。
sentences.en: Scientists are dedicated to developing new vaccines to tackle the challenge of one single bacteria: highly contagious.

phrase.en: One loyal minister: sacrifice for his country

sentences.zh: 這是一個忠臣為國捨命的故事，他的精神在歷史上流芳百世。
sentences.en: This is a story of one loyal minister sacrificing for his country, and his spirit is remembered throughout history.

sentences.zh: 為了保衛國家，這位忠臣義無反顧地為國捨命，成為世人的楷模。
sentences.en: To protect the nation, this loyal minister bravely sacrificed for his country, becoming a model for others.

sentences.zh: 人民永遠不會忘記那一位忠臣為國捨命的無私奉獻。
sentences.en: The people will never forget the selfless sacrifice of the loyal minister who gave his life for the country.

sentences.zh: 在危難時刻，一個忠臣為國捨命，展示了不屈的愛國精神。
sentences.en: In times of crisis, one loyal minister sacrificed for his country, displaying an indomitable patriotic spirit.

sentences.zh: 經過藝術家的巧手，一根浮木創意無限，變成了一件獨特的藝術品。
sentences.en: Through the artist's deft hands, one driftwood becomes an art piece with boundless creativity, transformed into a unique masterpiece.

sentences.zh: 在他的眼中，一根浮木創意無限，可以幻化成各種形狀，展現出大自然的奇妙。
sentences.en: In his eyes, one driftwood holds infinite creativity, capable of transforming into various shapes, showcasing the wonders of nature.

sentences.zh: 博物館中展示了一根浮木創意無限的雕塑，吸引了很多參觀者的目光。
sentences.en: The museum exhibited a sculpture made from one driftwood, an art piece of limitless creativity, drawing the attention of many visitors.

sentences.zh: 經過多次嘗試，他成功地把一根浮木創意無限地雕刻成了一艘小船。
sentences.en: After multiple attempts, he successfully carved one driftwood into an art piece, a small boat with infinite creativity.

phrase.en: One strand of hair: into heaven and down to earth.

sentences.zh: 在禪宗的教法中，一根汗毛上天入地，象徵著任何微小的事物都有著無窮的可能。
sentences.en: In Zen teachings, one strand of hair: into heaven and down to earth symbolizes the infinite possibilities within even the tiniest things.

sentences.zh: 這種理念告訴我們，即使是一根汗毛上天入地，也可見證宇宙的奧秘。
sentences.en: This philosophy teaches us that even one strand of hair: into heaven and down to earth can witness the mysteries of the universe.

sentences.zh: 修行者應該學會觀察一根汗毛上天入地，這樣才能領悟天地之道。
sentences.en: Practitioners should learn to observe one strand of hair: into heaven and down to earth, so as to grasp the way of the universe.

sentences.zh: 法師在開示中提到，一根汗毛上天入地，啟發我們在日常生活中尋找寂靜與深奧。
sentences.en: In his sermon, the monk mentioned one strand of hair: into heaven and down to earth, inspiring us to find tranquility and profundity in daily life.

sentences.zh: 即使只是一根香煙氣味難聞，也能讓整個房間充滿濃烈的煙味。
sentences.en: Even just one cigarette's unbearable odor can fill the entire room with a strong smell of smoke.

sentences.zh: 她不喜歡跟吸煙的人在一起，因為她覺得一根香煙氣味難聞。
sentences.en: She disliked being around smokers because she found the odor of one cigarette unbearable.

sentences.zh: 許多人抱怨在公交車站等候時，一根香煙氣味難聞，難以忍受。
sentences.en: Many people complain about the unbearable odor of one cigarette while waiting at the bus stop, making it hard to tolerate.

sentences.zh: 在室內吸煙區，一根香煙氣味難聞，常常讓非吸煙者感到不舒服。
sentences.en: In indoor smoking areas, the unbearable odor of one cigarette often makes non-smokers uncomfortable.

phrase.en: One complete effort: give it your best.

sentences.zh: 在這次比賽中，他一股腦兒全力以赴，憑藉堅強的毅力贏得了冠軍。
sentences.en: In this competition, he gave it his best with one complete effort, winning the championship through sheer determination.

sentences.zh: 她一股腦兒全力以赴地投入工作，結果獲得了晉升的機會。
sentences.en: She gave it her best in her work with one complete effort, which resulted in a promotion opportunity.

sentences.zh: 面對困難的挑戰，他告訴自己要一股腦兒全力以赴，絕不放棄。
sentences.en: Facing a difficult challenge, he told himself to give it his best with one complete effort and never give up.

sentences.zh: 團隊一股腦兒全力以赴地完成了這個項目，使客戶非常滿意。
sentences.en: The team gave it their best with one complete effort to complete the project, which left the client extremely satisfied.

phrase.en: One beauty: she can overrun cities and ruin states.

sentences.zh: 古代詩人常用『一顧傾城再顧傾國』來形容女子的絕世美貌。
sentences.en: Ancient poets often used 'One beauty: she can overrun cities and ruin states.' to describe a woman's unparalleled beauty.

sentences.zh: 她的美貌讓整個宴會都仿佛陷入了『一顧傾城再顧傾國』的沉醉與驚嘆。
sentences.en: Her beauty seemed to cast the entire banquet into a state of awe and enchantment, reminiscent of 'One beauty: she can overrun cities and ruin states.'

sentences.zh: 在傳說中，那位女王以其『一顧傾城再顧傾國』的姿色，改變了歷史的進程。
sentences.en: In legends, the queen with her 'One beauty: she can overrun cities and ruin states.' allure, changed the course of history.

sentences.zh: 朋友笑稱她是一位具有『一顧傾城再顧傾國』容貌的現代女性，總是吸引眾人的目光。
sentences.en: Her friends joked that she was a modern woman with an 'One beauty: she can overrun cities and ruin states.' kind of allure, always capturing everyone's attention.

phrase.en: One vigorous effort: accomplish something in one go.

sentences.zh: 他們決定一鼓作氣一氣呵成，把整個活動的籌備工作在一周內完成。
sentences.en: They decided to accomplish everything in one vigorous effort, finishing all preparations for the event within a week.

sentences.zh: 面對困難，她選擇一鼓作氣一氣呵成，迅速解決所有問題。
sentences.en: When faced with challenges, she chose to tackle everything in one vigorous effort, swiftly resolving all issues.

sentences.zh: 這部小說是他一鼓作氣一氣呵成的，沒有中途停止過。
sentences.en: He wrote the novel in one vigorous effort, without pausing in between.

sentences.zh: 音樂家一鼓作氣一氣呵成地完成了交響樂曲的創作，展現了極高的創作才華。
sentences.en: The musician composed the symphony in one vigorous effort, showcasing immense creative talent.

phrase.en: One eminent ruler: knows and employs the right people

sentences.zh: 一國明君知人善用，他能夠充分發揮優秀人才的潛力，推動國家的發展。
sentences.en: One eminent ruler: knows and employs the right people, he is able to fully harness the potential of talented individuals to propel the nation's development.

sentences.zh: 歷史上，許多國家在明君知人善用的治理下，得以繁榮昌盛。
sentences.en: Throughout history, many nations have flourished under the governance of an eminent ruler who knows and employs the right people.

sentences.zh: 一國的進步與否，往往取決於明君是否能知人善用，任人唯賢。
sentences.en: The progress of a nation often hinges on whether an eminent ruler knows and employs the right people, valuing merit above all.

sentences.zh: 只有當一國明君能夠知人善用，國家才能夠應對未來的挑戰，保持競爭力。
sentences.en: Only when an eminent ruler knows and employs the right people can a nation tackle future challenges and maintain its competitiveness.

phrase.en: One country, one family: a basis of human beings

sentences.zh: 在我們這個多元化的社會中，一國一家人之本份的理念提醒我們要尊重與包容彼此的差異。
sentences.en: In our multicultural society, the concept of 'one country, one family: a basis of human beings' reminds us to respect and embrace our differences.

sentences.zh: 這次會議強調一國一家人之本份的重要性，以促進國內的和諧與世界的和平。
sentences.en: The conference emphasized the importance of 'one country, one family: a basis of human beings' to promote domestic harmony and world peace.

sentences.zh: 教育需要灌輸一國一家人之本份的價值觀給年輕一代，使其發展包容和理解。
sentences.en: Education needs to instill the value of 'one country, one family: a basis of human beings' in the younger generation to foster inclusivity and understanding.

sentences.zh: 在災難面前，社會各界展示了一國一家人之本份的精神，互相支持，攜手共渡難關。
sentences.en: In the face of disaster, various sectors of society demonstrated the spirit of 'one country, one family: a basis of human beings,' supporting each other and working together to overcome challenges.

phrase.en: One pot of vegetarian delicacy: healthy and good.

sentences.zh: 媽媽為了我們的健康，喜歡每天準備一鍋素肴健康養生的晚餐。
sentences.en: For our health, mom likes to prepare one pot of vegetarian delicacy: healthy and good for dinner every day.

sentences.zh: 在寒冷的冬天，一鍋素肴健康養生的湯可以溫暖整個家庭的心。
sentences.en: In the cold winter, one pot of vegetarian delicacy: healthy and good soup can warm the hearts of the whole family.

sentences.zh: 禪修院每天供應一鍋素肴健康養生的菜肴，讓人感受身心靈的平衡。
sentences.en: The Zen retreat offers one pot of vegetarian delicacy: healthy and good dishes daily to promote balance in body and mind.

sentences.zh: 這家餐廳以其特有的一鍋素肴健康養生而聞名，吸引眾多顧客光顧。
sentences.en: This restaurant is famous for its special one pot of vegetarian delicacy: healthy and good, attracting many customers.

phrase.en: One ocean apart: connected by one culture

sentences.zh: 雖然我們一海之隔文化一統，彼此之間的文化交流卻一直非常密切。
sentences.en: Although we are one ocean apart, connected by one culture, cultural exchanges between us have always been very close.

sentences.zh: 去年的文化節讓我深刻體會到一海之隔文化一統的深意，因為來自世界各地的人都能感受到同種文化的共鳴。
sentences.en: Last year's cultural festival made me deeply appreciate the meaning of 'one ocean apart: connected by one culture,' as people from around the world resonated with the same culture.

sentences.zh: 這句諺語完美地描述了我們兩國之間的關係：一海之隔文化一統。
sentences.en: This proverb perfectly describes the relationship between our two countries: one ocean apart, connected by one culture.

sentences.zh: 即便我們的國家位於不同大陸，我們依然能夠一海之隔文化一統，分享相似的傳統和價值觀。
sentences.en: Even though our countries are located on different continents, we are still able to be one ocean apart, connected by one culture, sharing similar traditions and values.

phrase.en: One row of tears: wash away sorrows.

sentences.zh: 她的一行清淚洗去憂傷，令她重新找到了生活的希望。
sentences.en: Her one row of tears washed away her sorrows, allowing her to find hope in life once again.

sentences.zh: 在佛前，她的一行清淚洗去過往的痛苦。
sentences.en: Before the Buddha, her one row of tears washed away the pains of the past.

sentences.zh: 這本書描寫了一位母親如何以一行清淚洗去對孩子的牽掛。
sentences.en: This book describes how a mother washed away her worries for her child with one row of tears.

sentences.zh: 通過冥想，他總是能讓自己的一行清淚洗去心中的煩惱。
sentences.en: Through meditation, he always found that one row of tears could wash away the troubles in his heart.

phrase.en: One strand of white hair: a world on its tip.

sentences.zh: 禪語中常說『一毫端上世界在此』，意味著在一根細小的毫毛上即可體現整個宇宙的真理。
sentences.en: In Zen sayings, 'one strand of white hair: a world on its tip' suggests that the truth of the entire universe can be embodied in a tiny strand of hair.

sentences.zh: 他在冥想中體驗到一毫端上世界在此的奧妙，領悟到每一個微小存在的深刻意義。
sentences.en: In meditation, he experienced the profound mystery of 'one strand of white hair: a world on its tip,' realizing the deep significance of every small existence.

sentences.zh: 藝術家的作品常常呈現出一毫端上世界在此的理念，將無限的想像集中在一個微小的點上。
sentences.en: The artist's work often reflects the concept of 'one strand of white hair: a world on its tip,' focusing infinite imagination on a single tiny point.

sentences.zh: 他認為人心如一毫端上世界在此，蘊藏著無窮的智慧和潛力有待發掘。
sentences.en: He believes the human mind is like 'one strand of white hair: a world on its tip,' containing boundless wisdom and potential waiting to be discovered.

phrase.en: One side and the other: telling right from wrong.

sentences.zh: 他在辯論中總是一黑一白是非分明，讓大家很容易分辨正確與錯誤。
sentences.en: In debates, he always stands for one side and the other, making it easy for everyone to distinguish right from wrong.

sentences.zh: 面對複雜的問題，她堅持一黑一白是非分明的原則，不讓感情影響判斷。
sentences.en: Facing complex issues, she insists on the principle of one side and the other, telling right from wrong, without letting emotions cloud her judgment.

sentences.zh: 學習佛法讓我能夠一黑一白是非分明，清楚地看待生活中的對錯。
sentences.en: Studying Buddhism has enabled me to see one side and the other, telling right from wrong, with clarity in life's dilemmas.

sentences.zh: 在法庭上，法官必須一黑一白是非分明，才能做出公正的裁決。
sentences.en: In the courtroom, a judge must see one side and the other, telling right from wrong, to deliver fair judgments.

phrase.en: One dispersal in confusion: fruitless result

sentences.zh: 會議結束後，大家一哄而散沒有成果，問題依然懸而未決。
sentences.en: After the meeting ended, everyone left in confusion with a fruitless result, and the problem remained unresolved.

sentences.zh: 這次討論由於缺乏領導和方向，最終以一哄而散沒有成果告終。
sentences.en: The discussion lacked leadership and direction, ultimately resulting in a dispersal in confusion with no fruitful outcomes.

sentences.zh: 社區活動因組織不力而結束得一哄而散沒有成果，讓參加者倍感失望。
sentences.en: The community event ended with a dispersal in confusion and fruitless results due to poor organization, leaving participants disappointed.

sentences.zh: 在重要項目上缺乏協調，團隊最終一哄而散沒有成果。
sentences.en: Lack of coordination on the important project led to the team dispersing in confusion with no fruitful results.

phrase.en: One call answered by hundreds: public support

sentences.zh: 領袖的智慧和遠見使得他的提案能夠一呼百諾大家擁護，迅速得到推行。
sentences.en: The leader's wisdom and foresight allowed his proposal to be one call answered by hundreds, with public support leading to its swift implementation.

sentences.zh: 他在社區中建立了良好的信譽，因此每當他有所倡議，總是一呼百諾大家擁護。
sentences.en: He has built a good reputation in the community, so whenever he advocates for something, it is always one call answered by hundreds with public support.

sentences.zh: 這場救援行動一呼百諾大家擁護，顯示了社區中充滿人情味的互助精神。
sentences.en: This rescue operation, one call answered by hundreds, demonstrated the warm-hearted spirit of mutual aid within the community.

sentences.zh: 他在大會上提出的改革方案，一呼百諾大家擁護，成為當今最受歡迎的議題之一。
sentences.en: The reform plan he proposed at the conference was one call answered by hundreds, becoming one of today's most popular issues.

phrase.en: One pot of good tea: a chat on Chan and the Way

sentences.zh: 在清幽的茶室裡，他們一壺好茶談禪論道，彼此交流心靈深處的感悟。
sentences.en: In the tranquil tea room, they shared one pot of good tea, engaging in a chat on Chan and the Way, exchanging profound insights from their hearts.

sentences.zh: 每個周末，我們都會聚在一起，一壺好茶談禪論道，這成為了我們修行的一部分。
sentences.en: Every weekend, we gather together with one pot of good tea, having a chat on Chan and the Way, which has become a part of our practice.

sentences.zh: 老和尚笑著說，生活如同一壺好茶談禪論道，簡單中見真諦。
sentences.en: The elderly monk smiled and said that life is like one pot of good tea, a chat on Chan and the Way, where simplicity reveals the ultimate truth.

sentences.zh: 他常邀請朋友到家中，一壺好茶談禪論道，以此增進彼此的智慧與友誼。
sentences.en: He often invites friends to his home for one pot of good tea, to have a chat on Chan and the Way, fostering both wisdom and friendship.

phrase.en: One scenic lake: relaxing and soothing.

sentences.zh: 面對一湖景色心曠神怡，我們感受到了大自然的寧靜與美好。
sentences.en: Facing the scenic lake that is both relaxing and soothing, we felt the tranquility and beauty of nature.

sentences.zh: 在一湖景色心曠神怡的環境中，任何壓力都會被化解。
sentences.en: In the presence of one scenic lake that is relaxing and soothing, any stress seems to melt away.

sentences.zh: 那個度假村以其一湖景色心曠神怡的獨特風景而聞名。
sentences.en: The resort is famous for its unique, scenic lake which is both relaxing and soothing.

sentences.zh: 當我看到一湖景色心曠神怡，我的心境也隨之舒展。
sentences.en: When I saw the scenic lake that is relaxing and soothing, my state of mind also relaxed.

phrase.zh: 一花五葉　禪門宗派
phrase.en: A Five-Petaled Flower; The blossoming and development of Chan.

sentences.zh: 禪宗的發展被形容為一花五葉的開展，每一派皆象徵著禪的不同面向。
sentences.en: The development of Chan Buddhism is described as the unfolding of a five-petaled flower, with each sect representing a different aspect of Chan.

sentences.zh: 在一花五葉的比喻中，禪宗被認為是在中國文化的土壤上綻放的那朵花。
sentences.en: In the metaphor of a five-petaled flower, Chan is considered the blossom that flourished in the soil of Chinese culture.

sentences.zh: 一花五葉的傳統在禪宗的教義中被深深珍視，為禪門宗派的多元性提供了歷史的框架。
sentences.en: The tradition of the five-petaled flower is deeply cherished in Chan doctrine, providing a historical framework for the diversity of Chan sects.

sentences.zh: 禪宗流派的多樣性，宛如一花五葉的多瓣之姿，展現了靈性的繁榮與創新。
sentences.en: The diversity of Chan schools resembles the multifaceted nature of a five-petaled flower, showcasing spiritual flourishing and innovation.

phrase.en: One flower, five petals: Chan Schools

sentences.zh: 禅宗的分派，稱為一花五葉五宗七派，象徵著釋迦牟尼佛的教法在中國的傳播與發展。
sentences.en: The division of Chan Buddhism is referred to as 'one flower, five petals: Chan Schools,' symbolizing the propagation and development of Shakyamuni Buddha's teachings in China.

sentences.zh: 一花五葉五宗七派中，臨濟宗以其獨特的公案修行方法而著名。
sentences.en: Among the 'one flower, five petals: Chan Schools,' the Linji School is renowned for its unique koan practice method.

sentences.zh: 在一花五葉五宗七派的傳承中，各派系在禪修方法上有所不同，但都強調直指人心、見性成佛。
sentences.en: In the legacy of 'one flower, five petals: Chan Schools,' each sect differs in meditation techniques, but all emphasize directly pointing to the mind and realizing one's Buddha-nature.

sentences.zh: 一花五葉五宗七派的理論分享了中國佛教的多樣性和深度，影響延續至今。
sentences.en: The theory of 'one flower, five petals: Chan Schools' reflects the diversity and depth of Chinese Buddhism, with its influence continuing to this day.

sentences.zh: 在他的眼裡，一花一草皆是真如，每一片自然的景象都充滿了深刻的智慧。
sentences.en: In his eyes, one flower and one grass, each scene of nature, is filled with profound wisdom.

sentences.zh: 她在園中漫步時領悟到一花一草皆是真如，連最細微的事物都展現著生命的真實。
sentences.en: While strolling through the garden, she realized that one flower and one grass represent ultimate reality, with even the smallest things displaying life's truth.

sentences.zh: 老師教導學生，一花一草皆是真如，這是理解生命本質的重要一課。
sentences.en: The teacher instructed the students that one flower and one grass encapsulates true nature, an important lesson in understanding the essence of life.

sentences.zh: 他冥想時觀察到一花一草皆是真如，這讓他感受到萬物間的深刻聯繫。
sentences.en: During meditation, he observed that one flower and one grass illustrate ultimate reality, allowing him to feel a profound connection among all things.

sentences.zh: 他一揮而就，才思敏捷地解決了這個複雜的問題。
sentences.en: He solved the complex problem with one swift action and agile thinking.

sentences.zh: 這個畫家一揮而就，才思敏捷地完成了他的最新作品。
sentences.en: The artist completed his latest piece with one swift action and agile thinking.

sentences.zh: 她在會議中一揮而就，才思敏捷地提出了一個創新的解決方案。
sentences.en: She proposed an innovative solution in the meeting with one swift action and agile thinking.

sentences.zh: 工程師一揮而就，才思敏捷地優化了系統，顯著提升了性能。
sentences.en: The engineer optimized the system with one swift action and agile thinking, significantly enhancing its performance.

sentences.zh: 在禪修中，他體悟到一即一切的道理，感受到宇宙的每一部分都是相互連結的。
sentences.en: During meditation, he realized the principle that one is all, feeling the interconnectedness of every part of the universe.

sentences.zh: 佛教教導我們，一即一切，任何一個思想或行為都會影響整個世界。
sentences.en: Buddhism teaches us that one is all, and any single thought or action can impact the entire world.

sentences.zh: 她相信一即一切的概念，因此努力讓自己的每一個選擇都充滿善意和愛。
sentences.en: She believes in the concept of one is all, so she strives to make every choice full of kindness and love.

sentences.zh: 通過學習一即一切的理論，他開始認識到自己的存在與周圍世界密不可分。
sentences.en: By studying the theory that one is all, he began to recognize his existence as inseparably linked to the surrounding world.

phrase.en: One is all: all is one

sentences.zh: 在佛教中，一即一切，一切即一，這意味著每一個事物都與整個宇宙息息相關。
sentences.en: In Buddhism, 'one is all: all is one' means that every single thing is interconnected with the entire universe.

sentences.zh: 了解一即一切一切即一的觀念，有助於我們認識到自我和他者之間並無實質區別。
sentences.en: Understanding the concept of 'one is all: all is one' helps us realize there is no substantial difference between self and others.

sentences.zh: 在這幅畫作中，藝術家運用了‘一即一切一切即一’的哲學，將每一個細節融入整體構圖中。
sentences.en: In this artwork, the artist employed the philosophy of 'one is all: all is one', integrating every detail into the overall composition.

sentences.zh: 禪修中，專注於一即一切，一切即一，使我們能夠達到內心的平和與全然的理解。
sentences.en: In meditation, focusing on 'one is all: all is one' enables us to achieve inner peace and complete understanding.

phrase.zh: 一即一切　圓融無礙
phrase.en: One is All; Interpenetration without obstruction.

sentences.zh: 如同佛法中的信念，一即一切，圓融無礙，強調宇宙萬物息息相關，無論是內在或外在。
sentences.en: As in the belief within Buddhism, one is all; interpenetration without obstruction, emphasizing the interconnectedness of all things in the universe, both internally and externally.

sentences.zh: 這幅畫作表達了一即一切，圓融無礙的意境，每一筆都和諧地交織在一起。
sentences.en: This painting expresses the idea of one is all; interpenetration without obstruction, with each stroke harmoniously intertwined.

sentences.zh: 在他們的交流中，他們體現了一種深厚的理解，一即一切，圓融無礙，彼此心靈相通。
sentences.en: In their interactions, they embodied a deep understanding, one is all; interpenetration without obstruction, with a profound connection of minds.

sentences.zh: 我們的團隊遵從一即一切，圓融無礙的原則，努力確保每個部門合作無間，毫無阻礙。
sentences.en: Our team adheres to the principle of one is all; interpenetration without obstruction, striving to ensure seamless cooperation between departments with no obstacles.

phrase.en: One professional skill: a lifetime use.

sentences.zh: 父親常常告誡我們，一技在身終生受用，學得一門專業技能可以讓我們在未來受益匪淺。
sentences.en: Father often advises us that one professional skill: a lifetime use. Learning a specialized skill can benefit us greatly in the future.

sentences.zh: 在這個快速變遷的社會中，一技在身終生受用，擁有專業技能比以往任何時候都重要。
sentences.en: In this rapidly changing society, one professional skill: a lifetime use. Having specialized skills is more important than ever.

sentences.zh: 他的木工技術真是一技在身終生受用，讓他在退休後依然能維持一份不錯的收入。
sentences.en: His carpentry skills are truly one professional skill: a lifetime use, allowing him to maintain a decent income even after retirement.

sentences.zh: 老師總是強調，一技在身終生受用，這就是為什麼她鼓勵我們在學校裡多方嘗試不同領域。
sentences.en: The teacher always emphasizes that one professional skill: a lifetime use, which is why she encourages us to try different fields in school.

phrase.en: One professional skill: apply what has been learnt.

sentences.zh: 他非常善於將自己的一技之長學以致用，在工作中總能提出創新的解決方案。
sentences.en: He excels at applying his professional skill in practice, always coming up with innovative solutions at work.

sentences.zh: 通過學以致用，她在市場營銷領域開創了一片新的天地，使產品銷售額大幅提升。
sentences.en: By applying what she learned, she pioneered new approaches in marketing, significantly boosting product sales.

sentences.zh: 在這個技術驅動的時代，能夠學以致用是一項無價的能力。
sentences.en: In this technology-driven era, being able to apply what has been learnt is an invaluable skill.

sentences.zh: 他的一技之長讓他在這個競爭激烈的行業中脫穎而出，成為一名成功的專業人士。
sentences.en: His professional skill allowed him to stand out in this competitive industry, becoming a successful professional.

phrase.en: One gadget in hand: endless possibilities

sentences.zh: 擁有這部智慧手機真是一機在手功用無窮，你可以隨時上網、拍照和追劇。
sentences.en: Having this smartphone truly represents 'one gadget in hand: endless possibilities,' as you can browse the internet, take photos, and stream movies anytime.

sentences.zh: 現代科技讓一機在手功用無窮，這小小的裝置能幫助我們管理日常生活的方方面面。
sentences.en: Modern technology makes 'one gadget in hand: endless possibilities' a reality, with these small devices helping us manage every aspect of our daily lives.

sentences.zh: 在旅行中，一機在手功用無窮，能夠導航、翻譯甚至提供最新的天氣預報。
sentences.en: While traveling, 'one gadget in hand: endless possibilities' rings true as it can navigate, translate, and even provide the latest weather updates.

sentences.zh: 學習新技能時，一機在手功用無窮，我們可以隨時隨地觀看教程並練習。
sentences.en: 'One gadget in hand: endless possibilities' applies to learning new skills, as we can watch tutorials and practice anywhere, anytime.

phrase.en: One family of young and old: time together

sentences.zh: 在古老的農村，一家老小共創家業，共同面對生活中的挑戰。
sentences.en: In the ancient village, one family of young and old is spending time together, collectively facing the challenges of life.

sentences.zh: 這家餐館是一家老小共創家業的典範，每個人都在其中扮演著重要角色。
sentences.en: This restaurant is an example of a family of young and old spending time together, with everyone playing an important role.

sentences.zh: 在這個手工藝品店裡，一家老小共創家業，共享手工勞作的樂趣和成就感。
sentences.en: In this craft store, a family of young and old is spending time together, sharing the joy and sense of accomplishment in manual work.

sentences.zh: 每逢假期，一家老小共創家業的氛圍格外濃厚，大家都沉浸在親情的氛圍中。
sentences.en: During the holidays, the spirit of a family of young and old spending time together is especially strong, with everyone immersed in the atmosphere of familial love.

phrase.en: One family together for happiness and peace.

sentences.zh: 在新年聚會上，我們希望一家團結幸福平安，共同迎接未來的挑戰。
sentences.en: At the New Year gathering, we hope to be one family together for happiness and peace, facing future challenges together.

sentences.zh: 一家團結幸福平安，是我們每個人心中的理想和目標。
sentences.en: One family together for happiness and peace is an ideal and goal cherished in the hearts of each of us.

sentences.zh: 祖父母一直教導我們，保持一家團結幸福平安是最重要的價值觀。
sentences.en: Our grandparents have always taught us that maintaining one family together for happiness and peace is the most important value.

sentences.zh: 每年的家庭旅行都是為了增進感情，使得一家團結幸福平安。
sentences.en: The annual family trips are meant to strengthen our bonds, ensuring we stay one family together for happiness and peace.

phrase.en: One family, one country: loyalty, duty, benevolence and love.

sentences.zh: 在他的領導下，公司形成了一種一家一國忠孝仁愛的企業文化，員工們感受到強烈的歸屬感。
sentences.en: Under his leadership, the company cultivated a corporate culture of 'one family, one country: loyalty, duty, benevolence and love,' fostering a strong sense of belonging among the employees.

sentences.zh: 這位老人在他的家庭生活中實踐一家一國忠孝仁愛的價值觀，贏得了後輩們的尊敬。
sentences.en: The elderly man practiced the values of 'one family, one country: loyalty, duty, benevolence and love' in his family life, earning the respect of the younger generation.

sentences.zh: 學校希望通過教育培養學生成為擁有一家一國忠孝仁愛品格的未來公民。
sentences.en: The school aims to educate students to become future citizens who embody the qualities of 'one family, one country: loyalty, duty, benevolence and love.'

sentences.zh: 社區強調一家一國忠孝仁愛，以團結居民，促進和諧共處。
sentences.en: The community emphasizes 'one family, one country: loyalty, duty, benevolence and love' to unite residents and promote harmonious coexistence.

phrase.en: One head of the family: responsibilities

sentences.zh: 作為一家之主，他承擔著養家糊口的重要責任，確保家庭的和諧與穩定。
sentences.en: As the head of the family, he bears the important responsibility of providing for them, ensuring harmony and stability at home.

sentences.zh: 一家之主承擔重任，無論在順境還是逆境中，他都始終如一地引導家庭。
sentences.en: As the head of the family, he shoulders responsibilities, consistently guiding the family through both good times and bad.

sentences.zh: 她成為一家之主承擔重任，努力支持孩子的教育和成長。
sentences.en: Becoming the head of the family, she took on responsibilities, striving to support her children's education and growth.

sentences.zh: 在傳統觀念中，一家之主承擔重任，但現代社會的家庭角色可能更為多元。
sentences.en: Traditionally, the head of the family bears responsibilities, but in modern society, family roles can be more diverse.

phrase.en: One hotel: a place of stay to many

sentences.zh: 那一間旅店接待四方，每日總是座無虛席，因為其獨特的服務和文化吸引了許多旅客。
sentences.en: That hotel, a place of stay to many, is always fully booked daily, as its unique service and culture attract many travelers.

sentences.zh: 在這座小鎮，有一間旅店接待四方，游歷者們都喜歡在這裡交流見聞。
sentences.en: In this small town, there is one hotel, a place of stay to many, where travelers love to share their experiences.

sentences.zh: 這間旅店接待四方，成為了眾多旅客的心靈港灣，讓他們在忙碌的旅程中找到寧靜。
sentences.en: This hotel, a place of stay to many, has become a sanctuary for numerous travelers, providing them with peace amidst their hectic journeys.

sentences.zh: 一間旅店接待四方，被視為這個城市的象徵性建築，歷史悠久且充滿魅力。
sentences.en: One hotel, a place of stay to many, is considered a landmark of the city, with its rich history and charm.

phrase.en: One greenhouse: home for exotic plants.

sentences.zh: 那一間溫室奇花異草，吸引了許多人來參觀。
sentences.en: That one greenhouse, home for exotic plants, attracts many visitors.

sentences.zh: 在這一間溫室奇花異草中，科學家們正在研究稀有植物的生長特性。
sentences.en: In this one greenhouse, home for exotic plants, scientists are studying the growth characteristics of rare species.

sentences.zh: 一間溫室奇花異草，不僅提供觀賞價值，還有助於生物多樣性的保護。
sentences.en: One greenhouse, home for exotic plants, offers aesthetic value as well as contributes to biodiversity conservation.

sentences.zh: 這一間溫室奇花異草是園藝家的最愛，他們前來學習不同植物的栽培技巧。
sentences.en: This one greenhouse, home for exotic plants, is a favorite among horticulturists who come to learn various cultivation techniques.

phrase.en: A Spray of Plum Blossoms: snow and flowers in meeting

sentences.zh: 在冬日的清晨，屋外一剪梅飄香雪花相映，呈現出一幅詩意的畫面。
sentences.en: On a winter morning, a spray of plum blossoms and snow flowers in meeting outside the house, creating a poetic scene.

sentences.zh: 詩人描繪過一種境界，叫做「一剪梅飄香雪花相映」，將自然的和諧美展露無遺。
sentences.en: The poet described a realm called 'A Spray of Plum Blossoms: snow and flowers in meeting', perfectly showcasing the harmony of nature.

sentences.zh: 在那個庭院中，庭園設計師精心佈置了一剪梅飄香雪花相映的景觀，吸引無數遊客駐足欣賞。
sentences.en: In that courtyard, the landscape designer meticulously arranged a setting of a spray of plum blossoms and snow flowers in meeting, attracting numerous visitors to pause and admire.

sentences.zh: 儘管寒風凜冽，但那一剪梅飄香雪花相映的景象卻讓人心中倍感溫暖。
sentences.en: Despite the biting cold winds, the scene of a spray of plum blossoms and snow flowers in meeting warms the heart.

phrase.zh: 一箭雙雕　一舉兩得
phrase.en: To Kill Two Birds with One Stone; Achieve two aims at once.

sentences.zh: 他們設計了一個活動，既能推廣環保理念，又能提升社區凝聚力，真是一箭雙雕。
sentences.en: They designed an event that promotes environmental awareness and strengthens community ties, truly killing two birds with one stone.

sentences.zh: 這次旅行不僅讓我們放鬆身心，還加深了同事之間的友情，達到了一舉兩得的效果。
sentences.en: This trip not only allowed us to relax but also strengthened friendships among colleagues, achieving two aims at once.

sentences.zh: 通過在工作中使用新科技手段，公司得以提升效率並同時降低成本，實現了一箭雙雕的目標。
sentences.en: By using new technological means in their work, the company was able to increase efficiency and reduce costs simultaneously, achieving two aims at once.

sentences.zh: 他在學習語言的同時也認識了來自世界各地的朋友，無疑是一舉兩得的好處。
sentences.en: By learning the language, he also made friends from all over the world, undoubtedly achieving two aims at once.

phrase.en: Within an Arrow's Length; A short distance

sentences.zh: 村子和寺廟間只有一箭之地，朝聖者經常步行來來往往。
sentences.en: The village and the temple are within an arrow's length, and pilgrims often walk back and forth.

sentences.zh: 他的家就在公司的一箭之地內，所以他步行上班。
sentences.en: His home is within an arrow's length of the office, so he walks to work.

sentences.zh: 這兩顆星球之間在宇宙尺度上幾乎是一箭之地的距離。
sentences.en: On a cosmic scale, these two planets are almost within an arrow's length of each other.

sentences.zh: 學校與圖書館相隔一箭之地，因此學生們可以輕鬆地去借書。
sentences.en: The school is within an arrow's length of the library, allowing students to easily go and borrow books.

sentences.zh: 當兩人初次見面時，他們一見如故說話同心，似乎已經認識了一輩子。
sentences.en: When the two people met for the first time, it was as if they had known each other forever: one intimate first meeting, like soulmates.

sentences.zh: 他和她第一次見面時，便一見如故說話同心，立刻成為了無話不談的好友。
sentences.en: Upon meeting her, he found they were one intimate first meeting; soulmates in conversation, they quickly became inseparable friends.

sentences.zh: 有時候生命中會遇到少數幾個人，即使初次相識，也能一見如故說話同心。
sentences.en: Sometimes in life, you meet a few people where even a first encounter feels like you've known them forever: one intimate first meeting, soulmates indeed.

sentences.zh: 那位禪師曾說過，他和他的老師一見如故說話同心，這是他修行的開始。
sentences.en: The Zen master once said that his meeting with his teacher was one intimate first meeting: soulmates, marking the beginning of his practice.

phrase.en: One hem of the kasaya: a spiritual style

sentences.zh: 僧人身披一角袈裟，走在古老寺院的庭院中，這景象喚起了道風的莊嚴與清淨。
sentences.en: The monk, draped in one hem of the kasaya, walked through the courtyard of the ancient monastery, evoking a sense of spiritual style that is both solemn and serene.

sentences.zh: 當他們看到一角袈裟揚起，道風隨之而來，村民們立即感到心靈的平和。
sentences.en: As they saw one hem of the kasaya fluttering, accompanied by the spiritual style, the villagers immediately felt a sense of peace in their hearts.

sentences.zh: 一角袈裟揚起道風，象徵著佛教徒生活中簡樸而深刻的信仰。
sentences.en: The raising of one hem of the kasaya symbolizes the simple yet profound faith in the lives of Buddhists, embodying a spiritual style.

sentences.zh: 她學習用一角袈裟揚起道風，體現出深厚的修行功力。
sentences.en: She learned to uplift her spiritual style with one hem of the kasaya, reflecting her profound spiritual cultivation.

phrase.en: One footstep out: reach into the entire world

sentences.zh: 修行者依靠一腳走出行遍全球的精神，開始他的文化交流之旅。
sentences.en: The practitioner embraced the spirit of 'one footstep out: reach into the entire world' and embarked on a cultural exchange journey.

sentences.zh: 他憑藉一腳走出行遍全球的信念，勇敢地探索未知的世界。
sentences.en: With the belief of 'one footstep out: reach into the entire world,' he bravely explored uncharted territories.

sentences.zh: 一腳走出行遍全球，不只是移動，而是心靈的擴展。
sentences.en: 'One footstep out: reach into the entire world' is not just about movement, but an expansion of the mind.

sentences.zh: 旅程無需終點，只需有一腳走出行遍全球的決心。
sentences.en: A journey doesn't need a destination, only the determination of 'one footstep out: reach into the entire world.'

phrase.en: One single penny untaken: honest and upright

sentences.zh: 他一介不取，為人清廉，在同事中間備受尊敬。
sentences.en: He is one single penny untaken and is honest and upright, earning great respect among his colleagues.

sentences.zh: 即使面對誘惑，她始終保持一介不取為人清廉的原則。
sentences.en: Even in the face of temptation, she steadfastly upholds the principle of being one single penny untaken: honest and upright.

sentences.zh: 他的清廉之名傳遍四方，人們都知道他一介不取。
sentences.en: His reputation for honesty spreads far and wide, known to all as one who is one single penny untaken.

sentences.zh: 不論環境如何惡劣，他始終堅持一介不取，為人清廉。
sentences.en: No matter how adverse the circumstances, he consistently upholds being one single penny untaken: honest and upright.

phrase.en: One humble monk: the whole world is his home.

sentences.zh: 他如同一介貧僧天地為家，隨遇而安，遍歷四方。
sentences.en: He is like one humble monk: the whole world is his home, finding peace wherever he goes, traveling far and wide.

sentences.zh: 一介貧僧天地為家，無論身處何地，他都能感受到宇宙的寬容與平和。
sentences.en: As one humble monk: the whole world is his home, he feels the universe's vastness and peace, no matter where he is.

sentences.zh: 天地為家的一介貧僧，無懼風雨，總是微笑面對人生的挑戰。
sentences.en: One humble monk, for whom the whole world is his home, fears neither wind nor rain and always meets life's challenges with a smile.

sentences.zh: 在繁華市井中，他依舊保持著一介貧僧天地為家的清淨心。
sentences.en: In the bustling streets, he maintains the serene heart of one humble monk, for whom the whole world is his home.

phrase.en: One advance and one retreat: in orderly fashion.

sentences.zh: 在禪修時，一進一退前後有序的呼吸法有助於集中注意力。
sentences.en: During meditation, the one advance and one retreat breathing technique helps to focus attention in an orderly fashion.

sentences.zh: 這場辯論歷經兩小時，一進一退前後有序，雙方都理智謹慎。
sentences.en: The debate lasted for two hours, with arguments presented in an orderly fashion, one advance and one retreat, both sides being rational and cautious.

sentences.zh: 他們之間的對話如同舞蹈，一進一退前後有序，優雅而有節奏。
sentences.en: Their conversation was like a dance, with one advance and one retreat in orderly fashion, elegant and rhythmic.

sentences.zh: 在社交場合中，他的表現一進一退前後有序，顯示出良好的社交技巧。
sentences.en: In social gatherings, his behavior was in orderly fashion, one advance and one retreat, showing excellent social skills.

sentences.zh: 這一句成語流傳千古，激勵著一代又一代的人追求卓越。
sentences.en: This one single phrase, ageless inspiration, has motivated countless generations to strive for excellence.

sentences.zh: 老師告訴我們，一句成語流傳千古，蘊含著豐富的智慧和歷史。
sentences.en: The teacher told us that one single phrase, ageless inspiration, contains profound wisdom and history.

sentences.zh: 無論時代如何變遷，一句成語流傳千古，總能在困惑時指引方向。
sentences.en: No matter how times change, one single phrase, ageless inspiration, always guides us in moments of confusion.

sentences.zh: 這位學者的研究顯示，一句成語流傳千古，影響了許多文化和文明。
sentences.en: This scholar's research shows that one single phrase, ageless inspiration, has influenced many cultures and civilizations.

phrase.en: One word of kindness: heaven and earth will know.

sentences.zh: 在危難時刻，他的一句善言天地皆知，激勵了整個團隊。
sentences.en: In times of crisis, his one word of kindness was known throughout heaven and earth, inspiring the entire team.

sentences.zh: 她總是以一句善言天地皆知的態度來面對每一個人，這讓她深受大家的愛戴。
sentences.en: She always approached everyone with one word of kindness that heaven and earth would know, which earned her the affection of all.

sentences.zh: 他的名聲因為他總是能說出一句善言天地皆知的話而在鄉里中傳播開來。
sentences.en: His reputation spread throughout the village because he could always express one word of kindness that heaven and earth would know.

sentences.zh: 古書上記載著，一句善言天地皆知乃是通達心靈的鑰匙。
sentences.en: The ancient texts record that one word of kindness, known to heaven and earth, is the key to reaching the heart.

phrase.en: One mindless talk: a cause of trouble

sentences.zh: 因為一句閒話會惹事端，他們之間的友誼出現了裂痕。
sentences.en: Because one mindless talk can cause trouble, a rift appeared in their friendship.

sentences.zh: 她後悔當初那句閒話，因為一句閒話會惹事端，給公司帶來了不必要的麻煩。
sentences.en: She regretted that casual remark since one mindless talk can cause trouble and brought unnecessary issues to the company.

sentences.zh: 長老提醒我們，一句閒話會惹事端，說話前要三思。
sentences.en: The elder advised us that one mindless talk could cause trouble, hence we should think twice before speaking.

sentences.zh: 正因為一句閒話會惹事端，他開始學習如何更加謹慎地選擇詞語。
sentences.en: Precisely because one mindless talk can cause trouble, he began to learn how to choose his words more carefully.

phrase.en: One sense of humor: relief from an awkward situation.

sentences.zh: 在會談僵持不下時，他一句幽默打破僵局，讓大家笑了起來，氣氛瞬間輕鬆了許多。
sentences.en: When the meeting was at a standstill, he used one sense of humor to break the ice, making everyone laugh and easing the atmosphere instantly.

sentences.zh: 當面對此尷尬的場面時，他的一句幽默打破僵局，讓氣氛变得更加友善。
sentences.en: Faced with the awkward situation, his sense of humor provided a relief from the tension and made the environment friendlier.

sentences.zh: 她的一句幽默打破僵局，讓所有人放鬆，會議也因此得以順利進行。
sentences.en: Her quick wit provided relief from an awkward situation, allowing everyone to relax and the meeting to proceed smoothly.

sentences.zh: 在晚宴上，他的一句幽默打破僵局，使得原本的沉默變得活潑起來。
sentences.en: At the dinner party, his humorous comment provided a relief from the awkward silence, bringing liveliness to the gathering.

phrase.en: One sentence of praise achieves a 'win-win' situation.

sentences.zh: 在會議上，他的一句讚歎讓整個團隊皆大歡喜，增強了集體的士氣。
sentences.en: During the meeting, his one sentence of praise boosted the morale of the entire team, achieving a 'win-win' situation.

sentences.zh: 母親的一句讚歎使孩子皆大歡喜，讓孩子更有信心去面對下一個挑戰。
sentences.en: A mother's sentence of praise brought great joy to the child, giving him the confidence to face the next challenge.

sentences.zh: 老師的一句讚歎，使班上每位學生皆大歡喜，更加努力學習。
sentences.en: The teacher's sentence of praise made every student in the class happy, motivating them to study harder.

sentences.zh: 在婚禮上，新郎一句讚歎皆大歡喜，使新娘感動不已。
sentences.en: At the wedding, the groom's one sentence of praise brought about a 'win-win' situation, leaving the bride deeply moved.

phrase.en: One movement and action: to know things like one’s own palm

sentences.zh: 老師對每個學生的一舉一動了如指掌，因為他總是仔細觀察他們的表現。
sentences.en: The teacher knows each student's every movement and action like his own palm, as he always carefully observes their performance.

sentences.zh: 作為一名專業偵探，他對案件需要的一舉一動了如指掌，才能在最短的時間內找到線索。
sentences.en: As a professional detective, he must know every movement and action needed for the case like his own palm to find clues in the shortest time.

sentences.zh: 經理對公司運營的一舉一動了如指掌，這使他能夠快速解決問題並作出明智決策。
sentences.en: The manager knows every movement and action of the company's operations like his own palm, enabling him to quickly resolve issues and make wise decisions.

sentences.zh: 她對孩子們的一舉一動了如指掌，因此能夠及時提供所需的幫助和支持。
sentences.en: She knows every movement and action of her children like her own palm, allowing her to provide timely help and support when needed.

phrase.en: One torch shines with glorious bright light.

sentences.zh: 在暗夜中，他手中的一炬照耀光明燦爛，帶來了希望。
sentences.en: In the dark night, the torch in his hand shines with glorious bright light, bringing hope.

sentences.zh: 佛教教徒相信，一炬照耀光明燦爛能夠引導迷茫的人走向智慧之路。
sentences.en: Buddhists believe that a torch shining with glorious bright light can guide the lost toward the path of wisdom.

sentences.zh: 古老的寺廟中，一炬照耀光明燦爛，映照出莊嚴的佛像。
sentences.en: In the ancient temple, one torch shines with glorious bright light, illuminating the solemn Buddha statues.

sentences.zh: 在他的心中，一炬照耀光明燦爛，驅散了一切的恐懼與疑惑。
sentences.en: In his heart, one torch shines with glorious bright light, dispelling all fears and doubts.

sentences.zh: 面對一蹶不振的情況，我們需要省思過往的決策和行為，以尋求改善之道。
sentences.en: In the face of a setback, we need to reflect on past decisions and actions to seek ways for improvement.

sentences.zh: 一蹶不振需要省思，他決心從失敗中學習並變得更強大。
sentences.en: One setback: self-reflection is essential. He is determined to learn from failure and become stronger.

sentences.zh: 每當遇到一蹶不振的時刻，省思自己的行為能讓我們重新定位，繼續前行。
sentences.en: When facing setbacks, self-reflecting on our actions helps us realign and continue moving forward.

sentences.zh: 成功的關鍵在於在一蹶不振的困境中保持冷靜，並以省思的態度去面對挑戰。
sentences.en: The key to success is to remain calm amid setbacks and embrace challenges with a reflective attitude.

phrase.en: One opening and closing: a manner of entering

sentences.zh: 進入寺廟時，我們應該一開一關進出禮貌，以表尊敬。
sentences.en: When entering the temple, we should practice one opening and closing: a manner of entering to show respect.

sentences.zh: 在禮堂中，保持一開一關進出禮貌是對他人的基本尊重。
sentences.en: In the hall, maintaining one opening and closing: a manner of entering is a basic respect for others.

sentences.zh: 她總是保持一開一關進出禮貌，不僅是因為規則，也是出於內心的謙虛。
sentences.en: She always maintains one opening and closing: a manner of entering, not just because of the rules, but also out of inner humility.

sentences.zh: 和尚們教導我們，在通過任何門時都應該記得一開一關進出禮貌。
sentences.en: The monks taught us that whenever passing through any door, we should remember one opening and closing: a manner of entering.

phrase.en: One shiny pearl: long sealed by mundane trouble

sentences.zh: 在修行過程中，他終於打開心靈的封鎖，發現了自己內心深處一顆明珠塵勞封鎖。
sentences.en: During his spiritual practice, he finally unlocked the seal of his mind and discovered within himself one shiny pearl long sealed by mundane trouble.

sentences.zh: 那些年來，他忙於世俗瑣事，讓一顆明珠塵勞封鎖，卻在冥想中再度喜獲精華。
sentences.en: Over the years, he was entangled in trivial matters of the world, allowing one shiny pearl to be sealed by mundane trouble, until he rediscovered its essence through meditation.

sentences.zh: 弟子們被告誡要警覺，一顆明珠塵勞封鎖，莫讓凡俗之事遮住本性。
sentences.en: Disciples were warned to be vigilant, for one shiny pearl can be sealed by mundane trouble, and not let worldly matters obscure their true nature.

sentences.zh: 在那寧靜的時刻，她感受到一顆明珠塵勞封鎖的真相，遙望自己潛藏的光芒。
sentences.en: In that moment of tranquility, she sensed the truth of one shiny pearl being long sealed by mundane trouble, glimpsing the hidden radiance within herself.

phrase.en: Each Moment is as Precious as Gold

sentences.zh: 在禪修中心，他們強調一刻千金的重要性，讓學員珍惜每一個當下。
sentences.en: At the meditation center, they emphasize that each moment is as precious as gold, encouraging participants to cherish every present moment.

sentences.zh: 在緊張的工作日中，學習一刻千金的理念可以幫助人們保持專注和效率。
sentences.en: During hectic workdays, learning the principle that each moment is as precious as gold can help people maintain focus and efficiency.

sentences.zh: 導師告訴我們，修行中的一刻千金提醒著我們要活在當下，不再為過去而懊悔。
sentences.en: The instructor told us that recognizing each moment is as precious as gold in our practice reminds us to live in the present and not dwell on past regrets.

sentences.zh: 他對一刻千金的體悟使他能夠在最平常的資源中找到平靜與價值。
sentences.en: His understanding that each moment is as precious as gold enabled him to find peace and value in the most ordinary resources.

sentences.zh: 他經常執著於一孔之見眼光狹愛，無法接受不同的想法和觀點。
sentences.en: He often clings to one open hole: narrowed views, unable to accept different ideas and perspectives.

sentences.zh: 我們應該避免一孔之見眼光狹愛，去接納更多元的文化與思想。
sentences.en: We should avoid one open hole: narrowed views, and embrace a more diverse range of cultures and thoughts.

sentences.zh: 老師告誡學生不要陷入一孔之見眼光狹愛，建議他們多閱讀不同作者的書籍。
sentences.en: The teacher advised the students not to fall into one open hole: narrowed views, suggesting they read books by various authors.

sentences.zh: 在解決問題時，一孔之見眼光狹愛常常限制我們的創造力。
sentences.en: When solving problems, one open hole: narrowed views often limit our creativity.

phrase.en: One mouthful of delicacy: delicious smells

sentences.zh: 每當我聞到媽媽炖的湯的香味，我總是迫不及待地一口品嚐這美味飄香的佳餚。
sentences.en: Whenever I smell the aroma of the soup my mother is cooking, I am always eager to take one mouthful of delicacy: delicious smells.

sentences.zh: 這家餐廳的招牌菜值得一口品嚐美味飄香，每一口都讓我回味無窮。
sentences.en: The signature dish of this restaurant is worth experiencing one mouthful of delicacy: delicious smells, with every bite leaving a lasting impression.

sentences.zh: 在佛教寺廟的齋菜中，一口品嚐美味飄香，是一種純淨而獨特的體驗。
sentences.en: In the vegetarian dishes of Buddhist temples, experiencing one mouthful of delicacy: delicious smells is a pure and unique experience.

sentences.zh: 廚師用心烹調，每樣菜都讓人一口品嚐美味飄香，令人難以抗拒。
sentences.en: The chef puts his heart into cooking, making every dish a temptation where one mouthful of delicacy: delicious smells is irresistible.

phrase.en: One water well: providing for people.

sentences.zh: 這個偏遠村莊只能依賴一口水井供人利用，滿足村民的日常用水需求。
sentences.en: The remote village relies on one water well: providing for people’s daily water needs.

sentences.zh: 在乾旱季節，這口水井供人利用，並成為村莊的生命線。
sentences.en: During the dry season, this water well: providing for people, becomes the lifeline for the village.

sentences.zh: 由於這口水井供人利用，附近的農田才得以灌溉，作物生長繁茂。
sentences.en: Because this water well: providing for people, the nearby fields can be irrigated and crops flourish.

sentences.zh: 慈善組織修復了一口古老的水井，使之能夠再次供人利用。
sentences.en: A charity restored an ancient water well, making it possible once again to be a well: providing for people.

phrase.en: One spit of saliva: never in the wrong place.

sentences.zh: 在公共場合，我們應該遵守一口唾液不能亂吐的規範，以確保環境衛生。
sentences.en: In public places, we should adhere to the principle that 'one spit of saliva: never in the wrong place' to ensure environmental hygiene.

sentences.zh: 學校教育中提倡一口唾液不能亂吐，這樣孩子們才能養成良好的衛生習慣。
sentences.en: In school education, the principle of 'one spit of saliva: never in the wrong place' is promoted so that children can develop good hygiene habits.

sentences.zh: 即使在緊急情況下，他也記得一口唾液不能亂吐，保持了文明的行為。
sentences.en: Even in emergencies, he remembered that 'one spit of saliva: never in the wrong place,' maintaining civil behavior.

sentences.zh: 這一地區的管理規定非常嚴格，尤其是對於一口唾液不能亂吐這一點。
sentences.en: The regulations in this area are very strict, especially concerning 'one spit of saliva: never in the wrong place.'

sentences.zh: 學會一口外語必有能量，這打開了不少文化交流的機會。
sentences.en: Learning one second language offers endless potentials, opening up numerous opportunities for cultural exchange.

sentences.zh: 一口外語必有能量，它讓我在職場中獲得了許多優勢。
sentences.en: One second language: endless potentials, it has given me many advantages in the workplace.

sentences.zh: 一口外語必有能量，不僅可以提升溝通能力，還能擴展思維方式。
sentences.en: One second language brings endless potentials, enhancing communication skills and broadening ways of thinking.

sentences.zh: 掌握一口外語必有能量，可以讓旅行更加豐富有趣。
sentences.en: Mastering one second language provides endless potentials, making travel more enriching and enjoyable.

phrase.en: One tear and one laugh: the experiences of life.

sentences.zh: 在人生的旅途中，我們經歷了一哭一笑，這些經歷讓我們成為更完整的人。
sentences.en: On the journey of life, we go through one tear and one laugh; these experiences make us more complete individuals.

sentences.zh: 面對挫折，她明白一哭一笑的人生經歷會教會她如何成長和超越。
sentences.en: Faced with setbacks, she understands that the experiences of one tear and one laugh will teach her how to grow and transcend.

sentences.zh: 他回首過往，覺得一哭一笑的人生經歷讓他珍惜每一個當下的瞬間。
sentences.en: Looking back, he feels that the experiences of one tear and one laugh have taught him to cherish every moment of the present.

sentences.zh: 每個人都有一哭一笑的人生經歷，而這正是生命的美麗之處。
sentences.en: Everyone has their own share of one tear and one laugh experiences, and that is the beauty of life.

phrase.en: One fertile field: spring cultivation and autumn harvest.

sentences.zh: 佛法就像一塊良田春種秋收，經過修行可得智慧與解脫。
sentences.en: The Dharma is like one fertile field: spring cultivation and autumn harvest, where through practice, one gains wisdom and liberation.

sentences.zh: 農夫在一塊良田春種秋收，以簡單的生活找到知足常樂的智慧。
sentences.en: The farmer, with one fertile field: spring cultivation and autumn harvest, finds the wisdom of contentment and happiness in a simple life.

sentences.zh: 人生如一塊良田春種秋收，需要不斷的努力和堅持，才能得到豐厚的成果。
sentences.en: Life is like one fertile field: spring cultivation and autumn harvest, requiring continuous effort and perseverance to yield abundant results.

sentences.zh: 就像一塊良田春種秋收般，修行需要耐心，最終會得到精神的豐收。
sentences.en: Just like one fertile field: spring cultivation and autumn harvest, spiritual practice requires patience and eventually leads to spiritual abundance.

phrase.en: One piece of silver: a lifesaver

sentences.zh: 在戰亂時期，一塊銀元保住性命，人們靠著這些有限的財物才能勉強度日。
sentences.en: During times of war, one piece of silver was a lifesaver, as people had to rely on such limited resources to barely make ends meet.

sentences.zh: 她常說起那個故事，當年是一塊銀元保住性命，才能逃出困境。
sentences.en: She often tells the story of how one piece of silver saved her, allowing her to escape from dire circumstances.

sentences.zh: 面對生死關頭，他想起父親的話：有時一塊銀元保住性命。
sentences.en: Facing a life-and-death situation, he remembered his father's words: sometimes, one piece of silver could be a lifesaver.

sentences.zh: 在那個年代，一塊銀元保住性命，它的價值無法用金錢衡量。
sentences.en: In those days, one piece of silver could save a life; its value was beyond monetary measure.

phrase.zh: 一簣之功　最後努力

sentences.zh: 經過多年的艱苦奮鬥，他們終於來到了一簣之功的階段，只需最後努力即可達成目標。
sentences.en: After years of hard work, they finally reached the homestretch, needing only the final effort to achieve their goal.

sentences.zh: 這場比賽已接近尾聲，選手們需要一簣之功，最後努力才能奪得勝利。
sentences.en: As the race nears its end, the athletes need to make the final effort in the homestretch to secure the victory.

sentences.zh: 在一項浩大的工程中，有時一簣之功，最後努力就能決定成敗。
sentences.en: In a massive project, sometimes it is the homestretch, the final effort, that determines success or failure.

sentences.zh: 她在準備考試時一簣之功，最後努力，不僅改善了成績，還增加了自信心。
sentences.en: During her exam preparation, she put in the homestretch, the final effort, which not only improved her scores but also boosted her confidence.

phrase.en: One glance that takes in all: to see everything.

sentences.zh: 站在山頂，他們將整個城市的美景一覽無遺盡收眼底。
sentences.en: Standing atop the mountain, they enjoyed a breathtaking view of the entire city, one glance that takes in all.

sentences.zh: 畫家的作品在展覽中一覽無遺盡收眼底，每一個細節都清晰可見。
sentences.en: The artist's work was displayed at the exhibition for everyone to see, with every detail clear and one glance that takes in all.

sentences.zh: 從飛機窗口俯瞰，整個地區的一覽無遺盡收眼底，猶如一幅巨大的圖畫。
sentences.en: From the airplane window, the entire region was visible like a massive painting, one glance that takes in all.

sentences.zh: 登高望遠，整個自然風光一覽無遺盡收眼底，令人心曠神怡。
sentences.en: From a high vantage point, the entire natural landscape unfolded before them, one glance that takes in all, offering a sense of peace and contentment.

sentences.zh: 在這次會議中，一來一往交流溝通增進了我們對彼此需求的理解。
sentences.en: In this meeting, the interaction of exchange and communication enhanced our understanding of each other's needs.

sentences.zh: 通過一來一往的交流溝通，我們成功地解決了誤會，促進了團隊合作。
sentences.en: Through the interaction of exchange and communication, we successfully resolved misunderstandings and promoted team collaboration.

sentences.zh: 老師與學生之間的一來一往交流溝通，使得課程內容更加生動且富有成效。
sentences.en: The interaction through exchange and communication between the teacher and students made the course content more engaging and effective.

sentences.zh: 一來一往交流溝通是彼此之間建立信任的關鍵。
sentences.en: One interaction through exchange and communication is key to building trust with each other.

phrase.en: One elderly and one young: respect for seniority

sentences.zh: 在傳統的華人家庭中，一老一少長幼有序是非常重要的價值觀。
sentences.en: In traditional Chinese families, the concept of 'one elderly and one young: respect for seniority' is a highly valued principle.

sentences.zh: 節慶時，家族聚會常常強調一老一少長幼有序，每個人都有自己的位置。
sentences.en: During festive family gatherings, there is often an emphasis on 'one elderly and one young: respect for seniority,' with everyone having their designated place.

sentences.zh: 佛教提倡一老一少長幼有序的生活方式，培養社會和諧。
sentences.en: Buddhism advocates a lifestyle of 'one elderly and one young: respect for seniority' to foster social harmony.

sentences.zh: 他在公司裡總是遵循一老一少長幼有序，尊重每一位前輩的意見。
sentences.en: In the company, he always follows the principle of 'one elderly and one young: respect for seniority,' valuing the opinions of every senior colleague.

phrase.en: One thunder awakens the confused minds of the entire land.

sentences.zh: 一雷覺醒大地群迷，這聲音如同智慧的閃光，喚醒了沉睡已久的靈魂。
sentences.en: One thunder awakens the confused minds of the entire land, like a flash of wisdom, awakening long-slumbering souls.

sentences.zh: 和尚的教誨如一雷覺醒大地群迷，讓信眾從無明中逐漸覺悟。
sentences.en: The monk's teachings were like one thunder awakening the confused minds of the entire land, gradually bringing followers out of ignorance.

sentences.zh: 這部經書的智慧宛如一雷覺醒大地群迷，在閱讀後，我感覺靈魂得到前所未有的清晰。
sentences.en: The wisdom in this scripture is like one thunder awakening the confused minds of the entire land; after reading it, I feel an unprecedented clarity in my soul.

sentences.zh: 當那佛陀的話語響起，猶如一雷覺醒大地群迷，眾人終於理解了輪迴的真諦。
sentences.en: When the Buddha's words echoed, it was as if one thunder awakened the confused minds of the entire land, and the people finally understood the true meaning of samsara.

phrase.en: One grain of rice: as big as Mt. Sumeru.

sentences.zh: 這句話『一粒米中大如須彌』意在強調微小事物中蘊藏的巨大潛力。
sentences.en: The phrase 'one grain of rice: as big as Mt. Sumeru' emphasizes the immense potential hidden within small things.

sentences.zh: 即便是一粒米，其裡面所蘊藏的宇宙道理可大如須彌。
sentences.en: Even a single grain of rice can contain universal truths as vast as Mt. Sumeru.

sentences.zh: 真正的修行者可以從一粒米中領悟到大如須彌的智慧。
sentences.en: A true practitioner can realize wisdom as vast as Mt. Sumeru from just one grain of rice.

sentences.zh: 禪師用『一粒米中大如須彌』來說明看似微不足道的事物也能引發深刻的省思。
sentences.en: The Zen master used 'one grain of rice: as big as Mt. Sumeru' to illustrate that seemingly insignificant things can provoke profound reflection.

phrase.en: One mouse dropping: an entire pot of food ruined

sentences.zh: 在這個大屋子裡，一粒鼠屎壞一鍋粥，所有人的努力因為一個人的疏忽而受到影響。
sentences.en: In this large household, one mouse dropping can ruin an entire pot of porridge, as everyone's efforts are affected by one person's negligence.

sentences.zh: 這個專案的一些小錯誤就像是一粒鼠屎壞一鍋粥，最終可能會影響到整個計畫的推進。
sentences.en: Small mistakes in this project are like one mouse dropping ruining a pot of porridge, potentially affecting the progress of the entire plan.

sentences.zh: 在團隊合作中，有時候一粒鼠屎壞一鍋粥，因此每個成員都必須謹慎小心。
sentences.en: In team collaboration, sometimes one mouse dropping can ruin an entire pot of porridge, so every member must act with caution.

sentences.zh: 千萬要注意細節，因為一粒鼠屎壞一鍋粥，最微小的錯誤也可能帶來重大影響。
sentences.en: Be very mindful of the details, as one mouse dropping can ruin an entire pot of porridge, and even the smallest mistake can have a significant impact.

phrase.en: One principle thoroughly understood: so is everything else.

sentences.zh: 修禪之道在於一理通達萬事明白，掌握了根本原則，便能舉一反三。
sentences.en: The practice of Zen emphasizes that if one principle is thoroughly understood, so is everything else, allowing one to infer and comprehend further.

sentences.zh: 他在學習中遵循一理通達萬事明白的原則，以求從基礎中獲得全面的理解。
sentences.en: He adhered to the principle that one principle thoroughly understood makes everything else clear in his studies to gain a comprehensive understanding from the basics.

sentences.zh: 生活的智慧在於一理通達萬事明白，明白了生命的真諦，其他事情自然通達。
sentences.en: The wisdom of life lies in the understanding that one principle thoroughly understood clarifies everything else; once you grasp the essence of life, everything else becomes clear.

sentences.zh: 老師常強調一理通達萬事明白，鼓勵學生掌握核心概念以應對各類問題。
sentences.en: The teacher often emphasizes that one principle thoroughly understood means everything else is clear, encouraging students to master core concepts to tackle various problems.

sentences.zh: 佛教教導我們觀察自然界的現象時，常以一粒種子成長無限的概念來示現生命的無限可能。
sentences.en: Buddhism teaches us to observe the phenomena of nature, often illustrating life's limitless potential with the concept of one single seed: endless vitality.

sentences.zh: 這棵參天大樹曾經只是一粒不起眼的種子，正如佛經所說：一粒種子成長無限。
sentences.en: This towering tree was once just an inconspicuous seed, as the sutra says: one single seed, endless vitality.

sentences.zh: 農夫明白一粒種子成長無限的道理，於是他精心照料每一顆種子，期待著豐碩的收成。
sentences.en: The farmer understands the principle of one single seed: endless vitality, hence he meticulously tends to each seed, anticipating a bountiful harvest.

sentences.zh: 老師用一粒種子成長無限的故事激勵學生，鼓勵他們相信自己的潛力。
sentences.en: The teacher uses the story of one single seed: endless vitality to inspire the students, encouraging them to believe in their potential.

sentences.zh: 當老師解釋完這個複雜的數學題時，他一臉茫然不知所以地看著黑板。
sentences.en: When the teacher finished explaining the complex math problem, he had one confused face: totally clueless, staring at the board.

sentences.zh: 她突然轉到一個新的城市，對這裡的環境一臉茫然不知所以。
